text.body: <1-10> atha kāṭhake carakaśākhāyāṃ laugākṣigṛhyasūtrāṇi | devapālakṛtabhāṣyopetāni | prathamā kaṇḍikā | namo narahariṃ ghoradaṃṣṭrānakharadāruṇam | sanmārgotsādidurdāntadaityanirmūlanodyatam || 1 || avāvarīṃ dhītimirasya pīvarīṃ saṃsārasindhoḥ paramārthadṛśvarīm | sudhīvarīṃ satpuruṣārtha saṃpadāṃ namāmi bhaktyā parayā sarasvatīm || 2 || pituḥ śrīharipālasya nutvā pādau nibandhanam| samantrakāṭhagṛhyasya devapālo'bhidhāsyate || 3 || ekonacatvāriṃśatādhyāyairvaitānikāni karmāṇi pratipāditāni | sāṃprataṃ gṛhyāgnisādhyāni kathyante | yadyapi gṛhyānuṣṭhānapūrvāṇi vaitānikāni, tathāpi pratyakṣavidhimūlatvāt sūtrakṛtā pūrvaṃ pratipāditāni | tato vidhyuddeśavākyatvena nikaṭataratvādarthavādānāṃ tadgamyaṃ vratādyaṃ vidhāya, mantravarṇagamyān saṃskārān vakṣyati | tatra traivarṇikānāṃ kṛtavivāhānāṃ gṛhyakarmaṇyadhikāraḥ | vivāho'pyadhītavedasya 'vedamadhītya snātvā bhāryāmadhigacchet |' ityādismṛteḥ | adhyayanamapyupanītasya brahmacāriṇaḥ | tatropanayanaṃ vakṣyati | saṃskāravratāni tāvadāha upanayanaprabhṛti vratacārī syāt || 1 || vrataśabdo yamaniyamavācakaḥ | tatra prasaktipratiṣedhātmakā yamāḥ amāṃsabhakṣaṇādayaḥ | niyamāstu aprāptyaṅgaparipūrakā bhaikṣavṛttyādiviṣayāḥ | 'ahiṃsāsatyāsteyabrahmacaryāparigrahāḥ " yamāḥ | 'śaucasantoṣatapaḥsvādhyāyeśvarapraṇidhānāni' niyamāḥ | iti tu yamā niyamāśca tairuktāste'pi yathāsaṃbhavamiha nirdhāryante | upanayanādārabhya ā vedādhyayanaparisamāptervratacaraṇaśīlo bhavet ||1|| mārgavāsāḥ || 2 || syādityanuṣaṅgaḥ | uttaratrāpi yojyamevaitat | mṛgasyedaṃ mārga sāmānyaśabdenāpyeṇasyeti viśeṣo vakṣyamāṇatvāt | vaste ācchādayatīti vāsaḥ paridhānam | tacca mṛgacarma, mārga vāso yasyeti mārgavāsāḥ syāt || 2 || saṃhatakeśaḥ || 3 || hantihim̐sākarmā | samyak kṣureṇa natu kartaryādinā apasāritāḥ keśā yasya muṇḍitaśirā ityarthaḥ, tena muṇḍanena vakṣyamāṇena paunaruktyamityāhuḥ | athavā saṃhatā ekarūpāḥ keśā yasya saḥ | etaduktaṃ bhavati 'muṇḍo jaṭilo śikhī vā' iti vakṣyati, tatraikasya traivarṇikasya brahmacāriṇaḥ kālabhedena vikalpanivṛttyarthaṃ niyamābhidhānametat ekarūpā evaikaikena keśāḥ kartavyāḥ, jaṭī cenna muṇḍī śikhī veti | evaṃ muṇḍādiṣu || 3 || bhaikṣācāryavṛttiḥ || 4 || bhikṣāṇāṃ samūho bhaikṣam| ācāryastu 'upanīya tu yaḥ śiṣyam' ityādilakṣaṇaḥ | bhaikṣeṇaiva brahmacāriṇā śarīraṃ saṃdhāraṇīyamiti niyamaḥ | ācāryādhīnā cāsya vṛttiḥ sthitirūpā śarīrapoṣaṇarūpā ca syāt | ācāryo hi prerya kāṃścidbhikṣāṃdāpayatītyācāryeṇāpi tasya śarīrapoṣaṇalakṣaṇā vṛttiranyaceṣṭāvadupapadyate, anyato vā kadācidvaikṣasyālābhe ācārya eva bhojanādikaṃ dadātīti || 4 || saśalkadaṇḍaḥ || 5|| iha sāmānyābhidhāne'pi daṇḍaḥ pālāśādiḥ yathāyathaṃ vakṣyamāṇaḥ | saha śalkena tvacā vartamāno daṇḍo yasya sa saśalkadaṇḍaḥ syādityanuṣaṅga eva || 5 || saptamuñjāṃ mekhalāṃ dhārayet || 6 || saptabhirmuavyaktibhinivṛttyāvṛttī bhavati tāṃ mekhalāṃ dhārayet | atra mehanasaṃbandhinaḥ khasya mālā mekhaleti nirvacanaṃ kurvanti | mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsādhu kila | miha secane, mite sicyate vīryādikamaneneti mehanamānandendriyaṃ tasyopari nābheradhobhāge yatkhaṃ tasya mālā || 6|| na madhumāṃse aśnīyāt || 7 || mākṣikaṃ māṃsaṃ na bhakṣayediti tṛptyarthatayā prasaktasya pratiṣedhaḥ | madhu madyamapi tat kṣatriyavaiśyayorniṣidhyate ityupākhyānamekīyam | tanna, prasaktyabhāvāt 'tasmādrāhmaṇarājanyau vaiśyaśca na surāṃ pivet |' iti trayāṇāmapi na niṣedhaḥ syāt || 7 || kṣāralavaṇavarjī || 8 || kṣāraṃ ca talavaṇamauṣaraṃ sāmudrikādi tadvarjī tadvarjanaśīlaḥ | saindhavasauvarcalādikaṃ bhakṣayedeva | kṣāradravyaṃ sarvaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ varjayediti kecit || 8 || ācaryasyāpratikūlaḥ || 9|| anukūla ityarthaḥ || 9 || sarvakāryāsvatantraḥ ||10|| āstāmadhyayanādikam, kriyāmātramapyācāryānujñayā vinā na kuryādityarthaḥ || 10 || pūrvotthāyī jaghanyasaṃveśī || 11,12 || śayanādikamāśrite gurau utthātukāme prathamamevottiṣṭhet, śayanāvasthite cācārye tatpādasaṃvāhanādikaṃ ca kṛtvā paścāt śayanādikaṃ saṃviśet | jaghanyasaṃveśītyasyāyamarthaḥ - yadācāryaḥ khaṭṭāyāṃ tiṣṭhati tadā brahmacāriṇā khaṭṭāyāḥ sakāśādyajjaghanyamāsanaṃ paṭṭatalaśayyādikaṃ tatra saṃveśanīyam | evaṃ śayyāmāsīne gurau tato nimna ityādyanumantavyam || 11,12 || yadenamupeyāttadasmai dadyāt || 13 || yat suvarṇādikaṃ kilainamupeyādāgacchet tat brahmacārī asmai ācāryāya dadyāt || 13 || bahūnāṃ yena saṃyuktaḥ || 14|| yadyapi brahmacārī sakalavedavedāṅgopāṅgajñānārthaṃ yathāyogyaṃ krameṇa bahūnācāryānupāste, tathāpi yat yasya saṃnidhau nivasam̐llabheta tattasmai dadyāt natu sarvadā sarvaṃ sarvebhyo vibhajyetyarthaḥ || 14 || nāsya śayyāmāviśet || 15 || yasyāṃ śayyāyāmācāryaḥ sthitastāmapāṭavādidaśāyāṃ kāruṇyāt snehātiśayādvāpāṭave vācāryānujñāto'pi nādhitiṣṭhedityarthaḥ | tena jaghanyasaṃveśītyanena paunaruktyābhāvaḥ || 15 || na rathamāruhet || 16 || asyetyanuṣaṅgaḥ | ayamapyanujñātasya pratiṣedhaḥ | anye tu śayyāgrahaṇamācāryādhiṣṭhitāsanayānādyupalakṣaṇārthaṃ rathavākyaṃ varṇayanti, rathagrahaṇaṃ tu karituragādyupalakṣaṇārthaṃ varṇayanti, 'na saṃvatrayeta' ityatra ca sthitena dvitīyena nañā tatreṇāvṛttyā vā saṃbandhayanti rathaṃ na samārohena kiṃ tarhi grāmādikaṃ gacchannasamartho vāhanāntaraṃ ca na labhate tadācāryānujñātastenādhiṣṭhitamapi karituragaṃ samārohedevetyarthaḥ ||16|| na saṃvastrayeta || 17 || samānaṃ vastraṃ na kuryāt, ācārya parihitaṃ vastraṃ na paridadhīta | nāpyācārya vastreṇa saha samāne karaṇḍādibhāṇḍe svavastraṃ saṃśritaṃ kuryāt || 17 || sarvāṇi sāṃsparśikāni strībhiḥ saha varjayet || 18 || saṃsparśanimittāni yāni pāṇigrahaṇābhyaanādīni karmāṇi tāni sarvāṇyeva sarvābhiḥ strībhiḥ saha varjayet | 'gurāviva tatputradāreṣu vartanīyam' ityasyāḥ smṛterapyayamapavādaḥ pādasaṃvāhanādiviṣayaḥ || 18 || na muṣitāṃ prekṣet || 19|| muṣitāmiva nagnāṃ na paśyedityarthaḥ || 19 || na vihārārthaṃ jalpet || 20 || vihāraḥ krīḍā tadarthaṃ parihāsādikaṃ na vadet | athavā 'sarvakāryāsvatantraḥ' ityanena sarvakriyākhācāryānujñāgrahaṇapūrvikāyāṃ pravṛttau sthitāyāṃ vihāraṃ mūtramalotsargamāha vihārārthaṃ na jalpedanujñāgrahaṇāya || 20 || na rucyarthaṃ kiṃcana dhārayet || 21 || rucidaptiḥ ratiḥ prītiśca | tadarthaṃ dravyaviśeṣādikaṃ na saṃgṛhṇīyāt alaṅkaraṇaṃ krīḍādikam || 21 || na snāyāt || 22 || rucyarthamityanuvartate || 22 || udakaṃ vābhyupeyāt || 23 || ayamarthaḥ - rucyarthaṃ snānaṃ niṣiddhaṃ nityaṃ tu kartavyameva 'nityaṃ snātvā śuciḥ kuryāddevarṣipitṛtarpaṇam |' ityādinā brahmacāriṇo'pi vidhānāt | tatra ca vikalpaḥ snānaṃ kadācinmatrasaṃskṛtenodakena prokṣaṇaṃ kadācinmajjanam | tatrādyamanenoktam 'udakaṃ vābhyupeyāt' iti || 23 || majjanamadhikṛtyāha yadi snāyāddaṇḍa ivāpsu pariplaveta || 24 || yadiśabdaḥ pratibaddho vidhāyako'nuvādaṃ prārthayate 'yadi śāliṃ bhuñjīta tadā dadhyupasi cet' 'yadi rathantarasāmā somaḥ syāt aindravāyavāgrān grahān gṛhṇīyāt ityādivat | tenāyamarthaḥ yadā majjanarūpaḥ snānapakṣastadā brahmacāriṇā daṇḍenevāpsu pariplavamātraṃ kartavyam | natu kāntyādisiddhaye malāpasāraṇādinā yatanīyam || 24 || muṇḍo jaṭilaḥ śikhī vā || 25 || muṇḍaḥ śikhārahitaḥ || 25 || sāyaṃ prātaḥ sandhyāmupāsīta || 26 || sakalādityopalakṣitaḥ kālo divasaḥ | ādityaśūnyakālo rātriḥ | ardhoditenārdhāstaṃgatena cādityenopalakṣitaḥ kālaḥ sandhiḥ | sandhau bhavā sandhyā | tāmubhayamapi pratyahamupāsīta | upāsanaṃ sevā || 26 || kathamupāsītetyāha tiṣṭhetpūrvām || 27 || pūrvāhnabhāgagatāṃ tiṣṭhet nivṛttagatiḥ pūrvāṃ prāṅmukho japannavatiṣṭheta sanakṣatrakālādārabhya ā sūryajyotirdarśanāt || 27 || āsītottarām || 28 || aparāhnasaṃnihitāmupaviṣṭaḥ pratyaṅmukhaḥ sabhāskarakālādārabhya japannāsīta ā tārakajyotirdarśanāt āsītottarāṃ saṃdhyākālasyātisūkṣmatvādevaṃ tadupāsanamiṣṭam || 28 || oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svarityuktvā tatsavituriti sāvitrīṃ triranvāha || 29|| diṅmātradarśanametat | brāhme muhūrte'bhyutthāyānuṣṭhitaśarīradharmaḥ, 'atyantamalinaḥ kāyo navacchidrasamanvitaḥ | sravatyeṣa divā rātrau prātaḥ snānaṃ viśodhanam ||' iti smaraṇāt mukhyaṃ gauṇaṃ vā snānaṃ vidhāya 'trirācamya dvirunmṛjya khānyupaspṛśya prāṇāyāmaistribhiḥ pūtastata oṃkāramarhati' iti smaraṇāt trīnprāṇāyāmān pañcadaśamātrāparimāṇānsmārtoktānkṛtvā pratipraṇavayuktavyāhṛtisaptakānvitasaśiraskasāvitryā trirabhyāsena paricchinnāṃstrīnprāṇāyāmānkṛtvā aghamarṣaṇādisūryopasthānāntaṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvariti mahāvyāhṛtitrayayuktāṃ tatsavituriti sāvitrīmabhyastāṃ japet | sāvitrīmanvāhetyanuśabdo'bhyāsārthaḥ | tatsavituriti pratīkaḥ savitṛdevatākatve'pi 'ākṛṣṇena rajasā' ityādīnāṃ sāvitrāntarāṇāṃ nivṛttyarthaḥ || 29 || prāgastamayānniṣkramya samidha āhareddhariṇīrbrahmavarcasakāma iti śruteḥ || 30 || anastaṃgate bhānau grāma niṣkramyāṣṭau samidho agnisamindhanārthaṃ haritavarṇā ārdrā āharedyo vedādhyayanatadarthānuṣṭhānādisamṛddhilakṣaṇaṃ kāmayate | etaddhi śrutyāveditaṃ śrutimūlatvātsmṛteḥ || 30 || sāyaṃprātaḥ saṃdhyāniḥsaraṇaṃ bhaikṣācaraṇamagnīndhanam || 31 || sāyaṃprātaḥ saṃdhyopāsanārthaṃ grāmādbahirniḥsaraṇaṃ kartavyam | sāyaṃprātaśca bhaikṣācaraṇaṃ kartavyam | ubhayakālaṃ hi bhojanamāmnātam 'sāyaṃprātarmanuṣyāṇāmaśanaṃ devanirmitam |' iti | evamagnisamindhanaṃ kāladvaye'pi kartavyam | catasraḥ prātaḥ catasraḥ sāyaṃ samidho hotavyāḥ | evamanyakālaviśeṣavidhānārthānyetāni trīṇi vākyāni | pūrvaśca madhyāhnāt prātaḥkālaḥ uttaraśca sāyaṃkālaḥ || 31 || sāyamevāgnimindhītetyeke || 32 || ' sāyamevāgnisamindhanam' ityekeṣāṃ vedavidāṃ matam | atra ca pakṣe catasraḥ samidha āhartavyāḥ || 32 || bhaikṣasyācaraṇe doṣaḥ pāvakasyāsamindhane | saptarātramakṛtvaitadavakīrṇivrataṃ caret || 33 || upalakṣaṇametat | bhaikṣasyācaraṇe agne śvāsamindhane saṃdhyālopādike ca doṣaḥ pratyavāyo bhavati vihitātikramaṇāt | yathoktam 'nopatiṣṭhati yaḥ pūrvā nopāste yaśva paścimām | sa śūdravadbahiḥ kāryaḥ sarvasmādvijakarmaṇaḥ ||' iti | atha saṃdhyopāsanabhraṃśe bhaikṣārthamacaraṇe anaṭane agneścāsamindhane sati yatpāpaṃ bhavati tasya vināśāya avakīrṇitrataṃ prāyaścittamācaret | avakaraṇamavakīrṇo'vidhānotsargaḥ kāmato brahmacāriṇo retasa utsargaḥ | avakīrṇaṃ vidyate yasya so'vakīrṇī | tasya vratamāmnātam | 'saptāgāraṃ caredbhaikṣaṃ svakarma parikīrtayan | tebhyo labdhena bhaikṣeṇa vartayedekakālikam || upaspṛśaṃstriṣavaṇamabdena sa viśuddhyati |' iti | etatsandhyopāsanādikamakṛtvā avakīrṇivratamācaret | kiṃ paripūrṇamādikameva ? netyāha saptarātramiti | anye tu vyācakṣate saṃdhyopāsanādikaṃ saptarātramakṛtvā avakīrṇivrataṃ caret paripūrṇameveti | saptarātrānyūnādhike vā avakaraṇaṃ nyūnamadhikaṃ ceti | yājñavalkya āha 'bhaikṣānikārye tyaktvā tu saptarātramanāturaḥ | kāmākīrṇa ityābhyāṃ hutvā cājyāhutidvayam || nairṛtaṃ gardabhaṃ vaitatsaṃvatsaravataṃ caret |' iti | atrāpi pūrvavadyojanā || 33 || iti prathamā kaṇḍikā || 1|| atha dvitīyā kaṇḍikā | adhunā sandhyopāsanopayogina oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svarityādīnmantrān vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | tatra sarvamantreṣu devatā ṛṣiśchanda ityetatrayaṃ śrutirābodhayati ajñānanindāmukhena jñānasaṃstavāt 'yo ha vānadhigatarṣicchandodevato brāhmaṇena matreṇa vā yājayati vādhyāpayati sa sthāṇuṃ vaccheti |' iti | tatra sargādāva bhraṣṭasaṃskārāḥ puṇyakarmāṇo viditasakalaveditavyāḥ suptaprabuddhātmāna ṛṣayo yājñavalkyādyāḥ | hiraṇyagarbhādiparamparayā ca nityā vedāḥ | tathā ca śrūyate ' tata eva parameṣṭhī prājāpatyo yajñamapaśyaddārśapaurṇamāsau |' ityādi | mantrābhidheyā devatāḥ | gāyatrṣṇaganuṣṭubho bṛhatīpaṃktitriṣṭubhaḥ | jagatī jayadevasya cchandasāṃ sapta jātayaḥ || mantrārthaṃ ca samyagbubhutsamāṇena upasargāṇāṃ 'chandasi pare'pi vyavahitāḥ' ityādilakṣaṇamanusartavyam | 'varṇāgama' ityādi niruktam | vyatyayaśca saptajātīnām | evamādi pratimantraṃ nāmnābhidhīyamānaṃ granthagauravamātanotītyarthapradarśanameva kariṣyate | oṃ bhūḥ oṃ bhuvaḥ oṃ khaḥ oṃ mahaḥ oṃ janaḥ oṃ tapaḥ oṃ satyam, iti sapta mahāvyāhṛtayaḥ sapraṇavāḥ saptalokanāmāni | tatrādyāstisro mahāvyāhṛtayaḥ mahato'rthasyābhidhānāt | mahaḥprabhṛtayastu na mahattvena viśeṣyante svargeka deśābhidhānāt | 'bhuvanānāṃ samastānāmadhastānniviḍaṃ tamaḥ | lakṣapañcāśītyadhikakoṭiyojanasaṃmitam || avīcirnāma narakastasya copari vartate | avīcinarakādūrdhvaṃ merupṛṣṭhaparāvadhiḥ || bhūlako bhāṣitaḥ sarvaiḥ purāṇeṣu maharṣibhiḥ |' saiṣā saptadvīpā medinī | tāni punaruktāni paurāṇikaiḥ 'jambuḥ śākaḥ kuṃśaḥ krauñcaḥ śālmaliśca tathāparaḥ | gomedaḥ puṣkaraceti saptadvīpagaṇo mataḥ ||' iti | eṣāṃ vibhāgaḥ pātañjale yogaśāstre darśito'smābhirvibhūtipāde 'avanajñānaṃ sūrye saṃyamāt ' ityatra sūtre | tārānakṣatravicitrastvantarikṣaloko bhuvoloko meruśikharādārabhya dhruvāvadhiḥ | tataḥ parastātsvargalokaḥ | sa ca pañcavidha iti sapta lokā bhavanti | pañcavidhatvaṃ ca svargasya - māhendra ekaḥ mahendrakhāmikatvāt | evaṃ prājāpatyo dvitīyaḥ asya maha iti nāma | brahmalokastrividhaḥ janastapaḥ satyamiti | pañcānāmapyeṣāṃ svargaśabdaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ | ato vyāhṛtimatrāṇāmabhidheyāni bhuvanāni devatāḥ | tāsāṃ prāṇāyāme viniyoga staittirīye dṛśyate | smṛtāvapi iti | , 'praṇave nityayuktasya vyāhṛtīṣu ca saptasu | tripadāyāṃ ca sāvitryāṃ na bhayaṃ vidyate kacit ||' 'pṛthivyādilokadevatā vīryabhūtāḥ | iti brāhmaṇāt | ṛṣayastāsāṃ nidarśitāḥ śaunakena tāvat 'vyāhṛtīnāṃ tu sarvāsāmṛṣirādyaḥ prajāpatiḥ | vyastānāṃ ca samastānāṃ brāhmamakṣaramomiti ||' iti | anyenāpi iti | 'viśvāmitro jamadagnirbharadvājo'tha gautamaḥ | ṛṣiratrirvasiṣṭhaśca kaśyapaśca yathākramam ||' agnivāyū raviścaiva vākpatirvaruṇastathā | indro viśve vyāhṛtīnāṃ daivatāni yathākramam || agniḥ somastathā sūryo vākpatirvaruṇastathā | kvacidindrastathādityo vyāhṛtīnāṃ yathākramam || anyo babhāṇa 'satyasaṃkalpena prajāpatinā lokanivāsināṃ bhogāya sapta lokān sisṛkṣuṇā evaṃ vyāhṛtaṃ sapta lokā bhavi ṣyanti |' iti | tena prajāpatirevāsāṃ ṛṣiḥ vyāhṛtitvaṃ ca | tathāca purāṇam 'caturdaśavidhaṃ sargaṃ sṛṣṭvedaṃ vyāhṛtaṃ svayam | sapta lokā bhaviṣyanti tasmādvyāhṛtayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||' yujyante caikatrāneke draṣṭāraḥ kālabhedena yugapañca || oṃ tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt om || gāyatraṃ chandaḥ, prajāpatiṛṣiḥ, savitā devatā, japopanayanahomādiṣu viniyogaḥ | tathāca dvaipāyanaḥ 'viśvāmitra ṛṣiśchando gāyatraṃ savitā tathā | devatopanaye japye viniyogo hute tathā ||' iti | sarvamitro viśvāmitraḥ prajāpatireva vivakṣitaḥ | abhidheyatvāccātra saviturdevatārūpatvam | japamatrāṇāmapi pratīyamānatvāddurapahavo'rthaḥ yadyapi japamantraḥ pratītastathāpi japitā upamantreṇa tadarthaṃ dhyāyati | yuktiyuktametat jalpatijapatyorvyaktāyāṃ vāci vṛtteḥ | etadeva vyaktatvaṃ yadarthapratipādanayogyatvaṃ, viparyaye tu avyaktatvaṃ kukuṭādivācām | naca pratīyamāno'pyavivakṣita ityabhidheyo na bhavatīti bhaṇituṃ prabhavati kaścit | nahi cakṣurādinā pratīyamāno jalādirajalādyarthino nendriyaviṣayaḥ | nacāvivakṣāyāḥ savituḥ kāraṇamasti dhyānena tadarthajapoparahītenārādhitasya parāparapuruṣārthasiddhihetutvāt 'ya evaṃ vidvān japati' iti japamantreṣvapi vidvattāyā apekṣaṇāt | kiṃca sarvopaniṣatsu patvaṃ brahmaṇo'bhidhīyate, sarvabhāvātmakatvaṃ ca gāyatrīpraṇavayoḥ | tathāca cchāndogyopaniṣadi paṭhyate 'gāyatrī vā idaṃ sarvaṃ yadidaṃ kiṃca, vāgvai gāyatrī, vāgvā idaṃ sarva bhūtaṃ, gāyati ca trāyate ca yā sā gāyatrīyaṃ vāva sā yeyaṃ pṛthivī, asyāṃ hīdaṃ sarva pratiṣṭhitam |' ityādi | sāmānyavācyapi gāyatrīśabdaḥ prakṛtāyāmiha sāvitryāṃ vartate | ata eva gāyantaṃ trāyate iti gāyatrīti tatra tatra nirvacanam | trāṇaṃ ca pālanamupadravanivāraṇamupakārādhānaṃ ca | etāṃ ca sandhyādau japato'nādyavidyāvāsanopalavopaplutajīvendriyādyupadravavidrave sati akhilaprapañcavihīna caitanyasukhakhabhāvamayaparabrahmalakṣaṇamokṣaprāptirbhavati | kāmināṃ ca svargādiprāptirupāttaduritavidravaṇaṃ ca | ādāvante ca vedavācāṃ prapañcasyāpi oṃkārātmake brahmayavasthiti darśayitumādāvante ca oṃkāroccāraṇamiṣyate 'brahmaṇaḥ praṇavaṃ kuryādādāvante ca sarvadā | sravatyanoṃkṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ purastācca viśīryate ||' iti | tathāca smṛtāvapi 'oṃ tatsaditi nirdeśo brahmaṇastrividhaḥ smṛtaḥ |' ityuktam | yogaśāstre ca 'tasya vācakaḥ praṇavaḥ | ' 'tajapastadarthabhāvanam |' īśvarapraṇidhānādvā | ityanantaroktasya | īśvarasya ca prajāpatirviṣṇurityādi paryāya mātram | brahmātmikaiva gāyatrī sarvabhāvātmanāpadeśena vyavasthiteti | vājasaneyabrāhmaṇe'pi śrūyate 'bhūmirantarikṣaṃ dyaurityaṣṭākṣarāṇi, aṣṭākṣaraṃ havā ekaṃ gāyatryai padametadu hāsyā etatsa yāvadeteṣu lokeṣu tāvaddha jayati yo'sya etadevaṃ padaṃ veda || 1 || ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni ityaṣṭākṣarāṇi, aṣṭākṣaraṃ havā ekaṃ gāyatryai padamedu hāsyā etatsa yāvatīyaṃ trayī vidyā area jayati yossyā etadevaṃ padaṃ veda || 2 || prāṇāpānodānavyānā ityaṣṭākṣarāṇi, aṣṭākṣaraṃ ha vā ekaṃ gāyatryai padametadu hāsyā etatsa yāvadidaṃ prāṇi tāvaddha jayati yo'syā etadevaṃ padaṃ veda || 3 || atha etadeva turīyaṃ darśitaṃ padaṃ parorajā ya eṣa tapati iti yadvai caturtha tatturīyaṃ, darśitaṃ padamiti dadṛśa iva hyeṣa, parorajā iti sarvamu hyeṣa raja uparyupari tapatyevaṃ haiva eṣa śriyā yaśasā tapati yo'syā etadevaṃ padaṃ veda || 4 || saiṣā gāyatrī etasmiṃsturīye darśite pade parorajasi pratiṣṭhitā, tadvai tatsatye pratiṣṭhitaṃ cakṣurvai satyaṃ, cakṣurhi vai satyaṃ, tasmādyadidānīṃ dvau vivadamānāveyātāmahamadrākṣamahamaśrauṣamiti ya evaṃ brūyādahamadrākṣamiti tasmādeva śraddadhāma tadvai tatsatyaṃ bale pratiṣṭhitaṃ, prāṇo vai balaṃ tatprāṇe pratiṣṭhitaṃ, tasmādāhurbalaṃ satyādoghīya ityevamveṣā gāyatryadhyātmaṃ pratiṣṭhitā, sā vaiṣā gāyāṃstatre, prāṇā vai gāyāstāṃstatre yattasmāgāyatrī nāma, sa yāmevāmūmanvāṣaiva sā, sa yasmā anvāha tasya prāṇāṃstrāyate || 5|| tāṃ haike sāvitrīmevānuṣṭubhamanvāhurvāganuṣṭuvetadvācamanubrūma iti na tathā vidyādgāyatrīmeva sāvitrīmanubrūyāt yadi ha vā apyevaṃ vidvahniva pratigṛhṇāti na haiva tadgāyatryā ekaṃcana padaṃ prati || 6 || sa ya imāṃstrīllokānpūrṇānpratigṛhṇīyāt so'syā etatprathamaṃ padamāpnuyāt, atha yāvatīyaṃ trayīvidyā yastāvatpratigṛhṇīyāt so'syā etadvitīyaṃ padamāpnuyāt, atha yāvadidaṃ prāṇi yastāvatpratigṛhṇīyāt so'syā etattṛtīyaṃ padamāpnuyāt, athāsyā etadeva turīyaṃ darśitaṃ padaṃ parorajā ya eṣa tapatīti, naiva krenacanāpyaṃ, kuta evaṃ tāvatpratigṛhṇīyāt || 7 || tasyā upasthānaṃ gāyatryasyekapadī dvipadī tripadī catuṣpadī apadasi nahi padyase namaste turīyāya darśitāya padāya parorajase sāvado mātrāpaditi yaṃ dviṣyādasāvasmai kāmo mā samaddhayeti vā na vā sa kāmaḥ samṛddhyate yasmā evamu patiṣṭhate'hamadḥ prāpamiti vā || 8 || etaddha vai tajjanako vaideho buḍilamāśvitarāśvimuvāca yannu ho gāyatrīvidathā atha kathaṃ hastībhūto vahasīti mukha hāsyāḥ samrāṭ na vidāṃcakāreti hovāca tasyā agnireva mukhaṃ yadi ha vā api vahnivānāvabhyādadhāti sarvamevaitatsaṃdahatyevaṃ vidyadyapi pāpaṃ karoti sarvametatsaṃpsāya śuddhaḥ pūto'jaro'mṛtaḥ saṃbhavati || 9 ||' iti | asyāmupaniṣadi 'bhūmirantarikṣaṃ dyaurityaṣṭākṣarāṇi' ityādikasyāyaṃ tātparyārthaḥ - brahmātmikāyā gāyatryā trailokyaṃ vivartaḥ pariṇāmo vā, atastatrānekaśaktikatvāt bhūmyādiśaktiyogitvamastīti | 'ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni ' ityādikasyāpi yadyapi trayyāḥ pramāṇāntanavagatārthaprakāśakatvaṃ vidyate tadgāyatryāṃ bahmātmikāyāṃ yaccaitanyaṃ tadeva vivṛttaṃ pariṇataṃ vā prathitamiti | 'prāṇāpānodānavyānāḥ' ityādikasyāpi anantarapādapratipāditavācyavācakabhāvāpanna lokatrayīgatasya jagatsūtrākhyasya vāyoḥ prāṇarūpasya yā ceṣṭā lakṣyate sā brahmākhyāyāḥ saviturgāyatryā eva śaktiḥ tadvaśenaiva tathā pariṇāmādvivartanādvā | ' etadeva turīyaṃ darśitaṃ padam' ityādinā tu vedavidā nikhilalokāvalokya mānavirajaskapadgatatamaskavigalitākhilakallolālolajalanidhinibhaparabrahmanikaṭavivartarūpe savitari vācyaikabhāvena vyavasthite pādatrayasya paryavasānaṃ pratipāditam | ya evaṃ hyatra śabdānantaramarthaḥ pratīyate sa eva hi vākyārthaḥ | tena savitureva devatātvamabhidheyatveneha yuktamavabhāsate | etaduktaṃ bhavati paramārthato brahma praṇava gāyatrīśabdābhilāpyatattvātiriktamadvaitavāde tattvaṃ nāsti | kalpanayā tvekatraiva vācyavācakādivyavahāraḥ samāpyate | tatra pādatrayātmakena kalpitena rūpeṇa vācakatvaṃ, savitrātmanā tu vācyatvam | turīyapādavācoyuktirapi savitari kalpanayā pādatrayavatkriyate pāramārthikatattvaikapratipādanāye yalamatirasarabhasavaśaprasāritarahasyasvadhāsvādapramodānubhavavibhavapravitatavipinagahanavedāntodyānāvagāhana naipuṇyacāpalyena | asminnavasare sthitametat - japaviniyuktāyāmapyasyāmṛci sa vitā devateti | ayaṃ ca padārthaḥ - yattaditi sāmānyaśabdaḥ, sāmānyaṃ ca sarvabhedānugataṃ brahmarūpaṃ yathārtham | yathoktam 'oṃ tatsaditi nirdeśo brahmaṇastrividhaḥ smṛtaḥ |' iti | etadapi hi sāmānyavacanamevāvicāritasiddhyarthatvena prayujyamānatvāt | yatkilāvicāritameva gṛhyate tatra omiti prayujyate | avicāritasiddhatā cāsaṃdehavastuni upapadyate| saṃdehaśca bhedaniṣṭhāne koṭyavalehiśvāt | tasmādbrahmayevādvaite'vicārita siddhatvamupapadyate | ato yattaditi brahmavidheyau śabdau | ya ityapi liṅgavyatyayaḥ | dhīśabdaśca karmanāmasu paṭhyate | tena dhīśabdena jñānavatkarmāṇyapyucyante | te ca sarvalokā vayaṃ ceti vayam | tyadādiṣu paraśeṣaḥ | teṣāṃ no'smākamasmadyuktānāmityarthaḥ | dhīmahīti 'dhyai cintāyām', chāndasaṃ saṃprasāraṇam, vyatyayena laḍarthe liṅ, vyāyāmaścintayāmo bhāvayāma upāsmaha ityarthaḥ | evaṃ pracodayā dityatrāpi | athavā pracodayāditi saṃbhāvanāyāṃ liṅ | bharga iti dīptirucyate bhāsanaprakāśādiparyāyaḥ | ' bhā dīptau' ityasya auṇādiko pratyayaḥ, chāndasau ca varṇāgama vikārau, bhāti dīpyate prakāśate nityānandacaitanyātmakatayeti bhargaḥ | 'bhrājū dīptau' ityasya vā bhrājata iti bhargaḥ | ' bhrasja pārka' ityasya vā bhrasjati pacatyauṣadhādikamiti bhargaḥ | sarvaṃ hi sasyādikaṃ brahma ādityarūpeṇa pacati saṃpādayati | jalapavanāvapi hi ravirūpau | tathā ca niruktakāraḥ 'parjanyo vāyurādityaḥ śītoṣṇavarṣairoṣadhīḥ pacanti | iti | tathāraṇyake parvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirasya dhaumyena divākarārādhanasamaye'bhihitam 'yathottarāyaṇe sūryaḥ pṛthivyā raśmabhī rasān | uddhṛtyānnamoṣadhīḥ ṣaḍusāṃśca sṛjati || dakṣiṇāyane candratejobhiranvito divasteja uddhṛtya vāriṇānnādikaṃ janayatītyuktvoktam ' evaṃ bhānumayaṃ hyannaṃ lokānāṃ prāṇadhāraṇam |' iti | 'ḍubhṛñ dhāraṇa poṣaṇayoḥ' ityasya vā bibharti dhārayati puṣṇāti vā lokāniti bhargaḥ | 'galbha dhāṣṭayeṃ' ityasya vā varṇavikāraviparyayābhyāṃ pragalbhate śaknoti dhāṣṭarghyaṃ bhajate jagadudyasthitivilayatatprakāśanādāviti bhargaḥ sāmarthyam | 'vṛjī varjane' ityasya vā varjayati avidyānibandhanabhedaprapañcaduḥkhamiti bhargaḥ | tadanenādhyātmamadhidaivataṃ vā saviturbhargo rūpamuktam | tathāca śrutiḥ ' sa eṣa vai savitā ya eṣa tapati |' iti | 'vṛñ varaṇe' chāndasaḥ kenyapratyayaḥ, varaṇārhaṃ vareṇyaṃ dhyeyatayā dhyānaphalakamuktirūpaprāpyatayā cābhilaṣaṇīyamityarthaḥ | dīvyati krīḍati jagannirmāṇāvasthāpanavilāpanairvijigīṣate vyavaharati stauti cārthavādādibhirvivartātmanā gacchati ca vivartasaṃvartarūpamiti devaḥ, tasya | sūte sasyādīnīti savitā, tasya | eṣa padārthaḥ uktaḥ | atha vākyārthaḥ - saviturdevasya saṃbandhi vareyaṃ bhargo dhīmahi | taddhi yattadrūpaṃ sāmānyasvabhāvabrahmātmakaṃ yathāyogyatāṃ karmāṇi jñānāni ca lokasya prakarṣeṇa codayati pravartayati pracodayāt pravartayediti vā saṃbhāvyate | eṣā tāvadekā paghaṭanā | yadvā taditi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ 'supāṃ sulu' iti luk | ya iti yathāśrutameva | tasya devasya saviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo dhīmahi | kasya savituḥ | yaḥ savitāsmākaṃ karmāṇi jñānāni ca prakarṣeṇa codayati || āpo hi ṣṭā mayobhuvastā na ūrje dadhātana | mahe raṇāya cakṣase || gāyatraṃ chandaḥ | abdaivataṃ sūktam | tvāṣṭrastriśirā apaśyadambarīṣo vā sindhudvīpaḥ | mārjanādau viniyogaḥ | maya iti sukhanāma | ūrmityannanāma | 'teneha sakalaṃ bhogyaṃ lakṣyam | he āpaḥ, hiryasmādarthe, yasmādyayaṃ mayobhuvaḥ sukhasya bhāvayitryaḥ stha bhavatha, tasmāttā evaṃviśiṣṭā bhavatyaḥ karmabhūtānno'smān dadhātana dhārayata ‘taptanaptanathanāśca' iti tanādeśaḥ | kimarthaṃ dadhātana | ūrje annādyupabhogāya | evaṃ bhogārthamabhyarthya apavargārthamarthayate - mahe raṇāya cakṣase | mahe mahate | parabrahmaṇo'nyasya mahattvamāpekṣikaṃ brahmaṇa eva tu tāttvikaṃ paramamahattvamiti brahmaiva mahacchabdenocyate | dadhātanetyanuṣaṅgaḥ | kīdṛśāya mahate | raṇāya ramaṇīyāya nityānanda caitanyarūpāya, tathā cakṣase darśanīyāya yogināṃ dhyānajapapratyakṣaviṣayāyetyarthaḥ | tena darśanayogyāya nityānanda caitanyasvabhāvāya mahate brahmaṇe brahmaprāptaye asmān dhārayateti vākyārthaḥ || yo vaḥ śivatamo rasastasya bhājayateha naḥ | uśatīkhi mātaraḥ || apāmādhārabhedena śivaśivataraśivatamā rasāḥ santi | athavā apāṃ rasaḥ parabrahmarūpaḥ śivatamaḥ sukhatamo mataḥ | sa yathāyogyaṃ traivarṇikairabhyarthyate - he āpaḥ, yuṣmākaṃ yaḥ sukhatamo rasastamasmān bhājayata bhojayata prāpayata vā | naḥ asmākam dvitīyārthe ca vyatyayena ṣaṣṭhī aṃśāpekṣiṇī vā | yathāvayavisaṃbandhe śivatamarasāṃśabhāgino'smānvidhattetyarthaḥ | bhogārthināṃ kṣīrādirasāptaye'bhyarthanā, mumukṣūṇāṃ tu parabrahmasvarūpalābhāya | kiṃvadbhājayatetyāha uśatīriva mātaraḥ 'vaśa kāntau' yathā mātaro bālāpatyakānāṃ vṛddhiṃ kāmayamānā vātsalyātiśayāt stanapānādidānena svāpatyakān śivatamaṃ kṣīrādirasaṃ bhojayanti tadvat || tasmā araṅgamāma vo yasya kṣayāya jinvatha | āpo janayathā ca naḥ || yasyeti vyatyayena karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī | he āpaḥ, yaṃ rasaṃ prāṇiṣu jinvatha | 'ji jaye' | laṭ vyatyayena bhruḥ | tataḥ śap bāhulakāt kvacidvivikaraṇāditā 'hunuvoḥ sārvadhātuke' iti yaṇādeśaḥ | anekārthā dhātavaḥ | tenāyamarthaḥ - jayathopacinutha vā | kimartham | kṣayāya | 'kṣi nivāsagatyoḥ ' bhūtānāṃ nivāsāya sthitaye gamanāya ca nānārūpakarmopabhogārthaceṣṭāyai jñānāya ca | tasmai araṅgamāma vaḥ | ' gatyarthakarmaṇi' iti karmaṇi caturthī | taṃ yuṣmākaṃ saṃbandhinaṃ rasaṃ tūrṇamalaṃ paryāptaṃ vā kṛtvā gacchema jīvanārthamāsādayāmāśāsmahe iti bhogāsakraya āśāsyate | mumukṣvabhiprāyeṇa virathaṃ yojanāhe āpaḥ, yasya paramātmanaḥ kṣayāya nityānandadvāreṇānujñānāya jinvatha yatadhvam, taṃ yuṣmākameva saṃbandhinaṃ paraṃ svabhāvaṃ vayaṃ yuṣmatprasādātpūrṇa paryāptaṃ vā kṛtvā gacchema jānīyāma prāpnuyāma ca, mokṣaprāptirasmākamastvityāśāsmahe ityarthaḥ | āpo janayathā ca naḥ | yasmādyuṣmatprasādādevamāśāsmahe tasmādasmān mokṣaprāptiyogyān janayadhvaṃ kurudhvam | mahānubhāvatvāde kaiva ca sarvatra devatā brahmarūpā ādityarūpā vā śrūyate | gamāmeti yadyapyāśīrliṃṅo 'liṅāśiṣi' ityārdhadhātukatvaṃ, tathāpi 'chandasyubhayathā' iti sārvadhātukatvamapyastīti śapaḥ saṃbandhaḥ | ' sarve - vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante' iti chatvābhāvaḥ | evamanyatrāpi anusartavyam || śanno devīrabhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye | śaṃ yyorabhisravantu naḥ || I abdaivatyā | gāyatrī | sindhudvīpasyāmbarīsya vārṣam | dānādiguṇayuktā devyaḥ āpaḥ no'smākaṃ śaṃ bhavantu | śamiti sukhanāma sukharūpāḥ sukhakāriṇyo vā bhavantu, tādarthyaṃ vā jñeyaṃ sukhāya bhavatvityarthaḥ | kiṃca abhiṣṭaye śaṃ bhavantu | iṣyata itīṣṭiḥ svargādiphalābhimukhyeneṣṭirabhīṣṭiḥ | chāndasa evādeśavarṇavikāraḥ abhīṣṭiriti prāpte | iṣyamāṇānnādiprāptaye āpo'smākaṃ bhavantu | āpo hi annādirūpeṇa pariṇamanti | tathāca brāhmaṇam 'āpaśca pṛthivī cānnam |' 'etanmayāni vanāni bhavanti |' iti ca | tathā pītaye bhavantu, pānamupalakṣaṇaṃ bhuktapītasukhapariṇāmakāriṇyo bhavantvityarthaḥ | athavā abhiyajanamabhīṣṭiḥ, pītiḥ somapānaṃ, jyotiṣṭomādiyāgāya somapānāya cāsmākamāpo bhavantvityarthaḥ | adhiṣṭhātrī devatetthaṃ samabhyarthyate - śaṃthyorabhisravantu naḥ | 'yu miśraṇe' yauti miśrībhavatīti yurvyādhiḥ saṃsāro jvarādiśca | śamiti lakṣaṇayā duḥkhābhāvamatrāha | āpo'smākamabhisravantu kurvantvityarthaḥ | tenaiṣa vākyārthaḥ - yorvyādheḥ saṃbandhinaṃ duḥkhābhāvamāpo'smākaṃ kurvantviti | athavā yauti śarīrādibhirmiśrībhavati iti yuśabdenātmocyate | yorātmano yat śaṃ nityasukhaṃ, tadsmākamabhisravantu vyañjayantvityarthaḥ || rṣam | śanna āpo dhanvanyāḥ śatraḥ santvanūpyāḥ | śannaḥ samudriyā āpaḥ śamu naḥ santu kūpyāḥ || abdaivatyā | anuṣṭup | somaputrasyādhvarasyādhanvani marau jaṅgale bhavā dhanvanyāḥ | evamanūpe jalasrāviṇi deśe bhavā anūpyāḥ | tathā samudre bhavā samudriyāḥ | kūpe bhavāḥ iti ca | tathā pītaye bhavantu, pānamupalakṣaṇaṃ bhuktapītasukhapariṇāmakāriṇyo bhavantvityarthaḥ | athavā abhiyajanamabhīṣṭiḥ, pītiḥ somapānaṃ, jyotiṣṭomādiyāgāya somapānāya cāsmākamāpo bhavantvityarthaḥ | adhiṣṭhātrī devatetthaṃ samabhyarthyate - śaṃ thyorabhisravantu naḥ | 'yu miśraṇe' yauti miśrībhavatīti yurvyādhiḥ saṃsāro jvarādiśca | śamiti lakṣaṇayā duḥkhābhāvamatrāha | āpo'smākamabhisravantu kurvantvityarthaḥ | tenaiṣa vākyārthaḥ - yorvyādheḥ saṃbandhinaṃ duḥkhābhāvamāpo'smākaṃ kurvantviti | athavā yauti śarīrādibhirmiśrībhavati iti yuśabdenātmocyate | yorātmano yat śaṃ nityasukhaṃ, tadsmākamabhisravantu vyañjayantvityarthaḥ || rṣam | śanna āpo dhanvanyāḥ śatraḥ santvanūpyāḥ | śannaḥ samudriyā āpaḥ śamu naḥ santu kūpyāḥ || abdaivatyā | anuṣṭup | somaputrasyādhvarasyādhanvani marau jaṅgale bhavā dhanvanyāḥ | evamanūpe jalasrāviṇi deśe bhavā anūpyāḥ | tathā samudre bhavā samudriyāḥ | kūpe bhavāḥ kūpyāḥ | tāḥ sarvā no'smākaṃ sukhāya bhavantvityarthaḥ | śamu na ityatrokāro nipātaḥ pādapūraṇārthaḥ || āpo asmānmātaraḥ sūdayantu ghṛtena mā ghṛtapvaḥ punantu | viśvaṃ hi ripraṃ pravahanti devīrudidābhyaḥ śucirāpūta emi || triṣṭup | ṛṣiranantaroktaḥ | eṣaiva devatā ca | āpo mātaraḥ jagatāṃ nirmātryaḥ | asmāniti ṣaṣṭhyarthe dvitīyā | asmākaṃ ripraṃ pāpaṃ ghṛtena sāreṇa sūdayantu nāśayantu | ripranāśanena ca māṃ ghṛtena punantu pavitrīkurvantu asmākaṃ pāpaṃ nāśayantviti | etatkiyadvā citraṃ yato viśvaṃ sarvaṃ jagatrayagatamapi pāpaṃ pravahanti pravāhayanti apasārituṃ śaknuvanti | tā hi devīḥ devyo dānadyotanādiguṇayuktāḥ | udidābhyaḥ śucirāpūta emi iti | iditi pādapūraṇārthe nipātaḥ | uditi emītyanena saṃbadhyate | abhya adbhya āpūtaḥ pavitrībhūta eva śucirudemi āgacchāmi svargāpavargamāpnu vānītyarthaḥ || idamāḥ pravahata yatkiṃcidduritaṃ mayi | yāhamabhidudroha yadvā śeṣa utānṛtam || ṛṣiḥ pūrvavat | anuṣṭup | he āpaḥ yatkiṃcinmaya duritaṃ duśceṣṭitaṃ pāparūpaṃ karma tatpravahatāpasārayata | yadvāhamabhidudroha yat dugdhaṃ hiṃsitaṃ kiṃcinmayā, yaccānṛtamalīkaṃ niṣkāraṇamevāhaṃ kiṃcanābhiśepa ākruṣṭavān tatsarvaṃ pravahata | duritapadena sāmānyābhidhāne'pi drohābhiśāpayoḥ punarvacanamatiśayārtham || drupadādivenmumucānaḥ khinnaḥ sātvī malādiva | pūtaṃ pavitreṇevājyamāpaḥ śundhantu mainasaḥ || anuṣṭup | ṛṣiḥ kokilarājaputraḥ | āpo māmenasaḥ pāpācchundhantu mocayantu sugatiyogyaṃ kurvantu | kaḥ kasmānmukto yathā yatheṣṭabihārī bhavati, drupadādivenmumucānaḥ | drupadāḥ pādukāḥ, tathāca mantravarṇaḥ ' kanīnakeva vidradhe nave ḍupade iti | yadvā drutaṃ padaṃ yatra sadrupado dasyūpahato deśaḥ, drumayaṃ vā padaṃ drupadaṃ bandhanakāṣṭham | icchabdaḥ pādapūraṇaḥ | 'mulu mocane' vyatyayena laḍarthe liṭ kānac | yathādrupadātpādukāsabhayadeśabandhanakāṣṭhalakṣaṇānmucyamāno naraḥ svairavihārī bhavati | khinnaḥ snātvī malādiva | khinnaḥ prakhedayukto nidāghādau | 'snālyādayaśca' iti snātvīśabdo nipātitaḥ | yathā prakhedena vyāptagātraḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā malādvimukto nirvṛto bhavati, yathā vā darbhapavitreṇa pūtamājyaṃ nirmalaṃ bhavati titaunā saktava iva, tathā māmāpo nirmalaṃ niṣpāpaṃ saṃpādayantvityarthaḥ || ava te helo varuṇa namobhirakha yajñebhirīmahe havirbhiḥ | kṣayamasmabhyamasura praceto rājannenāṃsi śiśrathaḥ kṛtāni || triṣṭup | śunaḥśepasyārṣaṃ devāsurāṇāṃ vā | varuṇo devatā | avetyupasargaḥ īmahe ityanena saṃbadhyate 'vyavahitāśca' iti smṛteḥ | he varuṇa te tava helaḥ krodhamavema he'panayāmaḥ | kaiḥ | namobhiḥ stotraiḥ, yajñebhiḥ pañcamahāyajñādikaiḥ, havirbhiḥ puroḍāśādikaiḥ | atastvamapasāritakopaḥ prasannacittaḥ san asmabhyaṃ kṣayaṃ nivāsamannaṃ vā prayaccha | tathāca yānyasmābhirenāṃsi niṣiddhasevanādīni kṛtāni tāni śiśrathaḥ śithilīkuru nāśayetyarthaḥ | he asura, he pracetaḥ, he rājan ityāmantraṇatrayaṃ varuṇaviśeṣaṇam | asuḥ prāṇaḥ śaktiviśeṣaḥ sa vidyate yasya so'suraḥ, he balavan | prakṛṣṭaṃ ceto jñānaṃ mano vā yasya tasya saṃbodhanaṃ he pracetaḥ | rājan dīpyamāna || uduttamaṃ varuṇapāśamasmadavādhamaṃ vi madhyamaṃ śrathāya | athā vayamāditya vrate tavānāgaso aditaye syāma || anantaravat chandodevatāvagatiḥ | uttaratrāpyevam | śunaḥśepastribhiḥ pāśairyūpe mūlamadhyaprāntadeśeṣu baddho muktaye varuṇastutiṃ cakāra | udityupasargaḥ śrathāyetyanena saṃbadhyate | he varuṇa uttamaṃ pāśamasmatsakāśāducchrathāya ūrdhvaṃ śithilīkuru śithilaṃ kṛtvā ūrdhvasārana prāntapāśamapasārayetyarthaḥ | avādhamam, adhamaṃ mūlapradeśasthamavaśrathāya śithilaṃ kṛtvā - dhonayanena mūlapāśamapasārayetyarthaḥ | vi madhyamaṃ, madhyamaṃ viśrathāya madhyapradeśasthaṃ pāśaṃ vividharūpeṇa śrathaya śithilaṃ kṛtvā mūlena prāntena madhyamaṃ pāśaṃ yūpānnisārayetyarthaḥ | atha pāśatrayavimuktyanantaraṃ he āditya aditeḥ putraḥ tava vrate karmaṇi vartamānā vayamanāgaso nipāpāḥ syāma | kimartham | aditaye dainyā dainyasya pāpanibandhanatvāt || tattvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānastadāśāste yajamāno havirbhiḥ | alamāno varuṇeha bodhyuruśaṃsa mā na āyuḥ pramoṣīḥ || he varuṇa yadyajamāno havirbhiḥ puroḍāśasomaprabhṛtibhirāśāste tadahaṃ tvāṃ yāmi tvāṃ yāce | kiṃ kurvāṇaḥ | brahmaṇā matrarūpeṇa vedena vandamānaḥ stuvan | tadiha yācanaṃ stavanaṃ ca bodhi budhyakha | ahelamānaḥ 'heḍa anādare' anādaramakurvan | śaṃsanaṃ śaṃsaḥ urubhirbahubhiḥ śaṃso yasya sa uruśaṃsastasya saṃbodhanaṃ he uruśaṃsa bahustuta | mā na āyuḥ pramoṣīḥ, asmāka māyurvilopaṃ mā kārṣīḥ || uduttamaṃ mumugdha no vipāśaṃ madhyamaṃ śratha | avadhamāna jīvase || vāruṇī | gāyatrī | ṛṣiḥ śunaḥśepa eva | pāśavimocanamabhyarthyājarāmaraṇamabhyarthayate | udityupasarge mumugdhītyanena saṃbadhyate | asmākamuttamaṃ pāśamunmumugdhi ūrdhvaṃ mocaya vi pāśaṃ madhyamaṃ śratha, madhyamaṃ pāśaṃ viśratha | adhamāni ca bandhanāni avaśratha adhobhāge vimucyāpasāraya | kimartham | jīvase 'jīva 'prāṇadhāraṇe' jīvanāya pāśamocanaṃ kṛtvā bahvasmabhyamāyurdehi ityarthaḥ | athavā jīvanamiha kaivalyam | bandhanāni devarṣipitṝṇāmṛṇāni uttamādhamamadhyamāni yathāsaṃkhyaṃ, tadvimocanena mokṣaḥ prārthyate | yathoktam 'ṛṇāni trīṇyapākṛtya mano mokṣe niveśayet |" iti || hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā yāsu jātaḥ kaśyapo yākhindraḥ | yā agniṃ garbhaṃ dadhire virūpāstā na āpaḥ śaṃsyonā bhavantu || abdaivatyā | triṣṭup | hiraṇyasyeva śuddho nirmala varṇo yāsāṃ tā hiraṇyavarṇāḥ | śucayaḥ pavitrabhūtāḥ | ata eva pāvakāḥ pavitratāyā āpādikāḥ | yāsu kaśyapaprabhṛtaya ṛṣayo jātā indraprabhṛtayaśca devāḥ | kā gaṇanānyeṣām | tathāca manuḥ 'apa eva sasarjādau tāsu vīryamathāsṛjat | tadaṇḍamabhavadvaimaṃ sahasrārkasamadyuti || ' ityādi | yāśca vividharūpā gaganasāgarādivyavasthitā api agniṃ vaidyutavaḍavāmukhādikaṃ garbha dadhire | tathāca matravarṇaḥ 'āpo ha yanmahatīrviśvamāyangarbha dadhānā janayantīragnim | iti | tā āpo no'smākaṃ śaṃsyonāḥ sukhatamā bhavantu || yāsāṃ devā divi kṛṇvanti bhakṣyaṃ yā antarikṣe bahudhā bhavanti | yā agniṃ garbha dadhire virūpāstā na āpaḥ śaṃsyonā bhavantu || yāsāmapāṃ traivarṇikadattānāṃ devāḥ pitṛprabhṛtayo divi svarge bhakṣaṇaṃ kurvanti, bhakṣitena balena haviṣyarūpeṇāpi pariṇatānāṃ devopayogitvaṃ pratīyate | tathāca śrutiḥ ' tataḥ prajanaṃ devā upajīvanti |' iti | tata eva manuṣyebhya evopajīvanti natu vidyamānamapi svayaṃ gṛhṇanti meghādāvityarthaḥ | yāścāntarikṣe bahuprakārā himakarakapānīyarūpā bhavanti | śeṣaṃ vyākhyātam || yāsāṃ rājā varuṇo yāti madhye satyānṛte avapaśyañjanānām | yā agniṃ garbhaṃ dadhire virūpāstā na āpaḥ śaṃsyonā bhavantu || yāsāmapāṃ madhye rājamāno varuṇo yāti | kiṃ kurvan janānāṃ satyānṛte dharmādharmau paśyan || śivena mā cakṣuṣā paśyatāpaḥ śivayā tanvopaspṛśata tvacaṃ me | madhuśrutaḥ śucayo yāḥ pāvakāstā na āpaḥ śaṃsyonā bhavantu || gatārtham || hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā vicakramurhitvāvadyamāpaḥ | śataṃ pavitrā vitatānyāsāṃ tābhirmā devaḥ savitā punātu || hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śuddhaḥ śucitvāt pavitratvāpādikāḥ, āpaḥ avayavadānārhaṃ khaṇḍanayogyaṃ pāpaṃ tyaktvā vicakramuḥ vividhaṃ krāntā bhūlakamāgatāḥ | śatagrahaṇamatibahutvopalakṣaṇam | pavitrā iti liṅgavyatyayaḥ | ativitatāni subhūyāṃsi ca pavitrīkaraṇāni rūpāṇi āsāṃ yasmāttasmādāsāmadhipatiḥ savitā tābhirami punātu || etā hiraṇyavarṇāḥ samākhyātā ṛcaḥ | ita ūrdhvaṃ pāvamānīḥ samākhyātāḥ ṣaḍūco bhaviṣyanti | tāsāmṛṣiḥ pavamānaḥ | somo devatā ardhāśritādhiṣṭhātṛrūpeṇa | anuṣṭup chandaḥ yaḥ pāvamānīradhyeti ṛṣibhiḥ saṃbhṛtaṃ rasam | sarvaṃ sa pūtamaśnāti svaditaṃ mātariśvanā || yaḥ pāvamānīradhyeti pavitrīkaraṇīrapām | tasmai sarasvatī duhe kṣīraṃ sarpirmadhūdakam || pavitrīkaraṇīrapāṃ vācikā iti kṛtvā ṛca eva pāvamānyaḥ | ṛṣibhirjñānibhirevātra saṃbhṛto ḍhaukito yo rasastatsvabhāvāḥ pāvamānīḥ ṛco yaḥ paṭhati, sa sarvamevānnādirasamuttamamaśnāti bhuṅke svabhāvapavitreṇa vāyunāpyāsvāditaṃ śodhitaṃ pāvitam | tathā sarasvatī vāk duhe dugdhe pūrayati kṣīraṃ śuddhatvādupacārāddharmam | sarpiriti snigdhatvasāmānyāt svargādikaṃ kāmam | madhviti nityānandātmakamapavarga madhuraikarasatvāt | udakamiti kṣīrādikamudakaprabhavamityarthaḥ, iti kecidanye tu udakaśabdena saṃtānabhāvātmako duḥkhābhāvo lakṣyate ityāhuḥ || 'pāvamānīḥ svastyayanīḥ sudughā hi ghṛtaścataḥ ṛṣibhiḥ saṃbhṛto raso brāhmaṇeṣvamṛtaṃ hi tat || pāva mānyaḥ pātrayitryaḥ | svastyayanīḥ svasti avināśaḥ avināśakāriṇyaḥ āyuṣpradā ityarthaḥ | sudughāḥ sudohanāḥ | ghṛtaśruto ghṛtasrāviṇyaḥ | ṛṣibhirmantrasāravedibhirayaṃ saṃbhṛta evātra rāśīkṛto raso yā etāḥ pāvamānyaḥ - yato brāhmaṇeṣu tadamṛtam, amaraṇakārī āyuprado bhogāsaktānāṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ tu mokṣado'yaṃ rasa ityarthaḥ || pāvamānīḥ svastyayanīryābhirgacchati nandanam | puṇyaśca bhakṣyānbhakṣayatyamṛtatvaṃ ca gacchati || tathā pāvamānyaḥ svastyayanyaḥ, yābhiradhītābhirnaro nandanaṃ vanaṃ devodyānaṃ gacchati prāpnoti tathā bhakṣyāṃśca puṇyaphalabhūtān svargādikān bhuṅkte amṛtatvaṃ ca mokṣalakṣaṇaṃ labhate || pāvamānī rdiśantu na imaṃ lokamatho amum | kāmān samardhayantu no devairdevīḥ samāhṛtāḥ || evaṃ caitāḥ pavamānyo'smākamimaṃ pṛthivīlokamamuṃ ca svargalokaṃ diśantu darśayantu, kāmāṃśca kāmyamānān sarvānarthānasmākaṃ samyavardhayantu devaidyatanaiṛṣibhiḥ samāhṛtā ekīkṛtāḥ satyaḥ || yena devāḥ pavitreṇa ātmānaṃ punate sadā | tena sahasradhāreṇa pāvamānyaḥ punantu naḥ || yena pavitrīkaraṇena udakaviśeṣātmanā devā ātmānaṃ pavitrīkurvanti, tenānantadhāreṇāsmān pāvamānyaḥ punantu || muñcantu mā śapathyādatho varuṇyāduta | atho yamasya paḍḍīśātsarvasmāddevakilbiṣāt || ātharvaṇasya bhiṣaja ārṣam | anuṣṭup āpa ucyante ṛṣiṇā | śapathyācchapathaprabhavāt paḍḍīśātpāśāt kilbiṣācca | tathā varuṇyāruṇapāśanimittāt yena pāpena satā varuṇaḥ pāśaināti tasmāt kilbiṣāt tannimittācca pāśāt | uteti samuccaye | tathā yamasya ca saṃbandhinaḥ pāśātpāpāccāpo vimuñcantu mām | yena pāpena satā yamaḥ prabhavati tadyamasya pāśaḥ | kiṃca sarvasmāddevakilbiṣāt, avaśyakartavyaṃ - yaddevānāṃ yāgahomādikaṃ tadakaraṇādyatpāpamupajāyate tadevakilbiṣam, tasmātsamagrātpāpādāpo māṃ muñcantu || jāgradyatsutaḥ pāpamabhijagāma | sarvasmānmā tasmādenasaḥ pramuñcatu || gāyatrī | āpa ucyante | yatpāpaṃ jāgradahamabhijagāma ābhimukhyena kṛtvā kṛtavān, yacca suptaḥ supta iva suptaḥ ajñānāt tasmātsarvasmādenaso māmāpaḥ pramuñcatu vimuñcantvityarthaḥ || tadvaṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ | divīva cakṣurātatam || viṣṇorvyāpakasya paramaṃ brahmarūpaṃ padaṃ mokṣalakṣaṇaṃ prāpnuyāmetyāśāsmahe | saṃmārjanamatrā vyākhyātāḥ | saṃmārjanādanantaraṃ 'ṛtaṃ ca satyam' ityādikamaghamarṣaṇasūktaṃ japet sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhārakāriṇaṃ sūktābhidheyaṃ prajāpatiṃ dhyāyan | sūktābhidheyāśca sṛṣṭisthitipralayāḥ prajāpatyadhīnā ityetadupaniṣatsu tatra tatra pratipāditam | prajāpatirhi anekaśaktikhacitaḥ saṃkalpamātreṇa trailokyaṃ khatanoreva sṛjati, saṃhārasamaye ca svātmanyeva punaḥ śaktirūpeṇopasaṃharati | tathāca śrutiḥ iti | 'hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre |' 'asadvā idamagra āsīttato vai sadajāyata | tadātmānaṃ svayamakuruta |' iti | brāhmaṇamapi 'yo brahmāṇaṃ vidadhāti pūrva yo vai vedāṃca prahiṇoti tasmai | taṃha devamātmabuddhiprakāśaṃ mumukṣurvai śaraṇamahaṃ prapadye || etasmājjāyate prāṇo manaḥ sarvendriyāṇi ca | khaṃ vāyurjyotirāpaśca pṛthvī viśvasya dhāriṇī ||' iti | tadetatsṛṣṭikartṛkatvāpannaprajāpatiprakāḥ śakaṃ sūktaṃ vyācakṣate || ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ cābhīddhāttapaso'dhyajāyata | tato rātrirajāyata tataḥ samudro arṇavaḥ || samudrādarṇavādadhi saṃvatsaro ajāyata | ahorātrāṇi vidadhadviśvasya miṣato vaśī | sūryācandramasaudhātā yathāpūrvamakalpayat | divaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ cāntarikṣamatho khaḥ || ṛṣiraghamarṣaṇaḥ | anuṣṭup chandaḥ | prajāpatirdevatā jagatsraṣṭṛtvena sūktajapasamaye dhyātavyaḥ | tapo jñānaṃ 'samyagjñānamayaṃ tapaḥ |' iti śruteḥ | tasmādabhīddhāttraṣṭavyapadārthasāṃmukhyena dīptādvartamānāt ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ cājāyata | jagatsūtrabhūtaḥ prāṇaḥ satyaṃ 'prāṇo vai satyam' iti śruteḥ | ṛtamapi prāṇasvarūpameva gatimattvāt | ṛtamiti hi gatyarthasyārte rūpam | mano'pi ṛtaṃ satyaṃ ca satyasaṃkapatvāt vidyudvatsuvegagāmitvācca | saṃkalpamātrāt manaḥ sahitaḥ prāṇaḥ prajāpatinā nirmita ityarthaḥ | tataḥ prāṇotpattyanantaraṃ tata eva saṃkalpamātrātprājāpatyādvātrirajāyata | añjanapuñjavarṇasāmyādrātriśabda ākāśe vartate | prāṇotpattyanantaraṃ tatra tatrākāśotpattiśrutirupaniṣatsu | tata ākāśotpattyanantaraṃ samudro arṇavaḥ jalamarṇavarūpaṃ gatiyuktaṃ polūyamānaṃ jalaṃ jātamityarthaḥ | samudragrahaṇaṃ bhūtatrayasyānyasyāpyutpattiṃ lakṣayati | tathāca śrutiḥ 'ākāśādvāyurvāyoragniragnerāpo'dyaḥ pṛthivī' iti | kramāniyamaṃ ca tatra tatra darśayannṛṣiravidyānirmitatvena bhedavivartasyādvaite kramasyāpāramārthikatāmāha - samudrādarṇavāt saṃvatsaraḥ samrāṭ 'adhirīśvare' 'yasmādadhikam' iti samuṃdraśabdātsaptamyāṃ jātāyāṃ vyatyayena pañcamī | samudragrahaṇaṃ ca bhūtapañcakopalakṣaṇam | adhibhūteṣu samrāṭ jātaḥ bhūtakhāmī bhūta ityarthaḥ | kiṃ kurvāṇaḥ samrāḍajāyata | ahorātrāṇi tatparicchedakāriṇau sūryācandramasau vidadhat janayan | kathaṃ virāḍ janayati, viniyuṅkte cādityādikaṃ kāryaśeṣeṣu iti cet tatrāha yato'sau miṣato nimeṣonmeṣavato viśvasya samastabhuvanasya dhātā nirmātāto vidadhāti, tasya ca vaśītikṛtvā yathāyogyatvaṃ yuṅkte | kathaṃ vidadhat | yathāpūrvaṃ pūrvakalpānatikrameṇa anādiretadīyaḥ sargapralaya ityarthaḥ | athavā yathāpūrvaṃ pūrvakarmānusāreṇa tena na muktān śarīrādinā yojayati | yadvā yathāpūrvaṃ yathākramaṃ na sarvān tulyān nirmitavān upabhogābhāvaprasaṅgāt kiṃ tarhi uccāvacān akalpayat kalpitavān | athavā pṛthivīmantarikṣaṃ ca svaśca svargamiti lokatrayaṃ yathākramamakalpayaditi saṃbandhaḥ | pṛthivyā uparyantarikṣaṃ nakṣatrādilokaṃ, tataḥ pañcavidhaṃ pūrvapradarśitaṃ svargamiti | kiṃ tasya jagannirmāṇa prayojanamiti cedata āha divamiti 'divu krīḍāyām ' krīḍayetyarthaḥ | evaṃ 'saṃmārjanānantarabhūtamṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ cetyetayānayukta āvartayet' iti kāṭhakaśruteḥ aghamarṣaṇasūktajapaḥ kartavyaḥ | tadanantaraṃ prāṇasaṃyamaḥ | tathāca yājñavalkyena 'mārjanaṃ prāṇasaṃyamaḥ | iti mārjanottarakāle'pi prāṇasaṃyamaścoditaḥ | kiṃca snānādāvapyasyopayogo'sti | tathā ca vasiṣṭhena prāyaścittārthatvamasya pāpakṣayahetutveoktam 'āvartayetsadā yuktaḥ prāṇāyāmānpunaḥ punaḥ | ālomāgrānnakhāgrācca tapastapsyannanuttamam || prāṇāyāmāndhārayetrīnyathāśāstramatandritaḥ | ahorātrakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || iti | tathāca 'ahorātraṃ ca yāñjantūnhinastyajñānato dvijaḥ | tataḥ svātvā viśuddhyarthaṃ prāṇāyāmān ṣaḍācaret ||' iti | yogaśāstreṣūpaniṣatsu ca prāṇāyāmaireva pavanajaye sati bhūtendriyajayaḥ prādhānyena pratipāditaḥ | tenāsya prayatnatareṇa lakṣaṇamabhidheyam | tacca tathaiva yājñavalkyādibhiḥ pratipāditam | 'gāyatrīṃ śirasā sārdhaṃ japedvyāhṛtipūrvikām | pratipraṇavasaṃyuktāṃ trirayaṃ prāṇasaṃyamaḥ || iti | vasiṣṭha 'vyāhṛtipraṇavairyuktāṃ gāyatrī śirasā saha | triḥ paṭhedāyataprāṇaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ sa ucyate ||' iti | tatra kumbhakenaiva prāṇāpānavṛtternirodhamicchanti sandhyopāsanaprāyaścittādiṣu, samādhau kumbhakena recakena ca | kumbhako bāhyavāyorācamane kriyamāṇe udarasya kumbhavatpūraṇādbhavati, recakastvāntaravāyorniḥsāraṇādudarasya riktatāpādanāt | tatrāyaṃ kramaḥ - oṃ bhūḥ oṃ khaḥ oṃ oṃ bhuvaḥ mahaḥ | kecittu takārāntaṃ mahacchabda paṭhanti oṃ mahaditi | tathāca pātañjalabhāṣye 'brāhmastribhūmiko lokaḥ prājāpatyastato mahān | māhendraśca svarityukto divi tārā bhuvi prajāḥ ||' iti | oṃ janaḥ oṃ tapaḥ oṃ satyam | oṃ tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt oṃ āpo jyotī raso'mṛtaṃ brahma bhūrbhuvaḥ svarom || etadyāvatā kālena triḥ paṭhyate tāvantaṃ kālaṃ prāṇanirodhaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ so'bhyasanīyaḥ | etaṃ ca prāṇāyāmamupakrame'pi sandhyopāsanasvecchanti | iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ 'trayaḥ prāṇāyāmāḥ pañcadaśamātrāparimāṇāḥ' ityayaṃ gautamoktaḥ prathamamanuṣṭheyaḥ, paścādayaṃ gautamīyavyatirekeṇātrādhikārāt | yathoktaṃ 'prāṇāyāmaistribhiḥ pūtastata oṅkāramarhati |' evameva cāsmākaṃ vṛddhebhya āgamaḥ - upakrama iva sandhyopāsanasya vayamupanayanakāla eva dvividhamapi prāṇāyāmaṃ yatnenānuṣṭhāpitā vedārthaviduttamaiḥ pitṛpādaiḥ | tatra vyāhṛtīnāṃ sāvitryācārtho vyākhyāto brahmarūpaḥ | lokasaptakamapi hi brahmaṇo rūpamoṃkāra sāvitrīvācyasyoktam | āpo jyotirityasyāpi sarvāṅgoparisthitatvāt prādhānyācca sākṣādbrahmaśabdavattayā śiraḥ śabdavācyasya brahmarūpamevābhidheyaṃ brahmādvaite jñānakāṇḍārthaṃ, dvaite'pi karmakāṇḍārtham | tatra brahmeti viśeṣyapadam | āpa ityādīni catvāri viśeṣaṇapadāni | 'āpū vyāptau ' ityasyāpaḥ, vyāpakaḥ sarvakāryānubandhitvādato brahmaṇa eva vyāpakatvamuktam | jyotiriti jñānaprakāśakatvamuktam | rasa iti sāratvam | amṛtamiti nityānandātmakatvaṃ paramavināśitvaṃ ca | bhūrbhuvaḥ svariti lokatrayātmakatvam | asya ca śirasaḥ prabhāvo'pyuktaḥ ' ṣoḍaśākṣarakaṃ brahma gāyatryāstu śiraḥ smṛtam | sadāvartayanvipraḥ saṃsārādāśu mucyate ||' chandaḥ śiraso nāsti yajuṣvāt | ṛṣistu prajāpatiḥ | devatāstvagnibrahmavāyusūryāḥ | tathāca pārāśaryaḥ 'gāyatryāstu śiraḥ proktamāpo jyotī raso'mṛtam | tatra prajāpaterārṣa chandohīnaṃ yajuḥ smṛtam || brahmāgnivāyu sūryāśca devatāstasya kīrtitāḥ |' iti | prāṇāyāmādanantaraṃ samantrakamācamanaṃ kuryāt | yathāha śaṅkhaḥ ' evaṃ saṃmārjanaṃ kṛtvā praṇāyāmāṃśca dharmavit | upaspṛśettataḥ paścānmatreṇānena sandhyayoḥ || āpaścarasi bhūteṣu guhāyāṃ sarvamūrtiṣu | tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkāra āpo jyotī raso'mṛtam ||' iti | brahmocyate tadrūpā āpaḥ stotum | tvameva sarvabhūteṣu carasi | tathāhi tvamevāpaḥ | tvameva guhāyāṃ hṛdayākāśe mana ityarthaḥ | sarvendriyopalakṣaṇaṃ caitat | sarvāsu ca mūrtiṣu ye sthitā jīvātmānaste'pi tvameva | tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkārastvameva sādhyasādhakarūpa ityarthaḥ | tvaṃ jyotistvaṃ rasastvamamṛtaṃ, yaśca tvaṃ tā āpa iti | dvitīyamabgrahaṇamācamyamānākhapsu brahmarūpopasaṃhārārtham | gautamo'pyāha 'aśva mādityaśca punātu' iti sāyam | 'rātriśca mā candramā punātu iti prātaḥ | ācamediti śeṣaḥ | prāṇāyāmādanantaraṃ 'sūryasya cāpyupasthānaṃ ...... iti darśanāt 'udutyaṃ jātavedasaṃ citraṃ devetyṛcau paṭhan | dvijaḥ pradadyādvidhivadbhāskarāya jalāñjalim ||" iti vacanāt 'udutyaṃ jātavedasamṛṣiḥ praskaṇva ucyate | gāyatraṃ chanda ākhyātaṃ devatā sūrya ucyate || citrandevetyatra tritaḥ kutso vā kīrtyate ṛṣiḥ | triṣṭup chando daivataṃ ca sūryo'syāḥ parikīrtitaḥ || ' 'atirātre'śvine śastre niyogo'syāstathā jape |' iti smaraṇāt 'udu tyaṃ' 'citrandevānām' iti dvābhyāmādityamupatiṣṭheta jalāñjalimādāya || udutyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketavaḥ dṛśe viśvāya sūryam || tyad śabdaḥ sarvanāma | uśabdo nipātaḥ pādapūraṇārthaḥ | udityupasarge vahantītyanena saṃbadhyate| tyaṃ taṃ jātavedasaṃ jātaprajñānaṃ jātadhanaṃ vā, devaṃ dānādiguṇayuktaṃ, sūrya vikrāntimantaṃ ketavo raśmayo'śvā vā vahanti | kimarthaṃ vahanti | dṛśe darśanāya | kasya | viśvāya ṣaṣṭhyarthe caturthī viśvasya sarvasya jagatrayasya || citra devānāmudgādanīkaṃ cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyāneḥ | āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca || ādityo brahma | sa cātra parāpararūpeṇa sthitaḥ stūyate | tatrāpararūpeṇa tāvadudayakālādārabhya stutimāha | citramiti kriyāviśeṣaṇam| yaścitramāścaryabhūtamudgādudagamat śārvaraṃ tamo'pahatya ayāditejaścāpahṛtya, devānāṃ ca dyotamānānāṃ raśmīnāmanīkaṃ mukhamādāya samūhaṃ vā | kaḥ | sūryaḥ | kīdṛśaḥ | jagato jaṅgamasya cakṣuḥ | kiṃvā sāmānyenocyate, mitrāvaruṇābhiprabhṛtīnāmapi netram | yaśca dyāvāpṛthivyau āprā ā samantāt aprāḥ pūritavān antarikṣaṃ ca | pararūpeṇa stauti - ātmā jagato jaṅgamasya, tasthuṣaḥ sthāvarasya | sūryādvaitamanenoktaṃ brahmādityarūpeṇa bhāvanīyam | tathāca śrutiḥ 'ye vai tamādityaṃ puruṣaṃ vedayante sa indraḥ sa prajāpatiḥ sa brahmā |' iti || 'upatiṣṭheta cādityaṃ matraistadaivatairdvijaḥ | ' iti vacanādanyairapyādityadevatākairmantrairādityaḥ stotavya iti prayujyamānā anye'pi vyākhyāyante | haṃsaḥ śuciṣadvasurantarikṣasaddhotā vediṣadatithirduroṇasat | nṛṣadara sahasayomasadabjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtaṃ bṛhat || chando jagatī | ṛṣirvāmadevaḥ | paramātmarūpeṇa stūyamānaḥ sūryo devatā | hanti dhvāntaṃ, gacchati cādhvānamadhidaivarūpeṇa vāvidyāmiti haṃsaḥ | tathācoktaṃ 'haṃso nārāyaṇaḥ prokto haṃsa ātmeti niścitaḥ | vātmā sa bhagavānviṣṇustadrahma sarvagam ||' iti | śucayo dīptayo raśmayaḥ, svarge vā śuciḥ, nityajñānasukhaṃ vā tatra sīdati śuciṣat | tathā vāsayati jagat vṛṣṭyādidvāreṇa vivarta pariṇatimukhena adhyātmarūpeṇeti vasurādityaḥ | antarikṣe sīdati vāyvādirūpeṇetyantarikṣasat, adhyātmarūpeṇa vā sarvajīvātmanāmantarikṣe hṛdayākāśa antaryāmirūpeṇa sīdatītyantarikṣasat | hoteti heo rūpam | saca prāṇināṃ rātrau prasuptānāṃ vyāpārasiddhiṣu sāṃmukhyāpādanādāhṛtervādhidaivarūpeṇādhyātmarūpeṇa āhvayati spardhayate juhotīti vā avidyāmadhikṣipatītyarthaḥ | vedyāṃ sīdatyagnirūpeṇeti - vediṣat | adhyātmarūpeṇāpi 'vida jñāne' vedyāṃ nityajñānarūpāyāṃ sīdatīti vediṣat, atithiḥ san duroṇe gṛhe jīvātmanivāse sarvaśarīre vā sīdati | yadvā droṇakalaśe somarasādhāne'gnyādidevatābhāvenetyatithirduroṇasat | athaca brahmāṇḍasthasya sarvaśarīragasya cānityatvādatithiḥ, atithirapyanityaḥ yato gṛhāgṛhāntaraṃ yāti | nṛṣu manuṣyeṣu antaryāmitvena prāṇādibhāvena ca sīdatīti nṛṣat | nṛgrahaṇaṃ cetanopalakṣaṇārtham | adhidaive'pi nṛṣu sarvacetaneṣu sīdati prakāśakatvena nayanasahakāritayeti nṛṣat | vare dyusthāne sīdatyadhidaivātmaneti varasat | tathāca brāhmaṇam 'varaṃ vā etatsadanaṃ yasminneṣa āsannastapati | iti | athavā vareṣūtkṛṣṭeṣu sthāneṣu nandanavanamahadādilokaprabhṛtiṣu sīdati krīḍati indrādibhāveneti varasat | adhyātmapakṣe ṛte satye nityacaitanyātmake tiṣṭhatīti ṛtasat | adhidaivapakṣe vā ṛte yajñe sauryādi ke sīdati devatātvenetyṛtasat | vyomnyantarikṣe hṛdayākāśe vā sīdatīti vyomasat | stutau paunaruktaye na doṣaḥ | yathoktaṃ 'vaktā harṣa bhayādibhirākṛṣṭamanāstathā stuvannindan | _ yatpadamasakadrūyāttatpunaruktaṃ na doṣāya || ' iti | ihāpi vedātmā vaktā | tathāca śrutiḥ 'yaṃ sarve vedā na viduryasya sarve vedāḥ śarīraṃ so'ntaryāmṛtaḥ |' iti | athavā paunaruktatyoccāraṇenedaṃ bodhayati yaduta sarvaḥ padagrāmo brahmābhidhāyitayaivaṃprāya iti | apsu jāyate ityabjāḥ 'apa eva sasarjādau....' ityādimānavaśāstrānusāreṇādityo'bjāḥ | athavā samudratīrasthadṛṣṭyā abjāḥ | tathāca śrutiḥ 'ao vā eṣa prātarudetyapaḥ sāyaṃ praviśati |' iti | vaidyutāgnirūpo vaḍavāgnyātmakaḥ sūryasya svabhāvo'bjāḥ | gavi kharge indrādirūpeṇa, antarikṣe vā bhānusvabhāvena, pṛthivyāṃ vā annaubadhyādirūpeṇa jāyata iti gojāḥ | ṛte satyajñāne jāyate tiṣṭhatīti ṛtajāḥ | tathā ca śrutiḥ 'satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma |' iti | evamadrau merau jāyate udayasamaye upalabhyate ityadrijāḥ | kiṃvā bahucyate ṛtamāditya eva ṛtaṃ sarvagataṃ parabrahmarūpaṃ yat sa sūrya iti | tatparamaṃ brahma prāpnuyāmeti vākyaṃ pūrayitavyam | bṛhadvyāpakam || udvayaṃ tamasaspari jyotiṣpaśyanta uttaram | devandevatrā sūryamaganma jyotiruttamam || anuṣṭup chandaḥ | sūryo devatā | udityupasargaḥ aganmetyanena saṃbadhyate | vayamuttamaṃ brahmalakṣaṇaṃ jyotirudganma | āśīrliṅo'rthe vyatyayena luṅ udaganmetyāśāsmahe ūrdhvaṃ gamyāsma ityarthaḥ | kiṃ kurvantaḥ | dīpādijyotirantarāpekṣayā uttaramutkṛṣṭamuparivarti vā jyotiḥ sūryaṃ paśyanto dhyāyantaḥ anena sūryadhyānenetyarthaḥ | anyacca kīdṛśaṃ sūrya paśyantaḥ | tamasaspari tamasa upari vartamānaṃ tamaso'ndhakārasyā vidyārūpasya ca nāśakamityarthaḥ | anyacca kīdṛśam | devaṃ dānādiguṇayuktaṃ dyotamānaṃ vā | tathā devatrā devānāṃ tridaśabrāhmaṇalakṣaṇānāṃ trāṇāt | 'traiṅ pālane' 'āto'nupasarge kaḥ' ākāro varṇāgamaḥ 'supāṃ sulu' iti dvitīyāluk | natu deva eva devatrā 'devapuruṣamanuṣyebhyastrā' iti taddhitastrāpratyayaḥ devamityanenaiva gatārthatvāt || mitrasya carṣaṇīdhṛtaḥ śravo devasya sānasi | dyumnaṃ citraśravastamam || gāyatrī mitro janānyātayati bruvāṇo mitro dādhāra pṛthivīmu̱ta dyām | mitraḥ kṛṣṭīranimiṣābhicaṣṭe mitrāya havyaṃ ghṛtavadvidhema || iyaṃ triṣṭup | dvayorapi mitrādityau devate | anayoḥ krameṇa bhāṣyam | mitrasyādityasyākārasnigdhasya śravo māhātmyaṃ dhyāyāmetyadhyāhāraḥ | śrūyata iti śravaḥ upaniṣatprasiddhaṃ parabrahmarūpamityarthaḥ | kīdṛśaṃ śravaḥ | dyumnaṃ dyotamānam | tathā sānasi samucchritam, citraśravastamaṃ citratamamāścaryatamaṃ śravastamaṃ ca prasiddhatamaṃ sarvajīvātmabhirantaryāmitayādhidaivarūpeṇa cetyamānatvāt | sarvo'pi hi manyate - kenāpyahaṃ preritaḥ karma karomīti | yathoktaṃ 'ajño janturanīśo'yamātmanaḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ | īśvaraprerito gacchecchu vā svargameva vā ||' iti | kīdṛśasya | carṣaṇīdhṛtaḥ carṣaṇayo manuvyāstāndhārayati vṛṣṭyādidvāreṇa adhidaivarūpeṇa, adhyātmarūpeṇa tu caitanyavivartapariṇāmādyātmanā || athottarā mitro janānīti | janānīti liṅgavyatyayaḥ, jāyanta iti janāstānātayati vistārayati kriyāsu pravartayatītyarthaḥ | kiṃ kurvāṇaḥ | na parān prakāśayanneva kriyāḥ kārayati yāvatā vedādirūpeṇa bruvāṇo'pi vidadhat niṣedhaśca | mitraḥ pṛthivīṃ dyāṃ ca dādhāra vyatyayena liṭ dhārayate vṛṣṭyādidvāreṇa | tathā kṛṣṭīrmanuṣyān mitra evānimiṣamanimīlitaṃ kṛtvā abhicaṣṭe ābhimu khyena paśyati kaḥ sukṛtaṃ karoti duṣkṛtaṃ vā yathoktamasmābhirviṣṇustotre 'ravirapi sakalānāṃ karmaṇāṃ sākṣibhūtaḥ |' ityādi | kiṃcana paraṃ vayaṃ mitraṃ dhyāyāmo yāvatāsmai mitrāya sūryāyāgnirūpāya vayaṃ sāyaṃ prātaśca pratidinaṃ havyaṃ havanīyaṃ ghṛtasahitaṃ havirvidhema dadma ityarthaḥ || ita ūrdhvamudakatarpaṇamṛṣivihitamavaśyaṃ kartavyam | tat matabhedena pradarśyate | tatra baudhāyanastāvadāha 'ato'nantaraṃ devatāstarpayati | agniḥ prajāpatiḥ somo rudro'ditirvṛhaspatiḥ sarpa ityetāni prāgdvārāṇi sadaivatāni sanakṣatrāṇi sagrahāṇi sāhorātrāṇi samuhūrtāni tarpayāmi vaśva tarpayāmi | tapano'ryamā bhagaḥ savitā tvaṣṭā vāyurindrāgnī ityetāni dakṣiṇadvārāṇi sadaivatāni sanakṣatrāṇi sagrahāṇi sāhorātrāṇi samuhūrtāni tarpayāmi rudrāṃśca tarpayāmi | mitra indro nirṛtiḥ pūṣā āpo viśve devā brahmā viṣṇurityetāni pratyagdvārāṇi sadaivatāni sanakṣatrāṇi sagrahāṇi sāhorātrāṇi samuhūrtāni tarpayāmi ādityāṃśca tarpayāmi | vasavo varuṇo'jaikapādahirbudhnyaḥ pūṣāśvinau yama ityetāni udagdvārāṇi sadaivatāni sanakṣatrāṇi saṃgrahāṇi sāhorātrāṇi samuhūrtāni tarpayāmi sādhyāṃśca tarpayāmi | brahmāṇaṃ tarpayāmi, prajāpatiṃ caturmukhaṃ tarpa0 parameṣṭhinaṃ tarpa0 brahma pārṣadān tarpa0 brahmapārṣadīśca tarpa0 | oṃ bhūḥ puruṣaṃ tarpa oṃ bhuvaḥ puruṣaṃ ta0 oṃ straḥ puruṣaṃ ta0 oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ puruṣaṃ ta0 | oṃ bhūsta 0oṃ || atha ṛṣayaḥ | śatarcinaḥ mādhyamāḥ gṛtsamadaḥ viśvāmitraḥ vāmadevaḥ bharadvājaḥ vasiṣṭhaḥ pragāthāḥ pāvamānyaḥ kṣudrasūktā mahāsūktāstṛpyantu | vaiśampāyana gandharvebhyaḥ nāgebhyaḥ vainateyebhyaḥ apsarobhyaḥ samudrebhyaḥ pavartebhyaḥ nakṣatrebhyaḥ nakṣatra devatābhyaḥ devamātṛbhyaḥ devapatnībhyaḥ devakanyābhyaḥ vedebhyaḥ vedāṅgebhyaḥ yajñāṅgebhyaḥ divācarebhyo bhūtebhyo namaḥ naktañcarebhyo bhūtebhyo namaḥ ||' atha baudhāyanaḥ 'darbheṣvāsīno darbhāndhārayamāṇaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ sāvitrīṃ sahasrakṛtva āvartayet śatakṛtvo vāparimitakṛtvo vā ' iti | praṇavavyāhṛtiyuktāṃ gāyatrīṃ ca japet | 'tatossūtramādāya tenaiva gaṇayeñjapam | nīcairjapaṃ budhaḥ kuryātsāvitryāstu viśeṣataḥ || sāvitrīṃ jayamānastu svarga gacchati mānavaḥ | śāntyarthaṃ mānasaṃ japyamupāṃśu syācca pauṣṭikam || abhicāre saśabdaṃ tu hyudakprāgdakṣiṇāmukham | dhyāyeta manasā matraṃ jihvauṣṭhaṃ naca cālayet || na kampayecchirogrīvaṃ dantānnaiva pradarśayet | piṇḍīkṛtyendriyagrāmaṃ matrārthadhṛtamānasaḥ || svaravarṇapadavākyaiḥ śuddhamāvartayejapam | daśabhirjanmacaritaṃ śatena ca purākṛtam || triyugotthaṃ sahasreṇa gāyatrī hanti kilbiṣam | vinā darbhaiśca yatnānaṃ yacca dānaṃ vinodakam || asaṃkhyātaṃ tu yajataṃ tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet | hiraṇyadantamaṇibhirjapyaṃ śataguṇaṃ bhavet || sahasraguṇamindrākṣai rudrākṣairayutaṃ bhavet | niyutaṃ prayutaṃ vā syātpadmākṣaistu na saṃśayaḥ || putrajīvakajapyasya parisaṃkhyā na vidyate |' sa eṣa etāmevāharaharahorātraṃ sandhiṣūpatiṣṭhamāno brahmaputro brāhmaṇaḥ śāstramanuvartamāno brahmalokamabhijayati ya evaṃ veda || ' yaṃ dhyāyanti cidātmānaṃ satataṃ japyapūrvakam |. so'stu vaḥ śreyase nityaṃ jagadādirajo'vyayaḥ || iti dvitīyā kāṇḍakā || 1 || tṛtīyā kāṇḍikā | brahmacaryavratasyācāryapūjāvidhidvāreṇāvadhimāha chandasyarthān buddhvā snāsyan gāṃ kārayedācāryamarhayet || 1 || chandasi vede ṛgyajuḥsāmalakṣaṇe matrabrāhmaṇārthavādanāmadheyabhedayukte ye vyavasthitā arthā dvādaśādhyāya nirṇeyāstān buddhā tadyogyatvāt, snāsyan dāraparigrahārthaṃ snātakadharmān grahītumicchan ācāryamadhīṣya gāṃ madhuparkārthaṃ kārayet svadhanaṃ dattvā arhayet | sā madhuparkopayoginī satī gurave dāsyate | ācāryo hi śiṣyāya siṣṇāsave madhuparkaṃ dadāti, śiṣyaśvācāryāya dakṣiṇāmiti kecit | anye tu goprabhavo madhuparko gośabdena vivakṣita iti vyācakṣate | tenācāryamadhīṣya madhuparko meṃ dīyatāmiti madhuparka kārayedityarthaḥ | gṛhītamadhuparkaśca brahmacārī ācāryamarhayeddakṣiṇādinā yathāśaktyā pūjayet | apare tu sūtrabhedena vyācakṣate – chandasyarthān buddhā snāsyan gāṃ kārayedityekam, ācāryamarhayediti dvitīyam | ācāryamadhīṣyādāvātmane gāṃ madhuparkaca dāpayedityādyasyārthaḥ | ācāryeṇa ca pūjito gṛhītadakṣiṇaḥ san brahmacārī paścādācāryamarhayet dakṣiṇādānādinā | brahmacāriṇaṃ hi samyagadhītāvabuddhavedamācāryaḥ pūrvaṃ pūjayatīti | tathāca smṛtiḥ 'taṃ pratītaṃ svadharmeṇa brahmadāyaharaṃ pituḥ | sragviṇaṃ talpa āsīnamarhayetprathamaṃ gavā ||' iti | taṃ brahmacāriṇaṃ, svadharmeṇa śiṣyadharmeṇa, pratītamabhimukhamāgatam, ācāryasya brahmaharaṃ piturdāyaharaṃ, tragviṇaṃ mālādhāriṇaṃ, talpe khaṭṭāyāmāsīnamupaviṣṭaṃ gavā pūjayedācāryaḥ | tasmānahītavidyo guruṇānujñātaḥ snāyāt, snātvā ca bhāryāmadhigacchet | anutsṛṣṭastu vīryaṃ hitvā upāvartate | tathāca śrutiḥ 'indro vai prajāpatau brahmacaryamuvāsa sa vā anutsṛṣṭo vīrya hitvopāvartata || iti | 'ācāryo brahmacāriṇaḥ prajāpatiḥ |' iti ca || 1 || dvividho brahmacārī — upakurvāṇo yo brahmacaryaṃ caritvā snānadāraparigrahādikaṃ saṃśrayate, naiṣṭhiko yo brahmacaryeṇa niṣṭhāṃ gamayati | tatropakurvāṇakasya sāvadhikaṃ brahmacaryamiti tadapekṣayoktaṃ 'chandasyarthān' ityādi | naiṣṭhikāpekṣayā tvidamucyate śrotriyo'nyo vedādhyāyī || 2 || anyo naiṣṭhiko brahmacārī | śrotriyo vedādhyāyī | 'śrotriyaṃśchando'dhīte iti śrotriyaśabdo vedādhyāyini nipātitaḥ | vedādhyāyīti punarvacanamavadhāraṇārthaṃ vedādhyāyyeva na snānādyācarati, nidhanāvadhikamasya brahmacaryavratamityarthaḥ || 2|| ata eva spaṣṭārthamāha na tasya snānam || 3 || tasyānantaroktasya naiṣṭhikasya snānaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ || 3 || tasya yasya tūpakurvāṇakasya snānādikamasti snānakartavyatāmāha athāsya snānaṃ vrajaparihitaṃ prapādya jaṭāśmaśrulomanakhamabhisaṃhārya āpo hi ṣṭheti tisṛbhiḥ snāyāt hiraṇyavarṇā iti ca dvābhyāṃ, śaṃ na iti ca dvābhyām || 4 || gosamūho brajaḥ, tena parihitamadhiṣṭhitaṃ deśaṃ prapādya praveśya prayojaka karturācāryasyāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ | yathāsaṃbhavaṃ jaṭilapakṣe jaṭānāṃ vāpanam, śikhipakṣe keśānām | tena jaṭādikamabhisaṃhāryāpasārya vāpayitvā āpo hi ṣṭhetyādibhistibhiḥ saṃmārjanaṃ kurvantaṃ snāyāt snāpayet majjayet | hiraṇyavarṇā iti dvābhyāṃ dvitīyaṃ majjanaṃ kuryāt, 'śaṃ na āpa' iti dvābhyāṃ tṛtīyam | atra ca śmaśrugrahaṇenauṣṭhoparigatakeśānāmapi grahaṇam | lomagrahaṇena guptasthānagatānāṃ grahaṇaṃ natu vādivṛttīnāmāryaprasiddhivirodhāt || 4 || tatastriḥ snātaḥ pavitrī bhūta idamidaṃ kuryādityāha dyauste pṛṣṭhamiti cchatraṃ dhārayeta ||5|| imamagna iti hiraṇyam || 6 || pratiṣṭhe stho devate mā mā hiṃsiṣṭamiti vārāhyopānahau pratimuñcate || 7 || dvivastroata ūrdhvaṃ tasmācchobhanaṃ vāso bhartavyamiti śrutiḥ || 8 || vaiṇavadaṇḍadhārī nityam || 9 || chatradhārī || 10 || apanthadāyī || 11 || adattaharaṇaṃ pratiṣiddham || 12 || aparayā dvārā niḥsaraṇam || 13 || malavadvāsasā saha saṃbhāṣā || 14 || rajovāsasā saha śayyā || 15|| gurorduruktavacanam ||16|| asthāne smayanam || 17 || saraṇam ||18|| gāyanam || 19 || nartanam || 20 || tasya cekṣaṇam || 21 || atra sūtragaṇe pāṭhakramādarthakramasya balīyastvāt uktānuktapadārthānāmarthavaśena kramaviśeṣayojanā kartavyā | tathāhi triḥsnātasya jalāśayānnādyāderuttīrṇasya caraṇaprakṣālanādayo'nuktāḥ sūtritāśca dhautavastraparidhānādayo yathākrameṇa jñeyāḥ | dyauste pṛṣṭamityādimantreṇa cchatraṃ dhārayeta, yathāvibhavānusāreṇa imamagna ityādinā kaṭakakuṇḍalādi hirayam | pratiṣṭhe stha ityādinā vārāhyopānahau pratimuñcate paridhatte | varāhaśabdo varāhacarmaṇi vartate | varāhacarmaṇā nirvṛtta ityaṇ, tasya 'aṇiñoranārṣayorgurūpottamayoḥ ṣyaṅ gotre iti vyaṅ, 'yaṅaścāpū' vārā ca te upānahau vārāhyopānahau | varāhaḥ sūkaraḥ | varāhopānahau ca rājasūyādāvarthavādādikādavagamyete | anye tu vārāhyaśabdaṃ saṃniveśaviśiṣṭopānadvācakaṃ vyācakṣate catuṣkacchāditavat | apare lakṣayā carmamātramyatvaṃ varṇayanti, nahi kaścidācāryaḥ sūkaracarmamayyāvupāna hau paridadhadṛśyate | kecittu paṭhanti vārāghupānahāviti | tatra vārāhī upānahau iti dve pade | 'chandovatsūtrāṇi bhavanti' iti prathamapadadvivacanasya luk pūrvasavarṇādeśo vā 'supāṃ suluka pūrvasavarṇa' ityādinā | dvivastrota ūrdhvam, ato brahmacaryādūrdhvaṃ dvivastraḥ | brahmacārī kavastra āsīt, mṛgājinaṃ hi tenopari dhāritam, naca tatra loke vastra śabdaprayogo'sti | tataśca vastradvayaṃ vibhavānusāreṇotkṛṣṭaṃ bharta vyam | tathāca śrutiḥ 'tasmācchobhanaṃ vāso bhartavyam' iti | veṇoḥ saṃbandhinaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ dhārayate tacchīlo vaiṇavadaṇḍadhārī | nityamiti natvavaṣṭambhanādyarthitayaiva kadācideveti | evaṃ chatradhārī | apanthadāyī nānyasmai panthānaṃ dadyāt dṛṣṭaprayojanavyatirekeṇa | apathadāyīti tu yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ | yataḥ 'rājñā tu śrotriyāya panthā deyaḥ' iti gautamādibhiruktamataḥ kathamayaṃ śrotriyaviśeṣaḥ sannanyasmai prāṇimātrāya panthānaṃ dadyāt | attaharaṇaṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ - parakīyaṃ yadravyaṃ tatpareṇādattaṃ na gṛhṇīyāt 'na parasvamapaharet' iti śrutyādiniṣiddhatvāt | aparayā dvārā niḥsaraṇam | pratiṣiddhamiti kāṇḍikāntaṃ yāvadanuṣaṅgaḥ | prasiddhamavigarhitaṃ yadvāraṃ, tato'nyayā dvārā aprasiddhayā guptāntaḥ - purādiniḥsaraṇapraveśāya parikalpitayā niḥsaraṇaṃ praveśanaṃ ca pratiṣiddham | malavadvāsāḥ śvapacādiḥ, tena saha saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ pratiṣiddham | tathā rajovāsasā rajakhalayā udakyāparaparyāyayā saha śayanaṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ, snānasya vivāhopakramatvādevamucyate itikartavyatayā hi snānasya vivāhamṛte nāsti prasaktiḥ | gurormānyasya 'vittaṃ bandhurvayaḥ karma vidyā bhavati pañcamī | etāni mānyasthānāni garīyo yadyaduttaram || ityādikasya, duṣṭaṃ paruṣādi vacanaṃ pratiṣiddham | asthāne gurustrījanādau smayanaṃ hasanaṃ pratiṣiddham | evaṃ saraṇaṃ gamanamasthāne rahasyagurujanādhiṣṭhite | evaṃ gāyanaṃ gītaṃ nartanaṃ cāsthāne pratiṣiddham, natūtsavādau samānaśīlamadhyagatasya guptasthāne | tathāca mahāvrate gītavādyanartanakartavyatāvacanam | 'tamudgātā vācayitvā prastotre prayacchati prastotādhvaryaasdhvaryuranyasmai brāhmaṇāya |' ityādivīṇāvādanavacanaṃ śrūyate | yājñavalkyaścāha 'vīṇāvādanatatvajñaḥ śrutijātiviśāradaḥ | tālajñaścāprayāsena yogamārga nigacchati ||' iti | tasya ca nṛttagītāderasthāne'vekṣaṇaṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ natūtsavādau || 'āpo hi ṣṭhā' ityādayo vyākhyātāḥ | hiraṇyavarṇā iti śākhāntarīyatvāt samastāḥ sūtrakṛtā paṭhitāḥ || dyauste pṛṣṭhaṃ pṛthivī sadhasthamātmāntarikṣaṃ samudro yoniḥ | vikhyāya cakṣuṣā tvamabhitiṣṭha pṛtanyataḥ || bṛhatī| aśvastutau viniyuktā | iha cchatrastutāvapi tulyā | tava dyauḥ svargalokaḥ pṛṣṭha pṛṣṭhe upari | pṛthivī sadhasthaṃ samānasthānam | ātmāntarikṣaṃ chatrāvayavino mahattvastutiḥ | samudra udakaṃ yoniḥ kāraṇam 'apsujo'śvaḥ ' iti saṃstavāt aśvayoniḥ sarvasyodakaprabhavatvānnetravastrādeśchatramapi tathā | evaṃ cenmahāprabhāvastvamataścakṣuṣā vikhyāya nirīkṣyābhitiṣṭha ākāma abhibhava | kān | pṛtanyataḥ pṛtanā senā tāmicchanti ye te pṛtanyantaḥ, tān pṛtanyataḥ || imana āyuṣe varcase kṛdhi tigmamojo varuṇa saṃśiśādhi | mātevāsmā adite śarma yaccha viśve devā jaradaṣṭiryathāsat || imaṃ suvarṇālaṅkāramāyuṣe cirajīvanāya, varcase ca dīptaye kṛdhi kuru | he varuṇa tvamapi ojo balaṃ tigmaṃ tīvraṃ samyak saṃpāda | he adite devamātaḥ asmai snātakāya śarma sukhaṃ yaccha prayaccha māteva jananīva | he viśve devāḥ sarvadivaukasaḥ jaradaṣṭirjarāvyāptiyathā yena prakāreṇa asadbhavati, tathā kuruta jarājarjaritaśarīrā yathā saṃpadyāmahe tathā kurutetyarthaḥ || pratiṣṭhe stho devate mā mā hiṃsiṣṭam || he deva upānahau supratiṣṭhe sthaḥ śobhanaprasthāne bhavatam | mā mā hiṃsiṣṭaṃ mama hiṃsāṃ || iti tṛtīyā kāṇḍakā || 3 || atha caturthī kāṇḍakā | athāto'ṣṭācatvāriṃśatsaṃmitam || 1 || vyākhyāsyāma ityadhyāhāraḥ | vratamiti ca prastāvādgamyate | caturṣu vedeṣu yadaṣṭācatvāriṃśatsaṃvatsaraiḥ saṃmitaṃ paricchinnaṃ vratamuktaṃ, tasya pratinidhibhūtaṃ saṃvatsara nirvartyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | yasya vedamadhīyānasya yathākālavihitaṃ vrataṃ na saṃpannaṃ, tena caitatkartavyamadhītavedacatuṣṭayena ca | ata eva traividyakavratamidamucyate | snānādanantaraṃ cāsyābhidhāne prayojanaṃ - snātakabhūtenāpyetatkartavyaṃ prāgvivāhāditi | anye tu yathākālavihitavratasaṃpattāvapi etadvārṣikaṃ vrataṃ tapo'tiśaya siddhyarthaṃ kartavyatayā anena vidhīyate iti vyācakṣate | athaśabdo vratapūraṇārthaḥ | yathoktam 'maṅgale pūraṇe hetāvānantaryādhikārayoḥ | ṣaṭsvartheṣyathaśabdo'yaṃ smṛtaḥ prākprastute'pi ca ||' anyo'picārtho yathāsaṃbhavaṃ yojyaḥ | ataḥ-śabda hetvarthaḥ | yato'dhyayanakāle yathāvihitavratāsaṃpattiḥ kasyacitsaṃbhāvyate, ato hetoḥ pratinidhibhūtaṃ vratāntaraṃ vakṣyāma iti || 1 || tatra vidhiviśeṣaḥ || 2|| ucyata iti śeṣaḥ || 2|| niyameṣvācāryapradhānaḥ syāt || 3 || sthānāsanādikān vakṣyamāṇānniyamān ācārya mādāya kuryāt | ācāryaprādhānyena ca vedaguṇanārthābhyāsāvanuvartete || 3 || nilayārthī yūnabaddhaṃ na praviśet || 4 || śītātapabhīto nilayārthī bhūtvā yūnabaddhaṃ miśraveṇuvīraṇakāṇḍādinibaddhaṃ kuṭīśālāparṇādikavāsaviśeṣaṃ na praviśet || 4 || anilayaḥ syāt || 5|| na kevalaṃ paranirmitamāśrayaviśeṣaṃ na praviśet yāvatā svayaṃ nilayamātramapi na kurvītetyarthaḥ || 5 || yadyevaṃ vātyākarakadṛṣṭyādyupalavāddehabhaṅgaḥ syādityāśaṅkayāha anyatra vṛkṣādvalmīkādvā || 6 || vṛkṣādikamāśrayedityarthaḥ | valmīkaṃ valmībhūmyādi || 6 || nistāntavamityeke || 7 || tanturveṇuriti kecit śītādyupahato vaṃśanirmitavyatirekeyāśrayāntaraṃ viśet | rajjustanturityanye, rajvādibandhairyannirvṛttaṃ śālādi, tattāntavam || 7 || yathoktamekaṃ tu vāsaḥ śāṇī kutapaṃ vā ||8|| yatpūrvamuktamekaṃ vāsaḥ, tadevātrāpi | iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ - iha śāṇī kutapaṃ vā | śāṇī varāsiḥ, na punaḥ kṣaumī prasiddhā, klinnakuṭṭitadarbhanirmiteti tvanye | ajalomanirmitaṃ kutapam || 8 || asya vāsasaḥ parimāṇamāha parimitamuraḥpramāṇamuparijānu || 9 || urasa ārabhya jānunoruparibhāgaṃ yāvalyāmoti tāvatparimitametatkartavyamekameva traividyena | adhyayanakāle tu adhobhāge paṭolikā vāsīdupari tu mārga carma, tacca vāsa iti nocyate loke ityuktam || 9 || caturthakālapānabhakṣaḥ || 10 || 'sāyaṃ prātarmanuṣyāṇāmaśanaṃ devanirmitam |' iti bhojanakālaḥ | tatra prathamadinasya sāyaṃprātarlakṣaṇaṃ kāladvayaṃ dvitīyadinasya ca prātaḥkālaṃ varjayitvā sāyaṃ caturthe kāle bhojanapāne kuryādityeke | ekadina vyavadhā nena ekakālaṃ bhuñjītetyarthaḥ | anye tvāhuḥpīyate iti pānaṃ kṣīratakādi tadeva caturthakāle paścimaprahare bhakṣo'syeti, kṣīrādipānīye bhakṣaśabdo dṛṣṭaḥ 'abbhakṣo vāyubhakṣaḥ' iti || asaṃcayavān || 11 || hiraṇyādi saṃcayaṃ na kurvītetyarthaḥ || 11 || aharaharvā bhaikṣamaśnīyāt || 12 || bhikṣāṇāṃ samūho bhaikṣam | pūrveṇa bhikṣāṇāmapi saṃcayasya pratiṣedhe prāpte pratiprasavo'nena kriyate | pratidinaṃ bhaikṣamaśnīyāt | śarīrāpāṭave tu kadācidekāmapi bhikṣāmaśnīyāt, aṭitumaśaktaḥ saktakaṇikādikaṃ vā | tāvanmātraṃ saṃcinuyādityanenābhiprāyeṇa vāśabdaḥ || 12 || ahastiṣṭhedrātrāvāsīta || 13 || kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge ahaḥ śabdādvitīyā | ahani tiṣṭhedeva ūrdhva evāsītetyarthaḥ | rātrāvāsītopaviśet | atiśrāntaḥ svapyādapi kadācidantarā manāk | atyantasaṃyogābhāvāt dvitīyāvirahaḥ || 13 || ubhayaṃ munivrataḥ syāt || 14 || ubhayamahorātraṃ vāksaṃyamaṃ kuryāt | munīnāṃ vratametat || 14 || strīśūdrapatitarabhasarajasvalairvā na saṃbhāṣayeteti cyavano bhṛguḥ || 15 || bhārgavastu cyavano manyate khyādibhireva na saṃbhāṣeta, natu sarvaiḥ | saṃbhāṣayeteti svārthe 'ṇica 'rāmo rājyamakārayat' itivat | patitātraivarṇikā api | rabhasā apṛṣṭavaktāro bhaṇḍavandiprabhṛtayaḥ | rajakhalāstu ye raktena śarīramavalipya bhojanādikaṃ dāpayanti || 15 || dvādaśarātraṃ vobhayato'māvasyāṃ paurṇamāsīṃ ca || 16 || asamarthāpekṣametat | saṃvatsarasyobhayorārambhasamāptilakṣaṇayoḥ pārśvayordvādaśarātrametasthānāsanavāgyamaprabhṛtikaṃ kuryāt paurṇamāsīmamāvasyāṃ ca | tena saṃvatsaramadhye aṣṭācatvāriṃśadināni bhavanti | upakramopasaṃhārayodaśarātradvayaṃ dvādaśa paurṇamāsyaḥ, dvādaśāmāvasyāḥ || 16 || pālāśyaḥ samidho nityāḥ paridhivṛkṣāṇāṃ vā || 17 || yā brahmacāriṇo nityāḥ samidhaḥ, tā iha pālāśyaḥ | palāśālābhe pratinidhiḥ, pratinidhāne ca paridhivṛkṣāṇāṃ vā, paridhivṛkṣāṇāṃ saṃbandhinyo grāhyāḥ | paridhivṛkṣāśca yūpyāḥ bi'lvakhadirapalāśarohīta kodumbarabadhiraprabhṛtayaḥ | tathāca brāhmaṇaṃ śrutiśca 'vailvo vā khādiro vā pālāśo vā rauhītako vā saumyasvādhvarasya yūpaḥ syāt | audumbaro yūpo bhavati |' 'khādire bhāti pālāśe bhāti rauhītake badhnāti ||' iti | yajñiyā vā sarve paridhivṛkṣāḥ | śrūyate hi paribrāhmaṇam 'tasyendraḥ paridhīnyajñiyemyo vṛkṣemya ājahāra' iti | paridhivṛkṣatvādeva pālāśīnāṃ siddheḥ pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ tāsāṃ nityatvārthaṃ tathāceha nityagrahaṇam | nanu mūlaprakṛtāveva kasmānnoktam | sādhūcyate bhavatā kiṃtu jñāpakārthaṃ bhaviṣyati yathā sādyaska evamuktaṃ madhyamāyāṃ saṃsthitāyāṃ yūpakarmeti, prakṛtau coktamupasatsu yūpakarmeti | tatra kālākāṅkṣāyāṃ satyāṃ vikṛtirapi prakṛtiṃ gṛhṇāti ityetamarthamavabodhayitumevaṃ sūtritavānācāryo virodhābhāvāt | evamanyatrāpi tulyanyāyatvādyojyam | tenāṃhomugbhiḥ samiddāne'pyevaṃ jānīyādeva 'tasyendro yajñiyebhyo vṛkṣebhyaḥ paridhīnājahāra | iti || 17 || medhāṃ mahyamiti pāṇinā mārga dattvā triṣavaṇamahorātramudakopasparśanam ||18|| kuryāditi śeṣaḥ | medhāṃ mahyamaṅgirasa ityādibhirmaṃtraiḥ dvābhyāṃ nābherārabhyordhva brahmadvāraparyantaṃ mārjanaṃ nigharṣaṇātmakaṃ kṛtvā 'nābherūrdhvameva pāṇinā unmārṣṭi ' iti smṛteḥ prātaḥsavane madhyandinasavane tṛtīyasavane iti savanatraye'pi rātribhāgatrayepyevamudakopasparśanaṃ kuryāt | upasparśanamiha snānam | upasparśanaśabdo hyācamanasparśanastrāneṣu dṛṣṭaḥ, 'upaspṛśya svastyayanaṃ bhavati' ityādāvācamane, na kulyādyantarāgamananimittaprāyaścittabhūte sadācārādisiddhe; 'upaspṛśya somamālabheran ' ityatra sparśe; 'ālabhya copaspṛśeyuḥ' ityatrāpyudakācamanamātre; 'rathyādāvupaspṛśet' ityādau snāne | tatra prakaraṇavaśādviśeṣavyavasthā | yathā saindhavaśabdāderaśvalavaṇamanuṣyeṣu | divā vātārkasaṃyogādrātrau nakṣatramārutaiḥ | sandhyayoragnivātābhyāṃ pavitraṃ sarvadā jalam || tatra cāgniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya suvarṇa saṃnidhāyeti vadanti | astamite vasatīvarīgrahaṇavat 'arvai vāk' ityabhedāt agnyabhāve'pi vāgucāryā evaṃ rātrāvācamanādyapi kuryāt || 18 || evaṃ snātvā namo hamāya mohamāyeti cānusavanamagnaye vaiśvānarāya tapāya tāpasāya tapantāya vindave vindāya vasuvindāya sarvavindāya namaḥ pārāya supārāya pārayantāya śāntāya, nama ūrmyāya sūrmyāya, namaḥ cyavanāya bhārgavāya ityetā eva devatāstarpayannudakena || 19 || etā eva devatāstarpayannudakena tarpayannamaḥśabdāvacchinnairmatraiścaturbhirupasparśanaṃ kuryāditi saṃbandhaḥ | āditya evopādhyavacchinno'trānekadevatārūpo'bhimataḥ | tathāca hama ādityo gantṛtvena stūyate | 'dramahammamīmṛgatau' iti hammeḥ rūpaṃ hama iti | 'mīñ hiṃsāyām' ityasya tvapratyaye rūpaṃ chāndasam, mohamāyeti andhakārāpasārakāyetyarthaḥ | tapatīti tapaḥ | tapaścacāreti tāpasaḥ āditya eva prajāpatirūpeṇa stutaḥ | tapyate iti tapaḥ brahmāṇḍādisargaḥ, taṃ tanoti utpādayatīti tapantaḥ 'sarve vidhayaichadasi vikalpyante' iti supo luk | vindate cetayate iti vinduḥ, vindyate cetyate iti vindaḥ cetya cetayitṛrūpaḥ prajāpatistasmai namaḥ | vasu vindate vasuvindaḥ, evaṃ sarvavindaḥ ' tayorviśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ | 'pāratīrakarmasamāptau, pārayatīti pāraḥ | pārayantaṃ tanoti pārayantaḥ | ūrmīnraśmikallolāna rhatīti ūrbhyaḥ | evaṃ sūryaḥ | cayāvayatīti cyavanaḥ | bhṛjjati pācayati bhūtānīti bhṛguḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ bhārgavaḥ - bhānurevātra || 19 || eṣa saṃvatsaraṃ caritvā vimalo vipāpo bhavati || 20 || eṣa brahmacārī snātako vā prakṛtaḥ saṃvatsaramuktaṃ vrataṃ caritvā, vimalo rāgādimalaśūnyo vigatapāpaśca bhavati || 20 || pāpābhāvapradarśanenādhyayanāṅgatvavihitādhyayanakālavratākaraṇanimittaprāyaścittatāmasya saṃvatsaravratasya darśayati sarveṣāṃ vedānāṃ caritabrahmacaryo yadi nānyatkurute || 21 || yadyantaṃ vedādhyayanakāle na kurute, tadāsiṃstatpratinidhibhūte saṃvatsarabate kṛte sati caturṇāmapi vedānāmadhītānāṃ caritabrahmacaryaḥ saṃpayate vrataparipūrṇa vedacatuṣṭayādhyanamasya saṃpadyata ityarthaḥ | ye tu svatatramevedaṃ saṃvatsaravrataṃ traividyakasya tapotiśayārthaṃ varṇayanti, ta evaṃ vyācakṣate - pūrveṇa sahāsyaikavākyatā, eṣa saṃvatsaravrataṃ caritvā sarveṣāṃ vedānāṃ caritavrataḥ san vimalo vipāpaśca bhavati, yadi tanmadhye'nyanniṣiddhācaraṇaṃ na kurute || 21 || sa tu khalu caritabrahmacaryo daśa daśa puruṣānpunāti pūrvāparān ātmānaṃ caikaviṃśam || 22 || tuśabdaḥ phalāntarasamuccaye | khalurniśvaye || 22 vaidikatvaprasiddhi dyotanāya ca phalāntaramāha paṅktiṃ ca yāvadanupaśyati yasyāmupaviśati || 23 || punātītyanuṣaṅgaḥ | yānpaśyati tānapaṅktipāvanānapi paṅgipāvanānkaroti tapobalāt yāṃścaikapayupaviṣṭānna paśyatyapi, tānapi pāvayati 23 samāpta etāsāmeva devatānāmannasya juhoti | dhenurdakṣiṇā || 24 || etasminvrate samāpte, pūrvoktadevatābhyo'nnaṃ juhoti taṇḍulalakṣaṇaṃ sthālīpākaṃ vā | 'chandovatsūtrāṇi bhavanti' iti subvyatyayaḥ | annaśabdo hi kṛte kṛte vipakke ca dṛṣṭaḥ 'heṣibhi nidhanaṃ kuryādannakāmāya' ityakṛtavacanaḥ, 'annaṃ prayoti ghṛtaṃ madhu taṇḍulān' ityādau kṛta'yosnnamaśnīyāt' ityādau vipakavavacanaḥ, canaḥ | trividhamapi brīhitaṇḍulasthālīpākarūpaṃ paryāyeṇa yathāsvaṃ nirvāhyam || medhā māmaṅgiraso medhāṃ saptarṣayo dadhuḥ | medhāmagniśca vāyuśca medhāṃ dhātā dadhātu me || 1 || meghāṃ me varuṇo rājā medhāmanirdadhātu me | meghāmiṃdraśca sūryaśca medhāṃ devī sarasvatī || 2 || yā medhā apsarassu gandharveṣu ca yanmanaḥ | daivī manuṣye yā medhā sā māmāviśatādiha || 3 || śarīraṃ me vicakṣaṇaṃ vā madhumahuhe | niśāmitaṃ niśāmaye mayi śrutam || 4 || yanme'nūktaṃ tadramatāṃ śakeyaṃ yadanubuve | priyāḥ śrutasya bhūyāsma medhayā saṃvidhīmahi || 5 || namo hamāya mohamāya || sayajuṣkaḥ paṃcarcaḥ | aṅgiraso devāḥ mahyaṃ medhāṃ buddhiṃ dadhurdadhatu madarthaṃ kurvantu dadatu vā mahyam | kaśyapādayaśca saptarṣayo medhāṃ dadhatu | tathāgnirvāyuḥ dhātā prajāpatirmedhāṃ me dadhātu | evaṃ rājā varuṇo'gnirindraśca sūryaśca mahyaṃ medhāṃ dadhātu devī ca sarakhatī | tathāpsaraḥsu ca yā medhā sthitā, gandharveṣu ca yat manaḥ sthitaṃ, tadubhayamihaiva mānuṣaśarīre sati māmāviśatāpraviśatu | yā ca manuṣyaviśeṣe daivī amānuṣī medhā, sāpi māmāviśatāt | mama ca śarīraṃ vicakṣaṇaṃ vipaścit sakalakalākovidmastu | vāk sarakhatī trayīrūpā me mama madhumat madhuravipākaṃ svargāpavargādikaṃ phalaṃ duhe dogdhu | yacca mayi śrutaṃ jātaṃ, niśāmitaṃ cāvabuddhaṃ mayāsīt, tat niśāmaye niśāmayeya smaraṇaśaktistatra mamāstvityarthaḥ | yacca mamānūktaṃ guruṇā nigaditaṃ, tadramatāṃ śataśākhaṃ śiṣyapraśiṣyādīn prasaratu phalaparyavasāyi sat | yaccānubuve nigaditumicchāmi, tacchannuyām | tathā vayaṃ śrutasya priyāḥ bhūyāsma śrutamasmākaṃ phaladānaprasādaparamastu | medhayā ca saṃvidhīmahi sambadhyemahi vayam | yajurvyākhyātam || 24 || iti caturthī kāṇḍakā || 4 || atha pañcamī kāṇḍikā | 3 yenādhīyānena yathāvihitavratāni nānuṣṭhitāni, nāpi saṃvatsaravrataṃ paścāt taṃ prati prāyaścittāntaraṃ svatatraṃ vā tapo'ntaraṃ pūrvavatkṛcchrādikamāha atha kṛcchravidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1|| kṛtamakuśalaṃ vihitākaraṇapratiṣiddhasevanalakṣaṇaṃ karma cchradati iti kṛcchraḥ | tathānantarameva vakṣyati 'sarvākuśalamokṣāya' iti | gautamoha 'athaitāṃstrīnkṛcchrāṃścaritvā sarvavedeṣu svāto bhavati, sarveṣu tīrtheṣu svāto bhavati |' iti | trīniti kṛcchramahākṛcchrataptakṛcchrān | kṛtasya pāpasya cchradanaṃ vā kṛcchramiti nirvacanam | varṇalopaśchāndasatvāt kṛcchraśabdasya | tathāca cārāyaṇisūtram 'purukṛte cchacchrayoḥ ' iti puruśabdaḥ kṛtaśabdaśca lupyate yathāsaṃkhyaṃ che che parataḥ | purucchadanaṃ puccham, kṛtasya cchradanaṃ vināśanaṃ kṛcchramiti | dustaraṃ gahanaṃ kṛcchraṃ kaṣṭaṃ duṣkaramityapi | lokaprasiddhaparyāye lipyāpyartho'sya gamyate || kṛcchrasya vidhiḥ prabhāva itikartavyatā kṛcchravidhiḥ, taṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti śiṣyabuddhisamādhānārthamidaṃ vākyam | evamanyatrāpyanusartavyam || 1 || stutyarthamātmārthaṃ cāsya vratasya purākalpārthavādamāha devāso yathācaranvasavo rudrā ādityā marudaṅgirasaḥ purā || 2 || devādīnāmevātra vrate ārṣam | praśastaṃ caitaddevādibhiḥ pāpavimokṣāyānuṣṭhitatvāditi tātparyārthaḥ | devā eva devāsaḥ 'ājjaserasukū| yena prakāreṇa devādaya ācarantaṃ prakāraṃ vakṣyāma ityanvayaḥ || 2 || strīśūdraṃ nābhibhāṣeta || 3|| strīmātraṃ śūdramātraṃ ca na saṃvādayetkṛcchraṃ caran || 3 || devapālakṛtabhāṣyopetāni | naktamāsīta saṃśritaḥ || 4 || kuḍyakāṣṭhādikamālambanamātramāśritaḥ san rātrāvāsītaiva upaviśet śramātiśayanivṛttaye, natu supyāt | evaṃ hi sātiśayaṃ tapo bhavati | atiśrāntastūpaviṣṭa evāntarāntarā manāk svāpaṃ kurvīta śarīrāpāyasyāvaśyavarjanīyatvāt natu śayyāmārohet || 4 || sarvāṇyahāni tiṣṭhet || 5|| dineṣu sarveṣu tiṣṭhedeva, natūpaviśet || 5 || brahmacārī || 6 || brahmacaryacaraṇaśīlaḥ | etena gṛhasthasyāpyadhikāraṃ darśayati || 6 || kṣapāśayaḥ || 7 || yadi śramātiśayamapanodayituṃ manāṅgidrāṃ kuryāt tadā kṣapāyāmeva kuḍyādyavaṣṭambhenopaviṣṭaḥ san, natu kathaṃcidapi divā śayyāyāṃ vā ||7|| madhumāṃsalavaṇaśrāddhāni varjayedavicārayan || 8 || 'akāmopetaṃ madhu na duṣyati' iti vājasaneyakādau yaddṛśyate, tathā.............iti, iti, saindhavaṃ tu na duṣyati |' dattvā tu devaviprebhyaḥ khādanmāṃsaṃ na duṣyati | ' 'vratasthamapi dauhitraṃ śrāddhe yattena bhojayet |' ityādyāgamamavicārayanneva prayatnaviśeṣeṇa madhvādīnyatra vrate varjayet || 8 || gavājinaṃ śāṇīcīraṃ kutapaṃ mārgaṃ vā vāsa ucyate || 9 || gavājinaṃ gocarma | śāṇīcīraṃ varāsikhaṇḍaḥ | mṛgasyedaṃ mārga carma | kutapamuktam || 9 || sarvākuśalamokṣāya maruto'pyācaraṃstathā || 10 || adhyayanakāle vaiguṇyakṛtasyevānyakālakṛtasyāpi samastasyeha janmakṛtasya pūrvajanmavihitasya ca akuśalasya pāpasya karmaṇo mokṣāya || ādityā vrātapatayo vratamālame tadvaḥ prabravīmi tacchakeyaṃ tenardhyāsam || marudaṅgiraso vratapatayo vratamālabhe tadvaḥ prabravīmi tacchakeyaṃ tenardhyāsam || ā me gṛhā bhavantvā prajā ma āmā bhūmā mā prahāsīt svāhā || triṣṭupchandaḥ | mudgalasya bhānyaśvasyārṣam | me mama gṛhā dārā ābhavantu | prajāśca putrā mamābhavantu | yajñaśca vīryavānmāṃ viśatu | tathā devīḥ devyaḥ āpo yajñiyā sammukhamityarthaḥ | ādityā rudrā vasavaśca mama sadasi bhavāḥ sadasyāḥ bhavantu | sahasretyādi vyākhyātam || asaṃkhyātā sahasrāṇi ye rudrā adhi bhūmyām | teṣāṃ sahasrayojanesa dhanvāni tanmasi || 1 || agniprakaraṇe rudrābhidhānāḥ ṣaḍanuvākāḥ paṭhyante 'namaste rudra manyave' ityādyāḥ | tanmadhye ete daśa mantrāḥ | sarveṣu teṣvanuvākeṣu devānāmām | tathāca śrūyate 'rudraṃ vai devā yajñānnirabhajan | sa devānāyatayā āyāmavatyā senayābhiparyāvartata | ete devā bhītā etacchavarudriyamapaśyaṃstenainamaśamayanyacchatarudriyaṃ juhoti tenaitaṃ rudraṃ vitatadhanvānaṃ saṃhateṣu ityarthaḥ teṣāṃ kupitānāmāropitaguṇadhanuṣkāṇāṃ hananodyatānāṃ satāṃ dhanvāni dhanūṃṣi avatanmasi avatanumaḥ idanto masiḥ, avatāritaguṇāni kurmaḥ stutidvārakako praśāntyā sahasrayojane atidūre sthitāḥ sūkṣmasamudrayuktamityāhuḥ rātryādāvavaśyāyādirūpajalapatanadarśanāt, athavā ye samudre'ntarikṣe ca mahati adhi bhavā adhipatitvena vartamānāḥ, teṣāṃ dhanūṃṣi avaropitajyāni dūrādeva kurma iti pūrvavat || ye nīlagrīvāḥ śitikaṇṭhā divaṃ rudrā upāśritāḥ | teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi || 3 || ye rudrā nīlagrīvā aśuklagalāśca divaṃ svargamupāśritāḥ | śeṣaṃ pūrvavat || ye nīlagrīvāḥ śitikaṇṭhāḥ śarvā adhaḥ kṣamācarāḥ | teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi || 4 || ye śarvā rudrā adhaḥkṣamācarāḥ pātālacarāḥ || ye vaneṣu śaṣpijarā nīlagrīvā vilohitāḥ | teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va janān | teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmaṃsi || 6 || ye cānneṣu bhujyamāneṣu, pīyamāneṣu kṣīrādiṣu pracchannarūpeṇāntargatāḥ santo bhoktṛn pātṝṃśca janān vividhyanti tāḍayanti vyathayanti || ye bhūtānāmadhipatayo viśikhāsaḥ kapardinaḥ | teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi || 7 || ye bhūtānāṃ pṛthivyādīnāṃ devaviśeṣāṇāṃ vādhipatayo rakṣakāḥ | viśikhāso muṇḍāḥ | kapardino jaṭilāḥ || ye pathīnāṃ pathirakṣaya aiḍamṛdā yanyudhaḥ | teṣāṃ sahasrayojanesa dhanvāni tanmasi || 8 || ye pathīnāṃ adhvanyānāṃ pathirakṣaya adhvanyāḥ santo rakṣakā ādityarūpā ityarthaḥ | iḍā annaṃ tatsamūha aiḍaṃ, tanmṛganti komalīkurvanti iti aiḍamṛdāḥ | yudhi saṃgrāme yuvanti miśrībhavantīti yavyudhaḥ yoddhāra ityarthaḥ || ye tīrthāni pracaranti sṛkāvanto niṣaṅgiṇaḥ | teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi || 9 || ye tīrthāni pracaranti tapotiśayasiddhaye sṛkāvantaḥ sātiśayabuddhiyuktāḥ, niṣaṅgāḥ khaṅgāstadyuktāḥ || ya etāvanto vā bhūyāṃso vā diśo rudrā vitaṣṭhire | teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'vaṃ dhanvāni tanmasi || 10 || ye rudrā etāvanta iyattayā avaghṛtā, bhūyāṃso vā iyattayā anavadhṛtā diśo vitaṣṭhire dikṣu vividhaṃ sthitāḥ || kadācana starīrasinendra saścasi dāśuṣe | upopennu maghavanbhūya innu te
