yajamānasya bhavasi pratyuta saścasi dāśuṣe | saśrutiranugrahakarmā | dāśuṣe iti dvitīyāsthāne vyatyayena caturthī | dāśvāṃsaṃ dātāraṃ yajamānamanugṛhṇāsi phalena yojayasi | eko nuśabdaḥ kṣipravacanaḥ, dvitīyo niścayārthaḥ | icchabdo'vadhāraṇārtha ekaḥ, upedityatra tu pādapūraṇārthaḥ | ghamannaṃ dhanaṃ ca vidyate yasya sa maghavā | he maghavan dhaneśa te tava devasya dānādiguṇayuktasya sambandhi dānaṃ dīyamānaṃ svargādiphalaṃ bhūyaḥ pracuraṃ kṣiprameva upapṛcyate 'pṛcī samparke' sambadhyate | kena | arthāddāśuṣā yajamānena | 'dāśvānsāhānmīḍhāṃ śva' iti āditye pravṛttaḥ ādityānāṃ sthālīpāke viniyogāt | ādityo vātrendro brahmā prajāpatistasyaiva prakāśavibhavatvāt | 'yuccha pramāde' | he indra tvaṃ samyak pūjitaḥ san na kadācit prayucchasi pramādyasi yajñe phalavaiguṇyādirūpeṇa | yata ubhe devamānuṣajanmanī nipāsi nitarāṃ rakṣasi | he turīya tvaramāṇa caturthagāyatrīpādātmakaparabrahmasvabhāva āditya te tava sambandhi savanaṃ sūyamānaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ karma sūyate'nena phalamiti savanamiti karma, indriyamindradṛṣṭaṃ divi dyusthānamamṛtamamaraṇadharma kamātasthau āsthitaṃ yajamānaṃ tatra prāpayatītyarthaḥ || yadvā yajño devānāṃ pratyeti sumnamādityāso bhavatā mṛḍayantaḥ | ā vordhvācī sumatirvavṛttyādaṃhośvidyā varivovittarāsat ||3|| triṣṭup | ādityadaivatyā | āditya evādityāsaḥ 'ājaserasuk' | bhavatā iti subvyatyayaḥ | mṛḍayanta iti sādhayatītyarthaḥ | kiṃca vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ sambandhinī sumatiḥ kalyāṇī buddhiḥ arvācī abhimukhā satī āvavṛttyāt asmadabhimukhā āvartatāṃ punaḥ punarasmākaṃ kalyāṇī matirbhavatvityarthaḥ | kīdṛśī matiḥ | || adabdhebhiḥ savitaḥ pāyubhiṣṭuṃ śivebhiradya paripāhi no gayam | hiraṇyajihvaḥ suvitāya navyase rakṣā mā kirno aghaśaṃsa īśata || 5 || he savitaḥ adyāsminnahani naḥ asmākaṃ gayaṃ gṛhaṃ paripāhi paripālaya | kaiḥ | pāyubhiḥ pālanaśīlaiḥ pānaśīlairvā raśmibhiḥ | adabdhebhiḥ anupahiṃsitaiḥ | yatastvaṃ hiraṇyajihvaḥ satyavādī, tena suvitāya phalaprasavanāya yajñāya navyase navāya gayaṃ gṛhaṃ rakṣa | kiṃca mā naḥ asmān kiḥ kaścit aghaṃ pāpaṃ śaṃsatītyaghaśaṃsaḥ pāpiṣṭha īśata prābhūt || sāntapanā iṭuṃ havirmarutastajujuṣṭana | yuṣmāko riśādasaḥ || 1 || he marutaḥ idaṃ haviḥ yuṣmākaṃ tattasmāt jujuṣṭana juṣata bhajadhvaṃ ūtī rakṣāścāsmākaṃ kuruta | samyak tāpayanti vighnakāriṇo rakṣaḥprabhṛtīniti sāntapanāḥ | yato riśādasaḥ riśatihiṃsākarmā 'dasu upakṣaye' hiṃsākāriṇāmapakṣayakāriṇaḥ || yo no marto maruto durhṛṇāyustiracittā vo vasavo jighāṃsat | druhaḥ sapāśaṃ pratiṣūmucīṣṭa tapiṣṭhena tapasā hantanā tam || 2 || he marutaḥ yo naḥ asmān marto maraṇadharmā manuṣyo, duṣṭaṃ hṛṇaṃ kāryamapakāraṃ kāmayamānaḥ, tiraḥ nikaṭe vartamānaḥ guptarūpo vā cittā cittena tiraścitto vā aspaṣṭacittaḥ jighāṃsat jighāṃset vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ sambandhī yuṣmānapi vā yo jighāṃset - he vasavaḥ vāsayitāraḥ - anyacca kīdṛśo martaḥ, druhaḥ svabhāvena hiṃsakaḥ - taṃ pratiṣūmucīṣṭa suṣṭhu pratimuṃcata nīta | tathā hantana hiṃsata | kena | tapiṣṭhena tapasā atiśayena tapasā | kīdṛśaṃ tam | sapāśaṃ pāśayati pāśaḥ putradārādiḥ svavargaḥ, saha pāśena vartamānaṃ sapaśubāndhavamityarthaḥ || gṛhamedhā riśādaso maruto māpabhūtana | pramuñcanto no aṃhasaḥ || 3|| gāyatrī | he marutaḥ gṛhamedhā asmākaṃ bhavata gṛhaṃ medhayantīti gṛhamedhāḥ | kīdṛśāḥ santaḥ | riśādasaḥ hiṃsānāṃ kṣayakāriṇaḥ asmān 3 aṃhasaḥ pāpāt pramuñcantaḥ santaḥ | mā apabhūtana asmākaṃ abhibhavaṃ mā kārṣuḥ || prabunayā va īrate mahāṃsi pra nāmāni prayajyavastiradhvam | sahaśriyaṃ damyaṃ bhāgametaṃ gṛhame dhīyaṃ maruto juṣadhvam || 4 || triṣṭup | he marutaḥ etaṃ bhāgaṃ havilakṣaṇaṃ sthālīpākaṃ juṣadhvaṃ bhajadhvam | gṛhamedhīyaṃ gṛhadevatārha prayājānuyājahīnam | etena ca bhāgena prayajyavaḥ ijyamānāḥ santaḥ asmabhyaṃ dayaṃ damanārha abhinavakarituragaprabhṛtikaṃ pratiradhvaṃ dadata sahaśriyaṃ kanakamaṇimuktākalāpādilakṣmīyuktam | mahāṃsi ca tejāṃsi nāmāni ca 'yajvāno mī dhārmikāḥ satputrāḥ ' ityādīni pratiradhvam | yato bune bhavā bujhyā bhūmiloke vartamānā janā vo yuṣmān pra īrate prerate upasarpanti yuṣmadadhīnāḥ siddhivityarthaḥ || krīḍaṃ vaśśardho mārutamanarvāṇaṃ ratheśubham | kaṇvā abhipragāyata || 5 || riśādasaḥ hiṃsānāṃ kṣayakāriṇaḥ asmān 3 aṃhasaḥ pāpāt pramuñcantaḥ santaḥ | mā apabhūtana asmākaṃ abhibhavaṃ mā kārṣuḥ || prabunayā va īrate mahāṃsi pra nāmāni prayajyavastiradhvam | sahaśriyaṃ damyaṃ bhāgametaṃ gṛhame dhīyaṃ maruto juṣadhvam || 4 || triṣṭup | he marutaḥ etaṃ bhāgaṃ havilakṣaṇaṃ sthālīpākaṃ juṣadhvaṃ bhajadhvam | gṛhamedhīyaṃ gṛhadevatārha prayājānuyājahīnam | etena ca bhāgena prayajyavaḥ ijyamānāḥ santaḥ asmabhyaṃ dayaṃ damanārha abhinavakarituragaprabhṛtikaṃ pratiradhvaṃ dadata sahaśriyaṃ kanakamaṇimuktākalāpādilakṣmīyuktam | mahāṃsi ca tejāṃsi nāmāni ca 'yajvāno mī dhārmikāḥ satputrāḥ ' ityādīni pratiradhvam | yato bune bhavā bujhyā bhūmiloke vartamānā janā vo yuṣmān pra īrate prerate upasarpanti yuṣmadadhīnāḥ siddhivityarthaḥ || krīḍaṃ vaśśardho mārutamanarvāṇaṃ ratheśubham | kaṇvā abhipragāyata || 5 || he prakṛtā marutaḥ vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ sambandhi śardhaḥ balaṃ krīḍaṃ krīḍayatvasmān | kaṇatiḥ śabdakarmā, kaṇantīti kaṇvā vāyavaḥ yūyameva mārutaṃ marutāṃ sambandhi śardhaḥ pragāyata kayata yādṛśaṃ taditi | kīdṛśaṃ śardhaḥ | ratheśubhaṃ rathavimānādīnāmanukūlaṃ gamane, tathānavīṇaṃ liṃgavyatyayaḥ | anarva apracyutamityarthaḥ || atyāso na ye marutaḥ svañco yakṣadṛśo na śubhayanta maryāḥ | te harmyeṣṭhāḥ śiśavo na śubhra vatsāso na prakrīḍinaḥ payodhāḥ || 6 || triṣṭup | antatyā aśvāḥ | naśabdaḥ sarvatropamārthīyaḥ | ye marutaḥ aśvā iva svañcaḥ śobhanagatayaḥ, ye ca yakṣadṛśa iva śubhayantaḥ śubhamicchantaḥ samyagavalokanaṃ kurvanti yakṣā yajvānaḥ maryā martyāḥ, te harmyeṣṭhā bhavantu yajñamaṇḍapasthā bhavantu tatra krīḍantvityarthaḥ | śiśava iva śubhrā anāhāryaśobhāyuktāḥ | prakrīḍanaśīlā vatsā iva vatsāsaḥ, ata eva prakrīḍanaśīlāḥ | payodhāḥ payo dhayanti pivanti ye te payodhāḥ abhinavāḥ | te hi prakrīḍanaśīlā bhavanti vatsāḥ śiśavaśca || tvāmane aṃgiraso guhā hitamanvavindañchiśriyāṇaṃ vane vane | sa jāyase mathyamānaḥ saho mahattvāmāhuḥ sahasasputramaṃgiraḥ| he tvāmaṃgirasaḥ guhāhitaṃ aṃgāreṣu guptamanvavindan lebhire vane vane śiśriyāṇaṃ teṣāṃ vanaspatyādīnāṃ vaneṣvāśritam | saho mahat mahatā sahasā balena mathyamānastvaṃ jāyase | yasmātsa tvamevaṃbhūtaḥ, tasmāttvāmṛṣayaḥ sahaso balasya putramāhuḥ | aṃgiraḥ aṃgāreṣu jātaḥ || vāyuragregā yajñaprīssākaṃ ganmanasā yajñam | śivo niyudbhiḥ śivābhiḥ || vāyureva sarvadevatānāmagre gacchati yasmāt, tasmātsa eva prathamaṃ yajñaprīḥ yajñe prīyate tarpyate | tena 'aṃgirobhyo dīyamāne haviṣi tanmadhye vāyave'pi havirdīyate' iti liṃgāḍāyorapi devatātvaṃ pratīyate yato vāyureva manasā sākaṃ saha yajñaṃ gat gacchati | śivaḥ śāntaḥ | rūpeṇa yajñopakāriṇā niyujyante iti niyutaḥ aśvāḥ tābhiraśvābhistulyaṃ kṛtvā gacchati || havyavāhamabhimātiṣāhaṃ rakṣohaṇaṃ pṛtanāsu jiṣṇum | jyotiṣmantaṃ dataṃ purandhimagniṃ sviṣṭakṛtamāhuvema || vayamagnimāhuvema āhvayāmaḥ havyavāhaṃ yo devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca havyaṃ vahati tam | abhimanyate iti abhimāḥ śatruḥ, taṃ prasahate abhibhavati yastamabhimātiṣāham | rakṣasāṃ hantāram | pṛtanāsu parasenāsu jayanaśīlam | jyotiṣmantaṃ jvālākarālam | dīdyutaṃ atiśayena dyotamānam | puraṃ samūhaṃ dhatte dhayati vā purandhistam | yajanamiṣṭaṃ, śobhanamiṣṭaṃ karotīti sviṣṭakṛt tam || vastūṃstarpayāmi rudrāṃstarpayāmi ādityāṃstarpayāmi marudaṃgirastarpayāmi || vasavo vratapatayoṃ vratamacāriṣaṃ tadaśakaṃ tadvaḥ prabrūmastanno gopāyata || rudrā tapatayo vratamacāriṣaṃ tadaśakaṃ tadvaḥ prabrūmastanno gopāyata || ādityā vrātapatayo vratamacāriṣaṃ tadaśakaṃ tadvaḥ prabrūmastanno gopāyata || marudaṅgiraso vrātapatayo vratamacāriṣaṃ tadaśakaṃ tadvaḥ prabrūmastanno gopāyata || he vasavaḥ vāsayitāraḥ vratapatayo vratasya pālayitāraḥ yuṣmatprasādādahaṃ vratamacāriṣaṃ caritaṃ sampāditaṃ mayā vratam | tadvratamahamaśakaṃ yuṣmatprasādādaśaknavaṃ śaktiṃ pāritaṃ mayā vratamityarthaḥ | tattasmādvayaṃ vaḥ yuṣmān brūmaḥ tadvratamāmākīnaṃ vrataṃ yūyaṃ gopāyata rakṣata | etenaivānyadapi mantratrayaṃ vyākhyātam || iti aṣṭamī kāṇḍakā || 8 || atha navamī kāṇḍikā | varṣāsu śravaṇenādhyāyānupākaroti ||1|| atra 'antevāsināṃ yogamicchan' iti vakṣyamāṇaṃ sambandhanīyam | yadyadadhyayanādhyāpanāṃgaṃ smaryate, tattatkila vaktavyam | upākaraṇaṃ cādhyayanādhyāpanayorapyaṃgam | tathāca 'antevāsināṃ yogamicchan' ityato'dhyetuḥ phalasambandhaḥ pratīyate | 'amuṣmai kāmāyāyuṣe tvā' ityataśca mantraliṃgādupākartrācāryeṇa prayujyamānādvayorapi śiṣyācāryayoraviśeṣeṇa phalaṃ pratīyate | tatra traividyakatvasiddhyarthaṃ vedādhyayanāṃbhūtāni vratāni pratipāditāni | adhītavedasyāpi ca śiṣyasyāṃgopāṃgagrahaṇārthaṃ gurorvāsa iṣyate śilpādiśikṣārthaṃ ca | tathāca smṛtiḥ 'kṛtaśilpo'pi nivasetkaṃcitkālaṃ gurorgṛhe | antevāsī...|| ityādi | tatrāntevāsināṃ yogaṃ samvandhamicchannācārya upākaraṇaṃ vedānāṃ kuryāt | upākaraṇaṃ khīkaraṇaṃ, manasā saṃkalpanaṃ, etatsthānakaviśeṣādi mayā asmai śiṣyāya pravaktavyamiti | śiṣyo hi śilpāṃgopāṃgaparijñānāyāpi gurau vasan sthānaka viśeṣādikamapi guroḥ sakāśādadhīte, tamadhyāpayatā guruṇā upākaraṇaṃ kartavyam | śiṣyo yadi kasmaicidadhyāpayati, tadā tenāpi kartavyam | so'pihi śiṣyasya guruḥ | naca vaktavyaṃ śiṣyasyācāryavṛttitvānnānādrahmacāriṇi gurau kathaṃ vṛttistasya bhojanāstaraṇādidānasāmarthyābhāvāditi, yato bhaikṣavṛttitvamapyānām | sambhavati ca traividyakasya brahmacāriṇo'pi dhanaviśeṣaprātyā jñānādinā vā svaśiṣyapoṣaṇasāmarthyam| tasmātenāpyupākaraṇaṃ. kartavyaṃ yathāsaṃbhavam | śrāvabhādrapada māsau varṣāḥ | tatra yat prathamameva śravaṇanakṣatraṃ, tatraivopākaraṇaṃ kartavyaṃ prathamaparityāge kāraṇābhāvāt 'prathamaṃ vā niyamyeta kāraṇādatikramaḥ syāt' iti nayena | kiṃ kurvatā | antevāsināṃ sāṃgopāṃgādiśikṣārthaṃ gurau nivasatāṃ yogaṃ sambandhamadhyāpayitradhyāpyalakṣaṇamicchatā antevāsinaśca prajñātiśayasambandhamicchateti phalato vyākhyā || 1 || sa juhoti 'apavā nāmāsi tasyāste joṣṭrīyaṃ gameyamahamiddhamedhaspari medhāmṛtasya jagṛhurahaṃ sūrya ivājani svāhā' rantirnāmāsi, yuktirnāmāsi, yogo nāmāsi, ityuttarāstisraḥ | tasyāsta iti sarvatrānuṣajati || 2 || sa juhoti ya upākaroti 'apanā nāmāsi' ityādibhiryajurbhiḥ | anyāstisraḥ | eteṣu yajuṣuḥ prathamamatrasthaṃ 'tasyāste' ityetadanuṣajyate vākyaparipūraṇasāmarthyāt anuṣaṃgo vākyasamāpti sarveṣu tulyayogitvāditi nayena | tena 'rantirnāmāsi tasyāste' ityādīni trīṇi vākyāni bhavanti | samastapāṭhaḥ śākhāṃtarīyatvāt || 2 || yuje svāhodyuje svāhā yuktyai svāhā yogāya svāhetyantevāsināṃ yogamicchan || 3 || antevāsināṃ yogamicchanniti pratyekaṃ sambadhyate || 3 || 'dadhikrāvṇa' iti trirdadhi bhakṣayitvā darbhapāṇiḥ sāvitrīṃ triranvāhāditaśca trīnanuvākān 'kastvā yunakti' iti ca || 4 || 'dadhi krāvṇa ' iti mantraḥ sakṛt | dadhibhakṣamevāvartate triḥ | sāvitrī savitṛdaivatyā tatsaviturityādikaiva mahāprabhāvatvāt | nānyā 'ākṛṣṇena rajasā' ityādikā | ādāvāditaḥ ye trayo'nuvākaḥ 'iṣe tvā' ityādirekaḥ, 'devasya tvā' ityādirdvitīyaḥ, 'vasoḥ pavitramasi' ityādistṛtīyaḥ | ‘kastvā yunakti' iti vāśvamedhe paridhiniyojane niyuktaḥ | ubhayatrānvāhetyanuṣaṃgaḥ || 4 || tasyānadhyāyaḥ || 5 || tasyādhyāpayituradhyetuścānadhyāya ucyate ||5|| na vidyotamāne na stanayati || 6 || vartamānanirdeśāttātkālikametadanadhyayanam | vidyotamāne vaidyute tejasi | stanayati garjati meghe || 6 || ākālikaṃ devatumulaṃ vidyuddhanvolkā ||7|| ākālikaṃ samānakālamucyate | ya evādiḥ sa eva cedanto bhavati, tasya vacane ākālikśabdo nipātitaḥ 'ākālikaḍādyantavacane' iti sūtreṇa, ṭakāro ṅībarthaḥ | ākālikī vidyut, ya evopakra makālaḥ, sa eva vināśakālo vidyuta ityarthaḥ | evamihāpi yasminprathamārdhapraharādau devatumulādikamutpadyate sa tasyādikālaḥ sa eva dvitīya divase'ntakālo bhavati etadākālikaśabdenoktam | etaduktaṃ bhavati yāvati kāle devatumulādikamutpadyate, tāvatyeva kāle dvitīyadivase'dhyayanayogyatā bhavati antarā tvanadhyāyaḥ | ye tvākālikaśabda 'na vidyotamāne na stanayati ākālikam' ityevaṃ pūrveṇa sambandhayanti, yāvaddevatumulādi śrūyate tāvanmātrakālaṃ cānadhyayanamiti vyācakṣate; teṣāmuttaratrāhorātrikamanadhyayanaṃ śabdataḥ prayojyaṃ, vartamānanirdeśalabdhasya ca punarvacanaṃ punarutam | tatrāntarikṣe gītavādyātmakaṃ gandharvādikṛtaṃ devatumulam | vidyuditi vidyutpāto vivakṣito'trāhorātrādikādhyayanāvasare, dhanvaśabdenāpīndradhanurvarṣā kālādanyatra | varṣāsu tātkālikatvaṃ sadācārarūḍham | ulkayāpi mahatyā ulkāyāḥ pāto vivakṣitaḥ | tārakāmātrapatane'pi hyulkāśabdaprayogo'sti || 7 || ācāreṇānye || 8 || anye'pyanadhyayanahetava ācārādhyāyoktā anusartavyāḥ bhūkampacandrārkoparāganṛpatimahāpuruṣapramayaprabhṛtayaḥ || 8 || tadyathā atyakṣarāḥ śabdāḥ santatavalīkaprasrāvāḥ || 9 || atikrāntā akṣarāṇi atyakṣarāḥ śabdāḥ nirghātahuṃkāratalāsphoṭanaprabhṛtayaḥ | santatasya valīkasya prastrāvo, natu prasrāvamātraṃ tasya prāyeṇa bhāvāt | etadvayamākālikasyānadhyayanasya nimittam || 9 || ardhapañcamānmāsānadhītya paṃcārdhaṣaṣṭhānvotsṛjate, utsṛjāmahe'dhyāyān prativiśvasantu chandāṃsi, kastvā vimuñcatīti ca || 10 || ardha paṃcamo yeṣāṃ te'rdhapaṃcamā māsāḥ sārdhacatvāraḥ| evamardhaṣaṣṭhāḥ sārdhapaṃca | māsānuktavidhinādhītyādhyayanārthaprayojakavyāpārādhyayanaṃ nirvartya adhyāpyeti yāvat, utsṛjate adhyāyān utsargasaṃkalpanaṃ karotītyarthaḥ naca vedādhyayanasya tyāgo'sti, anadhyāyaviśeṣebhyo'pivā utsarge madvayasambandhamāha 'utsṛjāmahe ' ityādi || 10 || tasyānadhyāyo'māvasyāṃ pakṣiṇīṃ nādhīte || 11 || ayamanyo'nadhyāyaḥ | pakṣāvilobhayapārśvavartitayā amāvasyāyāścaturdaśī pratipañca | yadyapi - cācārādhyāye dve paurṇamāsyau he amāvasye iti caturdaśīsahite paurṇamāsyamāvasye ukte, tathāpi pratipadvidhānārthā punaḥ śrutiḥ | taduktaṃ 'guṇāna punaḥ śrutiḥ' iti || 11 || nāta ūrdhvamabhreṣu || 12|| ata utsargādūrdhvamabhradarśanamātre'pi sati nādhyetavyaṃ, kā kathā vidyotamānādiṣu || apanā nāmāsi tasyāste joṣṭrīyaṃ gameyamahamiddhamedhaḥ pari medhāmṛtasya jagṛhurahaṃ sūrya ivājani khāhā || rantirnāmāsi, yuktirnāmāsi, yogo nāmāsi, yuje svāhā udyuje svāhā yuktyai svāhā yogāya svāhā || brāhmī vidyā devatā | pavate svarūpāccayavate iti pavā adhruvā, tatpratiṣedhena apavā dhruvā vidyā | kecidapveti paṭhanti tatrāpyayamevārthaḥ | apanā nāmāsi nityānandā, tasyāstava sambandhi yadedhaḥ iddhaṃ rūpaṃ, tadahaṃ gameyaṃ prāpnuyām | iddhamedha iti punarvacanamanāditvakhyāpanārtham | kīdṛśamedhaḥ | joṣṭrīyamatiśayena sevanīyam | etasya amṛtasya maraṇarahitasya brahmamayasya vidyārūpasya medhāṃ parijagṛhurvipaścitaḥ medhāvanto vidyāsvarūpaṃ brahma lebhire ityarthaḥ, athavā ṛtasya satyasya brahmaṇo medhāṃ parijagṛhurvipaścitaḥ | ataścāhamapi sūrya ivājani sūrya ivāhamuttamaprakāśo brahmarūpanikaṭaḥ syā mityarthaḥ | svāhā suhutamastu || ramate kīḍati jagadvivartādinā iti rantiḥ brahmamayī vidyā | yujyate loke vivartapariṇāmaśaktibhiriti yuktiḥ | evaṃ yogo, yuk, udyagityādi vyākhyeyam | punarvacanaṃ stutyartham || dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣaṃ jiṣṇoraśvasya vājinaḥ | surabhi no mukhā karatpra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat || anuṣṭup | asyāśca ṛcaḥ surabhimatīti nāma | tathāca śrutiḥ 'ṛtvijo yajamānāśca surabhimatīmṛcamanvāhurvācameva punate ' iti | anyatrāśvasaṃskārottarakālamṛtvigyajamānayordadhibhakṣaṇasamayādāviyamabhyarthanā ihāpi yathāyogyatvaṃ yojayitavyā | krāmatīti kāvā | jayanaśīlo jiṣṇuḥ | vyātyarthasya aśnoteraśvaḥ, vejanavānvājī anyatrāśvaḥ, iha tu prajāpatiḥ| yatkāvṇo jiṣṇoraśvasya vājinaḥ aśvasya saṃskārakāle aślīlābhibhāṣaṇena mukhāṇyapavitrībhūtāni dadhidanā pavitrāṇi akāriṣaṃ vyatyayenaikavacanaṃ uttaratra ca karat loḍartheleṭ 'itaśca lopaḥ parasmaipadeṣu' iti terikāralopaḥ 'leṭossicau' ityaḍāgamaḥ karotu | kiñca aśvaḥ prajāpatirvā asmāka māyūṃṣi pratāriṣat prataratu karotu | ' tṛplavanataraṇayoḥ sthānaṃ gacchati urvantarikṣaṃ vīhi || he caraṇayugalaka uru vistīrṇamantarikṣaṃ vīhi gaccha || darbhastamvaṃ triḥ parilikhati indrasya pariṣūtamasi || he darbhastamva tvamindrasya kṛte paripūtaṃ 'ruṣa riṣa hiṃsārthaḥ ' te tava samācchettā lavitā ṛddhiṃ mā riṣat mā hiṃsīt yajñasādhanaśaktiṃ mācchaitsīdityarthaḥ | ṛddhyeti vyatyayena tṛtīyā || chinnaśeṣāṇi bhūmilagnāni punaḥ prarohaṇasamarthāni sahasraśākhāḥ viruhema vardhimahi || bandhanārthaṃ rajjuṃ karoti adityā rāsnāsi || asi tvaṃ adityāḥ pṛthivyā rāstā rajjuḥ || barhiḥ sannahyati indrāyāḥ sannahanaṃ pūṣā te granthi praśnātu sa te mā samavasrāvaṃ samavasrutya vā yasmādvā prāgudīcīrāpo nirdraveyuḥ pratyagudīcīrvā tasminprāgdvāraṃ dakṣiṇadvāraṃ vā śaraṇaṃ kārayet || 1 || adhyāhitāgniṃ vakṣyati | navaṃ anyānupayuktadārvādinirmitam | navāvasānaṃ avasānaṃ bhūpradeśaḥ navapradeśamityarthaḥ | samamanimnonnatam| samūlaṃ praśasta krīḍākusumādimūlayuktam | samavasrāvaṃ samo'vasrāvo yatra tatsamavasrāvaṃ, udakaṃ prakṣiptaṃ yatra samaṃ kṛtvā sravati sañcarati, tatsamavasrāvaṃ, atiraścīnamityarthaḥ | samavasrāvaṃ yadbhūmaṃḍalaṃ tasminniti saṃbandhaḥ | samavasrutya vā yasmātprāgudīcyaḥ āpo nirdraveyuḥ, pratyagudīcyo vā nirhareyuḥ nirgaccheyuḥ | athavā pratīcīmudīcīṃ vā yatrāpo gacchanti, tasmiṃstiraścīne'pi śaraṇaṃ kārayet || 1 || madhyamāyāḥ karte prāgagrodagagrāndarbhānāstīrya teṣu sthūṇāmavadadhāti || dhruvāṃ sinomyamṛtasya patnī kṣeme tiṣṭha ghṛtamukṣamāṇā | tāṃ tvā sthūṇe sarvavīrāḥ suvīrā ariṣṭavīrā iha saṃviśema || ihaiva sthūṇe amṛtena rohāśvāvatī gomatyamṛtāvatī sūnṛtāvatī | ūrjasvatī payasvatī cāsmānsthūṇe payasābhyāvavṛtsva || ā tvā kumārastaruṇa ā vatso jagatā saha | ā tvā parisrutaḥ kumbha ā dadhnaḥ kalaśairayamiti || 2|| madhyamāyāḥ sthūṇāyāḥ stambhasya sambandhini karte 'kṛtī cchedane' kṛtyate iti kartaḥ khātaḥ gartastasmin prāgagrānudgagrānvā svastikasanniveśabhājo darbhānāstīrya, teṣveva darbhedhvadhikaraṇabhūteṣu sthūṇāṃ stambhaṃ madhyamamavadadhāti prakṣipati || prakṣepe cedaṃ mantratrayamāha dhruvāmityādi kṛtvā sinomi prakṣipāmi garte | tvaṃ hi amṛtasya amaraṇadharmakasya patnī pālayitrī | ataḥ kṣeme tiṣṭha kṣemanimittaṃ tiṣṭha | kiṃ kurvatī | ghṛtamukṣamāṇā dadatī ghṛtagrahaṇaṃ sarvasampadupalakṣaṇārtham | yata evaṃbhūtāsi, atastāṃ tvāṃ he sthūṇe vayamāviśeme tyāśāsmahe | praviṣṭāśca santastvadāyattaṃ gṛhamihaiva janmani sarvavīrāḥ bahuputrāḥ, suvīrāḥ suputrāḥ, ariṣṭavīrāḥ anupahiṃsitaputrāśca syāma || 1 sthūṇe ihaiva sthāne amṛtenāvināśinā rūpeṇopalakṣitā satī roha rūḍhā bhava | kīdṛśī satī | aśvāvatī aśvayuktā | evaṃ gomatī | amṛtaiśca gṛhamānuṣairyuktā satī | sūnṛtaṃ satyaṃ vaidikaṃ ca karma yāgādikaṃ, tadvatī | ūrjasvatī 'ūrja balaprāṇanayoḥ' prāṇayantī balavatī vetyarthaḥ | payasvatī kṣīravatī | sarvasamṛddhiyuktamasmadṛhaṃ kurvityarthaḥ | ata evāha 'asmānsthūṇe payasābhyāvṛtsva' he sthūṇe asmān payaḥprabhṛtinā ābhimukhyena vartamānena āvavartayakha || kiṃca tvāṃ karmabhūtāṃ kumārastaruṇa āviśatu, vatsaśca āviśatu | ekavacanaṃ vyatyayena bahuvacanasthāne | jagatā jaṃgamena garbhavāsādinā parisrutaḥ parivṛto dugdhasya kumbhastvāviśatu ayaṃ dadhnaḥ kalaśaiḥ saha || 2 || prāñcaṃ vaṃśaṃ samāropayati ṛtena sthūṇāmadhiroha vaṃśogro virājannapasedha śatrūn | athā rayiṃ sarvavīrā vayanta iti || 3 || matramāha ṛtena sthūṇāmiti virāṭ | he vaṃśa ṛtena satyena apātinā rūpeṇa tvaṃ sthūṇāmadhiroha stambhasyopari tiṣṭha | kīdṛśaḥ| ugraḥ anabhibhavanīyaḥ san viśeṣeṇa rājamānaḥ| anyañca apasedha nāśaya śatrūn ātmīyān sthitipratibandhahetubhūtān, āsmākāṃśca | stambhādhiṣṭhātrī devataivamabhidhīyate | evaṃ ca śatrūn asmadarīṃścābhibhūya niścintaṃ gṛhādhitara tvayi sthite sati, athā anantaraṃ tava vayameva sarvavīrāḥ bahuputrayuktāḥ rayiṃ dhanaṃ bhaviṣyāmaḥ pratidinaṃ havirdānena vayameva hi svabhūtāḥ | itiśabdo mantrasamāptipratīkaḥ | madhyamavaṃśastambhayoḥ mantraviniyogāditarastambhavaṃśānāmamantrakaṃ tūṣṇīmevārohaṇaṃ śasyate || uttarapūrvaṃ samādhānam || 4|| 'prāñcaṃ vaṃśaṃ samāropayati' iti 'prāgdvāraṃ dakṣiṇadvāraṃ vā śaraṇaṃ kārayet' iti coktam | tatra prāgdvāratāpakṣe pūrvāgratā vaṃśasamādhānasya bhāvayitavyaitadarthamidaṃ sūtram | samādhānaṃ samyagādhānaṃ vaṃśasyāropaṇaṃ kuḍyakoṭiṣu || iti ekādaśī kāṇḍikā || 11 || atha dvādaśī kāṇḍikā 'amī vahā vāstoṣpate' iti catasṛbhirvāstoṣpatīyasya sthālīpākasyeṣṭvātha vāstvāviśet || 1 || atha vivāhe kṛte vaivāhanānau praveśite'nantaramadhyāhitāgniko vāstvāviśet || vasantyasminniti vāstu gṛham | kiṃ kṛtvā praviśet | vāstoṣpatīyasya sthālīpākasyeṣṭvā | vāstorgṛhasya patiradhiṣṭhātrī devatā vāstoṣpatiḥ mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsupo'luṅipātanam| vāstopatirdevatā yasya sa vāstoṣpatīyaḥ 'vṛddhācchaḥ' vyatyayena ṣaṣṭhī sthālīpā ke neṣṭrā, avayavāvayavisambandhena vā, nahi samasto'sau hūyate bhakṣyasaṃrakṣaṇāt | nanu ceṣṭrā āviśedityuktamayuktaṃ praviśya yajanāt ? satyaṃ, kintvadhyavasāpaurvakālyena netre sammīlya hasatītyādivat | yājayitveti vā ṇijartho yojanīyaḥ | nirvāpasyāmatrakasyeṣṭatvāt 'amī vahāḥ' ityādinā ' catasṛbhiḥ' ityantena śiṣyahitārthaṃ catasraḥ paṭhitvārpayati || amī vahā vāstoṣpate viśvā rūpāṇyāviśan | sakhā suśeva edhi naḥ || 1 || vāstoṣpate pratijānīhyasmānsvāveśo'namīvo bhavā naḥ | yattvemahe prati tanno juṣasva śanno bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade || vāstoṣpate prataraṇo na edhi gayasphāno gobhiraśvebhirindo | ajarāsaste sakhye syāma piteva putrānprati no juṣasva || 3 || vāstoṣpate śagmayā saṃsadāte sakṣīma hiraṇvayā gātumatyā | pāhi kṣema uta yoge varanno yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ || 4 || prathamā gāyatrī | anyāstriṣṭubhaḥ | vāstoṣpatirantarikṣativāsī vāyuḥ, yadvā prāṇaḥ | he vāstoṣpate gṛhasvāmin viśveṣāṃ sarveṣāmasmatparijanānāṃ rūpāṇi svarūpāṇi āviśan adhitiṣṭhan amī amūn parijanānāvaha prāpaya pūrvametāneva gṛha praveśaya | prathamaṃ parijanasya gṛhapraveśamanujānīhi paścādasmākamiti bhāvaḥ | evamevānutiṣṭhanno'smākaṃ sakhā mitraṃ supraveśanīyo bhava || he vāstoṣpate pratijānīhyasmān gṛhapatiḥ paramaḥ san asmānapyavāntarakhāmitayāṃgīkurvityarthaḥ | khāveśaḥ sukhapraveśaśca no'smākaṃ bhava | tathānamīvo vyādhiśūnyo'smākaṃ bhava | kiṃca tubhyaṃ kiñcidmo havirādikaṃ, tanno 'smākaṃ sambandhi juṣasva bhajakha | tathā śaṃ sukhaṃ no bhava dvipade mānuṣarūpe, catuṣpade gavāśvādike || he vāstoṣpate naḥ asmākaṃ prataraṇaḥ prakarṣeṇa saṃsārasāgarakleśataraṇaḥ edhi bhava | 'asa bhuvi ' loṭ, sipi hyādeśaḥ 'hujhalbhyo' iti dhitvaṃ 'dhvasoreddhāvabhyāsalopaśca' | gayasphānaḥ gayaṃ gṛhaṃ gṛhe sphītaḥ san gobhiraścaiśva sahitaḥ he indo parameśvara te tava sakhye vartamānā vayamajarāsaḥ ajīrṇāḥ syāma | tvaṃ ca no'smānpratijuṣasva prīṇīhi | ka iva kān | piteva putrān || he vāstoṣpate yā tvāṃ saṃsadāte sevate vibhūtistayā vayamapi sakṣīma 'ṣaca samavāye' yujyemahi | kīdṛśyā | śagmayā sukharūpayā, hiraṇvayā tiramaṇīyayā hiraṇyayuktayā vā, gātumatyā kīrtirūpagānayuktayā udgātṛgītayutayā ca | yaccāsmākaṃ kiñciramutkṛṣṭaṃ tvatprasādopanataṃ, tatsarvaṃ pāhi rakṣa | kiṃ kurvan | alabdhalābhātmake yoge, prāptaparirakṣaṇarūpe ca kṣeme vartamānaḥ | utaśabdaścārthe | kiṃvā viśeṣeṇa vāstoṣpatireva prārthyate | he gṛhadevatāḥ evaṃ sarvā eva yūyaṃ no'smān svastibhiravināśaiḥ ḥ pāta rakṣata sarvakālam || 1 || vaṃśodvīkṣaṇikānbrāhmaṇānbhojayet ||2|| tasmin gṛhe brāhmaṇān bhojayet | tasya ca karmaṇo vaṃśodvīkṣaṇikamiti nāma | te hi vaṃśānudvīkṣamāṇā bhuñjate || 3 || iti dvādaśī kāṇḍikā || 12 || atha trayodaśī kāṇḍikā | atha pākayajñāḥ || 1 || sahadharmacāriṇyā sārdhaṃ yo gṛhapraveśaḥ, tadnantaraṃ pākayajñāḥ kartavyāstadanuṣṭhānāvasaralābhāt | pāka nirvartyā yajñāḥ pākayajñāsteṣāmāsūtraṇamātramiha kriyate, vistareṇa te vakṣyante || caturvidhaḥ pākayajño bhavati huto'hutaḥ prahutaḥ prāśitaśceti || 2|| bahuvacanenopakrāntānāmihaikavacanaṃ yajñatvasāmānyāpekṣayā ekasyaiva cāturvidhyaṃ pratyakṣasyeva cākṣuṣādibhedeneti pradarśanāya | caturṇāmevāvāntarabhedāḥ ṣaṭ | yānāha gautamaḥ 'aṣṭakāḥ pārvaṇaśrāddhaṃ śrāvaṇyāgrahāyaṇī caitrī āśvayujī ca |' iti 'ṣaṭpākayajñasaṃsthāśca' iti | tatra huto havananirvatrtyo vaiśvadevādiḥ | ahutastvahavana sādhyo balyupahārādiḥ | yasya tu prārambhe havanaṃ, sa prahuto'nvaṣṭakādiḥ | prakṛṣṭenāśanena nirvartyate yo'tithibrāhmaṇabhojanādiḥ, sa prāśitaḥ | sarvavāyaṃ yāgo devatoddeśena dravyasaṃkalpanāt || huto hutānām || 3 || prakṛtiriti śeṣaḥ | ihatyānāṃ hutānāṃ vaidiko homaḥ prakṛtirityarthaḥ | yataḥ itikartavyatopajīvyate, sā prakṛtiḥ | yopajīvati, sā vikṛtiḥ | tathāca vaiśvadeve prākṛtāḥ samūhanaparyukṣaṇaparistaraṇasvāhākārānnaprakṣepādayaḥ kriyāḥ kriyante || 3 || upahāro'hutānām || 4|| vaidika upahāro'tratyānāmupahārāṇāṃ prakatiḥ | atropaniviṣṭaramāstīryāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā srajo gandhāṃścopahṛtya dhūpaṃ pradāya balyupakalpanamiti itikartavyatā || 4 || piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ prahutānām || 4 || vaidikaḥ piṇḍapitṛyajño'tratyānāṃ prahutānāṃ prakṛtiḥ | vaiśvadevaśeṣapiṃḍapratipattitvāttadīyapiṇḍamantrā grāsāsanadānādayaśca taddharmā bhavantyatideśāt || 4 || madhuparko brahmaudanaśca prāśitānām ||5|| prāśitā dvividhā atithibhojanadānātmāno brāhmaṇabhojana vitaraṇātmānaśca | tatrātithibhojanādāvasyātithye vaidiko yo madhuparkaḥ, saprakṛtiḥ | tatra ca śrotriyāṇāṃ pādyārghyamadhuparkapūrva māṃsapradhānaṃ bhojanamityādirvidhyantaḥ | devatāviśeṣoddeśena tu brāhmaṇabhojanadāne ādhānavihito brahmaudanaḥ prakṛtiḥ, tatrāpi bahiryukteṣvāsaneṣu upaveśanaṃ arghyadānādikaṃ saghṛtamannaṃ devatāyai saṃkalpya 'prāśnantu bhavantaḥ' ityanujñānapūrvakaṃ cāśanamityādiritthaṃbhāvaḥ ||5|| darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtayaḥ pākayajñāḥ ||6|| sādhāraṇetikartavyatātideśī'yam | asādhāraṇāstu pūrvamitikartavyatā nidarśitāḥ ||6|| dārśapaurṇamāsike vidhyate aviśeṣeṇa prāpte kacidapavādamāha teṣvāvṛdupacārastūṣṇīm || 7 || āvṛt kriyā | upacāro'nuṣṭhānam | tūṣṇīṃ nirvāpāvaghātādikriyānuṣṭhānamamantrakamityarthaḥ || anarthaluptam || 8 || yahutārthaṃ niṣprayojanaṃ tatprakṛtau dṛṣṭamapi na kartavyaṃ vikṛtāvamatrakamapi | yathā peṣaṇakapālopadhānādi sthālīpāke niṣprayojanam | evaṃ sāmidhenīnāṃ luptatvāt samidādhānaṃ lutārthatvānna kartavyaṃ prayājābhāvāccopabhṛt | sāmidhenyādyabhāvastu vakṣyamāṇātparisaṃkhyānāt | nacaitāvatā darvi homagṛhame dhīyādivadapūrvatvaṃ pākayajñānāṃ kiṃ darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtitvābhidhāneneti vācyaṃ juhūhomādidharmopajīvanāt || 13 || iti trayodaśī kāṇḍikā || 13 || atha caturdaśī kāṇḍikā | udagayane bhāryāṃ vindeta || 1 || " snātvā bhāryāmadhigacchet" iti snānānantaraṃ bhāryānveṣaṇakālaḥ | bharaṇamarhatīti bhāryā 'arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca' iti ṇyat | vindeta labheta paśyedityarthaḥ | udagayane ādityasya dakṣiṇadigbhāgāduttaradigbhāgābhimukhagamane sati uttarāyaṇa ityarthaḥ || 1 || nakṣatrāṇyāha kṛttikāsvātipūrvairvarayet || 2 || kṛttikā ca svātiśca pūrvāṇi ca tairvarayet kaṃcitprayuñjīta natu svayaṃ vṛṇuyādityaucityaṃ ṇicā darśayati || 2 || lakṣaṇinā lakṣaṇāni parīkṣayet ||3|| hastādilakṣaṇavedinā lakṣaṇāni śubhasūcakāni parīkṣayet | pāṭhakramādarthakramasya balīyastvādyathārthaṃ kramo jñeyaḥ - lakṣaṇaparīkṣaṇapūrvakaṃ varaṇamiti || 3 || lakṣaṇālābhe parīkṣāyāḥ karaṇāntaramāha bhāgadheyamapi vā piṇḍaiḥ parīkṣayet ||4|| apiśabda upāyāntarābhyupagame | vāśabdo vikalpe | piṇḍairvā bhāgyāni parīkṣayet bhartaryanukūlatvāpādanāni pūrvoktālābha ityarthaḥ || vedyāḥ sītāyā hṛdādgoṣṭhādādevanādādahanāccatuṣpathādiriṇātsaṃbhāryaṃ navamam | ṛtameva parameṣṭhyṛtaṃ nātyeti kiñcana | ṛta iyaṃ pṛthivī śritā sarvamidamiyamasau bhūyāditi || 5 || yajñārthī vediḥ prasiddhā | sītā halokhātā bhūmiḥ | aśoṣyaḥ padmādyākaro jalāśayo hṛdaḥ | goṣṭhaṃ gavāśrayo gokulādiḥ | ādīvyantyasminnādevanaṃ kitavasthānam | ādahyante'sminnityādahanaṃ śmaśānam | svastikākāreṇa sambadhyamānaṃ mārgadvayaṃ catuṣpathaḥ | iriṇaṃ ūṣarapradeśaḥ | etebhyaḥ pratyekaikaṃ piṇḍaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | saṃbhāryaṃ ca navamam, vedyādibhyo leśaṃ leśaṃ mṛdaḥ saṃbhṛtya, navamaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ || vedyādibhya uddhṛtānāṃ piṇḍānāmanumantraṇe matramāha ṛtameveti | itiśabdaḥ sarvapratīkārthaḥ | parameṣṭhī prajāpatiḥ | ṛtaṃ satyaṃ nātyeti nātivartate kimapi | ataḥ so'tra sannihito bhūtvā satyaṃ dyotayatu | iyamapi vedyādirūpā pṛthivī ṛte āśritā | asāvityukte nāma pratīyāt | kanyā ucyate asau śobhāvatyādisaṃjñitā | iyaṃ pratyakṣatvena vartamānatvāt | idaṃ bhūyaḥ satyaprakāśayoḥ || 5 || kanyāyā nāma gṛhītvā sarvataḥ kṛtalakṣaṇānpiṇḍānpāṇāvādāya kumāryā upanāmayedeteṣāmekaṃ gṛhāṇeti brūyāt pūrveṣāṃ caturṇāmekaṃ gṛhṇatīmupayacchet || 6 || vedisatāhṛdgoṣṭhoddhṛtānāmanyatamaṃ gṛhṇīyācedodvahedenām, itaragrāhiṇīṃ tu varjayet | 'vedipiṇḍe hi vedārthakriyā sāhāyyamāvahet | prajāvatīti sītāyāṃ goṣṭhapiṇḍe gavādikam || idapiṇḍe hradodbhūtakusumābharaṇocitā | tṛptidā caityahetuśca bhartṛjīvanakāriṇī || śmaśāne vidhavāvaśyaṃ dyūtabhūmau kalipriyā | iriṇe nityasaṃtaptāvakīrṇā ca catuṣpathe ||' sambhāryamapītyeke || 7|| manyante ityadhyāhāraḥ | gṛhṇatīmupayacchedityanuṣaṃgaḥ || 7 || rohiṇī mṛgaśiraḥ śraviṣṭhottarā ityupayame || 8 || upayamaḥ svīkāraḥ, tatraivānukūlāni nakṣatrāṇi etānītyarthaḥ || yadvā puṇyoktam || 9 || puṇyoktaṃ jyotiḥśāstroktaṃ yathāsambhavamanusartavyamityarthaḥ || iti caturdaśī kāṇḍikā || 14 || atha pañcadaśī kāṇḍikā | atha brāhmadeyāyāḥ pradānavidhiṃ vakṣyāmaḥ ||1|| brāhmena vidhinā yā dīyate sā brāhmadeyā | tasyāḥ prakṛṣṭe dāne vidhimitikartavyatāṃ vakṣyāmaḥ | athetyadhikārārthaḥ | brāhmo daiva ārṣaḥ prājāpatya āsuro gāndharvo rākṣasaḥ paiśāca ityaṣṭau vivāhāḥ | tatra brāhmāsuravyatirekiṇāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ vidhānaṃ suprathitaṃ neha vacanamarhati | tena brāhmāsurayorevetikartavyatoktā | tathāhi prasahyāpahārāt rākṣaso vivāhaḥ, tatra kiṃ prakārābhidhānena | evamasaṃvijñātopagamātyaiśāco'pi prakāravacanānarho'tipāpatvāt | svayamicchantyā sahecchāvataḥ saṃyogo gāndharvaḥ, tatrāpyasādhāraṇetikartavyatā | saha dharmaścaryatāṃ, sahāpatyamutpādyatāṃ dharme cārthe ca kāme ca na vyabhicaritavyamiti prājāpatyavidhiḥ prathitaḥ | alaṃkṛtya kanyāntarveda ṛtvije pradīyate, iti daivo vivāha uktaḥ smṛtikāraiḥ | gomithunaṃ kanyāvate dadyādityārṣasya vidhānam ||1|| śuklapakṣasya puṇyāhe parvaṇi vodagagrāndarbhānāstīrya teṣūpaviśataḥ prāṅmukhaḥ pratigrahītā sāmātyaḥ pratyaṅmukhaḥ pradātā || 2 || śuklapakṣasya sambandhini praśaste jyotiḥ - śāstraviśuddhe divase parvaṇi vā paurṇamāsīrūpe, viṣṭaraviśeṣe pavitrārthamuttaradigagrāndarbhānāstīrya, teṣu tayordātṛpratigrahītrorupaviśet prāṅmukho bhūtvā | kaḥ | pratigrahītā | kīdṛśaḥ | sāmātyaḥ parijanasahitaḥ | pradātā punaḥ pratyamukha upaviśet tathaiva sāmātyo darbhānāstīryodayān || 2 || madhye prāgagrodagrāndarbhānāstīrya teṣūdakaṃ sannidhāya vrīhiyavānupya dakṣiṇata udaṅṅāsīna ṛtvigupayamanaṃ kārayet || 3 || tayordātṛpratigrahītrordakṣiṇadeśe uttarābhimukha upaviṣṭaḥ san ṛtvigviśeṣaḥ ācāryastayoḥ upayamanaṃ dātṛpratigrahītusambandhaṃ kārayet | kiṃ kṛtvā | dātṛpratigrahītrormadhye prāgagrānudāṃśca darbhānāstīrya, teṣu ca darbheṣu kāṃsyapātryāmudakaṃ sannidhāya tatrodakamadhye brīhiyavasyāvapanaṃ kṛtvā | atha 'udakaṃ sannidhāya' iti sāmānyavacanātkaṃsasya kuto lābhaḥ ? 'kaṃse hiraṇyaṃ samupya' iti darśanāt ||3|| sameteṣvāha dadānīti pratigṛhṇāmīti trirāvedayate || 4 || sameteṣu saṅghaṭiteṣu dātṛpratigrahītṛvandhuṣu satsu ṛtvigbrūyāt, dātustāvadidaṃ brūyāt kanyāsmai pradīyatāmiti, pratigrahītuḥ kanyāsmātpratigṛhyatāmiti | tato dadāni te dadāni te, dadāni te iti triruccārayeti dātāraṃ bodhayet | dātā ca tathaiva kuryāt | evaṃ pratigṛhṇāmi ityapi ṛtvijāveditaḥ pratigrahītā brūyāt | 'triḥsatyā hi devāḥ' iti śrutiḥ, 'trirabhihitaṃ na vyabhicāri bhavati' iti triruccāraṇamiṣṭamata evaṃ sameteṣvāhetyuktam | bahujanasannidhau dattāṃ pratigṛhītāṃ ca nāpahartuṃ tyaktuṃ vā śakṣyatīti || 4 || etadvaḥ satyamityuktvā 'samānā vaḥ' 'saṃ vo manāṃsi' iti ṛtvigubhau samīkṣamāṇo japati || 5 || etaddānapratigrahakarma yuṣmākaṃ satyamavyabhicaritamastviti laukikoktyā ṛtvika 'samānā' ityādi ṛgdvayaṃ japati, ubhau dātṛpratigrahītārau vīkṣamāṇaḥ || samānā va ākūtāni samānā hṛdayāni vaḥ | samānamastu vo mano yathā vaḥ susahāsati || 1 || saṃ vo manāṃsi saṃvratā samu cittānyākaram | abhī ye vivratāḥ sthana tānna sannamayāmasi || 2 || anuṣṭubhau | he dātṛpratigrahītārau vaḥ yumākaṃ sambandhīnyākūtānyabhiprāyāḥ samānāstulyānyekarūpāṇi āsati santu, kasyacidapi kanyāpahārādyabhiprāyo duṣṭo mābhūdityarthaḥ | evaṃ manaḥ samānamastu, ahaṃ ca vo yuṣmākaṃ tathā ā akaraṃ karomi japena, yathā susaha asati suṣṭhu vaḥ sahabhāvo bhavati, tathā manāṃsi samākaraṃ, vratāni ca saṃmilitāni karomītyarthaḥ | evaṃ cittāni caitanyāni samākaramiti yojyam | ye ca yuṣmākaṃ madhye vitratā viruddhācārāḥ yūyamiti kecit, amī iti pratyakṣaṃ tāneva mukhavikārādinā durācārāndarśayati, sthana bhavatha, tānna sannamayāmasi netivarṇopajanaḥ tānvayaṃ sannayāmaḥ samyak natān kurmaḥ sadācārān saṃpādayāma ityarthaḥ || 5 || iti pañcadaśī kāṇḍikā || 15 || atha ṣoḍaśī kāṇḍikā | āsuravivāhavidhimāha atha śulkadeyāyāḥ || 1 || pradānavidhirucyate iti śeṣaḥ | śulkena mūlyena dīyate yā, sā śulkadeyā || 1 || hiraṇyaṃ vyatiharataḥ || 2 || suvarṇa vijigīṣayā parasparaṃ dadato dātṛpratigrahītārāvasuratvāt, dasyuvijigīṣupradhānatvāccāsurāṇāṃ rājasatvenānyonyopacāraṃ kuruta iti śasyate | kanyāmūlyabhūtaṃ tu suvarṇaṃ vyatiharato niścinuto dvau dātṛpratigrahītārau sambhūyetyarthadvayaṃ tatreṇāvagamyate || 2 || prajābhyastveti pradadāti || 3 || tatprakṛtaṃ hiraṇyaṃ prajābhyastvetyanena dadāti varaḥ kanyāyāḥ pitre, he hiraṇya prajārthaṃ tvāmahaṃ dadāni || 3 || rāyaspoṣāya tveti pratigṛhṇāti ||4|| kanyāyāḥ pitā | rāyaspoṣāya tvāṃ pratigṛhṇāmi || 4 || kaṃse hiraṇyaṃ samupya 'hiraṇyavarṇāḥ' iti catasṛbhiḥ samavamṛśante || 5 || tatkanyā mūlya bhūtaṃ hiraṇyaṃ pratigṛhītaṃ kāṃsyapātre nidhāya jalayuktaṃ 'hiraṇyavarṇāḥ' iti ṛgbhiścatasṛbhiḥ samavamṛśante upaspṛśanti ghorapāpaviśuddhaye | vahuvacanaṃ sarvabaṃdhvapekṣaṃ sarveṣāṃ pāpabhāgitvapradarśanāya | hiraṇyavarṇā ityādyāḥ saṃmārjanāvasare vyākhyātāḥ || 5 || prajābhyastvā dadāni | rāyaspoṣāya vā pratigṛhṇāmi || ityetāvantāveva matrau kecitprayuñjate vākyaparisamāpteriṣe tvetyādivat, anyamate tu prajābhyastvānuprāṇantu tvaṃ ca prajāḥ anuprāṇihīti prathamasya, suprajārthaṃ ca vīryārthaṃ ca tvāmahaṃ pratigṛhṇāmīti dvitīyasya śeṣaḥ || iti ṣoḍaśī kāṇḍakā || 16 || atha saptadaśī kāṇḍikā | atha vivāhamāha gaudānikairmantraiḥ kanyāmalaṅkṛtya catuṣpāde bhadrapīṭhe prāgāsīnāyāścatasro'vidhavā mātā pitā ca guruḥ saptamastāṃ sahasracchidreṇa pavitreṇa snāpayitvāhatena vāsasā pracchādya sthālīpākasya juhotīndrāyendrāṇyai kāmāya bhagāya hriyai śriyai lakṣmyai puṣṭyai viśvāvasave gandharvarājāya svāheti || 1 || pāṭhakramādarthakramasya balīyastvāttadanusāreṇa vyākhyā kartavyā yathā jātaṃ janinā juhoti jātamatiprāṇitīti, tathāgnihotreṇa juhoti yavāgūmadhiśrayatīti | tenāyamarthaḥ - pādacatuṣṭayayukte bhadrapīṭhe śobhane āsane prāmukhyā upaviṣṭāyāścatasṛṣu dikṣu catasro'vidhavā bhavanti, vāmabhāge mātā, dakṣiṇabhāge pitā, agre guruḥ saṃskārasya kartā saptamaḥ | teṣu yathāsaniveśaṃ sthiteṣu godāne bhavā gaudānikāstanmantraistāṃ guruḥ kanyāṃ sahasracchidrayuktena pavitreṇa pāvanena vastraviśeṣeṇa suprajastvāya gaudānikaireva matraiḥ kaṭakakeyūrādibhiryathāvibhavamalaṃkṛtyāha tenānupabhuktena vāsasā pracchādya sthālīpākena gururjuhoti | atra pallavacatuṣṭayaṃ vastrasya pavitrasya catasro'vidhavā avaṣṭananti | pitarau jalamabhiṣiñcataḥ | gururmantrapāṭha karoti | snāpane'laṃkaraṇe ca gurureva prayojakakartā, tena homena samānakartṛkatvam| ye tvalaṃkaraṇaṃ viparītalakṣaṇayā keśavapanaṃ vyācakṣate, amāṅgalikāste | sthālīpākasyetyupādīyamānagatatvādekatvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ paśugataikatvavat | juhotītyekavacanaṃ eka eva homo navasvapyāhutiṣu, iti pratyabhijñānabalena sūcayati, tenaivāhutīrnigaditi | viśvāvasave gandharvarājāyetyevāhutistena nava bhavanti | indraḥ parameśvaraḥ | indrāṇī śacī | kamanīyaḥ kāmaḥ | bhajanīyo bhagaḥ | hīrlajjā | śrīḥ śrayaṇīyā | lakṣaṇīyā lakṣmīḥ | poṣaḥ puṣṭiḥ | svāhā suhutamastu || 1 || nāḍīṃ tūṇavaṃ mṛdaṅgaṃ paṇavaṃ sarvāṇi ca vāditrāṇi gandhodakena samupalipya kanyā pravādayate 'svanaṃ vada dundubhe suprajastvāya gomukha | prakrīḍayantu kanyāḥ sumanasyamānāḥ sahendrāṇyā kṛtamaṃgalāḥ ||' iti || 2 || nāḍyādīni sarvāṇi vāditrāṇi gandhodakena sugandhinopalipya pūrvaṃ kanyaiva pravādayate | vādyamāneṣu ca gurumaṃtraṃ paṭhati | tatra nāḍī vaṃśaḥ, tūṇavo gomukho vādyaviśeṣaḥ | maṃtrārthastu he dundubhe paṭaha svanaṃ vāyuṃ vada vāḍhya śabda kāraya | kimartham | suprajastvāya satprajārtham | evaṃ he gomukha khanaṃ vadeti pūrvavat | prakrīḍantu anyonyaṃ kanyāḥ sakhibhūtāḥ prakrāntavivāhayā kanyayā sahitāḥ | tā api hi kanyā eva bha vitumarhanti samānaśīlānāṃ sakhitvasyānyonyāntaratvāt | kīdṛśaḥ kanyāḥ | sumanasyamānāḥ sumanaskā hṛṣṭā ityarthaḥ | indrāṇyā saha indrāṇyapyatrotsave krīḍitumavataratvityāśāsyate | sumaṃgalā maṃgalapradhānagītaghoṣiṇyaḥ || atha gaudānikamaṃtrā vyākhyāyante yā āpo divyāḥ payasā saṃbabhūvuryā antarikṣyā uta pārthivāsaḥ | tāsāṃ tvā sarvāsāṃ rucābhiṣiṃcāmi varcasā || abhi tvā varcasāsicaṃ yajñena payasā saha | yathāso mitravardhanastathā tvā savitākarat || indrāya svāhā || pūrvā virāṭ | uttarānuṣṭup | yā divyā divi bhavā āpo, yāśca antarikṣyā antarikṣe bhavāḥ, yāśca pārthivāsaḥ pārthivyaḥ, payasā sambabhūvuḥ kṣīreṇa yajñopayoginā sambhūtāḥ, tāsāṃ sarvāsāṃ rucā dītyā varcasā ca sāreṇa bana he kanye tvāmabhiṣiñcāmi tvāmahamabhyasicamabhiṣiñcāmi yajñena payasā varcasā saha yajñādiyogyāṃ ca karomītyarthaḥ 1 mitrasya mehanasya svargapaśuputrāderasau yajñādeśva vardhano yathā bhavati, tathā savitā āditya akarat tava karotu he kanye | indrāya suhutamastu || 2 || iti saptadaśī kāṇḍikā || 17 || atha aṣṭādaśī kāṇḍikā | yajñiyasya vṛkṣasya prāgāyatāṃ śākhāṃ sakṛdācchinnāṃ sūtratantunā pracchādya sāvitreṇa kanyāyai prayacchati 'yā te'lakṣmīrmātṛmayī pitṛmayī saṃkrāmaṇī sahajā vāpi kācittāṃ tiṣyeṇa saha devatayā nirbhajāmi nirṇudāmi sā dviṣantaṃ gacchatu tiṣyabṛhaspatibhyāṃ namo namaḥ' iti ||1|| yajñamarhati yajñiyaḥ 'yajñarvigbhyāṃ ghakhanau' iti ghaḥ, yajñārhāṇāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ vaṭādīnāmanyatamasya sambandhinīṃ śākhāṃ sakṛdācchinnāṃ sūtratantunā prācyāṃ diśyāyatāṃ prasṛtāṃ sakṛdekenaiva prahāreṇa chinnāmekasāreṇa sūtratantunā pracchādya kanyāyai prayacchati 'devasya tvā' ityādinā 'tāṃ prayacchāmi' iti śabdāntena || gururgṛhītaśākhāṃ kanyāmanumantrayate ' yā te ' ityādinā | he kanye yā te tava kācidalakṣmīralakṣaṇaṃ mātṛmayī pitṛmayī vā mātuḥ piturvā sakāśāsaṃkrāntā bījādidoṣāt anyato vā kutaścit saṃkrāntā, tāmahamanena matreṇa nirbhajāmi tvāṃ prati nirbhāgāṃ karomi | kimekakaḥ | netyāha tiṣyeṇa devatayā sahakṛtaḥ, tathā nirgudāmi niḥśeṣeṇa nudāmi apasārayāmi | sā cāpasāritā satī dviṣantaṃ tava śatruṃ gacchatu | alakṣaṇāpasāre codyatasya mama vighnāpasāraṇāya tiṣyabṛhaspatibhyāṃ namaskāro'stu | anye tu 'tiṣyabṛhaspatibhyāṃ namo namaḥ' ityetaṃ yajurekadeśamācchidya śākhotsarge'pi prayuñjate || tasyā utsargaḥ sthāvarodake śucau vā devatāyatane || 2 || sthāvarodakaṃ taḍāgādi | tatra tasyāḥ śākhāyā utsargaḥ pratipattikarma śucau devagṛhe | devagṛhaṃ madyopahāraśoṇitādinā apavitramapi sambhāvyeta, tadarthaṃ śucigrahaṇam || iti aṣṭādaśī kāṇḍikā || 18 || atha ekonaviṃśī kāṇḍikā | athāto haviṣyakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ || 1 haviṣyakalpa iti pāribhāṣikī karmaviśeṣasya saṃjñā || 1 || daśavārṣikaṃ brahmacaryaṃ kumārīṇāṃ dvādaśavārṣikaṃ vā || 2 || varṣadaśakādūrdhva kumārī na sthāpayitavyā pitrā, agatyā vā dvādaśa varṣāṇi nātikramaṇīyāni || 2 || brahmacaryānte gandharve devakule vā dvāvagnī prajvālya dvau paśū upākarotyaryamṇe dakṣiṇaṃ prājāpatyamuttaram || 3 || brahmacaryāvasāne vivāhātpūrvaṃ gandharve nirni mittajalasrāviṇa deśe, devatāyatane vā laukikau dvāvagnī prajvālya, dvau paśu cchāgau kanyāsaṃskārārthamupākkuryātpaśukalpavat, ekamaryamṇe dakṣiṇabhāgavartinyagnau, dvitīyaṃ prajāpataye uttaradigbhāgavartinyagnau | itikartavyatāṃ samantravyākhyānāṃ paśukalpe eva vyākhyāsyāmaḥ || asambhave tvekapaśuḥ || 4 || pracurādyabhāve eka eva dvidaivataḥ paśurupākartavyaḥ | avadānāni ca hṛdayādibhyo medo'ntebhyo dvādaśabhyo dvirdvirgrahītavyāni | 'aryamaprajāpatibhyāṃ svāhā' iti cohaḥ | eka eva ca yogaḥ saṃhatayorekadeśatvadharma samavāyāt | ata evaca kecit hṛdayādibhyo dviguṇāni avadānāni necchanti || 4 || taṇḍulairvā kuryāt || 5 || dhanadaurgatye sati ahiṃsāniyame vā taṇḍulairvā kuryāt | taṇḍulagrahaṇaṃ piṣṭārtham || 5 || yathāsthānaṃ paśuryathāsthānamavadānāni tathā haviḥ || 6 || yatraiva sthāne ājyabhāgābhyāṃ pūrvo mukhyapaśuḥ, tatraiva piṣṭakapaśuḥ, avadānānyapi hṛdayādibhyastadvat | teṣāṃ ca śrapaṇahomau sarvadānyāpītikartavyatā raśanābandhayūpaniyojano pāyena viśasanādiḥ | luptārthavarja haviḥ paśupuroḍāśasthāne sthālīpākastadapi yathāsthānaṃ paśupuroḍāśakrame, vapāhomasthāne tvājyahomaḥ || agniṃ somaṃ varuṇaṃ mitramindraṃ bṛhaspatiṃ skandaṃ rudraṃ vātsīputraṃ bhagaṃ bhaganakṣatrāṇi kālīṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ bhadrakālīṃ pūṣaṇaṃ tvaṣṭāraṃ mahiṣikāṃ ca gandhāhutibhiryajeta || 7 || sugandhacandanaghanasārādidravyayutenājyenāhutayo gandhāhutayaḥ, tābhiramyādikāḥ saptadaśa devatā yajeta | vātsīputra iti devatānāma yataḥ śabdaikasamadhigamyā devatā | vibhaktivipariṇāmena caturthyantaiḥ svāhākārayuktaiḥ śabdairuddiśyāmyādidevatā yaṣṭavyāḥ 'agnaye svāhā' ityādikaiḥ || iti ekonaviṃśī kāṇḍakā || 19 || atha viṃśī kāṇḍikā | athāto haviṣyapuṇyāhaḥ || 1 || iyamapi pāribhāṣikī saṃjñā | haviṣyeṇa vrīhyādinā puṇye'hani kriyamāṇatā śabdapravṛttinimittam || 1 || udakāntaṃ gatvā yathopapatti vā payasi sthālīpākaṃ śrapayitvā sarvagandhaiḥ phalottaraiḥ saśiraskāṃ snāpayitvāhatena vāsasā pracchādya sthālīpākasya juhotīndrāṇī varuṇānī gandharvāṇyudakānyagnirjīvaputraḥ prajāpatirmahārājaḥ skando'ryamā bhagaḥ prajānaka iti || 2 || udakasya samīpaṃ gatvā atidūrataḍāgādike tu grāme, yathopapatti yatropapadyate sthāne, tatra kṣīre sthālīpākaṃ kṛtvā māṃgalikavilvākṣoṭādiphalopetābhiḥ sarvoṣadhyādigandhayoginībhiścādbhirāmalakaiḥ kanyāṃ snāpayet | saśiraskāmityanenānyadā strīṇāmaśiraskamapi snānaṃ bhavatīti sūcayati | snāpanāhatavastrācchādanavyavadhānena ca sthālīpākena homaḥ, snānācca pūrva sthālīpāka iti vivakṣitaḥ kramaḥ | caturthyā devatāpadapariṇāmaḥ svāhākāraśca pūrvavat | jīvaputro'gnirityekaiva devatā jīvaḥ prāṇo vāyuḥ putro rakṣako'syeti bahuvrīhiranya padārthapradhāno yogyaśca sannihito'gnirevānyapadārthaḥ | mahārāja ityatra 'na pūjanāt ' iti pratiṣedho nāsti niyamāśrayaṇāt 'pūjāyāṃ svatigrahaṇaṃ kartavyam' iti vacanāt anyathā hi paramarāja ityādāvapi ṭacaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt | ye mahārājā ityākārāntaṃ paṭhanti te svatiniyamaṃ nādriyante || iti viṃśī kāṇḍikā || 20 || <21-30> atha ekaviṃśī kāṇḍikā | yāmeva dvitīyāṃ rātriṃ kanyāṃ vivāhayiṣyansyāttasyāṃ rātryāmatīte niśākāle navāṃ sthālīmāhṛtya payasi sthālīpākaṃ śrapayitvā sarvagandhaiḥ phalottaraiḥ saśiraskāṃ snāpayitvāhatena vāsasā pracchādya sthālīpākasya juhotyagnaye somāya mitrāya varuṇāyendrāyodakāya bhagāyāryamṇe pūṣṇe tvaṣṭre rājñe prajāpataye iti || 1 || ekā vivāhāhorātrarātristasyāḥ pūrvā yā dvitayā rātriyasyāṃ pitā kanyāṃ vivāhayiṣyanbhavet vivāhayiṣyāmītyanenādhyavasāyena yuktaḥ, athavā yāṃ bhaviṣyantīṃ rātrimadhikṛtya pitā kanyāṃ vivāhayiṣyansyāttasyā yā pūrvā dvitīyā rātristāmāśrityetikartavyatāpravṛttaḥ san tasyāmeva rātryāmatīte ||' 'prajāpate nahi tvat' iti ca || 2 || akṣatānāmanavahatānāṃ yavānāṃ saktubhiragniṃ puṣṭipatiṃ yajeta 'agninā rayim' ityetayaca | tathā prajāpatiṃ 'prajāpate' ityādimatreṇa | etāvājyabhāgānte yāgau || 2 || sarvatrodvāhakarmasvanādiṣṭadaivateṣvagniṃ puṣṭipatiṃ prajāpatiṃ ca yajeta || 3 || yatra nāmnā mantravarṇairvā devatānirdiṣṭā vivāhaprakaraṇo karmaṇi, tatrāgniṃ puṣṭipatiṃ prajāpatiṃ ca yajeta agneḥ pūrva kartavyaṃ uddhatasya cāvokṣitasya ca parisaṃvāhanaparyukṣaṇaparistaraṇapūrvakamājyāhutipaṃcakena santanīhomaiścaikādaśabhiḥ saṃskaraṇamupasamādhānamucyate, tatra jayaprabhṛtibhirmantrairhomaṃ kuryāt jayābhidhānānvā homān kuryāt 'ākūtaṃ cākūtiśca, 'bṛhaspatipurohitāḥ' 'ṛtāṣāda' ityādibhirmantrairjuhuyādityarthaḥ | ete hi mantrāstatsādhyā vā homā jayābhyātarāṣṭrabhṛdājyabhāgādiśabdasādhyatayā prasiddhāḥ | ājyabhāgānte cāgniṃ puṣṭipatiṃ prajāpatiṃ ca yajeta 'sarvatrodvāhakarmasvanādiṣṭadaivateṣu' ityādisūtravacanaprāmāṇyāditi kecit | anye puṣṭyarthamagnaye puṣṭipataye cākṣatasakubhihamaḥ kartavyaḥ anyathā hi nāmnā mantravarṇairvā sarvatra devatāvagamānnānādiṣṭadaivataṃ kiṃcidudvāhakarmasu karma vidyate iti sūtrārthasaṃpratyayābhāvaḥ vrajantītyarthaḥ || 3|| śanno devīrityupaspṛśya prācī digiti yānti yathādiśam || 4|| udakāntaṃ prāpya udakopasparśanaṃ śirasi prakṣepaṇamācamanaṃ kṛtvā 'prācī digagnirdevatā' ityādinā matreṇa yathādiśaṃ yā digyeṣāṃ gantavyā, tadabhidhāyinā mantreṇa yathāliṃgamabhidhāya varaprabhṛtayo gacchanti | atra vivāhasya kārayitā yo guruḥ, sa eva pitā vā varasya maṃtrapāṭhe kartā || pūṣā mā prapathe pātu pūṣā mā paśupāḥ pātu pūṣā mādhipatiḥ pātu || puṣṇāti vardhayatīti pūṣā pṛthivī antarikṣaṃ dyauśca | tathāca brāhmaṇam 'iyaṃ vai pūṣā prapathe'ntarikṣaṃ paśupā dyauradhipatiḥ |' iti | etaddhi iyamityaparokṣanirdeśena prayuktasya puṣaśabdasya mantre pṛthivyarthatāṃ darśayati | antarikṣaṃ pūṣetyanenāpi madhyavartinā mantreṇa pūṣaśabdasyāntarikṣavṛttitvaṃ darśayati | yathaivahi bhūtāni puṣṇātīti pṛthvī pūṣā, tathaiva paśūnavakāśadānena pāti puṣṇātīti kṛtvā antarikṣaṃ pūṣā | evaṃ dyaurapi pūṣā, sā hi sarvalokādhipatiḥ to'sau sarvalokān vṛṣṭyādidvāreṇa puṣṇāti | tenāyaṃ mantrārthaḥpūṣā pṛthivī prapathe gantuṃ prastute pathi mārge māṃ pātu tathā paśupā yaḥ pūṣā antarikṣalakṣaṇaḥ, so'pi māṃ pātu rakṣatu | tathā adhipatiryaḥ pūṣā dyulakṣaṇaḥ, so'pi māṃ pālayatu pathi gacchantam | śanno devīrityādayo vyākhyātāḥ || 4|| prācī digagnirdektāgniṃ sa ṛcchatu yo maitasyā diśobhidāsati, dakṣiṇā digindro devatendraṃ sa ṛcchatu yo maitasyā0 pratīcī dik somo devatā somaṃ sa || yā prācī dik, tasyā agnirdevatā | ata eva tasyā diśaḥ sambaṃdhī kaścit yo māmabhidāsati 'dasu upakṣaye' upakṣetumicchatyābhimukhyena so'gnimṛcchatu agnimabhyṛcchatu agniṃ ṣaḍarghyārhā bhavantyācārya ṛtvigrājā vivāhyaḥ priyaḥ snātaka iti || 1 || vivāhātpūrvameva pāyārdhyamadhuparkervivāhyaḥ śvaśureṇa pūjanīyaḥ | tulyaṃ ca pūjāvidhānaṃ ṣaṇṇāmapīti ṣaṇṇāmuddeśaḥ | arghyaṃ pūjāmarhantīti ardhyāhaḥ ṣaṭ bhavanti | ācāryaḥ upanetādhyāpayitā ca śiṣyasya | ṛtvigyājyasya, tasyāpi prākkarmaṇaḥ saṃmānaḥ | rājā kṣatriyo'pi, natvabhiṣekabhāvena sa janapadasya pūjyaḥ | vivahanamarhatīti vivāhyaḥ 'arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca' iti kṛtyo ṇyatpratyayaḥ, sa kanyāyāḥ piturardhyārhaḥ | tathā yo yasya priyo guṇotkarṣeṇa sa tasya dānādyavasare ardhyāhaḥ | snātakastu sadyaḥstrāta ācāryasya || 1 || athainamarhayanti || 2 || athaśabdo vakṣyamāṇaprakārakhīkārārtho nipātānāmanekārthatvāt | enamācāryādīnāmanyatamaṃ vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇārhayanti pūjayanti saṃmānayanti || 2 || ādau ca karmaṇaḥ || 3 || vivāhottarakālamarhaṇaṃ vihitamiti yathācoditamānupūrvyamiti nayena vivāhādūrdhvameva madhuparkādidānaṃ kartavyamiti kecitprāhurata eva ca vivāhottarakāla evedamapakṛṣya vyācakṣate | tannirāsāyedam | karmaṇa ādāveva pūjanaṃ kartavyaṃ pāṭhakramādarthakramasya balīyastvāt | saṃskāro hyayamutsāhādijananamukhena ṛtviprabhṛtīnāṃ karmaṇi yogyatāviśeṣādhānārthaḥ, saṃvṛtte yajñavivāhādi karmaṇi ṛtvikprabhṛtīnāṃ kriyamāṇo niṣphala eva syāt | smārto'pi - cāyaṃ saṃskāraḥ, smṛtiṣu ca prāgeva karmaṇo'bhihitaḥ | kiṃca vivāhya ityarhe āvaśyake vā kṛtyaḥ - vivahanamarhatīti, vivahati vā avaśyaṃ kanyāmiti vivāhyaḥ 'arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca' 'āvaśyakādhamarṇyayorṇiniḥ' ' kṛtyāśca' iti smṛteḥ | naca vivāhādūrdhvaṃ vivāhārho bhavati || 3 || arghyalakṣaṇamāha arghyamudakaṃ sauṣadhaṃ darbhā iti ||4|| udakaṃ, vrīhiyavayoścānyatarat darbhā etatrayamarghyam || 4|| madhuparkalakṣaṇapūrvikāṃ pūjayituranupadeśāṃ pūjāpratipattimāha kaṃse camase vā dadhyāsicya madhu ca varṣīyasā pidhāya viṣṭarābhyāṃ niyuktatvādato mama pādyāyai pratipattaye tvaṃ bhava, virājaśca prajāpateḥ saṃbandhinaṃ dohaṃ pādyādikamahamaśīya vyāpnuyāṃ paśyeyamityarthaḥ | pādyasya saṃskārārthaṃ darśanam || 6|| viṣṭaro'si mātari ācchādayāsanāntaramācchādanārthameva mātari āsanāntare sīda tiṣṭha || 7 || viṣṭara āsīnāyaikaikaṃ triḥ prāha ||8|| viṣṭare darbhācchāditāsanaviśeṣe āsīnāyopaviṣṭāya vivāhyāya pādyādīnāmekaikaṃ triḥ prāha kanyāyā dātāpādyaṃ 3 arghyaṃ 3 madhuparkaḥ 3 ācamanīyaṃ 3 iti | āsīnāyeti saptamyarthe caturthī, viṣṭara āsīne vivāhya ityarthaḥ || naiva bhorityāha na mārṣeti || 9 || abhyarhaṇīyasyābhimukhyāpādanāya yat bho iti pūjāsaṃbodhanaṃ prāptaṃ, nāmasaṃbodhanaṃ ca mārṣa brahmadatta ityādi, tanniṣedhayati || 9 || śanno devīrityapo'bhimaṃtrya pādyābhiḥ prakṣālayate dakṣiṇaṃ pādamavanenija idamahamasmin kule brahmavarcasaṃ dadāmyuttaraṃ pādamavanenija idamahaṃ māṃ mayi tejo vīryamannādyaṃ prajāṃ paśūn brahmavarcasaṃ dadāmi || 10 || śanno devīrityādimaṃtraiḥ pūrvavyākhyātairapo'bhimaṃtrya viśeṣeṇa pādyābhiḥ pādayordhāvanasamarthābhiḥ pādau prakṣālayate abhyarhaṇīyasya kanyāyā dātā | pādayoḥ prakṣālane yathāliṃgaṃ maṃtrau dakṣiṇamityādi, uttaramityādi | idamityanena sadyaḥ phalaṃ darśayati kanyāpradānaṃ vivāhāntarasādhitaṃ ca tatkṣaṇādeva karmānuṣṭhānādisambandhirūpam | asya vivāhyasya brahmavarcasasampannaṃ uttaraṃ vāmapādmavanenije śodhayāmi | idamahaṃ tejo vīryamannādyaṃ prajāṃ paśūn brahmavarcasaṃ dadāmi vivāhyādike ardhyā | māṃ mayi yattu māṃ prāptaṃ tejaḥprabhṛti, tanmayyeva ciramastvityarthaḥ || 10 || āpohiṣṭīyābhirarghyaṃ parigṛhya sāvitreṇa madhuparkaṃ viṣṭarossyantarikṣamadhiviśrayasveti viṣṭaramavakṛṣyoru tvetyapasārya taccakṣuriti vīkṣya pṛthivyāstveti viṣṭare nidhāya madhu vātā ṛtāyate iti tisṛbhiḥ pradeśinyā pradakṣiṇamāloḍayati ||11|| āpo hi pretyādibhirvyākhyātārthābhirayaṃ pratigṛhṇāti | devasya tvetyādinā ' madhuparka pratigṛhṇāmi' ityadhyāhārapūritena savitṛdevatākena maṃtreṇa madhuparkaṃ pratigṛhṇāti | viṣṭaro'sītimaṃtreṇoparitanaṃ viṣṭaramapakarṣati | apakṛṣya cākṣipya uru tveti maṃtreṇāpasārayati | taccakṣurityādinā madhuparka vīkṣya, pṛthivyāstvetyādinā maṃtreṇādhastane viṣṭare madhuparkapātraṃ nidadhāti | madhu vātā ṛtāyate iti tisṛbhiraṃguṣṭhasamīpavartinyā pradeśinīsaṃjñayāṅgulyā pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā dadhimadhunī miśrayati | pradiśati tarjayati tacchīlā pradeśinī tarjanī || devasya tnā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ madhuparka pratigṛhṇāmi || devasya dānadyotanādiguṇakasya saviturādityasya prasave'nujñāyāṃ vartamānā aśvinordevabhiṣajorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇaśca hastābhyāṃ natu svābhyāṃ carmamayābhyāṃ madhuparka pratigṛhṇāmi || viṣṭaro'syantarikṣamadhiviśrayakha || asi tvaṃ viṣṭaraḥ mithyaivāvārakaḥ, ato'smādadhastanaviṣṭarādapasarāntarikṣamākāśamāśraya || urutvā vātāya || he viṣṭara tvāmahaṃ pṛthivyāṃ prakṣipāmi, ataḥ uru dūraṃ gaccha | kimartham | vātāya vāyvartham || taccakṣurdevahitaṃ purastācchukramuccarat | paśyema śaradaḥ śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ śatam || tadetaccakṣuḥ śastaṃ yaddevahitaṃ satpurastāduccarati, tadeva kṛtakaraṇīyaṃ cakṣuḥ devārthaṃ havirādivīkṣaṇayāgadāna homādiṣu sādhanabhāvaṃ bhajata ityarthaḥ | kīdṛśam | śukraṃ śuklam | ata āśāsmahe vayaṃ yāgādisādhanāni varṣaśataṃ paśyema, tadarthameva saṃvatsaraśataṃ jīvema || pṛthivyāsvā nābhau sādhayāmi || he madhuparka tvāmahaṃ pātrasthamapi santaṃ nābhāvadhastane darbhaviṣṭare sādhayāmi | dhānyāni havīṃṣi vedaprastare sādhyante | pṛthivyā hi sāramoṣadhayastāsāmapi darbhā iti nābhitvaṃ darbhaviṣṭarasya || madhu vātā ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti siṃdhavaḥ | mādhvīrnaḥ santvoṣadhīḥ || 1 || madhu naktamutoṣasā madhumatpārthivaṃ rajaḥ | madhu dyaustu naḥ pitā || 2|| madhumāno vanaspatirmadhumāṃ astu sūryaḥ | mādhvīrgāvo bhavantu naḥ || 3 || vātā vāyavaḥ madhu santu madhurasaparyavasāyino bhavantu | kasmai | ṛtāyate ṛtaṃ satyaṃ yajñaṃ vā ya icchati, tasmai | siṃdhavo nadyaḥ madhu kṣaranti kṣarantu sravantu | tathā oṣadhayaḥ phalapākāntāḥ vrīhyādayo madhumatyo'smākaṃ santu || naktaṃ rātriprathamabhāgaḥ madhumānno bhavatu, uta apica upasā rātripaścimabhāgena saha | madhumatpārthivaṃ rajaḥrajo bhūmiloka ucyate, dhūlirvā | dyauryulokaḥ madhvastu madhurasasyandinī vṛṣṭyādidvāreṇa bhavatu | kīdṛśī dyauḥ | pitā pālayitrī || vanaspatiḥ phalī madhumānasmākaṃ bhavatu | evamasmākaṃ sūryo madhumān bhavatu | anena karmaṇā gāvaśca madhumatyo naḥ santu kṣīrādidānadvāreṇa madhurasāḥ || 11 || vasavastvāgnirājāno bhakṣayantu pitarastvā yamarājāno bhakṣayantu rudrāstvā somarājāno bhakṣayantvādityāstvā varuṇarājāno bhakṣayantu viśve tvā devā bṛhaspatirājāno bhakṣayantviti pradakṣiṇaṃ pratidiśaṃ pratimantraṃ pātrasyānteṣu lepānnirmārṣṭi || 12 || prācyā ārabhya pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā bhakṣayantvantairmantrairmadhuparkapātraprānteṣu aṃgulilepān nirmāṣṭi | pratidiśaṃ pratimatramitivacanātpaṃcamena madreṇātpūrvoktadikkoṇe nirmārjanamāpatati | mantrārthastu - he lepa prācyāṃ diśi vartamānā vasavo devatāviśeṣāstvāṃ bhakṣayantu vasavastvayā tṛptā bhavatvityarthaḥ | kīdṛśā vasavaḥ | agnirājāno'gniryeṣāṃ rājā | tatpuruṣe hi samāsāntaḥ syāt | eṣā yojanā sarvamatreṣu tulyā || 12 || yanmadhuno madhavyasya paramasyānnādyasya paramamannādyaṃ rūpaṃ tenāhaṃ madhuno madhavyasya paramasyānnādyasya paramo'nnādo madhavyo bhūyāsaṃ trayyai vidyāyai yaśo'si śriyai yaśo'si yaśase brahmaṇo dīptirasi satyaśrīryaśaḥ śrīrmayi śrīḥ śrīḥ śrayatāmiti madhuparkasya catuṣprāśnātyaṅguṣṭhadvitīyābhiḥ kaniṣṭhayā prathamamevamanupūrvaṃ sarvābhistadavaśiṣṭaṃ suhṛde prayacchati || 13 || yanmadhuna ityādimatreṇa madhuparkasya saṃbandhino bhāgānaṅguṣṭhasahitayā ekaikayā aṃgulyā gṛhītvā caturo vārānaśnāti aṃguṣṭhasahitayā kaniṣṭhayā prathamaṃ tato'nāmikayā, madhyamayā, pradeśinyā pratyeka maṃguṣṭhasahitayāvadānacatuṣṭaye gṛhīte yacchiṣyate, tatsuhṛde kanīyase bhrātṛprabhṛtaye prayacchati | mantrārthastu - pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni madhvivāmṛtamiva, madhavyaṃ madhusāraḥ amṛtasāraḥ sārasāra ityarthaḥ, yanmadhuno'mṛtasya saṃbandhi madhavyaṃ sārasāraḥ pṛthivīti 'iyaṃ pṛthivī sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ madhu' ityādinā bṛhadāraṇyake pṛthivyā bhūtasāratvena pratipādanāt, tasya madhavyasya pṛthivīlakṣaṇasya sārasārasya yatparamamutkṛṣṭatamaṃ rūpamannādilakṣaṇaṃ, tena bhuktenāhaṃ madhavyasya sarvāmṛtasārasya madhuno'mṛtasya nityānandarūpasya paramasya paramātmatādātmyavṛtterannādyasyādanīyasya susaṃvedanabhogyasya paramo'nnādaḥ paramātmasvarūpaḥ tatra layāt bhūyāsaṃ brahmabhūyamahaṃ gaccheyamiti yāvat | kiṃca he madhuparka asi tvaṃ trayyai vidyāyai vedatrayasya yaśaḥ prakāśaḥ, tathā śriyai saṃpado yaśaḥ prakāśo'si, ato yaśase tvāmaśnāmi | kiṃca brahmaṇaḥ paramātmano dīptiḥ prakāśastvaṃ, satyasya vedārthasya śrīḥ saṃpadasi yaśasaśca śrīḥ, ato mayi śrīḥ śrīḥ śrayatāṃ bhūyobhūyo mayi śrīstiṣṭhatvityarthaḥ || 13 || ācāmatyamṛtopastaraṇamasīti ||14|| anena matreṇācāmati | he ācamanodaka amṛtasya madhuparkasya upastaraṇamācchādakamasi || 14 || tasmā asipāṇirgāṃ prāha || 15 || arhayitā dattamadhuparkaḥ san khaṅgapāṇirbhūtvā tasmai arhaṇīyāya bhakṣitamadhuparkāya gāmāha 'gāṃ kariṣye' ityanujñāṃ prārthayate anyārthenetyarthaḥ | gośca karaṇaṃ nipātanam || 15 || tāṃ śāsti || 16 || tāṃ gāṃ śāsti 'oṃ kuruṣva' ityanujñāṃ arhaṇīyo dadātītyarthaḥ || 16 || arhayitāmuṃ matramāha mama cāmuṣya ca pāpmānaṃ jahi hato me pāpmā pāpmānaṃ me hata || 17 || he gauḥ mama cāgniśarmaṇo'muṣya ca viṣṇuśarmaṇaḥ pūjyasya yaduddeśena vaidika vidhiparavaśīkṛto'hamidamakartavyaṃ karomi tasya pāpmānaṃ jahi nāśayeti yāvat, athavā hato me pāpmā nāstyataḥ karmaṇo mama pāpaṃ vidhicoditatvādityarthaḥ | he viśasitāraḥ mama pāpmānaṃ hata nāśayata || 17 || oṃ kuruteti || 18 || hai viśasitāraḥ gauḥ kriyatāmityanujānātītyarthaḥ || 18 || caturo nānāgotrān brāhmaṇānbhojayedeṣa ādyopāyaḥ || 19 || nānāgotrānnānāpravarāṃścādau caturo brāhmaṇān bhojayetpaścātsavāndhavamarhaṇīyam | eṣa āyo brāhmaṇāyopāyo gokaraṇādika upadiṣṭastena nātra vicikitsā kartavyetyarthaḥ || 19 || yadyutsṛjenmātā rudrāṇāmiti japet mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ svasādityānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ | pra nu vocaṃ cikituṣe janāya mā gāmanāgāmaditiṃ vadhiṣṭa || sūyavasādbhagavatī hi bhūyā atho vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma | addhi tṛṇamaghnye viśvadānī piva śuddhamudakamācarantī || 20 || niścite'pi yadiśabdo dṛṣṭaḥ 'yadi vedāḥ pramāṇam' iti yathā | uktāmitikartavyatāṃ vidhāya gāmutsṛjet na hanyādityarthaḥ, mātā rudrāṇāmityādica paṭhet | iyaṃ gau rudrāṇāmantarikṣacāriṇāṃ devatāviśeṣāṇāṃ mātā pari poṣikā payaḥ prabhavāhutidvāraka vṛṣṭyādidvāreṇa vasūnāṃ vāsayitṛṇāmoṣadhīnāṃ bhūmijānāṃ duhitā poṣaṇīyā, ādityānāṃ svasā bhaginī adititanayā, ato'haṃ pranuvocaṃ cikituṣe janāya nuśabdo niścaye, niścayaṃ kṛtvā pravadāmi cikituṣe caitanyātiśayavate janāya | kiṃ vadāmi | he viśasitāraḥ gāṃ mā vadhiṣṭa | kīdṛśīm | anāgāmapāpāṃ, aditimakhaṇḍitāṃ dainyaśūnyāṃ vā | kutaḥ | yasmādiyaṃ śobhanaṃ yavasaṃ ghāsamatīti sūyavasāt | kiṃca he gauḥ bhago dhanaṃ payo yaśaśca vidyate yasyāḥ sā bhagavatī payasvinī tvaṃ bhūyāḥ, tathā vayamapi tvatprasādāt bhagavanto dhanayuktāḥ yaśasvinaśca syāma | anupa hiṃsi tṛṇamaddhi bhuṅkṣva | yatastvaṃ viśvadānī sarvasya dātrī payodvāreṇa | piva śuddhamudakamā samantāt carantī viharantī || 20 || omutsṛjata tṛṇānyattvityuktvā tāmutsṛṣṭāṃ paśumaṃgaṃ vā || 21 || nāmāṃso madhuparkaḥ syāditi ha vijñāyate || 22 || apivā ghṛtaudana eva syāt || 23 || arhayitāha omityavicāritasiddhaṃ kṛtvā he viśasitāraḥ yūyaṃ gāmutsṛjata | utsṛṣṭā satī svācchandyena tṛṇānyattu bhakṣayatu ityuktvā tāmutsṛṣṭāṃ dṛṣṭvā paśuṃ chāgaṃ, paśvaṅgaṃ vā māṃsakhaṇḍaṃ pratinidadhīta | nāmāṃso māṃsavihīno madhuparkaḥ syāditi ha śrutito vijñāyate, haśabda itihāse | apivā ghṛtamiśrita odana eva kartavyo māṃsadveṣiṇe tādṛśā vā || 21, 22, 23 || iti caturviṃśī kāṇḍikā || 24 || atha pañcaviṃśī kāṇḍikā | anṛkṣarā ṛjavaḥ santu paṃthā yebhiḥ sakhāyo yanti no vareyam | samaryamā saṃ bhago no ninīyāt saṃ jāspatyaṃ suyamamastu devā ityudāhāraṃ prahiṇoti || 1 || anṛkṣarā ityādimantreṇa gṛhītajalabhāṇḍamudakasya āhartāraṃ preṣayati kanyāsnānādyupayogi jalamānetuṃ puruṣaṃ prahiṇotītyarthaḥ | ṛgarthastu - brahmaṇa ārṣa sūryasya vā | triṣṭup | paṃthā iti vyatyayenaikavacanam | ṛkṣarāḥ kaṇṭakādayaḥ paruṣāstṛṇaviśeṣāḥ, na vidyante ṛkṣarāḥ yeṣu te anukṣarāḥ paṃthānaḥ santu, ṛjavaścākuṭilāḥ | yebhiryaiḥ no'smākaṃ saṃbandhinaḥ sahāyā vareyaṃ varaṇīyaṃ gaṃgādikaṃ jalāharaṇasthānaṃ yanti gacchanti | sakhāya iti vyatyayena bahuvacanam | kiṃcāryamā ādityaḥ bhagaśca no'smākaṃ saṃbandhinaṃ sakhāyaṃ sanninīyāt samyagudakasthānaṃ prāpayet | he devāḥ ṛtvigprabhṛtayaḥ ādityaprabhṛtayaśca yuṣmatprasādāt jāspatyaṃ jāyāyāḥ patyuśca samāgamaḥ samyak suyamamastu susaṃyataṃ sthirataraṃ saṃpūrṇamastu | 'jāyāyāspatyau vā cchandasi' iti jāspatyaśabdaśchandasi nipātitaḥ || 1 || śamīśākhayā sapalāśayā pidhāyāharet || 2 || sa prati udāhāraḥ udakakumbhaṃ śamīśākhayā sapatrayā pidhāya sthagayitvā udakamānayet || 2 || etāsāmevāpāmudakārthān kurvīta ||3|| etāsāmeva āhāritānāmapāṃ saṃbandhino bhāgānavadāyāvadāyodakasaṃpādyānarthān kanyāsnānasuvarṇakṣāraṇāgniparyukṣaṇādīn kuryānnānyena jalena || 3 || śanna āpo dhanvanyāḥ śannaḥ santvanūpyāḥ | śannaḥ samudriyā āpaḥ śamu naḥ santu kūpyā yā imā ityakevalābhiradbhiḥ snātāṃ yā akṛntanyā avayanyā atanvata yāśca devīrantāṃ abhito'tatantha | tāstvā devīrjarasā saṃvyayantvāyuṣmatīdaṃ paridhatsva vāsa ityahataṃ vāsaḥ paridhāpyāśāsānetyantarato mauñjena dārbheṇa vā yoktreṇa sannahyati || 4 || śanna āpa ityādimantreṇākevalābhiḥ savauṣadhyādigandhadravyayuktābhiḥ phalaviśeṣasahitābhiścādbhiḥ kanyāṃ strāpayet | tato 'yā akṛntan' ityādinā ahatamapūrvaparihitamatyantābhinavaṃ vastraṃ paridhāpayet | tataśca 'āśāsānā' ityādinā mantreṇāntare guptāṃ kṛtvā yathā na dṛśyate tathā vā sannahanaṃ kanyāyāḥ kuryāt mauñjena darbhanirmitena vā yokreṇa || śanna āpa ityanuṣṭup vyākhyātā | yā imā udāhāreṇāhṛtāḥ, tāḥ śaṃ sukhaṃ naḥ saṃtviti viśeṣaḥ || yā akṛntanniti jagatī| he āyuṣmati kanye idaṃ vāsaḥ paridhatkha paridhehi | tvāṃ ca sarvāstā devyo jarasā parivyayantu jarasā veṣṭayantu jarājarjaritāṃ sabhartṛkāṃ satīṃ tvāṃ devatāḥ sampādayantu dīrghamāyustava kurvantvityarthaḥ | kāstā devyaḥ | yā idaṃ vāsokṛntan yābhiḥ kartanena saṃpāditamadhiṣṭhātrībhirdevatābhiḥ, yā avayan yābhirutaṃ saṃpāditaṃ vāsaḥ, yā atanvata yābhiḥ sūtramātataṃ dairyeṇa prasāritaṃ, yāśca devīrantāṃ abhito'tatantha, ubhayato mūlapallavasya cāntāḥ prāntāḥ yābhirātānitā ityarthaḥ | tāśca devatā mantrāntare svanāmnaivopāttāḥ 'revatīstvā vyakṣṇan' iti || āśāsānā saumanasaṃ prajāṃ saubhāgyaṃ rayim | agneranuvratā bhūtvā sanna sukṛtāya kam || anuṣṭup | pṛthivyā ārṣam | ahaṃ sanna vastraṃ badhnāmi | kimartham | sukṛtāya karmaṇe vivāhapūrvayāgadāna homādikarmārtham | kāmāyetyarthaḥ | yathā 'cakṣuṣe kaṃ pūrvamātyajyate' ityatra cakṣuṣkāmapratītiḥ, evaṃ sukṛtāya kamiti sukṛtakāmapratītiḥ | kīdṛśī satī sannaye | saumanasaṃ prasannamānasatvaṃ tathā saubhāgyaṃ bhartrānukūlyaṃ rayiṃ ca dhanamāśāsānā icchantī, tathā agneranutratā satī āhavanīyādiparicaraṇaśīlā satī sannadye || 4 || preto muñcātu māmutaḥ subaddhāmamutaskarat | yatheyamiṃdra mīḍhvaḥ suputrā subhagāsati || pūṣā tveto nayatu hastagṛhyāśvinau tvā pravahatāṃ rathena | gṛhāngaccha gṛhapatnī yathāso vaśinī tvaṃ vidathe mā vadāsi || mā vidanparipaṃthino ya āsīdanti dampatī | sugebhirdurgamatītāmapadrāvantvarātaya ityudānīyoktaṃ vāsasaḥ karma || 5 || preto muñcātvityādibhistisṛbhiḥ udānīyasthānādutkṣipya tsaṃge kṛtvā sthānāntare pitā jyeṣṭho bhrātā vā yathoktaṃ vāsasa uparibhāgācchādanasyāpyadhastanācchādanavat 'yā akṛntan' ityādinā mantreṇa karma kuryādityarthaḥ | sūryasyārṣam | prathamatṛtīye'nuṣṭubhau, dvitīyā triṣṭup | he kanye itaḥ sthānātpramuñcātu pramuñcāmi tvāṃ nayāmi bhavatīm | muñcātviti tivyatyayaḥ puruṣavyatyayaśca, tathāca śākhāntare preto mucāmīti matraḥ paṭhyate | pitṛkule bhartṛkule ca suddhāṃ suṣṭāṃ satīmetāṃ kanyāmamutaḥ pitṛkulādamutaśca bhartṛkulāt mākarat kaścinmā kārṣīt kuladvaye vigamaṃ tasyā mā kārṣīt kaścidapītyarthaḥ | he indra parameśvara mīdaḥ sektaḥ iyaṃ kanyā suputrā subhagā ca yathā bhavati, tathā kuru | he kanye itaḥ sthānāt pūṣā indrastvāṃ nayatu | hastagṛhya hastena gṛhītvā | aśvinau ca tvāṃ rathena pravahatāmabhimataṃ sthānaṃ prāpayatām | tathā krameṇa tvaṃ gṛhānbhartṛveśmāni gaccha | tatra ca gṛhapatnī gṛhasya pālayitrī prabhuryathā asaḥ bhavasi tathāstu | vaśinī jitakarmakarajanādikā bhava | vidathe ca yajñe mā vadāsi yajñapratikūlaṃ bharturmā vādīḥ vaidikakarmakalāpānukūlā bhavetyarthaḥ || ye paripaṃthino mārge pratikūlācauraprabhṛtayo dampatī jāyāvarau āsīdanti duṣṭabuddhyā samāsīdanti te tvāṃ mā vidan mā drākṣuḥ sugebhiḥ śobhanagamanairdurga mārgamatītāmatikrāntāṃ sarvam | kiṃca apadvāntvarātayaḥ śatravo dānahīnāśca dhanābhāvāśca dāridyābhidhānā apadrāntu bhītāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ santaḥ palāyamānāḥ kutsitāṃ skhalanarūpāṃ gatiṃ labhantāmityarthaḥ || ācārikāṇi || 6 || asminnavasare ācārikāṇi ācārādāgatāni deśajātikuladharmatayā prasiddhāni karmāṇi kārayedityarthaḥ | tadyathā - āgamanaprayojanakathanaṃ kanyāyā nāmagrahaṇaṃ kuladevatāpūjanaṃ sumanolatābhistāḍanamityādīni || 6 || tūṣṇīṃ nirmanthyaṃ bhrāṣṭrātsāntapanaṃ yatra dīpyamānaṃ vā bahiragnimupasamādhāya parisamūhya paryukṣya pariṣicya paristīryājyaṃ vilīnotpūtaṃ kṛtvāghārādājyabhāgāntaṃ hutvāpareṇāgnimano rathaṃ vāvasthāpya yoge yoga iti yunakti dakṣiṇamitaramuttaramitarām || 7 || 'eṣa aupasado'bhirvaivāhano vā' 'tasmin pākayajñāḥ' iti vakṣyati | vaivāha - nasya vikalpyamānāścatasraḥ prakṛtayo'trocyante | sadyaḥ araṇibhyāṃ nirmathito yastatra nirmanthyaśabdo rūḍhaḥ | tatra nirmanthana sāmānyānnirmanthanāntaravanmatre prāpte tūṣṇīmityuktam | eṣa ekaḥ | bhrāṣṭrādvitīyaḥ | sāntapanastṛtīyaḥ | yo balenāgninā santaptādapasāritāgnikābhāgāt kārpāsagomayacūrṇādisaṃsargaṃ kṛtvotpādyate pāpāṇaṃ kaṃsamaṇiṃ vā tāpayitvā sūryasaṃmukhaṃ sūryakāntamaṇiṃ vā sthāpayitvā so'bhimataḥ | yatra dīpyamānaścaturthaḥ | atrāviśeṣaśrutāvapi tretāvasathaśmaśānaparigṛhītasūtakapatitādyagnivarjamiti jñeyam | upasamādhāyeti pratyekaṃ sambandhanīyam, gārhapatyavaduddhatāvokṣite jānudane kuṇḍe sthāpayitvetyarthaḥ | gṛhāihireveti niyamaḥ | parisamūhanaṃ sajalena kareṇa caturdiksaṃsparśanam | paryukṣaṇamāsecanam | evaṃ caturdikameva darbhaiḥ paristaraṇaṃ prathitam | prāgdakṣiṇodakṣvavastaraṇamityanye manyante tribhistaraiḥ stṛṇātīti vaiśravaṇīyadarśanāt | ājyasya vilayanaṃ vigalanam, utpavanaṃ pavitreṇa pāvanam | ādhārādājyabhāgāntān homān hutvā agneḥ paścimabhāge sthitayoḥ satoḥ kanyāvarayoryathāsaṃkhyaṃ vāmadakṣiṇabhāgenāgneraparabhāge anaḥ śakaṭaṃ, rathaṃ syandanaṃ vā sayugamavasthāpya yoge yoga ityādikayarcā kanyāvarau yūpe yunakti dakṣiṇabhāge varamuttarabhāge kanyāṃ yokreṇa saṃyojayatītyarthaḥ || yoge yoge tavastaraṃ vāje vāje havāmahe | sakhāya indramūtaye || gāyatrī | maitrī | kaśyapasyārṣam | vayamindraṃ havāmahe āhvayāmaḥ | kutra | yoge yoge, dampatyoḥ sahabhāvenāvasthitayoḥ parikarmasambandhe | tathā vāje vāje, vājaśabdo'nnabalasaṃgamavacanaḥ, iha tvannavacano gṛhyate gārhasthyasyānnamūlatvāt, vājaśabdena cānnasādhanaṃ vakṣyate, haviṣi haviṣi cājyeṣṭabhāgadānāyeti protsāhanā | kimarthamāhvayāmaḥ | ūtaye avanāya | kīdṛśā vayam | sakhāyaḥ samānakhyānāḥ | kīdṛśamindram | tavastaraṃ tavaḥ śabdo balavacanaḥ mahattvavacano vā, balavattaraṃ mahattaraṃ vā || 7|| tūṣṇīṃ vimucya khe rathasya khe'nasaḥ khe yugasya śatakrato | apālāmindrastriṣpūtvā karotu sūryavarcasamiti hiraṇyaṃ niṣṭarkyaṃ baddhvādhyadhi mūrdhani dakṣiṇasminyugatarmaṇyadbhiravakṣārayate śaṃ te hiraṇyaṃ śamu santvāpaḥ śaṃ te methī bhavatu śaṃ yugasya tarma | śaṃ ta āpaḥ śatapavitrā bhavantvenā patyā tanvā saṃsṛjasveti || 8 || prakṛtayoṛyuktāvivātrāpi prāptaṃ maṃtraṃ niṣedhayati tūṣṇīmiti | vimucya kaśāyojitaṃ yo mocayitvā | khe rathasyetyādikayaca hiraṇyaṃ darbhapavitreṇa vaddhā yugasya dakṣibhāgagate randhre nidadhāti | kathaṃ baddhā | niṭava kṛtvā yathā sukhamocanaṃ bhavati tathetyarthaḥ, niṣṭakyaṃ sukhavimocanam | tatsuvarṇe baddhānantaraṃ dakṣiṇabhāge varasthāne kanyāmānīya sasuvarṇe dakṣiṇasminyugasya tarmaṇi cchidre pūrvotābhiradbhiradhyadhi kṣārayati, 'uparyadhyadhasaḥ sāmīpye' iti vīpsāyāṃ sāmīpye adhyadhīti dvirvacanam, yugacchidrasyādhaḥ samīpe kanyāṃ sthāpayitvā mūrdhani suvarṇodakaṃ kṣārayatītyarthaḥ | asminnavasare kanyāvarayoḥ sthā naparivṛttiḥ saṃpannā, punaḥ sthāna eva sthitibhaviṣyati | yadvakṣyati 'dakṣiṇataḥ pumābhavati' iti || khe rathasyetyaindrī anuṣṭup | brahmaṇa ārṣam | anyatrāpyucyamāne brahmaṇa evārṣam 'anantaraṃ ca vakrebhyo vedāstasya vinirgatāḥ |' iti sarvavedānāṃ sāmānyena taddṛṣṭatvasmṛteḥ | he śataka to anantakriya indrastejasvināṃ madhye parameśvara āditya etāṃ kanyāṃ sūryavarcasamādityakalpakāntiṃ karotu | kiṃ kṛtvā | triṣpūtvā trīn vārān pavitrayitvā | kīdṛśīm | apālāṃ vivāhātpūrvaṃ svacchandacāriṇīmata eva pāvanayogyām | kva | rathasya khe, tathā anasaḥ śakaṭasya yugasya ca khe cchidre | athavā apālāmivendra imāṃ kanyāṃ pūtāṃ kṛtvā sūryavarcasaṃ karotviti ivārthagarbha vyākhyānam | yathā kilāpāleti nāmnā atrerduhitā kuṣṭhavyādhigrastā śunyāśrame snānādyarthāpassṛtamunike dṛṣṭā yūpādicchidreṣu suvarṇodakenābhiṣicyendreṇa vyapagatarogā sūryakāntiḥ saṃpāditā, tadvadetāmapyapagatapāpāṃ kṛtvā sūryavarcasaṃ karotu indraḥ | tathā cetihāsaḥ 'apālātrisutā tvāsītkanyā tvagdoṣiṇī purā | tāmindracakame dṛṣṭvā vijane piturāśrame || rathacchidre tu tāmindro yugasa śakaṭasya ca | prakṣipya nicakarṣa tristataḥ sā sukhacābhavat || iti | śaṃ te hiraṇyamiti jagatī | he kanye te tava hiraṇyaṃ śaṃ sukhamastu | śamu santvāpaḥ, u iti nipātaḥ samuccaye, āpaśca te sukhaṃ santu | methī rathāvastambhanaṃ varūthaṃ śaṃ sukhaṃ tavāstu | yugasya tarma cchidraṃ tava sukhakaramastu | āpaste śatapavitrā vahupāvanyaḥ sukhakāriṇyo bhavantu | enā patyā tanvā saṃsṛjasva, enā anena bhartrā saha tanvā śarīreṇa saṃsṛjasva saṃbadhyasva | kvacittu śākhāyāṃ paṭhyate tanvaṃ saṃsṛjakheti, bhartrā saha saṃyojayeti tatrārthaḥ || 8 || dakṣiṇataḥ pumān bhavati || 9 || kanyāyā abhiṣekasaṃskāre kṛte sati punaragneraparabhāge prāṅmukhaḥ puruṣo bhavati dakṣiṇena, arthāt kanyā uttareṇa bhavatīti labhyate | atra dakṣiṇabhāgamānīya saṃskriyamāṇatvāt kanyā pradhānamityeke, svatatratvāt sadā dakṣiṇabhāge cāvasthānāt puruṣaḥ pradhānaṃ vivāha ityanye || 9 || atha juhotyagnaye janivide svāhā somāya janivide svāhā gandharvāya janivide svāheti || 10 || athaśabda maṃgalārtha iti māṭharaḥ, antarāle'kṣatasaktahomadyotanāyāthaśabda ityādityadarśanaḥ | avaśyaṃ hi uktayuktyā te homāntalādāvapi hotavyā ityatraivāvasarena kṣatiriti | homān krameṇāha agnaye ityādi | ‘pūrvaṃ devaiḥ striyo bhuktāḥ somagandharvavahnibhiḥ |' iti śrūyate | tena niṣkrayāya teṣāṃ homaḥ | yadyapi ca somaḥ prathamastathāpyagrato homo'trānaye 'yena karmaṇecchedagnimukhaṃ kuryāt ityabhiprāyeṇa | agnaye svāhā suhutamastu | kīdṛśāya | janivide janī vadhūḥ janīṃ vetti vindate vā janivit tasmai | evamanyat || 10 || āyuṣaḥ prāṇaṃ saṃtanviti saṃtanīrjuhoti || 11 || ekādaśa saṃtanya evamādyāḥ || 11 || jayābhyātānān rāṣṭrabhṛtaśca || 12 || juhoti ityanuṣaṅgaḥ | jayāścābhyātānāśca, tān rāṣṭrabhṛtaśca juhotītyarthaḥ || 12 || tāni yathoktam || 13 || tāni trīṇi jayādīni karmāṇyuktānatikrameṇa kartavyāni | dvādaśagṛhītena jayāñjuhuyāditi laugākṣaḥ | yathādhītaṃ matramanuḍutya ṛgantena svāhākāreṇa dvādaśaprakṣepā apīti kecit | anye tu dvādaśāvadānagṛhītājyasya sarvamaṃtrānudravaṇe sarvānte svāhākāreṇaika eva prakṣepa ityanutiṣṭhanti, pratimaṃtraṃ tu dvādaśāvadānānyuddharanti | abhyātānāṃ home tu caturgṛhītaṃ juhoti | tatra 'bṛhaspatipurohitāḥ' 'devahūtyām' iti āghātagrahaṇam | rāṣṭrabhṛtastu dvādaśagṛhītena trayodaśa homāḥ | ṛtāṣāḍiti dvādaśabhirvaḍantairhutvā sa no bhuvanasya pate' iti rathamukhe'dhyadhyagniṃ śriyamāṇasyeti yathokatā | pākayajñeṣu tatrayaṃ yathāvadvyavasthitaṃ, tatraiva samantrakaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ || 13 || ādhipatyāni juhoti || 14 || adhipatiśabdo palakṣitaliṃgādādhipatyānyucyante | tāni sānuṣaṅgānyekaviṃśatiryajūṃṣi | agnirbhūtānāmadhipatiḥ sa māvatu tasmai svāhā | yamaḥ pṛthivyā adhi0 vāyurantarikṣasyādhi0 sūryo divo'dhi0 caṃdramā nakṣatrāṇāmadhi0 viṣṇurdiśāmadhi0 pūṣā pathīnāmadhi0 tvaṣṭā rūpāṇāmadhi0 savitā prasavānāmadhi0 indro jyeṣṭhānāmadhi0 mitraḥ satyānāmadhi0 varuṇo dharmaṇāmadhi0 rudraḥ paśūnāmadhi0 bṛhaspatirbrahmaṇāmadhi0 brāhmaṇo vācāmadhi0 soma oṣadhīnāmadhi0 samudraḥ sravatyānāmadhi0 annaṃ sāmrā jyānāmadhipatistanmāvatu tasmai svāhā | gāyatrī cchandasāmavipattī sā māvatu tasyai svāhā | maruto gaṇānāmadhipatayaste māvantu tebhyaḥ svāhā | pitaraḥ pitāmahāḥ pareśvarebhyaste naḥ pāntu te no'vantvasmintrahmaṇyasminkarmaṇyasminkṣetre'syāmāśiṣyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā || bhūtānāṃ sthāvarajaṃgamānāmagniradhipatirniyantā sa mā avatu āgacchatu havirgrahītuṃ māṃ rakṣatu ca tasmai svāhā suhutamastu ca | yamaḥ pṛthivyā niyantā sa mātu svāhetyanuṣaṃgaḥ | evamanyatra | viṣṇurdiśāmadhipatirvyāpakatvāt | pūṣā pathīnāṃ pathikānām | tvaṣṭā rūpāṇāṃ, tvaṣṭā prajāpatirviśvakarmā, sarūpāṇāṃ sarvākṛtīnāmadhipatiḥ | savitā prasavānāṃ, prasūyanta iti prasavāḥ aṃkurādayaḥ | indro jyeṣṭhānāṃ prāśastyānām | mitraḥ satyānāmiti tathāca śrūyate ' mitrāya satyapataye' iti | varuṇo dharmaṇāṃ dharmāṇo dhartārasteṣāṃ varuṇo'dhipatiḥ 'varuṇo'si dhṛtavrato varuṇastvottusnātu' iti darśanāt, dhartṝṇāṃ pṛthivyādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ varuṇo dharteti vaiśeṣikādibhirapyuktam | rudraḥ paśūnāṃ sahyaSbhyarthayate ' ahameva paśūnāmīśe' iti | bṛhaspatirbrahmaṇāṃ vedānāmadhipatiḥ | brāhmaṇo vācāṃ, sa eva hi daivīnāṃ mānuṣīṇāṃ ca vācāmupadeṣṭā 'tasmādvāhmaṇa ubhe vācau vadati daivīṃ ca mānuṣīṃ ca' iti śruteḥ | somaścandro grāmyāraṇyānāmoṣadhīnāṃ phalapākāntānāmadhipatiḥ | sravatyānāṃ nadīnāṃ samudro'ntarikṣākhyo'dhipatiḥ, apāmāśrayaṇīyaṃ hyantarikṣaṃ sūkṣmāṇāmanyathāvaśyāyaḥ katham | sāmrājyamaiśvarya, teṣāmannaṃ, pṛthivyāḥ sauro raso'dhipatiḥ | maruto gaṇānāṃ, sarveṣāmevānyādigaṇānāṃ maruto'dhipatayo vyākhyātāḥ | avarebhyaḥ nikaṭebhyaḥ pitṛpitāmahādibhyo ye pare sargasamudbhavā hiraṇyagarbhamanuprabhṛtayaḥ pitaraḥ, te naḥ pāntu pālayantu ceti prakṛtamapekṣaṇīyamavateḥ prakṛtasya gatyarthatvāt | kāvantu | asmin brahmaṇi, eteṣu brāhmaṇeṣu ṛtvikṣu dakṣiṇayā svīkṛteṣu, asmin vivāhākhye karmaṇi, asmin kṣetre pālane, asyāṃ cāśiṣi ṛtvigbhirādhīyamānāyāṃ dampatyoḥ phalabhūtāyāṃ, yadyapi ṛtvigviśeṣā māmavantvatyuccārayanti, tathāpi karmaṇo dakṣiṇayā tadīyasya parikrītatvādyajamānasyaiva phalam, purodhāyāṃ paurohityakarmaṇi, devahūtyāṃ devānāṃ hṛtirāhānaṃ havirdānāya yatra, sā devahūtirvivāhabhūmiriha || 14 || ākūtyā iti tribhistvetyantairhiraṇyagarbha ityaṣṭābhiḥ pratyṛcaṃ bhūḥ svāheti mahāvyāhṛtibhiścatasṛbhiragna āyūṃṣītyāgnipāvamānībhistisṛbhirhutvā hutvā mūrdhni saṃpātānavanayet || 15 || 'ākūtyai tvā' ityādibhirmantrairājyaṃ hutvā hutvā kanyāyā mūrdhni saṃpātān hutājyaśeṣabiṃdūn mūvanayet srāvayet | he ājya tvāṃ juhomītyarthaḥ | vyākhyānāṃga juhotiradhyāhiyate natu maṃtraikadeśaḥ | adhyāhriyamāṇasya mantraikadeśatve ṛcāmapi sākāṃkṣatvādadhyāhārasahitānāṃ yatirvinaśyet tataśca gāyatryanuvākyā bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt | sadādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||1|| aṣṭānāmapi puruṣasya nārāyaṇasyārṣam | hiraṇyagarbhaḥ prajāpatiḥ puruṣo nārāyaṇaḥ prāṇo jagatsūtraṃ kaḥ samrāḍiti paryāyāḥ | hiraṇyagarbhaḥ agre sargādau samavartata prādurbabhūva | sa ca jātaḥ prādurbhūtaḥ san eka eva bhūtasya samastasya pṛthivyādibhūtajātasya abhivyaṃgyasya vā mahadādeḥ patiḥ pālakaḥ prabhurāsīt vyatyayenātītavibhaktiḥ, prādurbhavati jagadādau hiraṇyagarbhaḥ patiśca bhavati sarvasyetyarthaḥ | saṃ māṃ pratyakṣa pṛthivīṃ kṣitiṃ dādhāra dhārayate, uta tathā dyāṃ svargaṃ pṛthivīṃ ca | pṛthivīśabdaḥ sāmīpyādantarikṣe vartate | hiraṇyagarbha eva hi sarva protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva | tasmai kasmai prajāpataye, devāya dānādiguṇayuktāya haviṣā ājyena vidhema paricarāma, tasmai havirda iti yāvat || yaḥ prāṇato nimiṣataśca rājā patirviśvasya jagato babhūva | īśe yo asya dvipadacatuṣpadaḥ kasmai0 || 2 || yaḥ prāṇāpānādimato nimeṣādimataśca devamānuṣādeḥ rājā prabhuḥ patiḥ pālayitā | antarikṣaṃ vimame varīyaḥ kasmai 0 || 4 || yena prajāpatinā dyaurantarikṣamugrā unnatā, ḍhā avaṣṭabdhā, tathā pṛthivī vyāptā, tathā svaḥ stabhitaṃ vyāptamavaṣṭabdhaṃ protaṃ, svarge'pyavaṣṭabdha
