kānac | upalakṣaṇametatprathamavivartasya | jalasya hiraṇyagarbho vivartaḥ, tasyoṅkārastasya vedā ityādirūpeṇa sa eva vivartate | sa hiraṇyagarbho yataḥ puṣṭipatistato'smākaṃ puṣṭimādadhātu || mahāvyāhṛtayo vyākhyātāḥ || agna āyūṃṣi pavasa āsuvorjamiṣañca naḥ | āre bādhasva ducchunām || 1 || tisro gāyatryaḥ | kūṣmāṇḍānāmārṣam | he agne tvamāyūṃṣi pavase punāsi rogajarādimalairvihīnāni saṃpādayasi | no'smabhyamūrjaṃ valaṃ iṣaṃ cānnamāsuva janaya dehi | duraḥ śuni paratastāntādeśe prātiśākhye ducchrunāmityanvākhyānāt śunāmiva duṣṭānāṃ duchunāṃ hiṃsrāṇāṃ bādhasva āre dūrata eva | ducchunāmiti hiṃsārthānāmiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī || 1 || agnirṛṣiḥ pavamānaḥ pāścajanyaḥ purohitaḥ | tamīmahe mahāgayam || 2 || agnirṛṣiḥ duṣṭān pavamānaḥ punānaḥ, paṃcajanā manuṣyāścatvāro varṇāḥ anulomajavargaḥ paṃcamastebhyo hitaḥ, purohitaḥ 'agnirvai devānāṃ purohitaḥ puro'gre paraloke vā hitaḥ karmasaṃpādanadvāreṇa, taṃ vayaṃ īmahe yācāmahe mahāgayaṃ mahāgṛham || 2|| apavasva khapā asme varcaḥ suvīryam | dadhadrayaṃ mayi poṣam || 3|| he agne asme asmān pavasva punīhi | apa iti karmanāma, śobhanānyapāṃsi yasya sa svapāḥ sukarmā agniḥ | kiṃ kurvan punīhi | varcastejaḥ śobhanaṃ ca vīryaṃ, tathā rayiṃ dhanaṃ poṣaṃ ca puṣṭiṃ dadhadvidadhānaḥ dadddvāsmabhyam ||3||15|| yā te patighnī tanūrapatighnīṃ te tāṃ karomi svāhā yā te'putriyā tanūḥ putriyāṃ te tāṃ karomi svāhā yā te'paśavyā tanūḥ paśavyāṃ te tāṃ karomi svāheti tribhiḥ || 16 || yā ta ityādibhiśca tribhimaṃtrehuvā hutvā kanyāyā mūrdhni saṃpātānavanayedityanuṣaṃgeṇa samāptiḥ | maṃtratrayārthastu - he kanye yā te tava patighnī tanūstāmapatighnīṃ karomi anena saṃpātāvanayena, tathā tava yā aputriyā putrebhyo'hitā tanūstāṃ putrebhyo hitāṃ putriyāṃ karomi, yāca apaśavyā paśubhyo'hitā tanūstāṃ paśavyāṃ paśubhyo vāhitāṃ karomi | atrāvasare pūrvanidarśitavidhānenākṣatasaktūn juhuyāt || 16 || pāṇigrahaṇamāha udagnerdarbheṣu prācīmavasthāpya śuciḥ purastātpratyaṅṅupayantā devasya te savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ hastaṃ gṛhṇāmīti hastaṃ gṛhṇāti dakṣiṇamuttānaṃ sāṃguṣṭhaṃ nīcāriktamariktenaivaṃ savyaṃ savyena || 17 || agnerudīcyāṃ diśi darbhāstīrṇe deśe prākhīṃ kanyāmavasthāpya gururdevasya ta ityādinā maṃtreṇa kanyāyāḥ saṃbandhinaṃ hastaṃ grāhayatītyadhyāhartavyaṃ samānakartṛkatvārtham | kena prayujya grāhayatītyapekṣāyāmarthādvareṇopayatreti yojyam | sacopayantā guruṇānujñātastaṃ gṛhṇāti | kīdṛśo voḍhā gṛhṇāti | śuciḥ karagrahaṇe'dhikṛtaḥ dharmopayoginī mameyamiti śuddhasaṃkalpaḥ, pratyaṅmukhaḥ kanyāyāḥ purastādagre sthitaḥ san | 'prāṅmukhaḥ sarvakarmāṇi kurvīta' ityasyāpavādārthaṃ pratyaṅmukha iti | dakṣiṇa lokaprasiddhaṃ, sāṅguṣṭhamaṅguṣṭhasahitamuttānaṃ nīcā dakṣiṇena nitāntamañcati ceṣṭāsu pragalbhate nyak dakṣiṇastena | yathoktaṃ dhanurvede 'pūrvaṃ vāmena śikṣeta pūrvasiddho hi dakṣiṇaḥ |' iti | nyañcatīti nyak tena nīcā nyagbhūnetyāvṛttyā yojyam | ariktaṃ sābharaṇaṃ, asambhave suvarṇakarṇikādiyuktam, atidaurgatye puṣpaphalādisahitam | arikteneti tadvat | evaṃ savyena savyamiti samastasya maṃtrāderatideśaḥ| he kanye te tavāhaṃ hastaṃ gṛhṇāmi devasyāntarātmanaḥ savituḥ vaidikakarmāṇi cikīrṣoḥ prasave'nujñāyāṃ vartamānaḥ ādityasya vā savituḥ prasave'nujñāyāṃ vartamāno'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ natvātmīyābhyāṃ carmamayābhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ gṛhṇāmi || 17 || gṛhṇāmīti catasrastriṣṭubhāvanuṣṭubhau japati || 18 || gṛhṇāmi te suprajāstvāya hastau mayā patyā jaradaṣṭiryathāsaḥ | bhago aryamā savitā puraṃdhirmahyaṃ tvādurgārhapatyāya devāḥ || 1 || sūryāyā ārṣam | māṃtravarṇikī devatā | ahaṃ te tava hastau gṛhṇāmi | kimartham | suprajāstvāya lokyaputrasiddhaye | tvaṃ ca mayā patyā bhartrā satā jaradaṣṭiryathāsaḥ bhavasi tathā bhūyāḥ jarājarjaritadehā bhūyāḥ asamaye bhavatyāḥ pramayo mā bhūdityarthaḥ | amutra pakṣe jarayā daṣṭirupakṣayo yasyāḥ sā jaradaṣṭiḥ | tvā tvāṃ bhagādayaścatvāro devā adurdatavantaḥ gārhapatyā gārhapatyārtham || tāṃ pūṣaśivatamāmerayasva yasyāṃ bījaṃ manuṣyā vapanti | yā na ūrū uśatī viśrayāte yasyāmuśantaḥ praharāma śepam 2 he pūṣan āditya asyāḥ priyāyāstāṃ śivatamāṃ matiṃ ā īrayasva prerayasva tanuṃ vā | yasyāṃ satyāmadhikaraṇabhūtāyāṃ vījaṃ reto manuṣyā vapanti kṣipanti | yā no'smānuśatī kāmayamānā satī ūrū viśrayāte vividhaṃ kṛtvā śrayāte samarpayati vitaṃtayati vātmīyāvūrū | vayamapi yasyāmuśantaḥ kāmayamānāḥ santaḥ praharāma prakṣipāma śepaṃ prajananam, anyonyamāvayoḥ prītirastvityarthaḥ | tathāhyayamupakāro bhavati 'saṃprītiryatra dampatyostrivargastatra vardhate | ' somo'dadadgandharvāya gandharvo'dadadagnaye | rayiṃ ca putrāṃścādādagnirmahyamatho imām || 3 || iyaṃ kanyā pūrvaṃ somasya saṃbandhinyāsīt | sa somo bhuktvemāṃ gandharvāyādadat dadau, gandharvo | agnirmahyaṃ saṃprati dadātu | na kevalamimāṃ yāvatā rayiṃ dhanaṃ putrāṃścāgnirmahyaṃ dadātu agnirimāṃ kanyāṃ mahyaṃ dattvā putradhanasamṛddhāṃ karotvityarthaḥ || etamevārthaṃ caturthyarcā prapaṃcayati somaḥ prathamo vivide gandharvo vivida uttaraḥ | tṛtīyo'gniṣṭe patisturīyo'haṃ manuṣyajaḥ || 4 || he kanye tvāṃ somaḥ prathamo vivide patistava babhūva prathamaḥ | tata uttaro dvitīyaḥ gaṃdharvo vivide | tṛtīyo'gniste patistava patirbabhūva | turīyaścaturtho'haṃ manuṣyajo mānuṣyaḥ saṃprati bhavāmi || 18 || tato gāthā vācayati sarasvati predamavetyanuvākamubhāvityeke yadi pṛthaktaṃtram || 19|| gīyanta iti gāthāḥ viśiṣṭā eva ṛcaḥ | ata eva kāstā ityapekṣāyāṃ sarakhati premavetyanuvākamāha atrānuvāke yāḥ sthitāstā evetyarthaḥ | dvyantarakharayuktāsu ca kāsucidṛkṣu gāthāśabda rūḍhaḥ | yathoktaṃ 'chandogā bahūcācaiva tathā vājasaneyinaḥ | uccanīcakharaṃ prāhuḥ sa vai gāthika ucyate ||' iti | ayaṃ samudāyārthaḥtato'nantaraṃ sarakhatītyanuvākaparicchinnā gāthā guruvaraṃ vācayati bhāṇayati | eke punarmanyante ubhāvapi kanyāvarau gāthā guruvacayati | kiṃ sarvadā | netyāha, yadi pṛthaktramiti | atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ - vivāho hi bhinne karmaṇī | kanyāsaṃskāro vivāhaḥ | varasaṃskāra udvāhaḥ | tatra yadi deśakālakatraikyāttatreṇetikartavyatā, tadā sakṛdekaṃ varameva bhāṇayati gāthāḥ svādhyāyiko guruḥ, yadi tu deśakālaikye'pi kanyāvarayorevādhikṛtatvādṛtvijo dakṣiṇayā kītatvāt kartṛbhedāttaṃtra bhedastadabhāvapi vācayitavyau - iti || sarasvati premava subhage vājinīvati | yāṃ tvā viśvasya bhūtasya prāgāyāmyasyāgrataḥ || 1 || atrānuvā brahmaṇa ārṣam | anuṣṭup chandaḥ | gandharvāpsarorājarṣiprabhṛtīnāṃ caritaṃ dvantareṇa vareṇa yābhirgīyate, tā gāthā ityuktam | iha ca sarvavāk sarakhatī, tadrūpeṇa ca vadhūrupacaryate | manomeghaprabhṛtiśca gandharvaḥ | tadrūpo varaḥ stutyarthamucyate sarakhatīti pretyupasargo'vetyākhyātena saṃbadhyate | he sarasvati sā tvamidaṃ karma prāva 'ava rakṣaṇe' gopāya | subhage sarvahitakāriṇi | vājinīvati vājinyaḥ phalapākāntā oṣadhayastadvati | stanayitnuvāgrūpā sarasvatī vṛṣṭyādidvāreṇa | sākā | yāṃ tvāmahaṃ prāgāyāmi śabdayāmi staumi | kīdṛśīm | asya viśvasya sarvasya bhūtasyotpannasya sargādāvagre sthitāṃ śabdabrahmavivartatvāt sarvasya sarasvatyāśca śabdarūpatvāt || yā sarva samabhavadyasyāṃ viśvamidaṃ jagat | tāmadya vācaṃ gāsyāmi yā strīṇāmuttamaṃ manaḥ || 2 || tāṃ cādya asminnahani sarakhatīṃ vācaṃ gāsyāmi śabdayiṣyāmi | yā strīṇāmuttamaṃ manaḥ mānasaṃ prakāśanam, prakāśātmikā hi vāk, prakāśarūpaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ cetaḥ | yāca agre prathamaṃ sargādau samabhavat sarvaṃ vivartarūpā babhūva | yasyāṃ cedaṃ vartamānaṃ viśvaṃ sarvaṃ jagadāśritam || ya iha pūrve janā āsan pūrve pūrvatarebhyaḥ | mūrdhanvāṃstebhyo gandharvaḥ purā devebhya ātapat || 3 || ya iha pūrve janāḥ, ya iha jagati pūrve janā abhūvan, tatpūrvatarebhyo'pica pūrve, tebhyo'pi purā gandharvo mūrdhanvānnānnāsīt | kiṃ bahunā, devebhyo'pi yaḥ purā ātapat prakāśitavān brahmarūpa ityarthaḥ | gāṃ sarakhatīṃ dhārayati vṛṇoti ca gaṃdharvaḥ | sarakhatī vāgātmikeyamadhigīyamānā kanyā, prajāpatirūpo gandharvo vara iti prarocanārthaḥ || 3 || ya eti sarvataḥ prāgbhyo diśo 'dhipavamānaḥ | mūrdhanvāṃstebhyo0 || 4 || yo vāyurūpaḥ san sarvata eti āgacchati adhipavamāna ādhikyena pavitrīkurvan | ataśca prāgādibhyo digbhya āgacchantaḥ prācyādideśabhedena vyapadeśabhedabhinnā vāyavo bhavanti, tebhyo'pi devebhyo vāyubhyaḥ purā pūrva mūrdhanvāneva gandharvaḥ ātapat || 4|| sa bhagavo na mariṣyasyahaṃ cedasmi bheṣajam | mūrdhanvāṃstebhyo0 || 5 || yaḥ pūrvotpannaḥ san jīvātmanā saha prāṇākhyo vāyuḥ, he bhagavaḥ bhagavan jīva, sa tvaṃ maraṇadharmāpi na mariṣyasi yāvadahamasmi bhavāmi bheṣajaṃ tiṣṭhāmi indriyaiḥ saha | tebhyo'pi devebhyo dyotanādidharmakebhyaḥ prāṇendriyebhyaḥ rāmūrdhanvān gandharva ātapat || 5 || hiraṇyavarṇo vairampaḥ sa tvā manmanasaṃ karotu | yadrājā yāti samitiṃ samudramiva sauśravaḥ || 6 || sa prakṛto gandharvaḥ prajāpatiḥ he vadhu tvāṃ manmanasaṃ karotu iti vara āśāste madekacittāṃ pativratāṃ karotvityarthaḥ | kīdṛśaḥ sa | hiraṇyavarṇaḥ bhākharaprakāśaikarūpaḥ | vairampo vīrasya yogino mohavaicitryamohanasamarthasya karma vairaṃ tat pāti rakṣatīti vairampaḥ | yat yaḥ saubhravaḥ śobhanabhrūmadhyasaṃyamātpratīto yogināṃ, rājā rājamānaḥ, samitiṃ saṃgrāmamiva samudramimaṃ saṃsāraduḥkhabhāraṃ yāti tārayatītyarthaḥ | ya eti sarvataḥ prāgbhyo diśa iti paṃcamyāḥ sthāne vyatyayena prathamā | kecitprāgbhyo viśa iti paṭhanti, tatra cchandaso varṇavyatyayaḥ| purāṇataracchāndasāstu paṭhanti prāgvādibhyo 'dhipavamāna iti, arthaṃ ca vyācakṣate prāk prathamaṃ vāti vāyate vā gacchati prāgvā, sarvābhyaḥ sarvato digbhyaḥ pavamāna tīti || vicchinna saṃpradāyeṣu śatādhyayanavartiṣu | mantreṣvapauruṣeyeṣu yathecchaṃ parikalpanāt || pāṭhānāṃ gatyabhāvena yathādṛṣṭi pradarśanam | kriyamāṇaṃ satāmagryairnopālabhyaṃ kathaṃcana || na vātasyāmi vāyate nodvātasyāmi dhīyate | na vātasyā dhuraṃ vahato nodvātasyāpamīyate || 7 || vātasyābhi agre na anyena kenāpi devena vāyate gamyate | nodvātasyābhi dhīyate naca vātasyābhimukhena kenāpi dhīyate āgantuṃ manyate | vātasya dhuraṃ vahataḥ pṛthivyādikaṃ dhārayato vimānādikaṃ ca prerayato nānyena kenāpyapamīyate saha gamyate māhātmyamācaryate | uditi nipātaḥ sahārthe | punaḥpunarvātaśabdodīraṇamatiśayārthamaho ramaṇīyā aho ramaṇīyetyādivat | kecittu paṭhanti nedvātasyāddha dhīyate na it vātasya āt ha dhīyate, ukāro varṇāgamaḥ, haśabda itihāse, anyenādhīyate sahāyenāgamyate || 7 || ā satyaharito rathaḥ saubhravaḥ suhiraṇyayaḥ | taṃ vāta idrajīyatyudvāto dṛḍhayā dhurā || 8 || ā ityupasargo dhajīyatītyanenākhyātena saṃbadhyate | satyaḥ satyapradhāno harito haritavarṇaḥ ādityarathaḥ, athavā satyapradhānāśca te harayośvāste vidyante yasya sa satyaharita iti matvarthīyastakāraḥ | saubhravaḥ bhrūsaṃyamena tīkṣṇadṛṣṭibhirapi draṣṭumaśakyaḥ | hiraṇyayaḥ hiraṇmayastaijasaḥ | tamudvāta ūrdhvagatirvāta ādhrajīyati 'ādhajayati gamayatīti vivartasya prajāpatirūpasya vāyormāhātmyavarṇanam | kayā ādhrajīyati udvātaḥ | dṛḍhayā dhurā ūrdhva utkṛṣṭo vāta eva ḍhā dhūtayā || 8|| tavaiva rājandundubhayastava dundubhirānakaḥ | taba bātodvātā avau tava caitrarathaṃ vanam || 9 || mūrdhanvān gandharva ucyate | he mūrdhanvan rājan tavaiva dundubhayo jayodghoṣaṇā vādyaviśeṣāḥ - utkṛṣṭā vā śabdādayaḥ prakāśanaparāḥ, tathā ānakaḥ paṭahākhyo'pi dundubhiviśeṣaḥ, tavaiva vātastiryaggatiḥ pavanaḥ, udvātaḥ ūrdhvagatirvāto'dhaḥpatanādvā, tathā aśvau | athavā dehagataḥ prāṇo vāyurudvātaḥ, apāno vātastau vātodvātau prāṇāpānau śarīrasya rathasya aśvāviva sarvaprāṇinām | caitrarathākhyaṃ vanaṃ devodyānaṃ tavaiva, sarvavibhavāstvatsvāmikā ityarthaḥ || 9|| te śukraṃ śakrasyāvindanparāñcaṃ nihitaguhā | mūrdhanvāṃstebhyo gandharvaḥ purā jatrubhya āvṛdaḥ || 10 || te devā vāyvādayaḥ śakrasya śaktasya sarvakāraṇasya prajāpateḥ śukraṃ sāramavindan jñātavantaḥ | parāñcaṃ parokṣaṃ guhāyāṃ hṛdaye viduṣāṃ nihitaṃ, avidyābhedaprapañca vā guhā | yadvā śakrasyendrasya śukraṃ prajananamudakalakṣaṇaṃ guhāyāṃ raśmisaṃghāte nihitaṃ parokṣaṃ jñātavantaḥ te devāḥ | tebhyo devebhyaḥ purā pūrvaṃ mūrdhanvān gandharvo 'vindat | kimavadhi jñātavān | jatrubhya ātṛdaḥ ājatrubhya ātṛdaḥ jatrūṇi saṃśleṣaṇāni sarvādhikaraṇāni 'sṛpitṛdoḥ kasuna tṛdaḥ tardanaṃ vināśaḥ āssṛṣṭerāpralayāt yadutpādanapālanapralayasaṃpādanasāmarthyaṃ, tanmūrdhanvānavindat sakalamicchātaḥ || 10 || hiraṇyavarṇa subhṛtaṃ śobhamānaṃ kanyāyā hastaṃ parigṛhya puṇyam | sā putrakāmā subhagāya bhartre bhava vaśīyāngirivatsthirāya ||11|| eṣa kaśmīreṣveva saṃprati paṭhyate | vara āśāste kanyāyā hastaṃ gṛhītvā ahaṃ vaśīyānbhava bhūyāsam | bhaveti vyatyayena madhyamapuruṣaḥ | athavā antarātmābhidhīyate kanyāyā hastaṃ gṛhītvā he antarātman vaśīyānbhava girivasthirāya parvatavat sthairyāya | he vadhu tvamapi yā mayohyase sā bhartre bhartrarthaṃ putrakāmā bhava | kāmanaṃ kāmaḥ putrārtha eva kāmo ratiryasyāḥ putrakāmā | kimartham | subhagāya saubhāgyāya, putravatī hi satī loke ślāghyā bhavati, natu ratyekaphalā | bhartṛviśeṣaṇaṃ vā subhagāyeti | hastaṃ viśinaṣṭi - hiraṇyavarṇaṃ suvarṇakānti, subhṛtaṃ kaṅkaṇāyābharaṇaiḥ supūrṇamata eva śobhamānaṃ, maṃtravatparigrahātpuṇyaṃ pavitram || 11 || vairampe muniparvate girau haritasaṃkāśe | saṃkalparamaṇe'marāvubhau sumanasau carāvaḥ || 12 || vara āhahe vadhu vairampākhye munijanasevite harita saṃkāśe suvarṇamaye merāviti yāvat, saṃkalpamātreṇa sarvābhilaṣitasatphalaprāptiryatra tatra saṃkalparamaṇe, amarāvamaraṇadharmako devo bhūtvā ubhāvapi sumanasau prasannacittau carāvaḥ saṃcariṣyāvaḥ puruṣāyuṣe pūrṇe || 12 || āṇī va rathaveṣṭasi vane vārivarṣaṇṇye | apsarāḥ sūryavarcasinī vaśinī manmanā bhūyāḥ || 13 || āṇī rathakāṣṭhikā, he vadhu tvamāṇī va rathaveṣṭasi rathavyāpinī yathā rathāvyabhicāriṇī, tathā mayi bhūyāḥ pavitrā | vaśabda upamāyām | tathā vane vārivarṣaṇye vidyullatā yathā avyabhi cāriṇī meghaṃ vanaṃ vinā na dṛśyate, tathā tvaṃ mayi bhūyāḥ | vāri varṣat patat nayatyanumāpayatīti vārivarṣaṇṇyā taḍit | apsarāśca setyāhuḥ | tathā sūryavarcasinī tejakhinī bhūyāḥ vaśinī ca īśānā manmanāśca mayi dattacittā pativratā bhūyā ityarthaḥ || 13 || yāsā upari tiṣṭhati vane vārivarṣaṇṇye | vasugā sūryavarcasinī vaśinī manmanā bhūyāḥ || 14 || athavā yāsau taḍidrūpadhāriṇī apsarā upari tiṣṭhati, saiveha tvaṃ rūpāntareṇāvatīrṇā ahaṃ ca megho vārivarṣaṇṇyaḥ | ataśca tvaṃ mayi dattacittā bhūyā iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa | vasugā dhanavatīti viśeṣaḥ || 14 || aśvatthaka upari śyeno ramaṇīyataro nāma | tasminha rambhā ramate śakra iva paritakmyāyām || 15 || praśasto vaṭavṛkṣo'śvatthakastatropari śyenaḥ śaṃsanīyo ramaṇīyataro nāma gandharva āste | tasminnapsarā rambhā nāma ramate krīḍate | śakra ādityaḥ, sa yathā paritakmyāyāṃ rātrau viśrāmyati || 15 || āsyandamānā subhage nirgiribhyaḥ sarasvati | māteva duhitṛbhyaḥ kulyābhyo vibhajā vasu || 16 || sarakhatīṃ nadīṃ vācaṃ vā madhyamāmabhyarthayate | he sarasvati subhage nirgatā giribhyaḥ, syandamānā sravantī, kulyābhyo'nyanadībhyaḥ vasu jalamābhaja vibhaja māteva duhitṛbhyaḥ | yathā mātā duhitṛbhyo dhanaṃ paitṛkaṃ vibhajate, tadvat | madhyamavākpakṣe girayo dehāḥ, kulyā galabilāni || idānīṃ 'vāgvā anuṣṭup vāksarasvatī' iti śrutyānuṣṭubhaḥ sarakhatīrūpatvapratipādanādanuṣṭuchandorūpeṇa stotumāha madhyaṃ tacchandasa āhuryatrādadhurnāma pareti devāḥ | aruṇapiśaṅgo'śvo'sya dakṣiṇā yastadveda sa ihāgantumarhati 17 chandasa iti vyatyayenaikavacanam | chandasāṃ devānāmasurāṇāṃ ca tadanuṣṭupchando madhyaṃ madhyavarti devā ṛtvija āhurvadanti | yatra cchandasi pareti parāgacchati devāsuracchandasāṃ madhyamanusarati anuṣṭubityanarthakaṃ nāma devā ādadhuḥ vihitavantaḥ | atrāntarā madhye'nuṣṭup vyavasthitā | tāni ṣoḍaśini grahe viniyuktāni | tatra ca ṣoḍaśini grahe aruṇapiśaṅgo'śvo'sya dakṣiṇā matā | sā cetaracchandomadhye vyavasthitasya rājaprakhyasyāsyaiva cchandaso'nuṣṭublakṣaṇasya bhavatīti sambhāvyate| ata evaṃbhūtaṃ tadanuṣṭupchando yo veda vetti, sa iha pāṇigrahaṇasthāne āgantumarhati ṛtvigjanyaprabhṛtiḥ, nātadvit | devāsuracchandasāṃ tu madhyavartitvamanuṣṭubha itthaṃ 'gāyatryuṣṇiganuṣṭubho bṛhatīpaṃktitriṣṭubhaḥ | jagatī ceti vijñeyāśchandasāṃ sapta jātayaḥ || tatraikaikākṣaravṛcyā daivānyekākṣarādīni saptākṣarāntāni sapta cchandāṃsi bhavanti | devī ekākṣarā gāyatrī | yakṣarā uṣṇik | tryakṣarānuṣṭup | evamādikrameṇa daivī jagatī satākṣarā, āsurī tu paṃcadaśākṣarā | ekaikākṣarahānyā ca prātilomyenānyānyāsurāṇi cchandāṃsi bhavanti | tatra navākṣarā gāyatrī bhavati | evaṃ caikākṣarādārabhya saptamākṣaraparyantānyānulomyena daivāni cchandāṃsi sthitāni | paṃcadaśākṣarādārabhya prātilomyena navamamakṣaraṃ yāvadāsurāṇi | aṣṭamaṃ tvakṣaraṃ vargadvayasya madhye bhavati | teneyamaṣṭākṣarā anuṣṭup madhye bhavatītyalamativaitatye || 17 || iṣīkavarṇe lekhaḥ subhage susmite | mūrdhanvāṃstvā gandharvo māmabhiniyacchatu || 18 || iṣīkaṃ śarakāṇḍaṃ suvarṇamityeke | he surṇavarṇe śarakāṇḍagaurākāre vā, he lekhanaḥ aṃjanalekhāvaddhruvau yasyāḥ, sā sambodhyate, he subhage priyadarśane, susmite cāruhāsini, tvāṃ mūrdhanvāngandharvo māmabhi māṃ prati niyacchatu niyatāṃ madekādhīnāṃ karotu | sa hi kanyākhāmītyuktam || 18 || ubhaye tvā devagandharvāḥ sabhyaśca vihvayāmahe | teṣāṃ yatarānkāmayase tānabhyehi sarasvati || 19 || somakrayiṇī vāk sarakhatītyucyate | he sarasvati devā gandharvāśvobhaye sadhyañcaḥ sahāñcamānāḥ saha bhūtvā tvāṃ vihṛyāmahe tava vividhamāhvānaṃ kurmaḥ | teṣāmubhayeṣāṃ madhye yatarān kāmayase devān gandharvānvā, tānabhyehi abhimukhyena gaccha || 19 || abhyāvarte'haṃ devāngāyataḥ kāmayāmahe | gāyantaṃ striyaḥ kāmayante na tathā brahmavādinam || 20 || sarakhatyāhagāyato devānevāhamabhyāvarte ābhimukhyena varte, natu vedaṃ paṭhataḥ surān | yatoShaṃ gāyata eva kāmayāmahe kāmaye iti vacanavyatyayaḥ | tathāhi gāyantameva hi striyaḥ kāmayante, natu brahmavādinaṃ vedānāṃ pāṭhakam ||20|| yā sā upari parvata ātmanā ramamāṇeva | kṣaumamṛdvī ha vā asi tvota ojasa śṛṇomi || 21 || yā upari parvate girau meghe vā vidyudrūpeṇa madhyamavāgrūpeṇa vā ātmanā khena rūpeṇa ramamāṇeva krīḍantīva tiṣṭhati sarakhatī, sā he vadhu asi bhavasi tvaṃ nāsti naḥ saṃśayaḥ | kīdṛśī | kṣaumamṛī dukūlavatkomalā jalavṛṣṭidānenārthābhidhānena vā | ha vai iti nipātau pādapūraṇau | evaṃ ca sati vadhūṃ vadati varaḥyatastvaṃ sarakhatī, tena tvayā ūto rakṣitaḥ sannahamojasi sati śṛṇomi ākarṇayāmi sakalaṃ kartavyaṃ śrutismṛtivihitaṃ kartavyatayā vyavasyāmi sahadharmacāriṇyāstava lābhabalenetyarthaḥ | kecittu śṛṇotviti paṭhanti | tatrāpyayaṃ madātmā śṛṇotvityarthaḥ || 21 || iti sārasvatānuvākavivṛtiḥ || tato gāthā vācayati sarasvati premavetyanuvākabhāvityeke yadi pṛthaktatramiti vivṛtamiyatā | yadi pṛthaktantramityuttarasūtreṇāpi saṃbadhyate || 19 || pradakṣiṇamagnimānīya tatraivopaveśya saṃsthāpayet || 20 || pṛthaktatrapakṣe'gnipradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā vadhūvarāvānīya punastatraivopaveśya yatra pāṇigrahaṇaṃ vṛttaṃ, saṃsthāpayet samāpayedṛtutithyādikaṃ bhaviṣyatatramudvāhasaṃbandhitayā, tato vivāhasaṃbandhitayā bhūya udvāhanatatraṃ sakalaṃ pūrva pradarśitaṃ vivāhasaṃbandhitayopakramya vakṣyamāṇaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ || 20 || ekakarmaṇi tantre uttareṇāgniṃ pratyetya tato vivāhaḥ || 21 || karmaśabdaḥ prayogavacanaḥ | tatramitikartavyatā vidhyantā | sakṛdnuṣṭhīyamānetikartavyatopakārapakṣe uttareṇāgniṃ pratyetya pradakṣiṇamakṛtvaiva uttarabhāgenaiva katipayakramān gatvā pratyāgatya tato vivāhaḥ vivāhāṅgatayā vakṣyamāṇānāmṛtutithyādīnāṃ prayogaḥ | tatreṇa codvāhopakāroktānāṃ vakṣyamāṇānāṃ ca āvṛttyānuṣṭhānamityarthaḥ | ekakarmaṇi tatra vivāhodvāhalakṣaṇa ityapi kecitpadayojanāṃ kurvanti || 21 || eta eva tatrāvṛttī spaṣṭārthamekenaiva sūtreṇa vivarītumāha ya ime dyāvāpṛthivītyādaya udvāhahomā jayaprabhṛtayaśca naikakarmaṇi tantre sviṣṭakṛdājyabhāgau ca || 22 || udvāhe . homā ye jayaprabhṛtayaḥ, ya ime dyāvāpṛthivītyādayaśca tathā sviṣṭakṛt, tathā ājyabhāgau | ete sarve na ekakarmaṇi tatre āvṛttyā kartavyāḥ ityarthājjñāyate | tena śrutyarthānāṃ vidhiniṣedhalakṣaṇamarthadvayaṃ yathāsaṃbhavamanena nidarśitam | sviṣṭakṛcchanda uparitanasya tatrakhaṇḍasyopalakṣaṇārthaḥ, ājyabhāgaśabdo 'pyadhastanasya || 22|| paścādagnerdarbheṣu sā tvamasīti vācayati sā tvamasyamohamamo'hamasmi sā tvam | tā ehi vivāvahai puṃse putrāya kartave | rāyaspoṣāya suprajāstvāya suvīryāya || 23 || ekakarmaṇi tatre uttareṇābhiṃ pratyetya pratyānīyāḥ paścāddarbheṣu vinihitacaraṇau vadhūvarau kṛtvā 'sā tvamasi' iti varaṃ guruvacayati || sā nāma ṛgāsīt amo nāma sāma, sā ca amaśca sāma ṛk ca gītiścetyarthaḥ | evaṃ sāmaśabdasya vyutpattiḥ | ṛksāmarūpāvāvāmiti vibhajya varaḥ pradarśayati - he vadhu tvaṃ sā ṛgasi bhavasi, amo'hamasmi ahamamaḥ sāma bhavāmi | sā tvaṃ sā tvaṃ bhavasi, amo'hamamo'haṃ bhavāmīti dviruktyā ṛksāmarūpatvaṃ draḍhayati | tā ehi vivahāvahai tau dvāvāvā he vadhu ehyāgaccha vivahāva hai vivāhaṃ kurvaḥ | kimartham | puṃse putrāya kartave, kartave iti tumarthe bhāve tavenpratyayaḥ, puṃse putrāyeti subvyatyayaḥ, pumāṃsaṃ putraṃ kartum | tathā rāyo dhanasya poṣāya puṣṭaye, suprajāstvāya śobhana prajālābhāya, suvīryāya suvīryaṃ karmakhojasvitā tadartham || 23 || agnimabhidakṣiṇamānīyehyaśmānamātiṣṭhāśmeva tvaṃ sthiro bhava | kṛṇvantu viśvedevā āyuṣṭe śaradaḥ śatamiti dakṣiṇena padāśmānamāsthāpayatyātiṣṭhemamaśmānamaśmeva tvaṃ sthirā bhava | pramṛṇīhi duvasyavaḥ sahasva pṛtanyata iti || 24 || agnimabhidakṣiṇaṃ vadhūvarāvānīya, agneruttarabhāge'śmānaṃ sthāpayitvā dakṣiṇena caraṇena āsthāpayati guruḥ prayojakaḥ, vadhūvarāvātiṣṭhata ākrāmataḥ | yathāmantraliṅgamādyena varo'śmānamākrāmati, uttareṇa vadhūḥ | gurustvāśāste tayomaṇeṣṭam - he vara aśmānamātiṣṭha aśmavat sthiro bhava, kiṃca te tava viśvedevāḥ śaradaḥ śatamāyuḥ kṛṇvantu kurvantu, he vadhu imamaśmānamātiṣṭha tvaṃ cāśmavat sthirā bhava, tathā duvasyavaḥ duvasyūn upatāpamicchataḥ śatrūn pramṛṇīhi jahi, tathā pṛtanyataḥ pṛtanāṃ senāmicchato yuyutsamānān sahasva prasahasva abhibhava dakṣiṇena padetyuttaramantre'pyanuṣajyate || 24 || ājyasyāñjalāvupastīryedaṃ havirityabhimṛśyāthāsyai śamīlājānāvapati bhrātā brahmacārī vā || 25|| ājyenāñjalāvupastṛṇāti caturavadānena | tata idaṃ havirityādinā matreṇa śūrpasthān śamīparṇamiśrāṃllājānabhimṛśati varaḥ | anantaramañjalāvasyā vadhvā bhrātā, brahmacārī vā bhrāturasannidhāne śamīparṇamiśrāṃlājānāvapati || idaṃ haviḥ prajananaṃ me astu daśavīraṃ sarvagaṇaṃ svastaye | ātmasana prajāsana paśusanyabhayasani lokasani | agniḥ prajāṃ bahulāṃ me karotu annaṃ payo reto asmāsu dhatta || kokilasya rājaputrasyārṣam | anuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ | idaṃ lājākhyaṃ haviḥ me mama prajananaṃ daśaputrasaṃpādanaṃ bhavatu, tathā sarvagaṇaṃ sarveṣāṃ gaṇaiḥ putraprabhṛtīnāṃ paśūnāṃ gaṇairyuktaṃ, svastaye'vināśāya cāstu | ātmasāna ātmānaṃ śarīramātmīyatvātsanati ' ṣaṇu dāne' ityasmāddhātoḥ dadāti prajñāpayatītyātmasani | evaṃ prajāsani paśusanyabhayasani lokasani | sarvatreha haviranyapadārthaḥ | agnirmama putrapautrādikāṃ bhūyasīṃ prajāṃ karotu | annādikaṃ cāsmākaṃ dhatta sthiraṃ kuruta | bahuvacanādarddhamagandharvatryambakā ijyamānā evaṃ prārthyante'parārdhe || 25 || tānavicchindatī juhotyaryamaṇaṃ nu devamiti || 26 || tān lājān avicchindatī vicchedamakurvatī ekenaiva prakṣepeṇa juhotyaryamaṇaṃ nu devamityādimantreṇa || aryamaṇaṃ nu devaṃ kanyā agnimayakṣata | so'smāndevo aryamā preto muñcātu māmuṣya gṛhebhyaḥ svāhā || brahmaṇa ārṣam | aryamagandharvatryambakā devatāḥ| upariṣṭādṛhatyo homamaṃtrāḥ | iyaṃ nārītyanuṣṭup | kanyā agniṃ devamayakṣata iṣṭavatyaḥ | aryamaṇamityagnerviśeṣaṇam | arīn yacchatītyaryamāgniḥ, tam | ayakṣateti tivyatyayaḥ yajante | anye tvagnimityapi dvitīyāṃ saptamyāḥ sthāne varṇayanti agnāvaryamaṇaṃ kanyā yajante | atra pakṣe'ryamaiva devatā | evamanūcya vadhūryajñaphalamāśaṃsati | amuṣyeti sāmānyena bhartṛnāma lakṣyate | so'ryamā iṣṭaḥ san amuṣya devadtasya ito gṛhebhyo'smānmā pramuñcātu, māita niṣedhārtho nipātaḥ, ito bhartṛgṛhebhyo'smākaṃ ghyāvaṃ mā kārṣīdityarthaḥ | svāhā suhutamastu || agnirmā janimāniti vācayati || 27 || varaṃ bhāṇayati gururagnirityādimantramityarthaḥ || agnirmā janimānanayā janimantaṃ karotu | jīvapatnirbhūyāsam || janī jāyā | agniryato jāyāvānato māmapi jāyayā avicchinnasaṃbandhaṃ karotu | tatprasādādahamapi jīvapattirbhūyāsaṃ jīvā patnī yasya sa jīvapattrirahaṃ syām || 27 || iyaṃ nārīti sarvatrānuṣajati || 28 || iyaṃ nārītyasya anuṣṭubhaḥ triṣvapyanuṣaṅgaḥ kartavyaḥ || iyaṃ nāryupabrūte tokmānyāvapantikā | dīrghāyurastu me patirevantāṃ jñātayo mama || eṣā nārī bravīti | kim | dīrghāyurastu me patirjñātayaśca mitrādayo mama vardhantāmiti | kiṃ kurvatī bravīti | tokmānyāvapantī lājān juhvatītyarthaḥ || 28 || evaṃ dviruttaram || 29 || dvau vārau dviḥ | evamuttaraṃ karma dvau vārau kartavyam || 29 || tadeva sphuṭaṃ darśayitumāha paryayaṇe paryayaṇe lājāhomo yajamānaṃ cāśmānaṃ cāsthāpayati gandharvaṃ pativedanamiti || 30 || paryayaṇamagniparigamanaṃ yajamānānuṣañjanam | tatra ca varaḥ kartā arthāt | tato'śmanaḥ sthāpanam | tatra paristīrya lājānāmāvapanaṃ gandharva pativedanamiti || gandharva pativedanaṃ kanyā agnimayakṣata | so'smāndevo gandharvaḥ prato muñcātu māmuṣya gṛhebhyaḥ khāhā || gāṃ pṛthvīṃ dhārayatīti gandharvastamagniṃ pativedanaṃ patyurlambhayitāraṃ kanyā anyā yato'yakṣata iṣṭavatyaḥ, ato'hamapi yaje iti nārī brūte ityarthaḥ | saca devo'gniriṣṭaḥ san gandharvo 'muṣya bharturgṛhebhyo'smān mā pramuñcātu iti pūrvavatpratiṣedhaḥ || 30 || somo mā jñātimāniti vācayati || 31|| soma ityādimatraṃ guruvacayatītyarthaḥ || somo mā jñātimānanayā jñāntimantaṃ karotu | jīvapatnirbhūyāsam || yataḥ somo jñātimānato māmapyanayā nāryā jñāntimantaṃ karotu | jīvapattirbhūyāsamiti vyākhyātam || 31 || tryambakaṃ yajāmaha iti || 32 || tryambakamityādinā tṛtīyo homaḥ || tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhi patipoṣaṇam | urvārukamiva bandhanānmṛtyormukṣīya māmuṣya gṛhebhyaḥ svāhā|| tryambakaṃ śaṃkaraṃ yajāmahe havirdānena pūjayāmaḥ | sugandhi suyaśasaṃ, gandhaśabdo yaśo'bhidhāyī prasiddhaḥ | patipoṣaṇaṃ bhartuḥ poṣayitāram | ahaṃ ca tryambakasya pūjitasya prasādāt mṛtyoḥ sakāśāt mukṣīya | kutaḥ kiṃvat | urvārukamiva bandhanāt urvārukaṃ karkarīphalaṃ, tadyathā bandhanādvṛntātpakkaṃ satsvata eva vimucyate vā arthibhitrovyate, tadvadahaṃ mṛtyoḥ sakāśānnityaviśliṣṭā syāmityarthaḥ | amuṣya bhartugṛhebhyaḥ punarmā kadācana mukṣīyeti niṣedhaḥ || pūṣā mā paśumāniti vācayati ||33|| asyāpi vācanameva, natvanena homaḥ || pūṣā mā paśumānanayā paśumantaṃ karotu | jīvapattirbhūyāsam || anayā paśusvāminaṃ māṃ pūṣā karotviti viśeṣaḥ || 33 || śiṣṭānsviṣṭakṛte juhoti śūrpeṇa kartā ||34|| lājaśabda ubhayaliṅgaḥ sūtrakṛtā dṛṣṭaḥ | kanyayā ye hutāstebhyo ye śiṣṭā lājāstān sviṣṭakṛte juhoti śeṣān 'sviṣṭakṛte samavadyati' iti vacanāt | kanyayā hi pradhānahomaḥ kṛto'ñjalinā | tannivṛttaye śūrpagrahaṇaṃ kartṛgrahaṇaṃ ca | vivāhakarmaṇi yaḥ kartā || 34 || atha dakṣiṇā kena deyetyāha varo dakṣiṇām || 35 || vara eva dakṣiṇāṃ vivāhakarmakartre dadyādidvattvāddhanakhāmikatvācca, natu nārītyarthaḥ | ṛtutithyādi yāvat sviṣṭakṛt || 35 || tūṣṇīṃ hastau vimucya vi te muñcāmīti sannahanam || 36 || sāvitreṇa mantreṇa hastagrahaṇaṃ yathā, tathā vimoko mā bhūditi tūṣṇīṃgrahaṇam | hastau vimucya tato 'vi te muñcāmi iti mantreṇa sannahanaṃ yokaṃ vimuñcati kartā matraliṃgāt natu svayam || vimuñcāmi raśanāṃ vi raśmīnvi yokrāṇi parivartanāni | dattvāyāsmabhyaṃ draviṇeha bhadraṃ pra mā brūtāddhavirdā devatābhyaḥ || triṣṭup | yatīnāmārṣam | 'vimoka evāsyaiṣa te' iti vacanādagnereṣa vimoko'nyatrānena pratītaḥ | bandhanasya ca raśanāraśmiyoṛśabdā abhidhāyakā ucyante | yujyante ebhiriti yokrāṇi | kīdṛśāni | parivartanāni samantāt cartanaṃ niyantritatayā yeṣāṃ tāni parivartanāni | muktamagniṃ yajamāno brūte - vimuktaḥ sannagnirasmabhyaṃ draviṇāni yajñopayogīni dhanāni dattvā bhadraṃ ca kalyāṇaṃ dattvā māṃ prabrūyāt | kīdṛśaṃ mām | havirdā devatābhyaḥ, haviṣo dātāraṃ yajñānuṣṭhāne māṃ viniyuktamiti prārthayate yajamāna ityarthaḥ | ihāpi parikrītenartvijā arthyamānasya yajamānārthatayā yajamānasyāśīrbhavati | raśanāraśmiśabdau ca yoṛparyāyau, paryāyaprayogo'tiśayārthaḥ | athavā yotrāṇi vimuñcāmi na kevalaṃ yotrāṇyeva raśanāṃ ca avidyāmityarthaḥ, vi raśmīn raśmīṃścāvidyāmūlātrāgādīnityarthaḥ | dampatyośca yoṝvimokena vivāhabhūmau sthito'nirmukto bhavati svātatryasaṃcaraṇena tasya saṃkaṭaparihārāt | ato vimuktaḥ pūrvavadyarthyate || uttarato'gnerdarbheṣu prācīṃ prakrāmayatyekamiṣe dve ūrje trīṇi rāyaspoṣāya catvāri mayobhavāya pañca prajābhyaḥ ṣaḍṛtubhyo dīrghāyutvāya saptamaṃ sakhā saptapadā bhava | sumṛḍīkā sarasvati mā te vyoma sandṛśi || viṣṇustvānvetvityanuṣaṅgaḥ || 37 || agneruttareṇāstīrṇeṣu darbheṣu prāṅmukhīṃ vadhūṃ prakrāmayati kartā saptapadāni saptabhirmaṃtraiḥ | viṣṇustvānvesviti sarvatrānuṣaṅgaḥ | ekamiṣe viṣṇustvānvetu - ekaṃ padamiṣe'nnāya nidhehi, tvāṃ ca gacchantīṃ viṣṇuranvetu | dve ūrje viṣṇustvānvetude pade ūrje balāya nidhehīti pūrvavat | trīṇi rāyaspoṣāya viṣṇustvānvetu - trīṇi padāni rāyo dhanasya puṣṭaye nidhehi | catvāri mayobhavāya viṣṇustvānvetu mayaḥ sukhaṃ tadbhavatyasmāditi mayobhūstasyedaṃ mayobhavaṃ, tadarthaṃ catvāri padāni nidhehi sukhabhavanaprārthanāyetyarthaḥ | paṃca prajābhyo viṣṇustvānvetu putrapauprajārthaṃ paṃca padāni nidhehi | ṣaḍṛtubhyo viṣṇustvānvetu - ṣaṭ padāni ṛtusāṃmukhyāya nivehi, te ca ṛtavaḥ saṃmukhībhūtāḥ phalaiḥ saṃbanantu tvāmityarthaḥ | dīrghāyutvāya saptamaṃ sakhā saptapadā bhava | sumṛḍīkā sarasvati mā te vyoma sandṛśi || viṣṇustvānvetu - dīrghāyutvāyāyuṣe saptamaṃ padaṃ nidhehi | ebhiśca saptabhiḥ padbhirbhartuḥ sukhāya bhava | sumṛḍīkā 'mṛḍa sukhane' susukhā | sarasvati mā te tava vyoma ākāśasthaḥ kaścitsaptamaṃ padaṃ drākṣīt pavanāndolitavāsaso nagnaṃ vā kaṃcitpradeśam || 37 || taccakṣurityādityamupasthāpayati || 38 || tacakṣurityādinā kartā kanyāmādityamupasthāpayati || taccakṣurdevahitaṃ purastācchukramuccarat | paśyema śaradaḥ śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ śatam || devahitaṃ devavihitaṃ devebhyo vā hitaṃ hitakāri | śukraṃ śuklam| uccarat ūrdhvaṃ carat gacchat udyat || 38 || astamite'gnim ||39|| vivāhe kriyamāṇe yadi rātrirbhavati rātrau cā vivāhaḥ, tadā tacakṣurityanayāgnimupa. sthāpayet || 39 || jīvantīṃ dhruvaṃ svastyātreyaṃ darśayatyarundhatīṃ ca || 40 || "jīvantīṃ kanyāmicchan dhruvādikaṃ darśayet | atra kecidrātrāvityanuvartayanti divā dhruvādidarśanābhāvāt, apare nānuvartayanti yato'ye paśyasīti praśne apaśyantī api paśyāmīti prativacanamāhetyartho lakṣyate | darśanamātra vivakṣayā hi paśyeḥ praiṣaḥ paśyāmi navetyatra cottaraṃ paśyema || 40 || eteṣāmekaikaṃ paśyasītyāha || 41 || paśyasītyaikaikasya nāma gṛhītvā pṛcchedguruḥ || paśyāmīti pratyāha || 42 || sāpi pṛṣṭā satī paśyāmīti pratibrūyāt || sumaṅgalīriyaṃ vadhūrimāṃ sametya paśyata | saubhāgyamasyai dattvāyāthāstaṃ viparītaneti vīkṣitānanumantrayate || 43 || vīkṣitān dhruvādīn gururanumantrayate | sumaṃ galīrityādyānuṣṭup | iyaṃ vadhūḥ śobhanamaṃgalayuktā bhavatu bhavatprasādāt | imāṃ sametya saṃbhūya paśyata | asyai ca saubhāgyaṃ dattvā paścādastaṃ gacchata | dattvāyeti ktvo yak | tena divāpi jñeyametat | dhruvādidarśanaṃ hi jīvanadyotanamāhuḥ | 'tadihāvasare'paśyantyā api paśyāmīti prativacanamapamṛtyuvyāghātāya smaryate | ata eva dhruvādikaṃ yaddarśayet, tatsvastyavināśameva darśayedityarthaḥ || 43 || uduttamamiti prāgudīcīmāvasathaṃ yatīmanumantrayate yato vā syāt || 44 || uduttamamityādinā anuṣṭupcatuṣṭayenāvasathaṃ gṛhaṃ yatīṃ gacchantīṃ prāgudīcīmuttarapūrvadigabhimukhīmanumantrayate | yatra vā āvasathaḥ `syāt, tadabhimukhaṃ gacchet || uduttamamārohantī vyasyantīva pṛtanyataḥ | mūrdhānaṃ patyurāroha prajayā ca virāṅgava || 1 || he vadhu uttamamutkṛṣṭaṃ gṛhaṃ sucaritaṃ vā ārohantī, pṛtanyataḥ pṛtanāṃ senāmicchataḥ śatrūn vyasyantīva kṣipantīva, patyurbharturmūrdhānamadhiroha tasya svaguṇagaṇena mānyā bhavetyarthaḥ, tathā prajayā putrapautrādikayā viśeṣeṇa rājamānā bhava || imāṃ tvamindra mīḍhvaḥ suputrāṃ subhagāṃ kṛṇu | daśāsyāṃ putrānāghehi patimekādaśaṃ kṛdhi || 2 || he indra mīḥ 'miha secane' sektaḥ, garbhagrahaṇākhyāyā retaḥ sthiterindraprasādāyattatvādevaṃ saṃbodhanam, imāṃ vadhūṃ suputrāṃ saubhāgyayuktāṃ ca kuru | daśāsyāṃ putrānādhehi vidhehi ekādaśaṃ patiṃ sampādaya || 2|| samrājñī śvaśure bhava samrājñī śvaśvāṃ bhava | nanāndari samrājñī bhava samrājñī adhidevṛṣu || 3 || he vadhu samrājñī śvaśure tvaṃ samrājñī mānanīyatamā samyagrājamānā bhava, tathā vananāndari ca bharturbhaginyā mevamadhidevṛṣu devareṣu || nuṣāṇāṃ śvaśurāṇāṃ ca prajāyāśca dhanasya ca | patīnāṃ ca devṛṇāṃ ca sajātānāṃ virāṅkava || 4 || sajātāḥ bāndhavaparijanaprabhṛtayaḥ | devṛṇāṃ 'chandasyubhayathā' iti hakhaḥ, madhyadeśe tu dīrghaḥ paṭhyate, devarāṇām | sarvaṃ gṛhagataṃ tavāyattamastvityarthaḥ | ata ūrdhvaṃ tvaṃ no agna ityāditaṃtraparisamāptiḥ| atra bhartṛgṛhagamanāvasare madhuparkakāṇḍikā paṭhyate | sā canātakaprakaraṇe vyākhyāsyate || 44 || iti jālandharīyajayapuravāstavyabhaṭṭopendrasūnuharipālaputradevapālaviracite samaṃtrakāṭhagṛbhāṣye vivāhaprakaraṇaṃ samāptam || iti pañcaviṃśī kāṇḍikā || 25 || atha ṣaḍviṃśī kāṇḍikā | puṇyāhe yuṃkte | yoge yoga iti yunakti || yadā vadhūḥ puṇye divase bhartṛgṛhaṃ gacchati tadā rathaṃ śivikāṃ vā yathāsambhavaṃ yuṃkte | tatra ca yoge yoga iti vyākhyātamaṃtrāvṛttyā aśvādikaṃ yunakti || 1 || aṅkunyaṅkā abhito rathaṃ ye dhvāntā vātāgramabhi ye saṃpatanti | dūrehetiḥ patatriṇī vājinīvāṃste no'gnayaḥ paprayaḥ pārayantviti cakre anumantrayate || 2 || aṅkunyaṅkāvityādikayā jagatyā āgnimārute rathacakre'numaṃtrayate ṛtvik pārśve vā | sakṛcca maṃtraḥ prayoktavyo dvivacanaliṃgāt | aṃcatītyaṃkuḥ, nyañcatīti nyaṅkaḥ, aṃkuśca nyaṃkaścāṅkunyaṃkau añcakanyañcakau gantṛviśeṣau yābhyāṃ cakre gacchataḥ | aṅkunyaṅkau rathasyābhitaḥ sthitau no'smākaṃ te'gnayaḥ pārayantu pathastārayantu pālayantu vā pathi | kenayaḥ | ye dhvāntāstamorūpāḥ kāṣṭhādīndhanajāḥ | ye ca vātāgramabhisaṃpatanti vaidyutādirūpā ityarthaḥ | yaśca dūrehetirdūragatārcirādityādirūpaḥ | yaśca patatriṇīvājinīvān patatriṇīvān vājinīvāṃścetyarthaḥ, patatriṇīvān vāyugaruḍādimūrtiṣu vyavasthitaḥ, vājinīvān vrīhyādimūrtyāśritaḥ | kīdṛśā agnayaḥ | paprayaḥ 'pṝ pālanapūraṇayoḥ prīṇantīti paprayaḥ pālayitāraḥ pūrayitāro vā kāmānāṃ 'prā pūraṇe' ityasya vā patriśabdaḥ || 2 || khe rathasya khe'nasaḥ khe yugasya ca tarmasu | khe akṣasya khe avadadhāmīti yugatarmasu śamīśākhāmavadadhāti || 3 || khe rathasyetyādinā yugasya tarmasu cchidreṣu śamīśākhāmavadadhāti | rathaṃsya khe ākāśe chidre avadadhāmi śākhāṃ, tathā khe'nasaḥ gavyāḥ, evaṃ yugasya tarmasu cchidreṣu, tathā khe akṣasya rathādhārakāṣṭhaviśeṣasyānyatrāpi ca khe chidre śāntyarthaṃ śamīśākhāmavadadhāmi || 3 || sukiṃśukaṃ śalmaliṃ viśvarūpaṃ hiraṇyavarṇaṃ suvṛtaṃ sucakram | āroha sūrye amṛtasya yoniṃ syonaṃ patye vahatuṃ kṛṇuṣvetyāropayate || 4 || sukiṃśukamityādinā vadhūṃ rathamāropayati | vadhu rathamāroha | kīdṛśam | sukiṃśukaṃ śopalāśakusumaistadupalakṣitairanyapuṣpaiśca parijanāhitaiḥ śobhanaṃ śalmaliṃ 'śala hula pallū gatau' gamanaśīlaṃ, athavā kiṃśukaśalmalidārunirmitatvādevamucyate, viśvarūpaṃ nānākāraṃ, hiraṇyavarṇa ujvalarūpaṃ, suvṛtaṃ phalakusumādibhiḥ parivṛtaṃ suvartulaṃ vā suvartanaṃ sukhaceṣṭaṃ vā, tathā śobhanacakraṃ, amṛtasya yoniṃ amaraṇadharmasya kāraṇamapramāpaṇakāriṇam | patye bhartre vyatyayena bhartuḥ syonaṃ sukhaṃ kṛṇuṣva kuruṣvainaṃ vahatuṃ vahatīti vahatustam || 4 || mā vidanparipanthinaḥ sumaṃgalīriti ca pravāhayate || 5 || ' mā vidanparipanthinaḥ' iti 'sumaṃgalīḥ' iti caitābhyāṃ vyākhyātārthābhyāṃ pravāhayate ratham || saṃkāśayā vivahataṃ brahmaṇā gṛhairaghoreṇa cakṣuṣā maitreṇa | paryāṇaddhaṃ viśvarūpaṃ yadasyāḥ syonaṃ patibhyaḥ savitā kṛṇotu taditi vadhūsaṃgame || 6 || etāṃ jagatīṃ sāvitrīṃ vadhūsaṃgame japati saṃkāśayetyādikām | aśvāvucyete | samyaganayā prakāśamānayā dṛṣṭayā idamano vivahataṃ prāpayatam | brahmaṇā annena saha, gṛhaiśca patyā gṛhaśabdena gṛhasthapatyucyate, aghoreṇa śivena, cakṣuṣā maitreṇa mitrasamvandhinā, natu śātraveṇa | kīdṛśaṃ vahatam | paryāṇaddhaṃ samantācchannam | tathā nānārūpaṃ yadanaḥ asyā vadhvāḥ patibhyaḥ syonaṃ sukhaṃ patibhya iti vacanavyatyayaḥ patye tacca savitā ca sukhādikaṃ sarvaṃ karotu | rathayoranyonyasaṃghāte vighātaśaṃkāyāmeṣa japaḥ|| ye pathīnāmiti catuṣpatheṣu japatīme catvāra iti ca ||7|| vyākhyātau maṃtrau | ye pathīnāmityanuṣṭup | ime catvāra iti triṣṭup || sūtraṃ spaṣṭārtham ||7|| ye śmaśāneṣviti śmaśāneṣu || 8 || japatītyanuṣaṅgaḥ || ye śmaśāneṣu puṇyajanāḥ śāvāsteṣu śerate | tatraiva te ramantāṃ mā vadhūranvavekṣata || śmaśāneṣu śavaśayaneṣu ye puṇyajanā yakṣā ye ca śāvāḥ pretāsteṣu śmaśāneṣu śerate tiṣṭhanti, tatraiva te ramantāṃ ratiṃ kurvantu, mā vadhūranvavekṣata mā drākṣurvadhūm | vadhūriti subvyatyayaḥ || 8 || ye vaneṣviti mahāvanaṃ mahāvṛkṣaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā japati || 9 || spaṣṭam | maṃtro'pi vivṛtaḥ || 9 || iha raḍiriti krūraṃ dṛṣṭvā || 10 || iha raḍirityādikaṃ krūraṃ siṃhādikaṃ dṛṣṭvā japatītyanuṣaṃgaḥ || iha raḍiriha ratiriha dhṛtiriha vidhṛtiriha svadhṛtiriha rantiriha ramatāmagre veṭ svāhā vaṭ || 'laḍa vilāse' laḍanaṃ raḍiḥ krīḍā iha asmāsu ramatām | tathā ratiḥ prītiḥ | sarvatra ramatāmityanuṣajati | iha dhṛtiḥ saṃtoṣaḥ | iha vidhṛtirvidharaṇaṃ sthairyam | svadhṛtiḥ svasya dhanasya dhāraṇam | iha raṃtiḥ ramaṇaṃ rantiḥ, raḍyādikaṃ hiṃsradarśanādasmatsakāśānmā dūrībhūdityarthaḥ | agre veṭ svāhā vaṭ saṃpradānārthīyā nipātāḥ || 10 || namo astu sarpebhya iti sarpān ||11|| dṛṣṭvā japatītyanuṣaṃgaḥ || namo astu sarpebhyo ye ke ca pṛthivyāmadhi | ye antarikṣe ye divi tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namaḥ || yeṣu vā yātudhānā ye vā vanaspatiranu | ye vāvaṭeṣu śerate tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namaḥ || ye vādo rocane divo ye vā sūryasya raśmiṣu | ye'psu sadāṃsi cakrire tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namaḥ || gatārtham || 11 || ye tīrthānīti tīrthe tā mandamāneti ca || 12 || tīrthe japati pratīkamudritānmantrānityarthaḥ | ye tīrthānīti vyākhyātā | tīrthamatra nipānaṃ nadyavatārasthānam | yathoktaṃ 'tīrthābhidhānamicchanti tritayaṃ kṛtabuddhayaḥ | śāstraṃ caiva nipānaṃ ca vāri cāpyṛṣisevitam ||' iti || tā mandamānā manuṣo duroṇa adhattaṃ rayiṃ sahavīraṃ vacasyave | kṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ suprapāṇaṃ śubhaspatī sthāṇuṃ patheṣṭhāmapa durmatiṃ hatam || āśvinī | jagatī | he aśvinau mandamānau stūyamānau harṣayuktau mada stutimodamadetyādikādarthanirdeśāt manuṣo manuṣyasya duroṇe gṛhe rayiṃ dhanaṃ adhattaṃ chāndaso hrasvaḥ ādhattam | kīdṛśaṃ dhanam | sahavīram putrasahitaṃ sahasravīrya vā putrapautrādimālāyuktamityarthaḥ | kiṃca tīrthaṃ suprapāṇaṃ kṛtaṃ yuvāṃ kurutaṃ svavagāhaṃ, tathā sthāṇuṃ tiṣṭhantyasmin saṃpada iti sthāṇuḥ | kasmai | vacasyave vaca icchatyātmanaḥ 'supa ātmanaḥ kyac' 'kyācchandasi' ityutvaṃ tasmai vacasyave | he śubhaspatī śubhasya pālayitārau durmatiṃ duṣṭāṃ matimasya manuṣyasya apahṛtaṃ vināśayatam | kīdṛśīṃ durmatim patheṣṭhāṃ pathi tiṣṭhati patheṣṭhā tāṃ surūḍhāmityarthaḥ || ayaṃ no mahyāḥ pāraṃ svasti naiṣadvanaspatiḥ | sīrā naḥ sutarā bhava dīrghāyutvāya varcase || tīrthaviśeṣanadītaraṇe'yaṃ maṃtraḥ | gāyatrī | ayaṃ vanaspatirvānaspatyo rathaḥ no'smān mahyāḥ mahatyā nadyāḥ pāraṃ naiṣat nayatu | svasti avināśaṃ kṛtvā | sīrā ca nadī no'smākaṃ sutarā bhava bhavatu | dīrghāyutvāya dīrghāyuṣe, varcase ca asmākaṃ sīrā bhavatu | dīrghāyutvāyetyatra tvapatyoriti salopaśchāndasaḥ || aśmanvatī rīyate saṃrabhadhvamuttiṣṭhata pratarāma sakhāyaḥ | atrājahāma ye asannaśevāḥ śivānvayamuttaremābhivājān || anena prakṛtā nadī tīryate | he sakhāyaḥ janyāḥ uttiṣṭhata, saṃrabhadhvaṃ saprayatnā bhavata, pratarāmo nadīm | prayatnaviśeṣeṇa preṣaṇe hetumāha yato'śmanvatī pāṣāṇasaṃghaṭṭavatī nadī rīyate tīryate | śeva iti sukhanāma | ye cāśevā asukhā asan saṃti, tānatraiva sthāne ājahāma tyāmaḥ tyaktvā tāngacchāma ityarthaḥ | vayaṃ ca śivāndeśaviśeṣān abhivājān vājābhimukhān annaviśeṣayuktān tarema tīrtvā prāpnuyāmetyāśaṃsā || 12 || iti ṣaḍviṃśī kāṇḍikā || 26 || atha saptaviṃśī kāṇḍikā | śanna iti nadīṃ tarati || 1 || gatārthaṃ samatrakam || 1|| ya ṛta iti rathāṅge viśīrṇe || 2 aviśeṣābhidhānādyasminkasmiṃścidrathāṅge viśīrṇe ślathe rathe ya ṛta ityādikāmaindrī bṛhatīṃ japatītyarthaḥ || ṛte cidabhiśriṣaḥ purā jatrumya āvṛdaḥ | sandhātā sandhi maghavā purūvasurniṣkartāviḍutaṃ punaḥ || he ratha yastvaṃ jatrubhyo granthibhyo bandhanebhyaḥ ṛte vinā abhiṣiḥ viśīrṇo vināśaṃ prāptaḥ purā pūrvamevātṛdaḥ ātardanādahiṃsita eva naṣṭa ityarthaḥ, taṃ tvā maghavā punaḥ niṣkartā sandhi sandhīyata iti sandhistaṃ niḥśeṣeṇa punaḥ kariṣyatītyarthaḥ | sahi sandhātā sandhānaśīlaḥ | kīdṛśaṃ sandhīyamānaṃ tvāṃ kariṣyati | dṛṣṭvā ūrja bibhratītyādi japati | vadhvā eṣa japo maṃtraliṅgāt || ūrje vibhratī vasuvaniḥ sumedhā gṛhānāgāṃ modamānā suvarcāḥ | aghoreṇa cakṣuṣā maitreṇa gṛhāṇāṃ paśyantī vaya uttirāmi || gṛhāṇāmāyuḥ vayaṃ tirāma gṛhā asmākaṃ pratirantvāyuḥ | gṛhānahaṃ sumanasaḥ prapadye vīrabhī vīrapatiḥ suśevā || irāṃ vahato ghṛtamukṣamāṇāsteṣvahaṃ sumanāḥ saṃviśāmi | yeṣāṃ madhye'dhipravasanneti saumanasaṃ bahu || gṛhānupahvayāmahe te no jānantu jānataḥ | nṛtāntaḥ svadhāvanta irāvanto ha sāmadāḥ || .akṣudhyā anuṣyāsta gṛhā māsmadvibhetana | upahūtā iha gāva upahūtā ajāvayaḥ || atho annasya kīlāla upahūto gṛheṣu me | upahūtā bhūridhanāḥ sakhāyaḥ sādhusammadāḥ || ariṣṭāḥ sarvapūruṣā gṛhā naḥ santu sarvadā | ahaṃ gṛhānāgāṃ āgatā, ūrjaṃ bibhratī annaṃ dhārayantī puṣṇatī ca, vasuvaniḥ 'vana ṣaṇa saṃbhakta' vasūni dhanāni vibhajamānā, sumedhāḥ śobhanayā prajñayā yuktā, modamānā hṛṣyantī, suvarcāḥ śobhanadīptiḥ, gṛhāṇāmiti vya tyayena dvitīyārthe ṣaṣṭhī, aghoreṇa saumyena, maitreṇa hitaiṣiṇā cakṣuṣā nivasan bahu saumanasameti prapadyate, tān gṛhānupahvayāmahe āhvayāmaḥ | te'smāñjanato jñānayuktān jānantu | gṛhādhiṣṭhātṛdevatāprasādācca vayaṃ sūnṛtāvantaḥ satyavācaḥ syāma, tathā svadhāvantaḥ ahaṃ prajā ajanayaṃ pṛthivyāmahaṃ janibhyo avarīṣu putrāniti stryādivyatyāsaṃ japataḥ || 3|| etākhiṣṭubhaḥ prathamasaṃveśane garbhādhāne ca vadhūvarau japataḥ khyādivyatyāsaṃ kṛtvā, prathamāṃ strī, vadhūrvadati - he putrakāma tvāmahamapaśyaṃ paśyāmi cekitānaṃ dedīpyamānaṃ brahmavarcasādinā atiśayena dīptimantam | kena paśyāmi | manasā, natu cakṣuṣā | kīdṛśam | tapaso jātaṃ tapa iti prajāpateḥ satkarmaṇaśca nāma, prajāpaterbrahmaṇaḥ sakāśājjātaṃ, tapasaścāvirbhūtaṃ vṛddhiṃ gatam | iha prajāṃ mayi putrarūpāṃ rayiṃ ca dhanaṃ rāṇa āt prajayā prajāyakha prajāmutpādayetyarthaḥ || 1 || vara āhapaśyāmi tvāṃ he putrakāme dīdhyānāṃ dīptimatīṃ manasā | kīdṛśīm | nādhaatri 'nādhṛ nāthū yāopatāpaiśvaryāśīḥṣu' prajāṃ yācamānām | kutra | vāyāṃ tanū svasyāṃ tanvām | kimartham | ṛddhyai samṛddhyai lokadvayābhyudayāya | māmupa mama samīpe vartamānā tvamuccā mahatī pūjyatamā satputrādiyogāt yuvatistaruṇī satī bhūyāḥ atiśayena bhūyāḥ | prajayā prajāyasva ātmā vai putranāmeti vacanāt prajārūpeṇa prajāyakha putravatī bhava || 2|| vadhūrāha bhartari prajāpatitvamadhyāropya - he prajāpate mama tanvaṃ tanūṃ śarīraṃ juṣasva | he tvaṣṭaḥ hai prajāpate tvaṃ indraḥ san sahasā balena devaiviśvaiśca devairanupatitaḥ san no'smākaṃ saṃvidānaḥ samyak jānānaḥ | yajñiyairyajñā hairiti devaviśeṣaṇam | vayaṃ ca bahūnāṃ puṃsāṃ putrāṇāṃ mātaro nirmānyaḥ syāma || 3 || vara āha - oṣadhīṣu phalapākāntāsu ahameva garbha phalajananasāmarthyamādadhāmādadhe | jīvātmanāṃ paramātmano bhedābhāvādevamabhidhānam | ata evāha viśveṣu sarveṣu bhūteṣu ahamevāntastiṣṭhāmi antaryāmitayā, pṛthivyāmahameva prajāmanavadyāmajanayaṃ janayiṣyāmi ca | ahameva janibhyo jananīnāṃ strīṇāmavarīṣu jaṭharābhyantaravartinīṣu garbhagrahaṇīṣu putrān janayāmi bījamādadhāmi || 4 || evamevartau prajākāmau saṃviśataḥ ||4|| gatārtham || 4 || karaditi bhasadamabhimṛśati || 5 || karaditi yajuṣā bhasadaṃ strīcihnaṃ varo'bhimṛśati | karat kurvāṇaṃ prajāṃ bhavetyarthaḥ || 5 || bhasadityupari jananam || 6 || puṃcihnaṃ bhasaditi yajuṣā abhimṛśati strī | he puṃjanana tvaṃ bhasaddīpyamānaṃ satkāryajananasamartha bhavetyarthaḥ || 6 || bṛhaditi jātam || 7|| bṛhadityanena jātaṃ vīryaṃ prakṣipati | bṛhadvistīrṇaṃ putrajananasamarthaṃ bhavetyarthaḥ || 7 || iti triṃśī kāṇḍikā || 30 || <31-40> atha ekatriṃśī kāṇḍikā | atha sīmantaḥ tṛtīye garbhamāse sīmantaṃ kārayate śuddhapakṣasya puṇyāhe parvaṇi vā yathoktamupasamādhāya jayaprabhṛtibhirhutvā paścādagnerdarbheṣu prāṅāsīnāyāḥ sarvānkeśānsaṃpramucya prasādhayate || 1 || garbhagrahaṇādārabhyaṃ yastṛtīyo māsastatra śuklapakṣasya parvaṇi mukhye dine sīmantonnayanasaṃjñayā yaugikyā prasiddhaṃ yatsaṃskārakarma, takārayate natu vidvānapi svayaṃ kuryāditi ṇicaḥ prayogāt darśitam | etacca pātrasyaiva kecitsaṃskāra micchanti ādhāra saṃskārādeva garbhasyopakāro bhaviṣyati golaka saṃskāreṇaiva cakṣuṣa iti vadantaḥ | tathāca smṛtiḥ 'sakṛtsaṃskṛtasaṃskārāḥ sīmantena dvijastriyaḥ | yaṃ yaṃ garbha prasūyante sa sarvaḥ saṃskṛto bhavet ||' iti | anye tu garbhasyaiva saṃskāraṃ manyante tatraiva tṛtīye garbhamāsa ityasyopapatteḥ | pātramātrasaṃskāratve hi kiṃ garbhamāsavyapekṣayā, yadā kadācitsīmanto vidhīyate, kāryaḥ sīmanta iti | smṛterapi 'gābhairhomairjātakarmacauḍamauñjīnibandhanaiḥ | vaijikaṃ gārbhikaṃ caino dvijānāṃ pratihanyate ||' iti | apare tūbhayasaṃskāramāhuḥ | tatra kṣetrasaṃskāra evānumatatamaprāyo vedārthavidāṃ sakṛdanuṣṭhānasya prasiddhatvādvāhulyena | yathoktamupasamādhānaṃ kṛtvā jayaprabhṛtibhirājyabhāgāntaṃ hutvā, prakṛtasya āvasathyasya agneḥ paścādbhāge agnerdarbheṣu prāṅmukhyā upaviṣṭāyāḥ sarvān keśān samyak prakarṣeṇa muktān kṛtvā, kaṅkatena dārumayobhayadikkabhūritaradantayoginā vālaspaṣṭīkaraṇena prasādhayate spaṣṭīkaroti vakṣyamāṇābhistisṛbhirṛgbhiḥ || 1 || yaṃ sīmantaṃ kaṅkataste cakāra yadvā kṣuraḥ parīvavarja vapaṃste | strīṣu rūpamaśvinau tannidhattaṃ pauṃsyenemaṃ saṃsṛjataṃ vīryeṇa || indrāṇī cakre kaṅkataṃ sa sīmantaṃ visarpatu | punaḥ patibhyo jāyāṃ dā agne prajayā saha || punaḥ patnīmagniradādāyuṣā saha varcasā | dīryāyurasyā yaḥ patirjīvāti śaradaḥ śatamiti || 2|| itiśabdaḥ karaṇa pradhānaḥ | anena mantratrayeṇa keśān prasādhayate iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ || yaṃ sīmantaṃ te tava kaṅkataścakāra kṛtavān, kṣuro vā yaṃ cakāra sīmantaṃ, kṣura iva tīkṣṇatvākaṅkata iti vyācakṣate vivāhādūrdhvaṃ kṣurasaṃsargasya strīṣvamāṅgalikatvāt | dṛṣṭaścopamāyāṃ vāśabdaḥ 'samudro vā mahāsattvaḥ' ityādau nipātānāmanekārthatvāt | yat vapan keśānspaṣṭīkurvan kaṅkataste tava paravavarja varjitavān vālānāṃ śirovidāraṇabhayāt, tadrūpaṃ sīmantākhya saṃskārayuktatvātstrīṣu he aśvinau nidhattaṃ kurutaṃ tathaiva tadrūpaṃ pasnena vīryeṇa saṃsṛjatamaśvinau || 1 || amuṃ kaṅkatamindrāṇī śacī cakre kṛtavatī | ato'yamutkṛṣṭatvātkaṅkataḥ sīmantaṃ visarpatu cinotu saṃpādayatvityarthaḥ | he agne iyaṃ patnī tvayā vivāhasamaye dattā, idānīṃ punaḥ prajayā saha patibhyaḥ etāṃ jāyāṃ dāḥ dehi putravatīṃ sampādayetyarthaḥ|| 2 || agnirimāṃ pattīṃ punaradāt dadau āyuṣā varcasā ca saha | asyā yaḥ patirbhartā sa dīrghāyurastu | jīvāti śaradaḥ śataṃ, jīvātīti loḍarthe laṭ, śaradāṃ śataṃ jīvatu varṣaśataṃ jīvatādityarthaḥ || 2 || triḥ śvetayā śalalyā śamīśākhayā sapalāśayā vā sīmantaṃ vicinoti yāste rāka iti || 3 || trīnvārān triḥ, śvetayā śuklayā, śalalyā śalaliḥ śvāvitsedhā, tasyāḥ śalākā śalalirupacārāt tayā, śamīśākhayā sapalāśayā sapatryā sīmantaṃ vicinoti 'yāste rāke' iti triṣṭubhā | śalalyā tāmraśalākayā śvetayālohitayeti yadvyācakṣate, tanna dṛṣṭānurūpam || yāste rāke sumatayaḥ supeśaso yābhirdadāsi dāśuṣe vasūni | tābhirno adya sumanā upāgahi sahasrapoṣaṃ subhage rarāṇā || brahmaṇa ārṣam | he rāke devaputra yāstava śobhanā matayaḥ, supeśasaḥ surūpā abhimataphaladānonmukhatvaṃ matīnāṃ surūpatvaṃ, yābhiḥ sumatibhirdāśuṣe dātre yajamānāya vasūni dhanāni dadāsi tābhirupalakṣitā satyadyāsminnahani no'smānupāgahi upāgaccha, sumanāḥ prasannacittā satī, he subhage sundari rāke sahasrapoṣaṃ sahasrasaṃkhyaṃ dhanaṃ rarāṇā dadatī ||3|| athāsyāḥ pṛthakkeśapakṣau sannahyati nīlalohitena sūtreṇa nīlalohitaṃ bhavati kṛtyā śaktirvyajyate | edhante asyā jñātayaḥ patirbandheṣu badhyata iti || 4 || anantaramasyā garbhiṇyāḥ kaṅkatasamīkṛtānāṃ śalalyā vibhajyamānābhiḥ rekhābhiḥ paricchedena kṛtasīmantabhāgānāṃ keśānāṃ kṛtau pṛthagdrau pakṣau pārśvadvayagatau sannahyati badhnāti nīlalohitena sūtreṇa nīlalohitamityādikayānubhā || nīlalohitamidaṃ sūtraṃ bhavati | kṛtiḥ kriyā tayā śaktirvyajyate garbhasya puṃstvaṃ vyajyata ityarthaḥ, asyā garbhiṇyā jñātaya edhante vardhante loḍarthe laṭ vyajyatāṃ śaktirvardhantāṃ jñātaya ityarthaḥ, patiśca snehādibandheṣu satsu baddhyatām || 4 || yo gurustamarhayet || 5 || yo guruḥ sīmantonnayanasya kartā brāhmaṇastamayedyathāśakti madhuparkadānādinā pūjayet ||5|| etadeva kumārīṇāṃ saṭoddharaṇamatraivānulepanam || 6 || atraiva kāle vāgdattānāṃ kumārīṇāṃ saṭoddharaṇaṃ karma kartavyaṃ keśaracanāviśeṣātmakam | anulepanaṃ sarvoṣadhikuṅkumaprabhṛtibhiranulepanaṃ śobhāviśeṣā dhāyi sīmantasya | atrāgneyyā ye ke ca jmetyādikayā caturgṛhītena pradhānayāgaḥ || ityekatriṃśī kāṇḍikā || 31 || atha dvātriṃśī kāṇḍikā | atha puṃsavanam || 1 || athetyānantarye sīmantonnayanānantaraṃ puṃsavanasaṃjñakaṃ garbhasaṃskārakarma kartavyamiti || 1 || bhūyiṣṭhagateṣu garbhamāseṣu trīnsthālīpākāñchrapayedāgneyamaindraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca teṣāṃ yathādaivataṃ juhoti 'agnistuviśravastamam' 'indra kṣattraṃ ' ' pra tadviṣṇuḥ' 'pumāna' ityabhijuhoti || 2 || 'daśame māsi sūtave' iti śruteḥ, darśanāca daśa garbhamāsāḥ | tatra pañca ardhabhāgaḥ, ṣaṭ bhūyāṃsaḥ sapta bhūyiṣṭhāḥ | bhūyiṣṭhaḥ saptamo gato yeṣu teṣu garbhamāseṣu satsu, aṣṭame māsi śiṣṭācārāt | trīn sthālīpākān śrapayet āgneyamaindraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca | teṣāṃ madhyādanyatamamanyatamaṃ gṛhītvā yathādaivataṃ juhoti | yatraikaḥ sthālīpākastatra devatābhede'pi ekaṃ karma dravyadevatāsaṃyogasyaikyāt | iha tūbhayabhedāt saṃyogabhedena karmabahulatvam | agnistuvītyādinā agniṃ juhoti, indra kṣatramityādinā indram, pra tadviṣṇurityādinā viṣṇum pumānityādinaikaikasmādbhāgamuddhṛtya sviṣṭakṛtaṃ juhoti || | agnistuviśravastamaṃ tuvibrahmāṇamuttamam | atūrta śrāvayatpatiṃ putraṃ dadāti dāśuṣe || 1 || agnirdāśuṣe havirdattavate yajamānāya putraṃ dadāti | kīdṛśam | tuviśravastamaṃ tuviśabdo bhūrināmasu paṭhitaḥ, śravaḥ śabdo'nnavacano yaśovacano vā, bahvannatamaṃ bahuyaśaskatamaṃ vā, tuvibrahmāṇaṃ brahmaśabdo vedavacano'tra bahuvedavidamityarthaḥ, tathotkṛṣṭaṃ sarvātiśāyinaṃ, atūrta tvarārahitaṃ ataralaṃ sphītamiti yāvat, śrāvayatāṃ patiṃ ṛtvijāṃ patiṃ yajvānamityarthaḥ || 1|| indrakṣatramami vāmamojo'jāyathā vṛṣabha carṣaṇīnām | apānudo janamamitrayantammuruṃ devebhyo akṛṇoru lokam || 2 || he indra tvaṃ kṣatramabhi kṣatatrāṇaṃ pratyajāyathāḥ jātaḥ | oja iti asya viśeṣaṇam | kṣātramojo valaṃ ca lakṣaṇīkṛtya tvaṃ jāta ityarthaḥ | vāmaṃ vananīyaṃ saṃvibhāgārham | he vṛṣabha varṣaka | keṣām | carṣaṇīnāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ devā apīha manuṣyāḥ | amitrayantamamitramivācarantaṃ janamasuralokaṃ tvamapānudaḥ apasāritavānasi | kīdṛśaṃ janam | urūṃ vistīrṇam | apānudya ca taṃ devebhyo devārthaṃ devānāṃ vā subvyatyayena lokaṃ kṛtavānasi || 2 || pratadviṣṇuḥ stavate vīryeṇa mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ | yasyoruṣu triṣu vikramaṇeṣvadhikṣayanti bhuvanāni viśvā || 3 || vyākhyāsyate || 3|| pumānagniḥ pumānindraḥ pumānviṣṇurajāyata | pumāṃsaṃ janayetputraṃ daśame māsi sūtave || yena jātena vinā jīvema śaradaḥ śataṃ paśyema śaradaḥ śatamiti taṃ no maṃhasva śatinaṃ sahasriṇaṃ gosanimaśvasaniṃ vīram || ābhyāmṛgyajuṣābhyāṃ sviṣṭakṛtkriyate | ayādayaḥ pumāṃsaṃ pauruṣātiśayayuktaṃ putraṃ janayeyuryatasta eva trilokyāṃ pumāṃsaḥ pauruṣātiśayayuktā ajāyanta jātāḥ | daśame māsi sūtave sotuṃ tumarthe tavepratyayaḥ | yena jātena satā vibhunā prabhuṇā vayaṃ śaradaḥ śataṃ jīvema paśyema ca, taṃ putraṃ no'smākaṃ maṃhasva vardhayasva, śatinaṃ sahasriṇaṃ śatasahasrādidhanayuktaṃ, gosaniṃ gavāṃ saṃvibhaktāramevamaśvasaniṃ vīraṃ putraṃ vikrāntaṃ vā vikramayuktam || 2 || iti dvātriṃśī kāṇḍikā || 32|| atha trayastriṃśī kāṇḍikā | atha soṣyantīsavanam || 1 || anantaraṃ soṣyantīsavanaṃ nāma dṛṣṭārthaṃ karmocyate | yaugikīyaṃ saṃjñā | sūyate'neneti savanaṃ sukhaprasavaṃ karma | soṣyamāṇāyā āsannaprasavāyāḥ savanaṃ soṣyantīsavanam || 1 || vijaniṣyamāṇāyā adbhiḥ pāṇiṃ sravantaṃ śirasyādhāyā hṛdayādabhimṛśet ||2|| vijaniṣyamāṇāyā āsannaprasavāyāḥ adbhiḥ sravantaṃ pāṇiṃ śirasyādhāya hṛdayaṃ yāvadabhimṛśet | bhartā atra kartā, tadsannidhāvāptaḥ kaściddevarādiḥ || 2 || mantramāha yathāyaṃ vātaḥ pavate yathā samudra ejati | evaṃ te garbha ejatu saha jarāyuṇāvapadyatāmiti | kṣiprameva prajāyate || 3 || anena maṃtreṇābhimṛśet | tathā sati kṣiprameva sukhena prasūyate iti dṛṣṭārthatāmasya karmaṇa āha || yathā pratyakṣo vāyurayaṃ vegavāhī pavate dhāvati, yathāvā samudra ejati kampate, evaṃ te tava garbha ejatu tūrṇaṃ prajāyatāṃ jarāgarbhāśayena saha avapadyatāṃ nirgacchatu ||3|| iti trayastriṃśī kāṇḍikā || 33 || atha catustriṃśī kāṇḍikā atha nāmakarma putre jāte nāma dhīyate || 1 || putre jāte jātakarma kṛtvā nābhivardhanādanantaraṃ nāma dhīyate saṃkalpyate - idaṃ nāma kariṣyate iti kecidyākurvate, nāmakaraṇaṃ hi 'ekādaśyāṃ nāma kurvīta puṇye vāhana' ityaśaucaśuddhau smṛtam | anye tvāhuḥ - jāte sati ekādaśaṃ tadanantaraṃ vā sulagnaṃ nāmakarmaṇi nātikrāmedityevaṃparametaditi | vayaṃ tu tattvamadūre vakṣyāmaḥ || 1 || ghoṣavadādyantarantasthaṃ caturakṣaram ||2|| nāmna ādau ghoṣavadakṣaraṃ kartavyam, madhye cāntasthasaṃjñakam, catvāryakṣarāṇi yatra tat | akṣarāṇi aco'tra halāmanavadhāraṇāt || 2 || yathopapatti vā || 3 || yathāvā devatāprasādalabdhatvādyanusāreṇa tadupapadyate, tathā kartavyam || 3 || agnimatrānīya tasminnājyabhāgāntaṃ hutvā sahiraṇye kāṃsye saṃpātānavanayet 'hiraṇyagarbhaḥ' 'saṃvatsarasya pratimāṃ' 'kāya svāhā, kasmai svāhā, katamasmai svāhā, prajāpataye svāhā' prajāpate na hi tvaditi ca dvābhyām || 4 || yatra gṛhe prasavastatra laukikamagnimāhṛtya tatraivājyabhāgāntān homān kṛtvā hiraṇyayukte kāṃsyapātre saṃpātān hutaśeṣabindūnavanayet srāvayet hiraṇyagarbha ityaṣṭābhirāhutibhiḥ | hira ṇyagarbha ityekāhutiḥ | saṃvatsarasya pratimāmiti dvitīyā | kāya svāhā, kasmai svāhā, katamasmai svāhā, prajāpataye svāheti catasraḥ | prajāpate nahi tvaditi dvābhyāṃ dve | evamaṣṭau bhavanti | kecit pradhānakarmatvāccaturgṛhītenaiva homa ityāhuḥ || hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt | sadādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema || eṣā vivāhakāṇḍe vivṛtā || saṃvatsarasya pratimāṃ ye tvā rātryupāsate | teṣāmāyuṣmatī prajāṃ rāyaspoṣeṇa saṃsṛja || he rātri tvaṃ saṃvatsarasya pratimā nirmātrī, tvāṃ ye janāḥ upāsate, teṣāṃ prajāmāyuṣmatīṃ kuru rāyaspoṣeṇa dhanapuṣṭyā saṃsṛja saṃyojaya || kāya svāhā || suhutamastu | kasmai svāhā | katamasmai svāhā | prajāpataye svāhā | kaprabhṛtīni catvāri prajāpatināmāni || prajāpate nahi tvadanya etā viśvā jātāni paritābabhūva | yatkāmāste juhumastanno astu svāhā || virāṭ | he prajāpate tvadanyo nāsti ya etāni viśvāni sarvāṇi jātāni janmavanti bhūtāni parivabhūva paribhūtavān vaśīkaroti vyānotīti yāvat | etā etāni, viśvā viśvāni "śeśchandasi bahulam' iti śerluk | paritetyatra ta iti varṇāgamaḥ | yatphalaṃ kāmayamānā juḍumastanno'stu || asā amuṣya putro'muṣyāsau putraḥ | vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇāṃ svāhā || asā amuṣya ceti nāmaviśeṣanirdeśaḥ | 'asau viṣṇumitro'muṣya yajñamitrasya putra iti pitāputrayordvirnāmoccāraṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhyantasya pitṛnāno madhye, putranāmna ādyantayoḥ | vayaṃ rayīṇāṃ dhanānāṃ patayaḥ svāminaḥ syāma sampadyemahe || agnerāyurasīti hiraṇyena mukhaṃ medhyaṃ kṛtvā pāṇinā mukhamadbhiḥ saṃspṛśya prakṣālya stanānanumantrayate madhu vāta ṛtāyata iti tisṛbhiḥ pratyṛcamubhāvuttamayā ||5|| agneyurasītyādinā mantreṇa hiraṇyena mukhaṃ medhyaṃ pavitraṃ kṛtvā jalāvilena hastena mukhaṃ spṛṣṭvā bālakasya mātuḥ stanānanumantrayate prakṣālya bālakasya pitā, tadasannidhau purohita ekaikayā ṛcā ekaikam, uttamayānyayā tūbhau | tadapekṣameva bahuvacanaṃ stanāniti | madhu vāta iti dakṣiṇam, madhu naktamiti vāmam, madhumānna iti dvau | madhuśabdo jagatprajananasyāmṛtasya nityānandamayasya madhuvidyāprasiddhasya nāma mantratraye jñeyaḥ || madhu vāta ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ | mādhvīrnaḥ santvoṣadhīḥ || madhu naktamutoṣasā madhumatpārthivaṃ rajaḥ | madhurastu naḥ pitā || madhumāno vanaspatirmadhumāṃ astu sūryaḥ | mādhvīrgāvo bhavantu naḥ || ṛto yajñaḥ | yajñamicchati yaḥ sa ṛtāyacchabdena kyajaṃntena śatrantena cocyate, ṛtāyate yajñamicchate yajamānāya vāto madhu astu amṛtatvakārī bhavatu | sindhavo nadyo madhu jalaṃ kṣaranti kṣarantu | oṣadhīḥ oṣadhyaḥ phalapākāntāḥ mādhvīrmadhurarasasaṃyuktā bhavantu | madhu naktam, utaśabdo'pyarthe, naktaṃ sandhyā, sāpi upasā rātryā saha madhvastu naḥ | pārthivaṃ rajaḥ pārthivalokaḥ madhumānastu | dyaurantarikṣaṃ madhvastu naḥ pitā | vanaspatayo madhumantaḥ santu, sūryaścāsmākaṃ madhumānastu, gāvaścāsmākaṃ mādhvīmādhyo madhumatyaḥ santu || 5 || hiraṇyena sampātānsannighṛṣya madhu cetyeke tanmukhe kṛtvā prapāyayatyāyurdhaya jarāṃ dhaya satyaṃ dhaya śriyaṃ dhayorjaṃ dhaya rāyaspoṣaṃ dhaya brahmavarcasaṃ dhaya || 6 || suvarṇena saṃpātān sannighṛṣya bālasya mukhe kṛtvā pāyayati | eke punarmanyante madhu ca, madhuyuktān saṃpātān sannighṛṣya pāyayedityarthaḥ | utsargeṇa pitṛkarmakatvāt jātakarmaprabhṛtīnāṃ pitā brūte - he bālaka āyurdhaya piva, evaṃ jarāṃ piva, pīyamānaṃ sampātaghṛtaṃ samadhu vā stanakṣīraṃ ca tavāyurādeḥ kārakamastvityarthaḥ | ūrjamannaṃ balaṃ ca | rāyaspoṣo dhanapuṣṭiḥ | vedādividyāsamṛddhirbrahmavarcasam || 6 || jīva śaradaḥ śataṃ paśya śaradaḥ śatamiti mūrdhani nighrāpya svastyayanaṃ vācayati || 7 || bodhaścametyanuvākam | svārthe ṇic vācayatīti | śiṣṭaṃ spaṣṭam || bodha mā pratīvodha purastādvopāyatāmakhamatha mānacadrāṇaśca dakṣiṇato gopāyatāṃ gopāyamānaśca mā rakṣamāṇaśca copāyatāṃ jāgṛviśva mārundhatī cottarāgopāyatām || anamitraṃ no adharāganamitramudakṛdhi | indrānamitraṃ naḥ paścādanamitraṃ puraskṛdhi || anamiratraihobhiḥ sacemahi viśve devā anamitrā na uṣasaḥ santu nimrucaḥ || yāḥ ṣaḍuvaḥ pañca pradiśastā naḥ pāntu mitradhā no mitre dadhātā abhayaṃ no astu || ye rātrīmanutiṣṭhatha ye ca bhūteṣu jāgṛtha | paśūnye sarvānrakṣatha te na ātmasu jāgṛta || bodha pratibodhākhamānavadrāṇa gopāyamāna rakṣamāṇa jārasad ye devāstanūpāḥ stha te ma iha tanvaṃ pāta bodhapratīodhetyasau vā ādityo bodho'gniḥ pratīodho'kha mānavadrāṇeti candramā vā asvapno'yaṃ yaḥ pavate so'navadrāṇo gopāyamāna rakṣamāṇetyaha gopāyamāno rātrī rakṣamāṇo jāgṛverundhatīti yajño vai jāgṛvirdakṣiṇārundhatyete vai devā rāṣṭrabhṛtastane ātmano gopīthāya || etatsvastyayanaṃ, svastiravināśastasyāyanaṃ prāpaṇaṃ avināśalābhakāraṇam | rāṣṭrabhṛtāmārṣam | rāṣṭraṃ jagaddibhrati dhārayanti puṣṇanti ca ye terāṭrabhṛta ādityādaya ṛtavo'pītyeke | bodhādayo'traivānuvāke purastādyākhyātāḥ | ādityo bodhaḥ, agniḥ pratībodhaḥ prakāśakatvāt| candramā manorūpeṇāsvapnaḥ satatajāgaraṇāt, prāṇarūpo vāyuranavadrāṇaḥ akutsitagatitvāt | divaso gopāyamāno jīvananimittakriyānuṣṭhāpanadvāreṇa, rakṣamāṇo rātriḥ | jāgṛviḥ yajñaḥ prajāpatirūpaḥ 'yajño vai prajāpatiḥ' iti śruteḥ sarvāntaryāmirūpeṇa sarvaprāṇiṣu jāgaraṇājjāgṛviḥ, arundhatī dakṣiṇā | sāhi arīnnivārayantī satī yajamānāya phalaṃ dadāti || bodha ādityo māṃ purastāt pūrvasyāṃ diśi gopāyatāṃ rakṣatu, pratībodhaścāgniḥ | asvapnacandro māṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi gopāyatāṃ, anavadrāṇaśca vāyuḥ| prāṇaḥ gopāyamāno divaso māṃ paścimadigbhāge gopāyatāṃ, rakṣamāṇaśca rātrikālaḥ | jāgṛviryajñaḥ prajāpatiruttaradigbhāge māṃ gopāyatāṃ, arundhatī ca dakṣiṇā || anamitraṃ no'dharāgityaindrī, anuṣṭup | na mitramamitraṃ nāmitramanamitraṃ mitramityarthaḥ nañyena prakṛtārthābhidyotanāt | he indra no'smākaṃ adharāgadhastanadigbhāge udakottaradigbhāge'namitraṃ kṛdhi kuru, yastatrāsmānhisitumicchati, tamanukūlaṃ sampādayetyarthaḥ | evamuttaratra | paścātpaścimadiśi | puraḥ pūrvasyāṃ diśi || anamitrairahobhiriti dve śakkaryuṣṇihau | abhidheyā sarvatra devatā | he viśve devāḥ sarve devā vayaṃ mitrībhūtairahobhiḥ sacemahi, uṣasaḥ prabhātakālāḥ, nimrucaśca rātrayo'smākaṃ mitrāṇi santu | ' mrucumluṃ gatau' nitāntaṃ gacchatyābhya āditya iti nimrucaḥ || yāḥ ṣaḍdevatā urvī urvyaḥ mahatyaḥ | kāstāḥ || dyauḥ pṛthivī, ahaḥ, rātriḥ, uṣaḥ, oṣadhayaḥ tathā pañca pradiśaśca - tasraḥ prāgādyā ūrdhvā pañcamī | tā no'smān pāntu rakṣantu | he anantaroktā yato yūyaṃ midhā hitasya kāryasya vidhātryastato no'smān mitre śubhakarmaṇi dudhāta dhārayata, abhayaṃ cāsmākamastu yuṣmatprasādāt || he pradarśita devā ye yūyaṃ rātrīmanutiṣṭhatha rātrīṃ lakṣaṇīkṛtya tiṣṭhatha, ye ca bhūteṣu jāgṛtha, sarvośca paśūn rakṣatha, te nossmākaṃ sambandhiṣu ātmasu śarīreṣu jāgṛta || bodha pratībodhetyādināṣṭānāṃ saṃbodhanam | he bodhādayaḥ arundhatīparyantāḥ ye yūyaṃ devāstanūpāḥ stha tanūnāṃ śarīrāṇāṃ rakṣakā bhavatha, te me mama iha gahane bhave tanvaṃ tanūṃ pāta rakṣata | bodhādīn pratīkairavacchidya vyācaṣṭe bodhapratī bodhetyādinā, gatārthametat | ete vai devāḥ, vaiśabdo'vadhāraṇe, eta eva bodhāyo rāṣṭrasya jagato bhartāra ṛtavaśca, ato'haṃ taumi | kimartham | ātmano gopīthā rakṣaṇāya | anyānyapyatra svastyayanāni paṭhanīyāni | vacicurādau paṭhyate, tataḥ svārthe ṇic svastyayanaṃ vācayatīti | tena yuktaṃ khakartṛkaṃ vacanaṃ pituḥ | svakartṛkāṇi hyetānyutsargeṇa prāk cūḍākaraṇāt || 7 || iti catustriṃśī kāṇḍikā || 34 || atha pañcatriṃśī kāṇḍikā | sarṣapānphalīkaraṇamiśrāndarvyā juhoti 'śaṇḍo markopavītaḥ' 'ālikhan ' 'haryakṣṇaḥ' ' keśinī' iti || 1 || bālakasūtikayoḥ rakṣārthā aśaucakāle'mī homāḥ, ataśca dṛṣṭārthā eva | phalīkaraṇaṃ kambukāḥ, tairmiśritānsarṣapāndarvyā daśāhaṃ yāvat sāyaṃprātarjuhuyāt śaṇḍa ityādicaturbhirmantraiḥ śaṇḍo markopavītastauṇḍuleya ulūkhalacapalo naśyatāmitaḥ svāhā || 1 || iha sūtikāsthānācchaṇḍādayo naśyantu palāyantāmiti samudāyārthaḥ | śaṇḍādayaḥ piśācānāṃ saṃjñāḥ | ekaiko mantrasaṃbandhaḥ | śaṇḍa itaḥ sthānānnaśyatu, evaṃ markaḥ, upavītaḥ, tauṇḍuleyaḥ, ulūkhalaścapalo naśyatāmitaḥ | khāhā suhutamastu || 1 || ālikhannavalikhankivadanta ulūkhalacapalo naśyatāmitaḥ svāhā || 2 || samānaṃ pūrveṇaitat || 2 || haryakṣṇaḥ kumbhaḥ śaktirhantā cupaṇīmukhaścapalo naśyatāmitaḥ svāhā || 3 || keśinī valominī kacā kaucāpakāśinyapeto naśyatāmitaḥ svāhā || 4 || haryakṣṇa ityādayaḥ saṃjñāḥ | keśinī nāma rākṣasī | tathā śvalominī, kacā, kaucā, apakāśinītyetānyapi rākṣasīviśeṣanāmāni ||4|| evaṃ sāyaṃ prātardaśāhaṃ juhuyāt || 2 || anena prakāracatuṣṭayena daśāhaṃ juhuyāt aśaucakālaṃ yāvajjuhuyādityarthaḥ || 2 || iti pañcatriṃśī kāṇḍikā || 35 || atha ṣaṭtriṃśī kāṇḍikā | atha nāmakaraṇam daśamyāṃ tasminnevāgnau payasi sthālīpākaṃ śrapayitvā sarvagandhaiḥ phalottaraiḥ saśiraskaṃ snāpayitvāhatena vāsasā pracchādya sthālīpākasya juhoti kayā naścitra iti dvābhyāṃ 'kayā tacchṛṇve prajāpataye svāhā' prajāpate nahi tvaditi ca dvābhyām || 1|| daśamyāṃ vyatītāyāmaśaucaśuddhāvekādaśe'hani dvādaśe'hani vā tatra nakṣatrādivaiguṇye dināntare nāmadheyaṃ daśamyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ vāpi kārayet 'puṇye'hani muhūrte vā nakṣatre vā guṇānvite |' iti smaraṇāt | audayikyā ca vyavasthayā trayodaśī tithigṛhyate, natvanyāyyādutthānādanyāyyācca saṃveśanādanadyatanakāla ityādikayā, 'rātriśeṣe dvābhyāṃ prabhāte tisṛbhiḥ' iti vibhātāyāmapi rajanyāmudadyāt prāgaśaucānuvṛttidarśanāt | tasminneva sūtikāgārasthe sūtaarat payasi sthālīpākaṃ śrapayitvā sarvoṣadhiprabhṛtibhiḥ sugandhidravyaviśeṣairuparivinihitamaṅgalārthajātī pūgaphalaviśeṣaiḥ saśiraskaṃ strāpayitvā, puṃliṅganirdeśāt striyaṃ varjayati, anupabhuktena vastreṇa saṃcchāya tasya sthālīpākasya saṃbandhibhiravadānairvyatyayena sthālīpākena juhoti kayā naścitreti pañcāhutīḥ || 1 || agnerāyurasīti tulyamā lalāṭābhimarśanāt || 2 || agneyurasītyādikamāyuṣeṣṭyā tulyamityatideśaḥ | avadhimāha ā lalāṭābhimarśanāt | 'tasya lalāṭamabhimṛśyāśvinoḥ prāṇa iti japati' iti vakṣyati | tadanantaramāyuṣeṣṭadhā samānamityarthaḥ || 2 || tadeva nāma dhīyate || 3|| anuvāke asāvityasya sthāne tadeva nāma dhīyate yattu jātakarmaṇi kṛtaṃ, nānyat || 3 || anyadityeke || 4 || eke punarāhuranyadvidhīyate | dve hi nāmnī brāhmaṇasya kartavye | tatra yadrahasyaṃ jātakarmayuktaṃ 'putre jāte nāma dhīyate ' iti, tasya prayojanaṃ parairabhicāre kriyamāṇe'nuccāraṇādi, prakaṭaṃ tvekādaśāhādau vyāvahārikam | tathāca śrutiḥ 'tasmādbrāhmaṇo dvināmā' iti ||4|| prāk sviṣṭakṛtaḥ kaṃse pūtamājyamāsicya hiraṇyaṃ cābandhanīyamagnerāyurityavadhāya tasya juhotīndrasya prāṇa iti pañcabhiḥ || 5 || sviṣṭakṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ pūtamājyaṃ kāṃsyapātre āsicya prakṣipya tatra ca hiraṇyaṃ prakṣipya agnerāyurasītyādinā mantreṇa | kīdṛśaṃ suvarṇam | ābandhanīyaṃ bālakasya kaṇṭhādau bandhanārham | tasyājyasya juhoti indrasya prāṇa ityādibhiḥ pañcabhirmantraiḥ || 5 || prāksaṃsthitayajuṣo brahmā ghṛte hiraṇyamavapadyate sarve cartvijo yadasarpa iti ||6|| saṃsthitayajumātpūrvaṃ brahmā ghṛte hiraṇyamavapadyate avaṣṭanāti yattaddālagalādibandhanārtha ghṛte nihitaṃ sarve ca ṛtvijastadvaṣṭananti dasarpa ityādimantraiḥ || 6|| pāvamānenetyuddhṛtya devā āyuṣmanta iti yajamānāya prayacchati || 7 || ājyātsuvarṇaṃ pāvamānenetyuddhṛtya yajamānāya prayacchati devā āyuṣmanta ityādimantraiḥ || tatpivati niravadhayet || 8 || tat suvarṇaniḥsrāvamājyaṃ bālakaḥ pivati | tacca niḥśeṣeṇāvadhayet pivet || 8 || hiraṇyādghṛtaṃ prakṣālyemamagna iti hiraṇyamābadhnāti || 9 || hiraṇyagnaṃ ghṛtaṃ prakṣālya taddhiraṇyaṃ badhnāti bālakasya galādau imamana ityādinā || 9 || tasya lalāṭamabhimṛśyāśvinoḥ prāṇa iti japati || 10 || lalāṭataṭaṃ hastena spṛṣṭvā japati aśvinoḥ prāṇa ityādikam || 10 || aṅgādaṅgātsambhavasi hṛdayādabhijāyase | ātmā vai putranāmāsi jīva śaradaḥ śataṃ paśya śaradaḥ śatamiti mūrdhani nighrāya svastyayanaṃ vācayati || 11 || aṅgādaṅgādityādinā bālasya mūrdhaniśivanaṃ kṛtvā svastyayanaṃ vakti | kvacinnighrāpyeti pāṭhaḥ, tatra svārthe ṇic | pitrasannidhau vā mātaraṃ prayujyeti kecit | ṛtvigvā pituḥ prayojako vivakṣitaḥ || 11 || evamata ūrdhvaṃ viproṣya || 12 || ato nāmakaraṇādūrdhvaṃ yadā pravāsādāyāti pitā, tadānenaiva prakāreṇa mūrdhanyabhitrāṇaṃ kuryāt || 12 || evaṃ māsi māsi sthālīpākasyeṣṭvā jātakarmaṇā vājyasya || 13|| evameva pratimāsaṃ janmadine sthālīpākena jātakarmavidhivadājyeneṣṭṭā nighrāṇaṃ mūrdhani kuryāt || 13 || evaṃ saṃvatsaram || 14 || pratimāsamimāṃ kartavyatāṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvatkuryāt || 14 || māṃsaṃ tu nāśnītaḥ || 15 || māṃsaṃ tu bālakasya mātā pitā ca saṃvatsaraṃ yāvannāśnīyāt || 15|| samāpte saṃvatsare'jāvibhyāṃ vāgnidhānvantarī iṣṭvā sarpiṣmadannaṃ brāhmaṇānbhojayet || 16 || prathame saṃvatsare samāpte ajenāgnimavinā dhanvantarimiṣṭhā vāśabdādājyena sthālīpākena vā sarpiṣā pracureṇa yuktamanyena ca pavitreṇa dadhiprabhṛtinā annaṃ brāhmaṇān bhojayet | taiḥ suprīteḥ svastyayanāśīḥprabhṛtibhirabhinandenam || 16 || kayā nacitra ābhuvatī sadāvṛdhaḥ sakhā | kayā śaciyā vṛtā || 1 || kastvā satyo madānāṃ maṃhiṣṭho matsadandhasaḥ | dṛḍhā cidāruje vasu || 2 || vratasyārtham | indraḥ prajāpatirvā devatā | citraścitracaritaḥ prajāpatirindro vā no'smānkayā ūtyā ābhuvadābhāvayati janayati | avanamūtiḥ 'supāṃ sulukpūrvasavarṇāiti tṛtīyaikavacanasya pūrvasavarṇaikādeśaḥ ūtīśabdāluk ca | kīdṛśaḥ prajāpatiḥ | sakhā samānakhyānaḥ antaryāmī | kīdṛśānasmān | sadāvṛdhaḥ sarvakālaṃ vṛddhiyuktān | kayā vṛtā vartanenābhāvayati | kayā śaciṣṭhayā śatyatiśayena caitanyātiśayena vā atiśayena śakitā śaciṣṭhā 'turiṣṭhemeyaḥsu' iti tṛco lopaḥ, chāndaso varṇavyatyayaścakāraḥ, kena śaktyatiśayena vartayedityarthaḥ | sraṣṭṛtvādiśaktyatiśayayuktaḥ prajāpatirvṛddhiviṣaye ṛtāvasmābhirijyate sa iṣṭyā prītaḥ san bālaṃ vṛddhyādisaṃyuktaṃ saṃpādayatviti tātparyārthaḥ || he prajāpate ko yajamānaḥ tvā matsat mādayati, andhaso'ndhasā haviṣā, dṛḍhā dṛḍhāni, vasu vasūni dhanāni, āruje ārujati vitarati dakṣiṇādidvāreṇa | kīdṛśo yajamānaḥ | satyaḥ uttamasattvaḥ, tathā madānāṃ maṃhiṣṭhaḥ hṛṣṭānāmānandayogināṃ madhye vṛddhatamaḥ paramānandayukto brahmasvabhāva ityarthaḥ | 'bahi mahi vṛddha' iti dhātoḥ prakṛtitvaṃ maṃhiṣṭhaśabde iṣṭhannante || kayā tacchṛṇve śacyā śaciṣṭho yayā kṛṇoti muhu kāci-eva | puru dāśuṣe vicayiṣṭho aṃho'thā dadhāti draviṇaṃ jaritre || atrāpi prajāpatirdevatā | ahaṃ śṛṇveṇomi vedāt | kiṃ tat | kācidevāsya prajāpateḥ śaktirlokottarāsti prajñā vā | kā | yayā śacyā śaktyā prajñayā vā sa ṛṣvo mahattamaḥ puru aṃhaḥ pāpaṃ muhurmuhuḥ punaḥ punaḥ kṛṇoti kṛntati nāśayati | kasmai | dāśuṣe yajamānāya | pāpaṃ ca nāśayitvā, anantaraṃ jaritre stotre dāśuṣe puru subahu draviṇaṃ dhanaṃ dadhāti dadāti karoti vā | kīdṛśaḥ prajāpatiḥ | śaciṣṭhaḥ śaktatamaḥ prājñatamo vā, vicayiṣṭhaḥ vividhaśaktinicayavattamaḥ | kayeti vyatyayena tṛtīyā prathamāsthāne || prajāpataye svāhā || prajāpataye suhutamastu | prajāpate nahi tvaditi, asā amuṣyeti dvayaṃ vyākhyātam || agnerāyurasi tasya te manuṣyā āyuṣkṛtastenāsmā amuṣmā brahmaṇa ārṣam | anena hiraṇyaṃ ghṛte'vadadhāti | he suvarṇa asi
