sati cūḍākarma kartavyam | ardhamavadhiṃ kṛtvā saptamo māso bhūyān, aṣṭamastu bhūyiṣṭhastasmin gate navame māsi kartavyam | dakṣiṇena viduṣāpi na svayaṃ pitrā kartavyamiti ṇicoktam || 1|| dakṣiṇataḥ kapūjā vasiṣṭhānām ||2|| kapūjā cūḍā | sā vasiṣṭhagotrasaṃbhūtānāṃ dakṣiṇe śiraso bhāge kartavyā | dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇata ādyādibhyastasiḥ || 2 || ubhayato'trikaśyapānām || 3|| ubhayoḥ śiraso dakṣiṇottarabhāgayoratrigotre kaśyapagotre ca jātānāṃ śikhā kartavyā || 3 || muṇḍā bhṛgavaḥ || 4|| bhṛgugotrajā muṇḍā niḥśikhāḥ kartavyāḥ ||4|| pañcacūḍā aṅgirasaḥ || 5 || āṅgirasagotre ye jātāste pañcacūḍāḥ kartavyāḥ || 5 || vājimeke || 6 || eke vājimicchanti āṅgirasānām | vājiḥ keśapaṅktiḥ|| 6 || maṅgalārthaṃ śikhino'nye || 7 || ye kathitebhyo'nye'gastyaviśvāmitrādigojāste śikhino bhavanti | kimartham | maṅgalārtham | niḥ śikhatvaṃ tvamaṅgaladharmaḥ ariṣṭahetuḥ | tathāca paṭhanti 'amedhyametacchiro yadaśikham |' iti | 'yatra bāṇāḥ sampatanti kumārā viśikhā iva |' iti ca nindāvāda yanmūlaṃ śikhākarmasmaraṇam || 7 || yathākuladharmaṃ vā || 8 || kuladharmānatikrameṇa vā ekaśikhatvādi kartavyaṃ kulācārāṇāmapi dharmatvena smaraṇāt 'yenāsya pitaro yātā yena yātāḥ pitāmahāḥ | tena yāyātsatāṃ mārga tena gacchanna riṣyati ||' śuddhapakṣasya puṇyāhe parvaṇi vā yathoktamupasamādhāya jayaprabhṛtibhirhutvāyamagātsavitā kṣureṇoṣṇena vāya udakena ehi | ādityā rudrā vasavaḥ sacetasaḥ somasya rājño vapata pracetasa ityuṣṇā apo'bhimantrayate || 9 || puṇyāha ityādi hutvetyantaṃ vyākhyātam | āyamagādityādinā uṣṇā apo'bhimantrayate ma breṇa | jagatī cchandaḥ | viśvedevā devatā | brahmaṇa ārṣamupanayana samāptiṃ yāvat | ayaṃ savitā kṣureṇoṣṇena codakena sahāgāt āgataḥ | ato he vāyo tvamapyābhyāṃ saha ehi āgaccha | he ādityāḥ rudrāḥ vasavaḥ sacetasa ekacittāḥ santo yūyamapyasya somasyeva rājño māṇavakasya vapata muṇḍayatainamityarthaḥ ' somo vā oṣadhīnāṃ rājā' iti śruteḥ rājānamivainaṃ gauravabhājanaṃ manyamānā muṇḍayateti yāvat || 9 || 'uṣṇāśca śītāśca sametya sarvā bṛhaspatiḥ savitā satyadharmā | tadanumanyatām ||' ārdradānavaḥ stha jīvadānavaḥ sthondatīrihainamavatāpa undantu jīvase dīrghāyutvāya varcasa ityabhyundet || 10 || uṣṇāścetyādinā varcase ityantenābhyudet 'undī kedane' māṇavakasya śiraḥ abhimantritābhiradbhiḥ prakṣālayedityarthaḥ || he āpaḥ ihaiva sthāne enaṃ māṇavakamavata rakṣata uṣṇāśca śītāśca sarvāḥ sametya saṃbhūya | taccāvanaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ savitā cānumanyatāmabhyupagacchatu | kīdṛśaḥ | satyadharmā satyameva hyasya dharmaḥ, satyasaṃkalpo hyata evāyam | he āpaḥ ārdradānavaḥ ārdrabhāvasya dātryaḥ stha bhavatha | dadāti iti dānuḥ, auṇādiko dānuśabdaḥ | evaṃ jīvadānavo jīvadātryaḥ stha bhavatha | undatīḥ kledayantyaḥ | āpa undantu jīvase jīvanāya dīrghāyutvāya ca āyuṣe tvapatyoriti salopaḥ | varcase brahmavarcasāya rūpaviśeṣāya || 10 || dakṣiṇe keśānta auṣadhe trāyasveti darbhamantardhāya svadhita iti kṣureṇābhinidhāya yenāvapatsavitā kṣureṇa somasya rājño varuṇasya vidvān | tena brahmāṇo vapatedamadyāyuṣmāñjaradaṣṭiryathāsadayamasau || yena dhātā bṛhaspateragnerindrasya cāyuṣe'vapat | tenāsyāyuṣe vapa sauślokyāya svastaye || yena pūṣā prajāpateragneḥ sūryasya cāyuṣe'vapat | tenāsyāyuṣe vapa sauślokyāya svastaye || yena bhūyaśca rātrī jyokpaśyā ca sūryam | tenāsyāyuṣe vapa sauślokyāya svastaya iti pradakṣiṇaṃ pratidiśaṃ pratimantraṃ darbhakṣurakarma || 11 || śiraso dakṣiṇe bhāge oṣadhe trāyasvainamiti mantreṇa darbhamantardhā svadhite mainaṃ hiṃsīrityanena kṣureṇābhinidhāyāvaṣṭabhya sadarbhān keśān yenāvapadityādibhiścatasṛbhiranuṣṭuṣubhiḥ dakṣiṇabhāgādārabhya pradakṣiṇaṃ yathā bhavati, tathā pratidiśaṃ pratimantraṃ darbhakṣurakarma kartavyamṛtvijā ādyayā dakṣiṇe bhāge, dvitīyayā paścime bhāge, tṛtīyayottarasmin caturthyāṃ khame || he oṣadhe enaṃ māṇavakaṃ trāyaskha gopāya | he svadhite kṣura enaṃ māṇavakaṃ mā hiṃsīḥ | yenāvapadyena kṣureṇa savitā somasya rājño varuṇasyāvapaduptavān śiraḥ, tena he brahmāṇa adyāsminnahani vapata muṇḍayata idaṃ bālakasyāsya śiraḥ | kīdṛśaḥ savitā | vidvān jānan | tathā vapata yathāyaṃ bāla āyuṣmān dīrghā yurjarāmaśrute vyāpnoti jaradaṣṭiścāsau bhavati | asāviti nāmaviśeṣo lakṣyate | yena dhātā, yena kṣureṇa prajāpatirbṛhaspateranerindrasya ca śira uptavān dīrghāyutvāya, tenaivāsya kṣureṇa bālasya śiro vapa dīrghāyutvāya ca suślokavāya kīrtaye tathā svastaye'vināśāya | yena pūṣeti anantarakhyākhyayā gatārthaḥ | yena bhūyaśca rātrī jyokpaśyā ca sūrya, yena kṣureṇa rātriḥ sūryamavapat bhūyaḥ punaḥpunaḥ | jyokū cirakālaṃ, paśyatīti paśyā jyokpaśyā bahudarśanā rātriḥ | tenetyādi samānam || 11 || yatkṣureṇa vartayatā supeśasā vaptarvapasi keśān | śundhi śiro māsyāyuḥ pramoṣīriti lohāyasaṃ kṣuraṃ keśavāpāya prayacchati || 12 || yatkṣureṇetyādiyajuṣā nāpitāya kṣuraṃ da dāti lohāyasamiti śastrāntarajātiviśeṣasya saṃjñā nāpitaprasiddhā | anye tu kṣuragrahaṇenaiva lohatvasya siddhatvāt stutyartha lohaprahaṇamityāhuḥ | yatkṣureṇa yena kṣureṇa atitaikṣṇyādiguṇabhājā praśastatamenetyarthaḥ yaditi luptatṛtīyaikavacanāntam, he vaptaḥ muṇḍayitaḥ nāpita yena kṣureṇa keśānvapasi supeśasā surūpeṇa, tena vartayatā parivartamānena asya āyurmā pramoṣīḥ mainaṃ vadhīrityarthaḥ, kiṃ tarhi, śundhi śiro'sya, śodhaya śiro'sya || 12 || mā te keśānanugātteja etattathā dhātā dadātu te | tubhyamindro bṛhaspatiḥ savitā varca ādadhuriti prapatato'numantrayate 13 anayā purastādbṛhatyā keśān patato'numantrayate | tava etatprasiddhaṃ rūpādikaṃ tejaḥ keśānanu keśānāṃ paścāt mā gāt | tathā dhātā prajāpatiste tubhyaṃ tejo dadātu | tathā tubhyamindro bṛhaspatiḥ savitā varco rūpaviśeṣādikaṃ ādadhuḥ dadatu || 13 || suhṛtparigrāhyānupyamānānharitagomaye samavacinoti || 14 || suhṛdaiva patantaḥ keśā grāhyā iti niyamaḥ | tāmuṣyamānān muṇḍyamānān patataḥ haritagomaye. samavacinoti samyagavacinoti pratīcchati haritagomaye saṃmiśrīkṛtya piṇḍīkarotīti kacidācāraḥ || 14 || uptvāya rājño varuṇasya keśānsomo dhātā savitā viṣṇuragniḥ | tebhyo nidhānaṃ bahudhānvavindannantarā dyāvāpṛthivī avasyuriti prāgudīcīṃ hriyamāṇānanumantrayate || 15 || anayā vaiśvadevyā triṣṭubhā mitreṇa prāgudīcīṃ diśaṃ nīyamānān keśānanumantrayate kartā | uvāya utvā muṇḍayitvā varuṇasya rājñaḥ sambandhinaḥ keśāṃstebhyastadarthaṃ yannidhānaṃ sthānaṃ, tadbahudhā anvavindan jñātavantaḥ | kutra | dyāvyāpṛthivyorantarāle madhye | ke te | somaścandro, dhātā prajāpatiḥ, savitā ādityaḥ, viṣṇuragniḥ | avasyuriti pratyekamabhisamba dhyate | avanamavaḥ rakṣaṇam | avamicchati 'supa ātmanaḥ kyacū' 'kyācchandasi' iti upratyayaḥ avanakāma ityarthaḥ || 15 || arikte paryāśleṣayata iti śrutiḥ ||16|| arikte dūrvālatāvanaspatiprabhṛtau śītapradeśe samāśleṣayate keśānmitramiti śrutyā pratipāditaṃ śrutimūlametatkarmeti pradarśitaṃ 'yatra bāṇā niṣpatanti kumārā viśikhā iva |' ityādinā || 16 || kartre varaṃ dadāti || 17|| ṛtvije varaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ yathāśakti dadāti yajamānaḥ | caturvarṣā gaurdakṣiṇātretyāhuḥ ||17|| pakṣmaguṇaṃ tilapeśalaṃ keśavāpāya prayacchati || 18 || sūkṣmairūrṇā guṇairveṣṭitaṃ tilapātraṃ nāpitāya dadāti || 18 || sarpiṣmadannaṃ brāhmaṇānbhojayet ||19|| gatārtham | cūḍākaraṇe'ṅganirdeśātpradhānānabhidhānātpradhānamājyenāgneyyā vaiśvadevyā vā kartavyamityāhuḥ | yadvopasamādhāyetyanenājyabhāgāntaramuktaṃ tadeva pradhānam | yeṣāṃ tvagnisaṃskāramātramupasamādhānaṃ teṣāṃ pūrva pradhānam || 19 || iti cūḍākaraṇavivṛtiḥ samāptā || samāptā ca catvāriṃśī kāṇḍikā || 40 || <41-50> atha kāṭhake carakaśākhāyāṃ laugākṣigṛhyasūtrāṇi | devapālakṛtabhāṣyopetāni | ekacatvāriṃśī kāṇḍikā | saptame varṣe brāhmaṇasyopāyanam ||1|| janmanaḥ prabhṛti saptame varṣe garbhādaṣṭame brāhmaṇasyopāyanamācāryasamīpagamanamekhalābandhanasaṃskāraḥ pradhānabhūtaḥ | tasminhi sati śrutismṛtyadhikāro bhavati | ata eva dvitīyaṃ janma smaryate 'prathamaṃ mātṛto janma dvitīyaṃ mauñjibandhanāt | atra mātā ca sāvitrī pitā tvācārya ucyate || iti || 1 || navame rājanyasya || 2 || aveṣṭyadhikaraṇanayena rājā kṣatriyastasyāpatyaṃ rājanyaḥ kṣatriyadārakaḥ | tasya janmanaḥ prabhṛti navame garbhāddaśame upanayanam || 2 || ekādaśe vaiśyasya || 3|| samānaṃ pūrveṇa || 3 || ā ṣoḍaśādbrāhmaṇasyānatikrama ā dvāviṃśādrājanyasyā caturviṃśādvaiśyasya || 4 || sarvatrābhividhāvāṅ | brāhmaṇasya ṣoḍaśavarṣāntaṃ yāvadupanayanakālānatikramaḥ, evaṃ dvāviṃśāntaṃ yāvat kṣatriyasya, ā caturviṃśādvaiśyasya || 4 || snātoptakeśe yathoktamupasamādhāya jayaprabhṛtibhirhutvā revatīstvā vyakṣṇankṛttikāścakratustvāpasastvā vyatanvata| dhiyo'vayannava gnā amṛjansahasramantām̐ abhitodayacchannaśītirmadhyamavayannu nārīrityahataṃ vāso'bhimantrayate || 5 || snātaścāsāvuptakeśo muṇḍitaśirāstasmin māṇavake upasthite sati yathāvidhi upasamādhānamagnisaṃskāramuddhata sikto palite bhūviśeṣe sthāpanaṃ parisaṃvahanaṃ paryukṣaṇaṃ paristaraṇaṃ ca kṛtvājyaṃ copanidhāya vilāpya saṃvīkṣya daṇḍamekhalādikaṃ yathopayogamānīyopanetā jayaprabhṛtibhirṛtunakṣatrādyantairhṛtvā revatīstvetyādikayā śakkaryā ahatamabhuktaṃ navaṃ vāso haste nidhāyābhimantrayate | kila vāsaso'yamutpattikramaḥ - ādau tāvadvevatībhiḥ karpāso loṣṭhanikābhirabhihanyate vidhūyate ca, tataḥ kṛtyate veṣṭayate sūtratāmāpādyate ityarthaḥ, tatastantuvāyena ātānāyate, tataḥ kūrcena parāmṛjyate | tato vastraṃ vayati tantuvāyaḥ, sampanne ca vastre pallavadvaye daśāḥ saṃyojayati | evaṃkramo'tra mantre karpāsādīnāṃ hananādau devatāviśeṣāṇāṃ kartṛtāropaṇena stūyate | he vastra tvāṃ revatīḥ devatāḥ vyakṣṇanviśeṣeṇākṣiṇvan karpāsāvasthāyāṃ loṣṭhanikādibhirhatavatyaḥ | kṛttikāḥ 'kṛtī veṣṭane' kartayoṃ veṣṭikāścakratuḥ cakruḥ sūtraṃ kṛtavatyastadvāreṇa saṃpāditavatyaḥ | apaso'pāpā marutastvāṃ vyatanvata viśeṣeṇātanvata ātānarūpatāṃ kṛtavanta ityarthaḥ | dhiyo'vayan buddhiviśeṣeṇa hi vastraviśeṣasya vānaṃ sampadyate | ava gnāḥ amṛjan 'vyavahitāśva ' ityavaśabdo mṛjinā sambadhyate | gnāḥ devatāḥ avāsṛjan 'mṛjū śuddha' kūrcena ātatasya sūtrasya mārjanaṃ kṛtavatya ityarthaḥ | sahasramantānabhitodayacchan, abhita ubhayataḥ pallavadvaye uditi nipātastathāśabdasyārthe, sahasraśabdo bāhulyārthaḥ, sahasramantānāṃ daśānāmayacchan babandhuḥ | kāḥ | gnā iti yojanīyam | aśītirmadhyamavayannu nārīḥ, nuśabdaḥ kṣipravacanaḥ, madhyaṃ vastrasyāśītirnāya nāgadevatā avayan utavatyaḥ || 5 || devīrdevāya savitā savitre paridhatta varcasā nayemaṃ śatāyuṣaṃ kṛṇuhi jīvase kamiti paridhāpayati || 6 || anena yajuṣā vāsaḥ paridhāpayati | he devyo revatyādyā idaṃ vāsaḥ paridhatta paridhāpayata | kasmai | devāya dyotamānāya māṇavakāya | tvamapi he māṇavaka paridhatta paridharakha | savitā vyatyayena he savitaḥ idaṃ vāsaḥ paridhāpaya savitre devatārthābhijñānasya janayitre māṇavakāya | tvamapi he māṇavaka paridhatta paridhatsva savitā bhūtvā | he vāsaḥ naya prāpaya imaṃ māṇavakaṃ kaṃ brahmāṇaṃ brāhmaṇatvaṃ prāpaya vedasamṛddhiyuktaṃ kurvityarthaḥ, śatāyuṣaṃ kṛṇuhi kuru || eṣa mantrayāṇāṃ varṇānāṃ paridhāpane sā dhāraṇo'dhovāsasaḥ | uttarīyaṃ vakṣyate'jinam | jarāṃ gacchetyādibhiḥ parihitavāsasamanumantrayate ityādityadarśanaḥ | natvevamācāra ācāryāṇām, nāpi mantraliṅgamevamiti yojanānyathā kāryā | ekaikasyāsādhāraṇa ityekaikasya vāsasaḥ paridhāpane mantratrayam | tatra devīrdevāyetyeko varṇatrayasādhāraṇaḥ, jarāṃ gaccheti dvitīyaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ paridhāpane, paramamityādīnāṃ trayāṇāmekaiko yathākramamekaikasyāsādhāraṇa ityekaikasya trayaḥ paridhāpane mantrāḥ || 6|| jarāṃ gaccha paridhatsva vāso'bhūrāpīvānabhiśastipāvā | śataṃ jīva śaradaḥ purūcī rāyaśca poṣamupasaṃvyayasva || 7 || mantraliṅgādayamapi paridhāpane | upanetā bravīti he māṇavaka vāsaḥ paridhatsva | āśiṣamāha - jarāṃ gaccha jarājarjaritatanurbhava | āpīvābhūḥ 'sphāyī opyāyī vṛddhau' āṅpūrvaḥ 'āto maninkanibvanipaśca' iti vanip pravṛddho bhavetyarthaḥ | anabhiśastipāvā abhūrityanuṣajyate, abhiśaso'bhiśastiḥ pāpayogastatpratiṣodho'nabhiśastiḥ pāpābhāvaḥ prasajyapratiṣedhaṃ kṛtvā paryudāsena ca dharmasaṃbandhaḥ, anabhiśasti pātīti anabhiśastipāvā | śataṃ jīva śaradaḥ śataṃ śaradāṃ ca tvaṃ prāṇān dhāraya | purucīriti śarado viśeṣaṇaṃ puruśabdo bhūrivacanaḥ bahūn puruṣānañcanti sādhayanti iti purūcyaḥ, purucīnāṃ rāyo dhanasya ca poṣaṃ puṣṭiṃ paridhatsva samantāddhāraya || 7 || parīmaṃ somaṃ tejase mahe śrotrāya dadhmasi | yathainaṃ jarasaṃ nayajjyok śrotrāya jāgarajjyok śrotre'dhijāgaraditi brāhmaṇasya || 8 || eṣa brāhmaṇasya paridhāpane mantraḥ somapadāliṅgāditarayoḥ somasaṃbandhābhāvāt 'yadi rājanyaṃ vaiśyaṃ vā yājayenyagrodhatatīrāhṛtya tāḥ saṃpiṣya dadhyutsṛjya tadasmai bhakṣaṃ prayacchenna somam' iti śruteḥ || he māṇavaka etadvāsaḥ paridadhmasi 'idanto masi' itīdantaḥ paridadhmaḥ paridhāpayāmaḥ, somameva cemaṃ paridhāpayāmaḥ, tvayā anenopanayanadvāreṇa soma eva hi parihito dhṛto vedastadarthābhyāsadvāreṇa bhaviṣyati | kimarthaṃ paridhāpayāmaḥ | tejase mahe, mahate, pūjārthaṃ vā maha pūjāyāmityasya rūpam | śrotrāya śrūyate iti śrotraṃ vedaḥ tadarthaṃ vedavedārthādhigamāya, athavā śrotrāya śrotrayuktāya śiṣyāya vedapāragamastvamupādhyāyaḥ śrotriyebhyo hitaḥ sampadyasveti tātparyam | yathainaṃ vāsoviśeṣaṃ jarasaṃ nayat jarāṃ nayati māṇavakaḥ tathā ca paridhāpanena paridhāpayāmaḥ, yathā bahūni vastrāṇi bhogena jarayiṣyati tathāhaṃ paridhāpayāmīti yāvat | jyok cirakālaṃ śrotrāya vedāya jāgarat jāgṛhi bahukālaṃ vedatadarthajāgaraṇaṃ paṭhanavodhānuṣṭhānātmakaṃ tavāstvityarthaḥ | jyok śrotre'dhijāgarat bahukālaṃ śiṣyebhyo jāgṛhi upadiśa atiśayena paropakāraprakṛṣṭadharmakatvāt || 8 || parīmamindramojase mahe kṣatrāya dadhmasi | yathainaṃ jarasaṃ nayajjyok kṣatrāya jāgarajjyok kṣatre'dhijāgaraditi rājanyasya || 9 || he brahmacārin vāsaḥ paridadhmasi vāsaḥ paridhāpayāmaḥ indramindreṇa saha bāhubhyāṃ jātavādindro rājanyastaṃ parameśvaraṃ svayameva prajāpālanasāmarthyāt | kimartham | ojase balāya | mahe mahate pūjitāya vā | kṣatrāya sādhūnāṃ trāṇāya utsāhāya ca | gatārthamanyat || 9 || parīmaṃ manumāyuṣe mahe poṣāya dadhmasi | yathainaṃ jarasaṃ nayajjyok poṣāya jāgarajjyok poṣe'dhijāgaraditi vaiśyasya ||10|| manumiti mānuṣatvānmanum | poṣo dhanapuṣṭistadartham | śiṣṭaṃ samānam || 10 || parīdaṃ vāso'dhidhā svastaye bhavāpīvānabhiśastipāvā | śataṃ jīva śaradaḥ suvīro vasūni cogro vibhaja sujīvanniti parihitavāsamanumantrayate || 11 || trayāṇāmapi varṇānāṃ parihitavāsasāmanenānumantraṇaṃ karotyupanetā | pariśabdaḥ pūrvavadihāpi vyavahitānvayaḥ | he māṇavaka tvamidaṃ vāsaḥ pari adhidhāḥ paryaṣyadhāḥ ādhikyenotkarṣeṇa parihitavānasi svastaye'vināśāya yat, tatvamāpīvā āpīnaḥ pravṛddho bhava, anabhiśastyanabhiśastaṃ pāti rakṣatītyanabhiśastipāvā, śataṃ ca śaradāṃ jīva, suvīraśca śobhanaputrayukto bhava, tathā vasūni dhanāni udāraḥ sanvibhaja viśeṣeṇa bhajasva dehi vā parijanarvikprabhṛtibhyaḥ | suṣṭhu jīvan sujīvan sukhādinā jīvan || 11 || 'yoge yoge' yuvā suvāsa iti caitābhyāmagnimabhi dakṣiṇamānīyehyaśmānamātiṣṭhāśmeva tvaṃ sthiro bhava | kṛṇvantu viśve devā āyuṣṭe śaradaḥ śatamiti dakṣiṇena padāśmānamāsthāpayati || 12 || yoge yoge ityanena yuvā suvāsa ityanena ca mantreṇāgniṃ lakṣaṇīkṛtya pradakṣiṇaṃ yathā bhavati, tathā māṇavakamānīya eāśmānamātiṣṭheti matreṇāśmānaṃ dakṣiṇena padā āsthāpayati adhiṣṭhāpayatyācāryaḥ || yoge yoge tavastaraṃ vāje vāje havāmahe | sakhāyamindramūtaye || vyākhyāteyam | atra vahnipradakṣiṇe tu yogaḥ sambandho viśeṣyate| yoge yoge sarvatra brahmacārikriyāsambandhe kartavye, vāje vāje haviṣi haviṣi, indra havāmahe āhvayāmaḥ ūtaye'vanāya, tavastaraṃ balavattaraṃ, sakhāyaṃ sahāyam || yuvā suvāsaḥ parivīta āgātsa ucchreyānbhavati jāyamānaḥ | taṃ dhīrāsaḥ kavaya unnayanti svādhyo manasā devayantaḥ || eṣa yūpocchrāyane viniyukto'nyatra mantraḥ | tatraiṣa mantrārthaḥ - yūpa eva yuvā navaḥ sadyaśchinnaḥ, śobhanena vāsasā raśanayā ca parito veṣṭita āgāt āgataḥ | taṃ dhīrāso dhīrāḥ paṇḍitā ṛtvijaḥ unnayanti ucchriyanti manasā devayantaḥ devān yaṣṭukāmāḥ paśuyāgaṃ cikīrṣantaḥ | prakṛto'trāyamarthaḥ - brahmacārī yuvā suvāsāḥ parihitaśobhanavastraḥ parivītaḥ saṃvṛto brahmacāryātmā sahi yuvā nityataruṇaḥ saṃvītaśca śaṇavāsasā, āgāt āgataḥ idaṃ śarīraṃ karmavaśātprāptaḥ | prāṇo vyākhyātavyo brahmacārisaṃbandhī | so'pi hi śarīreṇa vāsaseva saṃvṛta āgato brahmacāriśarīram | nityataruṇaśca yuvā sa brahmacārī ucchrita unnato jāyamāno vardhamāno bhavati ātmā vāyurgagana iva kṣudhādibhiḥ pravṛddho bhavati | taṃ dhīrāso dhīrāḥ paṇḍitāḥ kavayaḥ krāntadarśanā unnayanti ūrdhvaṃ nayanti ātmānaṃ mokṣaṃ prāpayanti prāṇamutkrāmayanti ūrdhvaṃ brahmadvāraṃ prāpayanti brahmacāriśarīramapyunnayanti kriyājñānakāṇḍānuṣṭhānotkṛṣṭaṃ sampādayanti, svādhyaḥ śobhanadhiyaḥ sukarmāṇaḥ, ekāgreṇa manasonnayanti || ehyamānamiti, he māṇavaka ehi āgaccha aśmānaṃ pāṣāṇamātiṣṭhādhitiṣṭha, aśmeva sthiro bhava, viśve sarve devā āyuṣṭhe kṛṇvantu śaradaḥ śataṃ samāḥ śatam || 12 || mama vrate hṛdayaṃ te dadāmi mama cittamanucittaṃ te astu | mama vācamekavrato juṣasva bṛhaspatistvā niyunaktu mahyamiti nābhideśādūrdhvaṃ pāṇinonmārṣṭi || 13 || mama vrata ityādinā mantreṇa nābhimārabhya śikhāntaṃ yāvadbrahmacāriṇaṃ ācārya unmārṣṭi | vratamiti karmanāma | he brahmacārin mama vrate karmaṇi te tava hṛdayaṃ dadāmi tvadīyaṃ hṛdayaṃ maccikīrṣita karma sahāyamastvityarthaḥ | mama samba ndhi cittaṃ te tavānucittamastu madīyacittānugataṃ tava cittamastvityarthaḥ | mama sambandhinīṃ vācaṃ tvamekatrato bhūtvā juṣasva yadahamadhyāpayāmi, tadekacitto bhūtvā adhīṣvetyarthaḥ | vāgvai bṛhatī, tasyāḥ patirbṛhaspatirātmā | sa tvāṃ niṃyunaktu samyaksaṃkalpadvāreṇa matsevādau pravartayatu, mahyaṃ madarthaṃ, mamāpi tathā sati ācāryakasampattirupakāro bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ || 13 || dadhikrāvṇa iti trirdadhi bhakṣayitvā brahmacaryamāgāmupa mā nayasvoṃbhūrbhuvaḥ svariti vācayati || 14 || brahmacārī vakti | tamācāryo vācayati brahmacaryamityādi svarityantam | kiṃ kṛtvā | dadhikrāvṇa ityādinā trirdadhi bhakṣayitvā bhakṣaṇe brahmacāriṇaṃ prayujya | khāditvā ācānto brahmacaryamityādi brahmacārī paṭhati gurupāṭhitaḥ sanniti tātparyam || dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣaṃ jiṣṇoraśvasya vājinaḥ | surabhi no mukhā karapraṇa āyūṃpi tāriṣat || eṣā vyākhyātā | brahmacaryamityādi brahmacārī bravīti | he guro ahaṃ brahmacaryamāgām, brahmaṇo vedasya caraṇamāgāmāgataḥ prāptaḥ brahmacarya mayā avaśyakartavyatayā saṃkalpitam | ata upanayakha māṃ saṃskurvityarthaḥ | adhyeṣaṇe loṭ | he upanetastavāpyācāryakasiddhiḥ phalaṃ bhaviṣyati māṃ saṃskurvata ityātmanepadena bodhayati | ādityadarśanastu vyākhyātavāngururidamāha brahmā prajāpatistasya caraṇaṃ brahmabhāvamahamāgāmāgataḥ, ato māmupanayasva brahmasamīpaṃ prāpaya he brahmacārinnityādi | etat vicintyam | omiti brahmaṇo'bhidhānamomiti brahma khaṃ brahmeti śruteḥ | bhūriti bhūlokasthā devatā agnirūpocyate | bhuvarityantarikṣadevatā pūrvavattātsthyāt, saca vāyuḥ | svariti svarlokasthā devatā ādityātmikoktā || 14 || iyaṃ duruktātparibādhamānā varṇaṃ pavitraṃ punatī ma āgāt | prāṇāpānābhyāṃ balamābhajantī sakhā devī subhagā mekhaleyam || ṛtasya goptrī tapasastarutrī ghnatī rakṣaḥ sahamānā arātim | sā naḥ samantamanuparehi bhadrayā bhartāraste mekhale mā riṣāma || śraddhāyā duhitā tapaso'dhijātā svasarṣīṇāṃ mantrakṛtāṃ babhūva | sā mā mekhale parirerihasva mayi dhehi tapa indriyaṃ ceti vācayanmekhalāmābadhnīte || 15 || iyaṃ duruktādityādikāstriṣṭubho vācayannācāryo mekhalāmānīte | brahmacārī vakti | gururvācayati | iyaṃ mekhalā duruktāduṣṭādasatyabhāṣaṇādikāduktādvacanātparibādhamānā vārayantī tasyāṃ baddhāyāṃ vākpāṇipādacāpalavāraṇānniyamacodanādvarṇaṃ brāhmaṇādijātitrayaṃ punatī pāvayantī adhyayanādiyogyatāpādanadvāreṇa, rūpādikaṃ vā varṇaṃ punatī, svabhāvapavitraṃ pāvanayogyaṃ vā | sā me mamāgādāgatā prāṇāpānābhyāṃ valamābhajantī dadatī svādhyāyādidvāreṇa | 'bhao āmardane' ityasya, varṇātmakaṃ rūpamābhajantī vināśayantī tasyāṃ hi satyāṃ adhyayanaṃ kriyate | tacca kriyamāṇaṃ prāṇāpānau niruddhya kriyata iti prāṇāpānabalamapahataṃ tayā bhavati | sakhā samānakhyānā | devī dyotanādiguṇayuktā | subhagā hṛdyā navakomalamuñjasaṃgatā | ṛtasya satyasya gotrī pālayitrī tasyāṃ satyāṃ yatheṣṭavācitvanivāraṇāt, ṛtasya yajñasya vā rakṣikā baddhamekhalena vedatīrthādigamanāt | tapaso vrataniyamasahitasya vedādhyayanasya tarutrī tārayitrī pāraṃ nayatrī | nnatī rakṣaḥ, yātudhānānnāśayantī vajro 'vai mekhaleti śruteḥ | sahamānā arātiṃ, śatrumadānaṃ vā prasahamānā abhibhavantī kārpaṇyaṃ śatrūṃśca nivārayantītyarthaḥ | sā no'smākaṃ samantaṃ samantādanuparehi āgaccha bhadrayā vṛttyā | he mekhale tava bhartāro dhārayitāraḥ santo vayaṃ mā riṣāma riṣihiṃsākarmā tvāṃ dhārayatāmasmākaṃ hiṃsā mā bhūt | śraddhāyā āstikyasya duhitā śraddhāsya mātā | tapaso'dhijātā, tapo'syāḥ pitā | mantrakṛtāṃ samyagjñānavidāmṛṣīṇāṃ svasā bhaginī babhūva bhūtā | he mekhale saivaṃbhūtā tvaṃ māṃ parirerihava 'liha ākhādane' chāndaso varṇavyatyayaḥ māṃ samāśliṣya, mayi tapo niyamayuktādhyayanaṃ dhehi nidhehi, indriyaṃ ca me indriyapaṭupāṭavaṃ ca dehi || 15 || mauñjīṃ trivṛtaṃ brāhmaṇāya prayacchati maurvīṃ dhanurjyāṃ rājanyāya sautrīṃ vaiśyāya || mauauṃ saptamuñja nirmitām | trivṛtaṃ triguṇaveṣṭitām | trivṛdvajraḥ | trivṛnnavakam | tatra trivṛtā yūpaṃ paricīyādityādau rajjau trivṛcchandaḥ | trivṛtstoma ityādau trivṛcchabdo navake | ihāpi rajjau triguṇāyāṃ trivṛcchandaḥ tathā sadācārāt | tena bhrāntyā kecinnavaguṇāṃ mekhalāṃ vyācakṣate | murvo nāma tṛṇaviśeṣastasya vikāro maurvī, tāṃ dhanujyāṃ dhanuṣaḥ prasāryaṃ guṇaṃ rājanyāya prayacchati | sautrīṃ vaiśyāya, sāmānyābhidhāne'pi smṛtyanusāreṇa karpāsa sūtramayīm | ādau prayacchati, tata ābadhnīyāditi kramo boddhavyaḥ || cittasya samo'si daivyo granthirasi mā visrasa iti granthiṃ kṛtvā mitrasya cakṣurdharuṇaṃ balāya tejo yaśasvi sthaviraṃ samṛddham | anāhanasyaṃ vasanaṃ cariṣṇu parīdaṃ vājyajinaṃ dadheyamiti vācayannaiṇeyaṃ carma brāhmaṇāya prayacchati vaiyāghraṃ rājanyāya rauravaṃ vaiśyāya || 17 || cittasya samo'sītyanena mantreṇa mekhalāgranthi kṛtvā śikhāvat yathākulaprasiddhi 'trivṛtā granthinaikena tribhiḥ pañcabhireva vā |' ityādismaraṇāt mitrasyetyādi vācayannaiṇeyaṃ kṛṣṇamṛgasya sambandhi carma brāhmaṇāya prayacchatyupanetā, rājanyāya vyāghracarma, rurucarma vaiśyāya | mekhalā granthau carmadāne ca trayāṇāṃ sādhāraṇau mantrau || cittasyeti | he granthe tvaṃ cittasya samaścittena tulyo yathā brahmacāriṇaścittaṃ na calati vratādhyayanādiśuddhaṃ tiṣṭhati, tathā tvamapi na calasi yāvadbrahmacaryamavasthānāt | daivyo devānāṃ sambandhī tvaṃ granthiriti stutiḥ, tataśca mā visrasaḥ mukto mā bhūḥ || mitrasyeti triṣṭup | brahmacārī brūte | idamajinamahaṃ paridadheyaṃ paridadhe | kīdṛśam | mitrasyāhiṃstrasya hariṇasya ruroścakṣurdarśanaṃ prasiddham | vaiyāghrapakṣe'pi vyāghro mitrameva rājño'bhimatacarmadānācchauryasmaraṇācca | dharuṇaṃ brahmacaryādikasya dhāraṇam | balāya brahmacaryasāmarthyārthaṃ paridadhe tejaḥ brahmavarcasasya tejaso nimittatvāt | yaśasvi yaśaskaram | sthaviraṃ vṛddhamiva gauravapātraṃ sthirataraṃ vā | samṛddhaṃ samṛddhikāri | anāhanasyaṃ āhantīti āhanāḥ 'sarvadhātubhyo'sun' ityasun, āhanasi sādhu āhanasyaṃ tatpratiṣedho'nāhanasyam | vasanamācchādanam | cariṣṇu gamanaśīlaṃ mṛgāvasthāyāmabhūt | vāji vājamannaṃ tadvidyate'syeti vāji, tasminparihite brahmacaryāvasthāya bhaktyānnaṃ prayacchantīti tasyānnatvamupacaryate || 17 || taccakṣurityādityamupasthāpayati ||18|| taccakṣurityādinā ādityopasthānaṃ kārayati || taccakṣurdevahitaṃ purastācchukramuccarat | paśyema śaradaḥ śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ śatam || tadeva cakṣutrailokyasya purastātpūrvasyāṃ diśyuccarati udeti | devahitaṃ devairvihitaṃ preritaṃ nirmitaṃ vā devebhya indriyebhyo vā hitam | tat śaradāṃ śataṃ paśyema paśyantaśca varṣaśataṃ jī. vemeti brahmacārī śaṃsatyupatiṣṭhamāna ādityam || ko nāmāsītyukte'bhivādane prokte'sāvahaṃ bho iti pratyāha || 19 || gururāha ko nāmāsīti | ka iti prajāpatināma | tathāca brāhmaṇaṃ 'ko nāmāsīti prajāpatirvai ko nāmeti | vedagrahaṇābhimukhatvātprajāpatirivāsīti ticchalena sākṣāt praśno'yaṃ prativacanavidhānāt | guruṇā pṛṣṭaḥ śiṣyo'bhivādayate | svanāmoccāraṇenāsāvityukte nāma pratīyāt viṣṇumitro'hamabhivādaye bho iti brahmacāriṇābhivādito guruḥ pratyabhivādanamāha tāntaṃ 'pratyabhivāde'śūdre' iti smṛterāyumādhi saumya viṣṇumitra 3 iti | smṛterapi 'āyuṣmānbhava saumyeti vaktavyo 'ntyākṣare plutaḥ |' iti || 19 || devasya te savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ hastaṃ gṛhṇāmyasā upanaye'sau || 20 || ācāryo brahmacāriṇo dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ dakṣina hastena vivāhoktavidhinā gṛhṇāti devasya taityādinā | he brahmacārin viṣṇumitra ahamācāryo hariśarmābhidhānastvāmupanaye iti śiṣyaṃ svanāmnā saṃbodhya svanāmoccārya gṛhītahasto gururbravīti, eko'sāviti śabdaḥ śivyabodhane, dvitīya ācāryanāmopalakṣaṇārthaḥ, te tava hastaṃ gṛhṇāmi | kīdṛśasya | devasya dyotanādidharmakasya, savituḥ padārthādijñānasya janayituḥ | kimartham | prasave prakṛṣṭajñānādijananāya | stutyarthamāha - naivaṃ bhramaṇīyaṃyaduta carmamayābhyāmātmīyābhyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ vā hastaṃ gṛhṇāmyahamiti | kiṃ tarhi | aśvinordevabhiṣajorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇaśca hastābhyām ||20|| savitā te hastamagrahīdagnirācāryastava | kastvā kamupanaye'sau kāya tvā paridadāmi || 21 || gṛhītahasta evācārya āha | savitābhimatasya janayitā ādityaste tava hastamagrahīt, ātmānameva savitṛtvenopacarati guruḥ | agnirācāryastava, nāham, ahamevāgnistavācāryo vedārthajñānatadanuṣṭhānatapaḥprabhṛtibhirjājvalyamānatvāt kaḥ prajāpatiḥ sannahaṃ gururātmarūpeṇa kaṃ prajāpatimeva santaṃ tvāmahamupanaye asau viṣṇumitranāmā | sarveṣāmevāntaramekaḥ | sa eva ca saṃsthānairau pādhikadoṣanivṛttyā saṃskriyate | kāya prajāpataye tvāmahaṃ paridadāmi parirakṣārthaṃ brahmaṇe tvāṃ samarpayāmītyarthaḥ || 21 || kasya brahmacāryasi prāṇasya brahmacāryasmīti pratyāha || 22 || kasya prajāpaterbrahmacāryasīti bhaṅgipraśne ācāryeṇa kṛte sati śiṣyaḥ pratyāha prāṇasya brahmacārī asmi bhavāmītyabhyupagamabhaṅgeyaiva pratyuttaram | prāṇo hi prajāpatireva jagatsūtrabhūtaḥ | tathāca śrutiḥ 'hiraṇyagarbhaḥ puruṣo mahāṃstvaṃ prāṇo jagatsūtramanādirindraḥ | bodhaḥ śucirgharmatarāntarātmā tathā vidhātā jagato'sya deva ||' iti || 22 || prajāpataye tvā paridadāmi | devāya tvā savitre paridadāmi bṛhaspataye tvā paridadāmyasau | deva savitareṣa te brahmacārī taṃ gopāyasva dīrghāyuḥ sa mā mṛta || 23 || he brahmacārin prajāpataye parirakṣārthamahaṃ tvāṃ dadāmi devāya savitre'ntarātmane bṛhaspataye vāgvai bṛhatī, tasyāḥ patirātmā tasmai dadāmīti samānam | asāviti ācāryanāmapradarśanārtham | he deva svaprakāśatayā dyotamāna | he savitaḥ abhimatavratādijanayitaḥ eṣa brahmacārī te taba sambandhī, taṃ gopāyasva pālaya | dīrghāyuḥ so'stu mā mṛta maraṇaṃ mā bhūdasya | pratyakṣe'pi " parokṣanirdeśo vaidiko vyatyayaḥ || 23 || agniputra vāyuputra sūryaputra viṣṇuputra brahmaputraiṣa te brahmacārī taṃ gopāyasva dīrghāyuḥ sa mā mṛta || 24 || agneḥ putraḥ ṛgvedaḥ | vāyoḥ putro yajurvedaḥ | sūryasya putraḥ sāmavedaḥ | he ṛgveda yajurveda sāmaveda eṣa brahmacārī tubhyaṃ parirakṣārthaṃ datta iti te tava pratyekaṃ sambandhī, atastaṃ gopāyaskha| tathāca brāhmaṇamayryādiputratvamṛgvedādīnāṃ darśayati 'prajāpatirvā eka āsītsa tapo'tapyata tatastapastepānena trayo devā asṛjanta agnirvāyurādityaste tapo'tapyanta tebhyastapastepānebhyastrayo vedā asṛjantāgneṛgvedo vāyoryajurveda ādityātsāmavedaḥ' iti | viṣṇuputro brahmaputraśceti sambhūtagrāmaḥ | athavā agneḥ putro bhūlokaḥ, asyādhiṣṭhātrī devatā agniḥ | evaṃ vāyuputro'ntarikṣalokaḥ, sūryaputro dyulokaḥ | yadvā puru bahu trāyate iti putraḥ, agniścāsau putro'gniputraḥ | evamanyatrāpi yojanā || 24 || brahmacāryasi| apo'śāna | karma kuru | divā mā svāpsīḥ | vācaṃ yaccha ||25|| gururāha - he brahmacārina tvaṃ saṃprati yato brahmacārī saṃpanno'ta etāni pañca kartavyāni buddhyakha | apo'śāna nimittopanatāvācamanāḥ dikaṃ kuru | tathā guruparicaryā vedādhyayanādikaṃ karma kuru | divāsvapnaṃ ca varjaya, matprasādena śarīrādyapāṭavadaśāyāmabhyupagaccha divākhāpamicchāyāḥ svatantrāyā niṣedhāt | vāksaṃyamanaṃ ca kuru anṛtaparuṣabhāṣaṇādikaṃ mā kurvityarthaḥ || bāḍhamityabhyupagamaḥ || 26 || medhāṃ mahyamaṅgiraso medhāṃ saptarṣayo daduḥ | medhāmagniśca vāyuśva medhāṃ dhātā dadātu me || medhāṃ me varuṇo rājā medhāmagnirdadātu me | medhāmindraśca sūryaśva medhāṃ devī sarasvatī || yā medhā apsarassu gandharveṣu ca yanmanaḥ | daivī manuṣye yā medhā sā māmāviśatādiha || śarīraṃ me vicakṣaṇaṃ vāṅme madhumadduhe | niśāmitaṃ niśāmaye mayi śrutam || yanme'nūktaṃ tadramatāṃ śakeyaṃ yadanubruve | priyāḥ śrutasya bhūyāsma medhayā saṃvidhīmahi || avṛdhamahamavṛdhastvamasau saumya prāṇastvaṃ me gopāya brahmaṇa āṇī stha śrutaṃ me mā prahāsīditi vācayati || 27 || medhāṃ mahyamityādikāḥ pañca ṛcaḥ, ṣaṣṭhaṃ yajuḥ śiṣyoṃ vakti, guruvacayati | kuśāgrīyā buddhirmedhā | tāmaṅgiraso vāyavaḥ prāṇāpānasamānavyānodānāḥ dadurdadatu mām | aṅgāni rasayantītyaṅgirasaḥ āntarā vāyavastathā saptarṣayoṃ vasiṣṭhādyā mahyaṃ medhāṃ dadatu | etatsamānamṛgdvaye | apsarassu yā medhā, yacca gandharveṣu mano'ntaḥkaraṇaṃ, yāca devī vedārthādisākṣātkāriṇī, manuṣyeṣu medhā sthitā ihaloke, sā sarvā māmāviśatu praviśatu | mama śarīraṃ vicakṣaṇaṃ paṇḍitamastu adhiṣṭhātṛdvāreṇa | vāk ca vedādirūpā madhumat madhuraphalaṃ duhe dugdhām | yacca mayi śrutaṃ sthitaṃ niśāmitaṃ, tanniśāmaye cintayeyaṃ samyakū | yacca mamānūktaṃ guruṇoktaṃ, tadramatām| yaccānubruve gurūktamanuvadāmi, tacchakeyaṃ śaknuyām | vayaṃ ca śrutasya priyā bhūyāsma śrutamasmākaṃ paryavasitamastu | medhayā saṃvidhīmahi saṃbayemahi | ātmānamuddiśya yajuṣā śiṣya idamāha - he antarātman prāṇādika asau viṣṇumitro'hamavṛṣaṃ vardhiṣye | tvamapi cāvṛdhaḥ asau prāṇādikaḥ, tasyāpi hi vedādhyayanādinātiśayo bhaviṣyati | he saumya prāṇastvaṃ jagatsūtramato me māṃ gopāya | tvaṃ brahmaṇa āṇī sāraṃ stha bhavasi | śrutaṃ me mā prahāsīt śrutaṃ me mā tyākṣīt mama saṃbandhi yacchrutaṃ tanmāṃ mā tyākṣīdityarthaḥ | atra caturthī uṣṇik | śiṣṭā anuṣṭubhaḥ | avṛdhamahamityādi ṣaṣṭhaṃ yajuḥ || 27 || etābhireva catasṛbhiranupravacanīyāñjuhuyādyajuṣottamām || 28 || anupravacanaṃ prayojanaṃ yeṣāṃ te'nupravacanīyā homā ityanvarthā saṃjñā | anu uttarakālaṃ hi sāvitryāḥ pravacanaṃ kārayiṣyate guruṇā | athavānupravacanamarhantītyanupravacanīyāḥ | atra hi manānupādhyāyo vakti, śiṣyo'nupravakti | anupravacanīyasaṃjñakān homānetābhireva prakṛtābhiścatasṛbhirṛgbhiḥ kapiñjalādhikaraṇanyāyena medhāṃ mahyamityādyābhirjuhuyāt | tena catvāro homāḥ | pañcamamāha yajuṣottamām, avṛdhami. tyādinā yajuṣottamāmāhutiṃ pañcamīṃ juhuyāditi kecit | anye tvāhuḥ - atra pakṣe pañcamyā ṛco viniyogābhāvaḥ prāpnoti | uttamāmiti strīliṅganirdeśo na yujyate prakṛtasyānupravacanīyasya puṃstvāt, tadapekṣayottamamiti prasaṅgāt | nacāhutiśabdaḥ prakṛto'sti | tasmāduttamāmṛcaṃ yajuṣā saha saṃyojya pañcamamanupravacanīyaṃ juhuyādityarthaḥ || 28 || ṣaṣṭhamanupravacanīya homamāha chandobhyaḥ svāheti kratunāmadheyena ca yathopācaritaḥ kraturbhavatyevaṃ sarvāṇi vedoktāni || 29 || ṛturiha karma | karmanāmadheyena ca juhuyāt | eṣa saptamo'nupravacanīyahomaḥ | kathaṃ ṛtunāmadheyena hotavyam | yathopācaritaḥ kraturbhavati, yena prakāreṇa prakṛtaṃ karmopācaritamiṣṭaṃ bhavati, tathā hotavyam | caturthīyogena khāhākāreṇa cābhidhānaśakti yoginā ca karmanāmadheyena upāyanāya svāhetyupanayanāya svāheti vā | evaṃ sarvāṇi vedoktāni anenaiva prakāreṇa sarvāṇi vedoktāni karmāṇi khanāmadheyena chandobhyaḥ svāheti huvā hotavyāni traividyakāya svāhetyādiprakāreṇa || 29 || paścādagnerdarbheṣu prāṅāsīnaḥ pratyaṅṅāsīnāya tatsavituriti sāvitrīṃ triranvāha paccho'rdharcaśaḥ sarvāmantato yaśca medhākāmaḥ syāt || 30 || paścādagnerdarbheṣūpaviṣṭaḥ prāṅmukho guruḥ pratyaḍyukhāsīnāyācāryasaṃmukhopaviṣṭāya śiṣyāya sāvitrīṃ savitṛdevatāṃ tatsaviturityādikāṃ gāyatrī trīn vārānanvāha | brāhmaṇāyeti jñeyam | upalakṣaṇametadrājanyavaiśyayorhi sāvitryāvanye smṛtisadācārābhyāṃ boddhavye'dabdhebhiḥ savitariti rājanyāya, viśvā rūpāṇīti vaiśyāya | kathamanvāha | pacchaḥ pādaṃ pādaṃ pacchaḥ prathamocāraṇe pādaśo'nubrūyāt | dvitīyoccāraṇe ardhacaśaḥ ṛco 'rdhamardharcamardharcamardharcamardharcaśaḥ | ante'ntataḥ sarvām, tṛtīyoccāraṇe yathāśaktyanusāraṃ vā sarvāmṛcamanubrūyāt | yaśca medhāṃ śivyasya kāmayate, sopi paccho'rdharcaśaḥ sarvāmantato'nubrūyāt | tatsavituriti vyākhyāteyam || adabdhebhiḥ savitā pāyubhiṣṭuṃ śivebhiradya paripāhi no gayam | hiraṇyajihvaḥ suvitāya navyase rakṣa mā kirno aghaśaṃsa īśata || viśvā rūpāṇi pratimuñcate kaviḥ prāsāvīdbhadraṃ dvipade catuṣpade | vi nākamakhyatsavitā vareṇyo'prayāṇaso virājati || ete yathāsaṃkhyaṃ rājanyavaiśyayoranubrūyāt | he savitarāditya adyāsminnahani no'smākaṃ gayaṃ gṛhaṃ pāhi rakṣa pāyubhiḥ pālakaiḥ raśmibhi radabdhebhiranupahiṃsitaiḥ, śivebhiḥ sukhakāribhiḥ | yatastvaṃ hiraṇyajihvaḥ dīprakiraṇaḥ | suvitāya havirādidā navyase stotrādikartre naurivācarasi tārayiṣyasi āpatsamudrāditi vā | ato'smān rakṣa | mā kiḥ kaścinno'smānaghaṃ pāpaṃ śaṃsati yaḥ, sa caurādiḥ īśata prabhūt || savitā viśvā rūpāṇi sarvānbhāvān pratimuñcate prakāśayati, kavirmedhāvī krāntadarśanaḥ | prāsāvīt prasūte janayati bhadraṃ sukhaṃ dvipade catuṣpade ca | nākaṃ svargaṃ vyākhyātaṃ vyakhyat prakāśayati | vareṇyo varaṇīyaḥ prārthanīyaḥ | uṣaso rātrīṇāṃ prayāṇamanu lakṣaṇīkṛtya hīnīkṛtya vā virājati rātritamaso'pahatatvāt prakāśate || 30 || pālāśamekasaraṃ navanītenābhyajya tasya cchāyāyāṃ vācayati suśravaḥ suśravā asi yathā tvaṃ suśravā asyevaṃ mā suśravaḥ sauśravasaṃ kuru | yathā tvaṃ suśravo devānāṃ vedasya nidhigopo'syevamahaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ brahmaṇo nidhigopo bhūyāsamiti ||31|| palāśasyāyaṃ pālāśo daṇḍaḥ | tamekasaramavāntaraśākhārahitamṛjuṃ satvacamatraṇaṃ navanītenābhyajya svahastena gṛhītvā gurustasya daṇḍasya sambandhinyāṃ chāyāyāṃ śiṣyaṃ vyavasthāpya suśrava ityādi pāṭhayati || pālāśa ucyate - he suśravaḥ suśravā asi śobhanaṃ śravaṇaṃ yasya sa suśravāḥ | tasminhi karmāṅgatvenopādīyamāne duṣṭasyā kīrtyātmakasya śabdasya śravaṇaṃ na bhavati | anuvādamāha 'yasya parṇamayī juhūrbhavati na sa pāpaṃ ślokaṃ śṛṇoti' | brāhmaṇamapi | śravā 'devā vai brahmansamavadanta tatastadbrahma parṇa upāśṛṇotsuvai nāma eṣa' iti, brahmaṇi vede devā avadanta tatastadbrahma parṇe palāśe samāśritaṃ palāśamāśritamityarthaḥ | ata eva palāśaḥ suśravā iti nāmnā prasiddha iti brāhmaṇatātparyam | he suśravaḥ sauśravasaṃ kuru subhavā eva sauśravasastaṃ sauśravasam | yathāṃ tvaṃ suśravo devānāṃ vivadamānānāṃ vedasya nidhigopaḥ vedānāṃ nidheḥ samūhasya rakṣako'si bhavasi, evamahaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ sambandhino brahmaṇo vedasya nidhigopo bhūyāsam || 31 || pālāśaṃ daṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇāya prayacchati || 32 || evaṃ prakṛtaṃ daṇḍaṃ pālāśaṃ brāhmaṇāya brahmacāriṇe'nuvacanānte prayacchatyācāryaḥ || 32 || āśvatthaṃ rājanyāya || 33 || aśvattho vaṭaḥ || 33 || naiyagrodhaṃ vaiśyāya || 34 || vaiśyāya nyagrodhasambandhinaṃ prayacchati daṇḍam || 34 || tacchāyāyāṃ pūrvatantrasyānuvacanaṃ kārayitvā, daṇḍaṃ dattvā kiṃ kārayatyācārya ityāha smṛtaṃ ca ma iti vācayati | smṛtaṃ ca me'smṛtaṃ ca me tanma ubhayavratam | nindā ca me'nindā ca me tanma ubhayavratam | vidyā ca me'vidyā ca me tanma ubhayavratam | śraddhā ca me'śraddhā ca me tanma ubhayavratam | satyaṃ ca me'nṛtaṃ ca me tanma ubhayavratam | mṛtaṃ ca me'mṛtaṃ ca me tanma ubhayavratam | śrutaṃ ca me'śrutaṃ ca me tanma ubhayavratam | vrataṃ ca me'vrataṃ ca me tanma ubhayavratam || yadbrāhmaṇasya brahmaṇi vrataṃ yadagneḥ sendrasya saprajāpatikasya sarṣikasya sapitṛkasya samanuṣyasya samanuṣyarājanyasya sagandharvāpsarojanaskasya sasarpetarajanaskasya sauṣadhivanaspatikasya saha grāmyaiśca paśubhirāraṇyaiśca sākāśasya saprakāśasya sātīkāśasya sānūkāśasya saha yanma ātmana ātmani vrataṃ tanme sarvavratam || 35 || yanmanvādibhiḥ smṛtaṃ yaccāsmṛtamanuṣṭheyatvena varjanīyatvena ca yathāsaṃkhyaṃ vratamavaśyaṃ pālanīyam | evaṃ nindā ca me'nindā ca me iti ninditaṃ varjanīyamaninditamupādeyam | athavā paranindā varjanīyā, anindā ca praśaṃsāvasare kartavyā paropakāraparyavasāyinī | evaṃ vidyāvidye jñātavye hānopādānārtham | śraddhā āstikyaṃ, nāstikyamaśraddhā | tathā satyānṛte | amṛtamamaraṇakāri jñānakarmasamuccayānujñānāt jñeyaṃ mama vratam | mṛtaṃ maraṇakāri kāmyaṃ saṃsārakāraṇaṃ, tadapi hānāya parapuruṣārthārthinā jñeyaṃ, svargādyarthanā tūpādānāya | śrutaṃ mīmāṃsādiśravaṇam, aśrutaṃ kutsitaśrutaṃ lokāyatādiśāstrābhāsaviṣayam | vrataṃ sadvratam, avrataṃ vratābhāsaḥ kartavyābhāsa ityarthaḥ | yat brāhmaṇasya brahmaṇi vede vratamadhyayanādyarthaṃ tat mamāvaśyakartavyaṃ jñānapūrvam | agneḥ prajāpatyādisahitasya yadvataṃ karma, tat mayā jñeyamanuṣṭheyaṃ ca krameṇa | sarvatra guro anugrahaṃ kurviti pratīyamānam | janaskasyeti sakārāgamaśchāndasaḥ || 35 || idamahamagnau samidhamabhyādadhāmyagne sarvavrato bhavāmyadhīte haiteṣāṃ vedānāmekaṃ dvau dvau trīnsarvānvā yamevaṃ vidvānupanayata iti śrutiḥ || 36 || kā mantraliṅgādidamahamityanena samidhamagnau prakṣipati | idamiti liṅgavyatyayaḥ | imāṃ samidhamahamagnāvādadhāmi | abhirābhyamukhyārthaḥ | he agne tvatprasādāt sarvavrato bhavāmi bhūyāsam | adhīte hetyādikamupanetṛstutyartham | ya eva vidvān mantrabrāhmaṇajñaḥ sannupanayate sa evopanetṛtve'dhikṛto, nānyaḥ | sa hi yamupanayate sa eteṣāṃ prasiddhānāṃ vedānāmanantaśākhāyuktānāṃ madhye yathecchamekaṃ dvau vā trīnvādhīte sarvān sarvaśākhākhacitān | haśabda itihāse | ato'nena saṃstutatvācchratamupanayanaṃ, na saṃskārāntaravat smārtamata evopanayanāsamarthā apyavaśyaṃ kurvantīti kecit | tadasat, smārtasyāpyanumitaśrutimūlatvāt | apratyakṣaṃ tatra vidhiriti cet; arthavāde'pi samānatā | yadapi bhaṇati mantragato na vidhāyaka ākhyātaśabda iti kṛtvā nedamahamityanena samitprakṣepaḥ kartavya iti, tadapyamīmāṃsakabhaṇitamākhyātasyāvidhāyakatve'pi liṅgātprakṣepasiddheḥ || 36 || kartre varaṃ dadāti || 37 || upanetre dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti brahmacāriṇaḥ svāmī pitā, tadabhāve jyeṣṭhabhrātrādiḥ || 37 || ahaḥśeṣaṃ sthāpayet ||38|| nopaveśayet, nāpi saṃcārayet || 38 || vyākhyātaṃ brahmacaryam || 39 || brahmacaryamupakrama eva 'upanayanaprabhṛti vratacārī syāt' ityādinoktamato na bhūya ucyate || ityupanayanam || ityekacatvāriṃśī kāṇḍikā || 41 || atha dvācatvāriṃśī kāṇḍikā | traividyakam || 1 || tisṛṣu vidyāsu vedatrayātmikāsu bhavaṃ grahaṇaṃ prayojanaṃ vā vrataṃ traividyakam | vakṣyāma iti śeṣaḥ || 1 || yaṃ prati kathyate, so'prabuddho brahmacārī | tena vyartha upadeśa ityāśaṅkayāha ācāryasya vidhiḥ || 2 || ācāryeṇānuṣṭhātavya ityarthaḥ || 2 || yo vedamadhīte purastāccopariṣṭācāṃhomugbhiḥ samidho'bhyādadhyāt || 3 || adhyayanasyārambhe samāptau cāṃhomugbhistisraḥ samidho'gnāvabhyādadhyāt svāhākāramātraśūnyaṃ prakṣepamātraṃ kuryādityarthaḥ, anyathā juhuyāditi brūyāt | aṃhasaḥ pāpādvimocayantī tyaṃhomuco mantrāḥ | te punaḥ yaddevā devahelanaṃ devāsaścakramā vayam | agnirmā tasmādenaso viśvānmuścatvaṃhasaḥ || yadi divā yadi naktamenāṃsi cakramā vayam | vāyurmā tasmādenaso viśvānmuñcatvaṃhasaḥ || yadi jāgradyadi svama enāṃsi cakumā vayam | sūryo mā tasmādenaso viśvānmuñcatvaṃhasaḥ || devā eva devāsaḥ 'ājaserasuk' he devā devāso'tiśayārthaṃ punaḥ sambodhanam, yadvayaṃ devalanaṃ cakramā 'heḍa anādare' anādareṇāvalepena yaddevānāṃ pāpaṃ kṛtavanto vayam tasmādenaso'hasaḥ pāpāt viśvāt samastādagnirmāṃ vimuñcatu | aṃhasa enasa iti duḥkhapīḍitasya punarvacanam | enaḥśabdo vā pāpakṛte duḥkhātiśaye vartate | anenaiva dvitīyatṛtīyau gatārtho | divānaktaṃśabdābhyāṃ madhyavartinyau sandhye api saṃgṛhīte || 3 || uktaṃ vratopāyanavimocanam || 4 || vratasyopāyanaṃ grahaṇaṃ, vimocanaṃ ca parityāgaḥ | tadvayamapi darśapūrṇamāsayoruktam | tathāca tatratyaṃ sūtraṃ ' pāṇī prakṣālya dakṣiṇato'gnestiṣṭhan brūyādane vratapate vāyo vratapate sūrya vratapate' iti || ame vratapate vratamāla me tatte pratravīmi tacchakeyaṃ tenardhyāsam | bāyo vratapate 0 | sūrya vratapate | agne vratapate vratamacāripaṃ tadaśakaṃ tatte prabrūmastanno gopāya | vāyo vrata0 | sūrya vrata0 || amī ṣaṭ kṛcchravidhau vyākhyātāḥ | iha ca vratagrahaṇe mocane ca samānāḥ kartavyāḥ | iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ - vimocane daṇḍamagnau prāsyedapsu mekhalāṃ vāsaśca hutasamāptiṃ yāvat | tata eva daṇḍādayo matrāvṛttibhājaḥ | tathāca manuḥ 'yadyasya vihitaṃ carma yatsūtraṃ yā ca mekhalā | yo daṇḍo yacca vasanaṃ tattatsarvaṃ vrateṣvapi ||' iti || 4 || iti traividyakamapavargasahitam || iti dvācatvāriṃśī kāṇḍikā || 42 || atha trayaścatvāriṃśī kāṇḍikā | athātaścāturhautṛkaṃ brahmacārikalpena vratamupaiti || 1 || cittiḥ srumityādayo mantrāścaturhotāra ucyante teṣu bhavaṃ cāturhotṛkaṃ vrataṃ brahmacārikalpena brahmacāridharmopadeśinā vedabhāgena coditamupeyāt || 1 || saṃvatsaramaṣṭau māsāṃścaturo māsānvā ||2|| saṃvatsarametadvatamupeyāditi mukhyaḥ kalpaḥ | aṣṭau caturo māsānvetyanukalpaḥ || 2 || śuddhapakṣasya puṇyāhe parvaṇi vā yathoktamupasamādhāya jayaprabhṛtibhirhutvā pūrveṇāgniṃ darbhastambhaṃ nihatyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dakṣiṇata upaveśya hiraṇyavarṇā iti catasṛbhiḥ samidho'bhyādadhyāt || 3 || agneryaḥ pūrvadeśastatra darbhastambhaṃ nihatyādhītavedamanyaṃ brahmacāriṇamagnerdakṣiṇabhāge upaveśya agneḥ paścārdhe avasthitaḥ san 'hiraṇyavarṇā' ityādibhiścatasṛbhiścatasraḥ samidho'gnau pūrvavadabhyādadhyāt | 'hiraṇyavarṇā' ityādayaścatasraḥ saṃmārjane vyākhyātāḥ || 3 || nityavratopāyane brāhmaṇā vratapataya iti caturtham || 4 || yadetatprastutaṃ brahmacāriṇo nityamavaśyakartavyaṃ vratagrahaṇaṃ, tatra 'brāhmaṇā vratapatayo vratamālabhe tadvaḥ prabravīmi tacchakeyaṃ tenarthyāsam iti matraṃ caturthaṃ kuryāt | trayastu pūrvaṃ vyākhyātā atrāpi sthitā agne vratapate vāyo vratapate. sūrya vratapate0 iti || 4 || atha vratahomān || 5 || vakṣyāma iti śeṣaḥ || 5 || caturgṛhītaiścaturhotṛbhirājyena tejaskāmo yāvakena paśukāmo'nnādyena vīryakāmaḥ payasi sthālīpākaṃ śrapayitvā brahmavarcasakāmo manasaikaikaṃ hutamanumantrayate yadvedavrataṃ tadatra vratam || 6 || sapta caturhotāro'tra mantrāḥ | śrapayitvetyetadantaṃ spaṣṭam | ekaikaṃ caturhotāraṃ hutaṃ mantraṃ manasānumantrayate mantrāgamamanusandadhīta mantradvāreṇetyarthaḥ | yadvedavihitaṃ vrataṃ, tat paripūrṇamastvatra mama vratamiti vācayet || 6 || vikārānanukramiṣyāmo na caturbhiḥ sahāsīta na caturṇāṃ samakṣaṃ bhuñjīta na caturbhiḥ saha bhuñjītaikatamo vā || 7 || evamapavarge || 8 || apavargaḥ samāptirvratasya, tatra || 8 || vāsa ācāryāya dadāti varaṃ dakṣiṇata āsīnāya || 9 || vastraṃ dakṣiṇāmācāryāya dakṣiṇata upaviṣṭāya dadyāt || 9 || caturhotṛmantrān vyākhyāsyāmaḥ bhaktyā brahma vivarta vā pariṇāmamupāśritān | ādhyātmikaikarūpārthāṃścaturhotṛnnamāmyaham || cittiḥ sruk cittamājyaṃ vāgvedirādhītaṃ barhiḥ keto agnirvijñātamagnidvācaspatirhotā mana upavaktā prāṇo haviḥ sāmādhvaryurindraṃ gaccha svāhā || caturhotṝṇāmārṣam | indro devatā | 'hu dānādanayoḥ' juhvati dadatīti hotāraḥ | caturṇāṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ dātāraścaturhotāraḥ pradyumnāniruddhavāsudevasaṅkarṣaṇāḥ prathamabrahma vivartāḥ | tathā ca brāhmaṇaṃ 'brahma vai caturhotāraḥ' iti, prajāpatirakāmayata bahu syāmityādi ca | evaṃ ca paramātmaiva yajñarūpaḥ stūyate | yajño vai prajāpatiriti, viṣṇuryajña ityādirapi śrutiḥ | ato'dhyātmayajñasvarūpaṃ rūpakeṇāha - cetanaṃ cittirjñānaṃ sruk | cittaṃ manaḥ svāntamantaḥkaraṇaṃ ceto mānasamiti paryāyaḥ, cittamājyaṃ, yathāhi sucā ājyaṃ prakṣipyate'gnau tathā vivekajñānena manaḥ paramānandadhyānavahnau prakṣipyate | yathāhi kṣiptamājyaṃ dahyate, tadvanmano'pyadhyātmadhyāne prakṣiptaṃ sat svayaṃ vilīyate sarvāvidyā bhedāntarāṇi ca vilāpayati katakaphalarajovat | vāgvediryajñāśrayatvāt | yathāhi vedimāśritya yajñapātrāṇi srugādīni nijakāryeṣu vyāpriyante, tadvadvaidikīṃ vācamupaniṣadrūpāmāśritya manaḥprabhṛti adhyājñānaṃ nijakāryaṃ janayati | ādhītaṃ barhiḥ, ādhyānamādhītiḥ cittadhyātṝṇāṃ tat barhistadāśritatvāccittisrugādīnāṃ 'prastare juhūṃ sādhayati sarvāśca khucaḥ' iti śruteḥ | keto agniḥ 'citī saṃjñāne' asun, chāndaso varṇavyatyayaḥ, ketaḥ prajñāviśeṣaḥ, sa evāgnistenaiva yogayogāṅgādisamidhāṃ sandīpanāt | vijñātamagnit, viśiṣṭaṃ jñānaṃ vedārthagrāhi, agnit chāndaso hakhaḥ, yathāhi ṛtvigviśeṣeṇaidha sāgniḥ sandīpyate, tathā vedārthajñānenottarottaramadhyātmacittāgniḥ | vācaspatirhotā, vācaspatirantarātmā, sa hotā cittinugādipreraṇāt, athavā āhātā manaḥprabhṛtīnāmṛtvijāṃ preṣayitādhvaryuḥ | mana upavaktā, manyate'numanyate iti mano'ntaryāmī, sa upavaktā brahmā | sa hi yat jīvātmā jānāti karoti vā, tat sarvamanuvadatyanupaśyatītyādirūpeṇa anumanyate | prāṇo haviḥ, sa hi paramātmāgnau hūyate niruddhyotkāntikāle brahmadvāreṇa parabrahmaṇi prakṣipyate | sāmādhvaryuḥ, sāmaśabdo vyānavacanaḥ, yathāhi adhvaryuḥ sarvartvijo nijanijakarmasu praiṣairniyacchati, tathā vyānākhyo vāyurnābherupari daśasvaṅguleṣu puruṣasthāne sthitaḥ prāṇāpānau svamaryādāyāṃ sthāpayati parasparaviruddhagatī | etacca yogasāre nirṇītamasmābhiḥ | yadeva puruṣasya sthānaṃ, tadeva vyānasya prāṇāpānayorniyantuḥ | yadā hotṛpadena āhvātā adhvaryurucyate, tadā bhūtayajñādadhyātmayajñasya vailakṣaṇyapratītiḥ prayojanamadhvaryudvayapradarśanasya | itthaṃ prajāpatinā indrādiśabdavācyena pradyumnādyavasthācatuṣṭayavivartena caturhotrā ca daśavidhamātmānaṃ kṛtvā paramātmani samarpaṇaṃ kṛtam | tadāha - indraṃ gaccha svāhā, he prāṇa indraṃ paramātmānaṃ gaccha, suhutamastu svāhūtaṃ vā | āhvānasya ca śobhanatvamanuṣṭhāpanaparyavasānam | evamasmadādayo'pi brahmavivartā brahmapariṇāmā vā saṃsāranivṛttikāmā anutiṣṭhanti, karmakāṇḍasyāpi ca advaitaprāptau paryavasānamityuktamasmābhiḥ sāṃkhyasāraśārīrakayoḥ | evaṃ tāvadekaścaturhotā vyākhyātaḥ || atha dvitīyaḥ pṛthivī hotā dyauradhvaryustvaṣṭāgninmitra upavaktā vācaspate vāco vīryeṇa sambhṛtatamenāyakṣyase yajñapataye vāryamā svaskaro vācaspatiḥ somaṃ pibatu jajanadindramindriyāya svāhā || anena prajāpatirūpayajñasyādhidaivikāni yajñasādhanānyucyante | pṛthivī hotā, sā hi ādhibhautikayajñaprajāpaterannādihavirdānenāpyāyanaṃ karoti | dyauradhvaryuḥ vṛṣṭyādipreṣaṇāt | tvaṣṭā ādityaḥ agnit paktṛtvāt | mitro ha upavaktā brahmā trayyarthabodhenaiva nirmalenālaṃkṛtatvāt | he vācaspate prajāpate caturhotṛrūpa vāco mantrabrāhmaṇātmikāyā vīryeṇa arthatattvāvabodhabalena atiśayasambhṛtena mayā tvamāyakṣyase pūjayiṣyase | sa tvamiṣṭaḥ san yajñapataye yajamānārthaṃ svaḥ svargamākaraḥ ābhimukhyena kuru | kīdṛśaṃ svargam | vāryaṃ varaṇārham | vācaspatiḥ prajāpatiḥ somaṃ pivatu somaśabdena havirmātramatra lakṣyate, pibatinā ca upayogaḥ | jajanadindram, anena cāturhautṛkeṇa karmaṇā prajāpatirjanitavānindramindravivartam | tathāca śrutiḥ 'te cāturhotrāḥ somaṃ gṛhapataye nyaṣīdannindraṃ janayāma ' iti te pṛthivyādayaḥ somaṃ gṛhapatiṃ kṛtvā caturhotrā mantreṇa niṣaṇṇā vedyāmindraṃ janayāmeti | indriyāyeti vratavīryasampatyarthamityarthaḥ | svāheti vyākhyātam || atha tṛtīyaḥ kimarthaṃ caturhotā somaḥ somasya purogāḥ śukraḥ śukrasya purogāḥ śrātāsta indra somā vātāpe havanaśrutaḥ svāhā || somo latārūpaḥ somasya candrasya purogāḥ agresaraḥ | śukraḥ pradarśyaḥ somo vā śukraḥ śukrasya grahasyāsuragurorvā purogāḥ | somāḥ śrātāḥ pakvāḥ āśritā vā | somaśabdo havirmātra upacārāt | upacāranimittaṃ tu vratasampattau krameṇa somayāgayogyatāpattiḥ | he vātāpe vātāhāra havanaśrutaḥ āhvānasya śrotustava suhutaṃ svāhūtaṃ vā astu | bahukarmaviniyogabhājo'mī caturhotāro yathāyogyaṃ bahvarthayujo yojyāḥ || agnirhotāśvinādhvaryū rudro'gnidbṛhaspatirupavaktā vācaspate - hṛdvidhe nāmanvācaspatiḥ somamapādāsmāsu nṛmṇaṃ dhāḥ svāhā || ayaṃ pañcahotā 'te pāñcahotrā varuṇabṛhaspatayo nyaṣīdannindraṃ janayāma' iti hyasya brāhmaṇam | atra cādhidaivikenādhiyajñiyānāmekatvamucyate mantre | agnirhotā tathā ca śrutiḥ 'agnirvai devānāṃ hotā' iti, mantraliṅgamapi 'agnimīle purohitam' iti | aśvinau devabhiṣajau adhvaryū adhvaryupratiprasthātārau | rudro'gnit, agnīdhro rudraḥ | bṛhaspatirupavaktā | he vācaspate hṛdvidhe nāman, hṛdi vidhirhṛdvidhirantaryāmī, tasya sambodhanaṃ he hṛdvidhe, nāman nāmnā antaryāmin tvaṃ vācaspatiḥ somamapāt somapaḥ ataḥ piba somamihāsmāsu asmabhyaṃ nṛmṇaṃ balaṃ ca dhāḥ dehi || vāgghotā vāto'dhvaryurdīkṣā patnyāpo'bhigaro mano havistapasi juhomi vācaspate'cchidrayā vācācchidrayā jihvā divi devāvṛdhaddhotrā mairayasva svāhā || ayaṃ ṣaḍhotā | adhyātmani yā vāk, saiva hotā | vāto'dhvaryuḥ prāṇo'ntarikṣagatirvā | | dīkṣā vratasiddhirūpā patnī | āpo'bhigaraḥ, śaṃsanamabhigarastatrāpa eva kartryo'nnādisaṃpādanadvāreṇa | mano havirātmāgnau hūyamānatvāt tapasi brahmaṇi juhomi manaḥprabhṛtikaṃ brahmaṇi prakṣipāmi | he vācaspate'cchidrayā avināśinyā vācā antaḥprakāśarūpayā acchidrayā jihvayā he divi deva me mama īrayasva prerayasva sampādaya karma | kīdṛśyā vācā | avṛdhaddhotrā'dṛṣṭahomādisampādanabhūtayetyarthaḥ || mahāhavirhotā satyahaviradhvaryuracittapājā agnidacittamanā upavaktānādhṛṣyaścāpratidhṛṣyaścābhigarā ayāsya udgātā vācaspate vidhe nāmanvidhema te nāma vidhestvamasmākaṃ nāma mā devānāṃ tantuśchedi mā manuṣyāṇāṃ svāhā || ayaṃ saptahotā mantraḥ | 'te sāptahotrā aryamagṛhapatayo nyaṣīdansantarāmi' iti hyasya brāhmaṇaṃ, saṃtaraṇaṃ brahmasaṃprāptiḥ | mahāhaviścandraḥ sarvairupajīvyamānatvādata evāsya kalākṣayaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣe, sa hotā devānāṃ havirdānenāpyāyakatvāt | satyahavirādityaḥ satatapreraṇāt, so'dhvaryuḥ | acittapājā agnit, cittaprajñāśūnyo'gnīdvāyuragnīdhra ityarthaḥ | evamacittamanā jñānamanovihīno vanya phalaśākādirupavaktā | kīdṛśaḥ | anādhṛṣyaścāpratidhṛṣyaśca anabhibhavanīyaḥ, atiśayāya bhūyovacanam | abhigarāḥ, gṛṇātiḥ stutyarthaḥ | ayāsya udgātā 'yasu prayatne' aprayatnasiddho vedopaniṣadrūpa udgātā, sa udgāyati tattvam | he vācaspate vidhe nāman vidhema te tava nāma tvannāmārthaṃ yajñaṃ kurma ityarthaḥ | yataśca tvamevāsmākaṃ nāma svarūpaṃ tenāsmākaṃ devānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ ca mā tantuśchedi saṃtatiṃ mā cchaitsīḥ | suhutamastu tava || " iti cāturhautṛkamantrāḥ || jñānānandamayaṃ nutvā paramātmānamacyutam | pravargyavratamantrāṇāṃ bhāṣyaṃ prastūyate'dhunā || tatra 'namo vāce' ityādyanuvākena 'prācyā tvā' ityādinā yajuścatuṣṭayarahitena 'divyo gandharvo bhuvanasya' iti 'āhuste bhaga' iti ca dvābhyāmanuvākābhyāṃ śāntibandhanaṃ kriyate | tasya punaḥ kuṇḍe samabhimantrya sthāpanaṃ pradarśitānuvākaiḥ | tataḥ śāntivimoko'vaśyakartavyaḥ | ete ca mantrā mantrarahasyādau saṃmārjane ca kuśalā apīha tāvacchāntibandhāya yojyante || namo vāce namo vācaspataye yā vāguditā yā cānuditā tasyaivāce namaḥ nama ṛṣibhyo maṃtrakṛdbhyo maṃtravidyo mā māmṛṣayo mantrakṛto maṃtravidaḥ parādudaivīṃ vācamudyāsaṃ śivāmajasrāṃ juṣṭāṃ devebhyaḥ svadhāvatīṃ pitṛbhyaḥ śuśrūpeṇyāṃ manuvyebhyastaṃ māṃ devā avantu śobhāyai pitaro'numadantu sucakṣā ahamakṣibhyāṃ suvarcā mukhena suśrutkarṇābhyāṃ bhūyāsamoṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ || rudrasyārtham | abhidheyo'rtho devatā | yā maśramayī vāk tasyai vāce namo'stu | vācaspataye vācāṃ vacanarūpāṇāṃ patistasmai uccārayitre namaḥ | yā vāgupadiśantī sūkṣmā ca tasyai vāce namo namaḥ | namaḥ śabdasya punaruccāraṇamatiśayārtham | ābhyāṃ hi bhūyāṃsamarthaṃ manyante yathā aho ramaṇīyā aho ramaṇīyeti | ye ca ṛṣayo mantravido mantrakṛtaśca tebhyo namo namaḥ | tatra mantravido brahmavakracatuṣṭayatūrṇavinirgatān mabrān sakṛdeva gṛhṇanti granthato'rthataśca sanakādayaste mantravidaḥ | tathā cāraṇyakam 'yathādvaidhārabhyāhitasya pṛthagdhūmā viniścarantyevaṃ vā are'sya mahato bhūtasya viniḥśvasitametadyadṛgvedo yajurvedaḥ sāmaveda' iti | anyatrāpi 'ye sākṣātkṛtadharmāṇa ṛṣayo vabhūvuste parebhyo'sākṣātkṛtadharmabhyo matrān saṃprāduḥ' ityādi | mā māmṛṣayo mantrakṛto mantravidaḥ parādurdevīṃ vācam iti, ye mantrakṛto mantravidaśca ṛṣayaste devīṃ vācaṃ māṃ mā parāduḥ, māmiti pañcamyarthe dvitīyā, matsakāśāt parāṅmukhīṃ mā kārṣuḥ mantrarūpāṃ vācam | kintarhi | daivīṃ vācamahamudyāsaṃ 'yā prāpaṇe' utkarṣeṇa prāpnuyāmityarthaḥ | śivāṃ śreyaskarīm, ajastrāṃ nityāṃ, juṣṭāṃ devebhyaḥ, devebhyaḥ prītijananīṃ 'juṣī prītisevanayoḥ' | svadhāvatīṃ pitṛbhyaḥ, pitṛbhyo'nnavatīm, mantrairhi devāḥ prīyante pitaraśca svadhāṃ bhajante | śuśrūṣeṇyāṃ manuṣyebhyaḥ, śravaṇā śuśrūṣeṇyām | tamevaṃbhūtaṃ māṃ stotāraṃ devā avantu, śobhāyai śobhayopalakṣitaṃ santaṃ pitaraścā'vantu anumadantu anumādyantu, śobhāyai devāḥ pitaraśca hṛṣṭā bhavantu | kiṃca devapitṛprasādādahamakṣibhyāṃ sucakṣā bhūyāsamakṣibhyāṃ sudarśanaḥ syāmityarthaḥ, mukhena ca suvarcā sudīptirbhūyāsam | abhūrbhuvaḥ svariti saṃkṣepeṇa vāgvibhava uktaḥ bhuvanatrayasya vāgvibhavavivartatvāt || prācyā vā diśāgninā devatayā gāyatreṇa cchandasā vasantamṛtuṃ praviśāmi || dakṣiṇayā tvā diśendreṇa devatayā traiṣṭumena cchandasā grīṣmamṛtuṃ praviśāmi || pratīcyā tvā diśā savitrā devatayā jāgatena cchandasā varṣā ṛtuṃ praviśāmi || udīcyā tvā diśā mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ devatayānuṭubhena cchandasā śaradamṛtaṃ praviśāmi || ūrdhvayā tvā diśā bṛhaspatinā devatayā pāṃktena cchandasā hemantamṛtuṃ praviśāmi || anayā tvā diśā prajāpatinā devatayā anāptena cchandasā śiśiramṛtuṃ praviśāmi || gāyatrīṃ cchandaḥ praviśāmi | triṣṭubhaṃ cchandaḥ pra0 | jagatīṃ chandaḥ pra0 | anuṣṭubhaṃ cchandaḥ pra0 | paktiṃ cchandaḥ pra0 | aticchandasāṃ cchandaḥ pra0 | cchandāṃsi praviśāmi | tāni naḥ pārayantu tāni no'vantu tāni sa ṛcchatu yo'smāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ || āpo'smān praviśantvāpo'smāsu jāgrata | āyurviśvāyurviśvamāyurvyaśnavai sarvamāyurvyaśnavai || udakāvamarṣaṇapravṛtta eva tu chandaḥprabhṛtīnāmudakena sahābhinnatvamāropyodakamāhahe udaka, tvāṃ vasantartubhūtamahaṃ praviśāmi prastutakarmaṇā tvāmārādhya tvanmayaphalāni labheyamityarthaḥ | kena praviśāmi | prācyā diśāgninā devatayā gāyatreṇa cchandasā | evamṛtupañcakapraveśe vākyāni yojayitavyāni | evaṃ gāyatrī chandaḥ praviśāmītyādi | cchandaḥ praveśavacanamātmādirakṣārthaṃ nirbhayasthānapraveśaparatvena yojayitavyam | tāni cchandāṃsi no'smān pārayantu prastutasamāptiṃ kurvantu | tāni no'vantu rakṣantu tarpayantu ca | tāni sa ṛcchatu yo'smāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmo yaścāsmāndveṣṭi sa tāni cchandāṃsi ṛcchatu, tāni chandaḥprabhṛtīni prāpya līyatāmityarthaḥ || āpaḥ asmān praviśantu, adhiṣṭhātrī devatā rakṣakatvena māmadhitiṣṭhatvityarthaḥ | āpo'smāsu jāgrata, he āpaḥ asmāsu jāgrata | āyurviśvāyurviśvamāyuryaśnavai sarvamāyurvyaśnavai, apāṃ prasādāt āyurvyaśnavai viśeṣeṇa vyāpnuyāṃ viśvāyurviśvamāyurityādi punarvacanamatiśayārthaṃ pūrvavat | divyo gandharvo bhuvanasya yaspatirekānyo manasā vikṣvīḍyaḥ | taṃ tvā yāmi brahmaṇā deva devī namaste'stu divi te sadhastham || divi pṛṣṭo yajata sūryatvagavayāto haraso divyasya | ekāvyo manuṣyaḥ suśevaḥ | mṛlād gandharvo bhuvanasya yaspatiranavadyābhiḥ samajagmābhirapsaraḥ khapi gandharva āsītsamudra āsāṃ sadanaṃ va āhustataḥ sadhyā ca parācarantyabhriye dinakṣatriye yā viśvāvasuṃ gandharvaṃ sasadhe tābhyo namo astu tā no mṛḍayantu tā naḥ śarma yacchantu tāyaṃ dvimo yaśca no dveṣṭi tamāsāṃ jambhe dadmaḥ || divi bhavo divyaḥ, gā raśmīndhārayatīti gandharvaḥ, sa eva rudraḥ iṣṭaḥ | sa eva bhuvanasya patiḥ | śrūyate hi 'ime vai lokā bhuvanaṃ teṣāmepo'dhipatiryo rudra iti' eka eva avati sarvaṃ rakṣatītyekāvyaḥ | manasā vikṣvīḍyaḥ, vikṣu devasenāsu madhye sa eva īḍyaḥ stutyaḥ manasā mananadhyānādinā ārādhanīya ityarthaḥ, athavā vikṣviti vibhaktivyatyayaḥ viśāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ manasaivejyaḥ yo'sāvantarāditye puruṣa aupaniṣadaḥ | he deva dyotanādikarmaka tamevaṃbhūtaṃ tvā bhuvanādhipatibhūtatvāt ahaṃ yāmi prāpnomi brahmaṇā mantrātmakena vedena vandamānaḥ stuvāna āyāmi vā prātumicchāmītyarthaḥ | ato namaste'stu yasya te divi sadhasthaṃ sthānaṃ tasmai | 'divi pṛṣṭaḥ' pravargyatratahomārambhārthamidamṛtvija uddiśyocyate | he ṛvijaḥ divi kharge pṛṣṭabhūto'yamādityaḥ sarvadevottama ityarthaḥ | sūryatva sūryasya tvagiva tvak yasya sa sūryatva avayāḥ bālyādyavasthāśunyo brahmaṇo'nādyantasvāt | ato'sya divyasya harasastejorūpasya yajata he ṛtvijaḥ, ekāvyaḥ, manuṣṣu manuṣyeṣu mumukṣuṣu sādhurmanuṣyaḥ, suśevaḥ, śeva iti sukhanāma, nityānandasvabhāva ityarthaḥ, sukhasevyo vā chāndaso varṇavyatyayaḥ, suśevā iti kecitpaṭhanti, mṛḍāt mṛḍaṃ sukhamattīti mṛḍāt nityasukhasya bhoktā | gandharva iti vyākhyātam | kābhiryajata | anavadyābhirāhutibhiḥ samajagmābhiḥ samaṃ kṛtvā agniṃ yatantībhiḥ | purastāpūrvasyāṃ diśi udagāduditaḥ mahato'rṇavātsamudrāt | viśeṣeṇa bhrājamāno dīpyamānaḥ sarirasya saraṇamārgasyā'ntarikṣasya madhye | vṛṣabhaḥ kāmānāṃ varṣayitā, vṛṣabho vā sarvajyotiṣāmutkṛṣṭaḥ | rohitākṣaḥ lohitalocanaḥ kanakanayanaḥ|| yadbrahmavādiṣma tanmā mā hāsītsūryāya vibhrājāya vai namo namaḥ || yadbrahma vedavādiṣma paṭhitavanto vayaṃ tanmā māhāsīnmātyākṣīt | sūryāya viśeṣeṇa bhrājamānāya punaḥ punaḥ namaskāro'stu || śāntivimokaḥ || āpamāpamapaḥ sarvā asmādasmādito'sutaḥ | agnirvāyuśca sūryaśca saha sañcaskarurdhiyā || aupaniṣadāḥ paramarahasyamantrā amī paramāḥ pāvanāḥ saṃsāraghorasāgarasantaraṇopāyāḥ prāyaḥ sarvatra samarthāḥ, pravargyatrate'pi śāntiprastāvopayogina āpamāpamityādaya itīhāvaśyaṃ vivaraṇīyāḥ | apaḥ pātre nidhāyopastautisarvā apa ahamāpamāpaṃ prāptavān | abhyāso'tiśayārthaḥ | asmādasmādito'mutaḥ asmāditi pratyakṣanadyādijalāśayanirdeśaḥ, amuta iti parokṣādhārābhidhānam | abhyāsaḥ sākalyārthaḥ | etā apaḥ sarvā anivāyusūryāḥ sañcaskaruḥ saṃstasbhavantaḥ | dhiyā prajñayā || vāyvaśvā raśmipatayo marīcyātmāno adruhaḥ | devīrbhuvanamvarī' putravattvā ime suvaḥ || vāyuvadaśvā vyāpakāḥ | ke | raśmipatayaḥ raśmayaśca te patayaḥ pālakāḥ apa, raśmaya eva garbhāḥ santo meghā bhavanti | ataśca marīcyātmānaḥ, āpo marīcyantarvartitvena sthitā ityarthaḥ | adruhaḥ sūkṣmarūpeṇa marīcimadhyagatā api drohaśūnyā anupahiṃsikā ityarthaḥ | devīḥ devya āpaḥ | bhuvanasya bhuvanānāṃ sūvarīḥ sūryaḥ prasavaśīlāḥ | ime imān lokān asuvaḥ sūtavatyaḥ | putravavai putrāṇāṃ jīvātmanāmavatvai avanāya saṃsārakleśaśāntaye || mahānāmnīrmahāmānā mahāyāmā mahāsomāsaḥ | devīḥ parjanyasūvarīḥ putravattvā imaṃ suva || mahānāmnībhirṛgbhirudakamucyate | ṛcaśca mahānāmnyaḥ tadabhidhānādāpastathā, mahadyato nāma āsāmapāmiti, mahāprabhāvā ityarthaḥ | ata eva ca mahāmānā, bṛhatyā pūjayā yuktāḥ | mahāyāmā mahāparimāṇāḥ | tathā mahāsomāsaḥ, tābhireva hyabhiṣutaḥ somo yāgayogyo bhavati | evaṃbhūtāśca parjanyasūvarīḥ parjanyasya meghasya savitryaḥ | putravattvā imaṃ suva, imaṃ brahmacāriṇaṃ putravattvāya suva putrajananayogyaṃ saṃpādaya || apāśnuṣṭimapārakṣamapāśnuṣṭimapārasam | apādhamanujāvarti mama devīṛte hitāḥ || apa iti ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanasya supāṃ subityādeśaḥ | snaṣṭirekadeśaḥ | spṛśāmītyadhyāhāraḥ | apāmekadeśaṃ spṛśāmītyarthaḥ | uddhṛtya hi jalaikadeśo'trābhimadhyata ityuktam | evamapāṃ rakṣakamaṃśamuddhṛtaṃ spṛśāmi, apāṃ rasaṃ sāram | apāghamanujāvarti, apāmaghaṃ pāpaṃ spṛśāmyapasārayāmi | sadbhāve'psu pāpasya pramāṇamāhaanujāvarti, apāmanujā jīvātmānastajjanyatvāt teṣvāvartamānamaghamaśucitvaṃ kāraṇe'pyanuvṛttiṃ gamayati, ghaṭādigatamiva gandhādi mṛtpiṇḍādike | ato vartamānaṃ aghaṃ āsāmuddhṛtya mantraiḥ pāvanaṃ śāntyādau | mama devīṛte hitāḥ, mama ṛte hitā mama ṛte yajñe satye ca hitāḥ | athavā mama devyo hitā āpaḥ, yathā ṛto yajño hito mama, ṛtaḥ satyaśabdo vā || vajraṃ devīruditāḥ stha varuṇaṃ devasūvarīḥ | ādityānuditaṃ devīryoninordhvamudīṣata || yūyaṃ pāpanivāraṇāya vajramivoditāḥ stha bhavatha | yato varuṇasya doṣa nivārakasya devasya sūryo yūyam | ādityānuditaṃ karma vratādikaṃ kāmyaṃ ca tasya kartāraṃ he devya ūrdhvamudīṣata sarvotkṛṣṭaṃ saṃpādayatetyarthaḥ yoninā svajanmanimittena parabrahmaśaktyetyarthaḥ || evamādayo mantrā bahuśaktayaḥ śāntivimokesyupayoginaḥ || bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadraṃ paśyemākṣibhiryajatrāḥ | sthirairaṅgaistuṣṭuvāṃsastanūbhirvyaśema devahitaṃ yadāyuḥ || evamādayo japamantrāḥ śāntyupayoginaḥ | heṃ devā vayaṃ karṇairbhadraṃ bhandanīyaṃ kalyāṇaṃ śṛṇuyāmaḥ brahmaprāptiparyavasāyi vedāntādikam | he yajatrāḥ yaṣṭṛṇāṃ trātāro'kṣibhitrairbhadraṃ pa śyema | tathā sthirairavināśibhiraṅgaiḥ karacaraṇādibhirupalakṣitāḥ santastuṣṭuvāṃsastuvanto devahitaṃ deveṣu nihitaṃ yadāyuḥ, tat vyaśema viśeṣeṇānuvāma tanūbhiḥ śarīraiḥ || svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ | svasti nastārkṣyo ariṣṭanemiḥ svasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu || indro vṛddhaśravāḥ vṛddhadhanaḥ bahudhano no'smabhyaṃ svasti avināśaṃ dadhātu dadātu dhārayatu vā | evaṃ pūṣā ādityo viśvavedāḥ sarvajñaḥ svasti no dadātu | tārkṣyo garutmānariṣṭanemiḥ, 'riṣṭihiṃsākarmā', ariṣṭo'nupahiṃsitaḥ nemirā spadaṃ sthānaṃ yasya saḥ, anupahiṃsitāspadaḥ | prānto vā nemirahiṃsitamaryādaḥ kenāpyanulati ityarthaḥ | bṛhaspatirdevaguruścāsmabhyaṃ svasti dadhātu dhārayatu vā || ketavo'ruṇāḥ saścarṣaṇayo vātaraśanāḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ śatadhāya samāhitā atho sahasradhāyasam || ketusaṃjñakā aruṇavarṇā jñātāro vātamekhalā śatadhāya samāhitā samāśritāḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ samādhisthairyādikaṃ śarīragateṣvanubhūya tato mokṣaṃ gatā ityarthaḥ | śatadhāyeti yakāro'narthakaḥ | atho sahasradhāyasaṃ, sahasradhā ityarthaḥ, cirataralabhyo mokṣa ityarthaḥ | tathā ca smṛtiḥ 'mahāyajñaiśca yajñaiśca brāhmīyaṃ kriyate tanuḥ |' iti || śivā naḥ śaṃtamā bhavātha divyā āpa oṣadhayo vanaspatayaḥ || no'smākaṃ śivāḥ kṣemakāriṇyaḥ śaṃtamāśca sukhatamā yūyaṃ bhavatha || sumṛlīkā sarasvati mā te vyoma saṃdṛśi || anena bhūmimālabhate | he sarasvati udakavati sumṛlīkā susukhadā bhava, mā te tava vyoma vicchedaviplavaṃ dasyuprabhṛtikṛtaṃ drākṣam || ityaruṇamantravivṛtiḥ || naiṣṭhika brahmacāriṇo vratamuktamadhunā mantrārtho vivriyate | tatra śatādhyayana upaniṣattvena prasiddheṣvanuvākeṣu pañcadaśasu prathamaikādaśadvādaśānāmihopayogo'sti | prathamasya vighnaśāntau, ekādaśasya śiṣyānuśāsane, dvādaśasyāpi śāntau | tatra prathamadvādaśau tāvat śaṃ no mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃ no bhavatvaryamā | śaṃ na indro bṛhaspatiḥ śaṃ no viṣṇururukramaḥ || namo brahmaṇe namo vāyave namaste vāyo tvameva pratyakṣaṃ brahmāsi tvāmeva pratyakṣaṃ brahma vadiṣyāmyṛtaṃ vadiṣyāmi satyaṃ vadiṣyāmi tanmāmavatu tadvaktāramavatvavatu māmavatu vaktāraṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ || . mitrādayo'trādhyātmikyo devatāḥ | tathā ca śrutiḥ iti | paramātmavivartāstatpariṇāmā vā jagatsūtra prāṇaprabhṛtayastadadhiṣṭhātryo devatā mitrādayaḥ | evaṃ cakṣuṣo'dhiṣṭhātā devatāviśeṣaḥ amā| arīna svādhyāyādivirodhinaḥ niyacchati yaḥ so'ryamā | no'smākaṃ mitraḥ śaṃ sukhaṃ bhavatu sukhamasmākaṃ bhāvayatvityarthaḥ | evaṃ varuṇādiṣvapi yojyam | viṣṇurvyāpako'ntaryāmī urukramo bṛhatkramaḥ | namo brahmaṇe, paramātmane namaskāro'stu | evaṃ vāyave vāyurūpāya jagatsūtrabhūtāya namaskāro'stu | he vāyo namaste'stu | parokṣeṇa stutvā pratyakṣeṇa stauti - he vāyo tvameva pratyakṣaṃ brahmāsi bhavasi nābherusthitastvameva vedarūpeṇa pratyakṣeṇa vivartase vipariṇamase vetyarthaḥ | atastvāmeva pratyakṣaṃ brahma vadiṣyāmi yatastvameva pratyakṣaṃ brahma | tvāmeva ṛtaṃ vadiṣyāmi satyaṃ ca | iha samuccīyamāne mokṣopāyabhūte jñāna. karmaṇī ṛtaśabdenokte, taditikartavyatā tu satyaśabdena | athavā ṛtasatyaśabdayorekārthatvātpunarvacanamatiśayārtham | tadṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ ca māmavatu, vaktāramavatu | punarvacanaṃ pūrvavat | athavā māmavatu vaktāraṃ, pravaktāraṃ copādhyāyam | śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntirityastu vighnānāmiti śeṣaḥ | trirvacanaṃ saṃsārasya vighnabhūyastvādatiśayārtham | eṣa prathamo'nuvākaḥ || śaṃ no mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃ no astvaryamā śaṃ na indravāgniśca śaṃ no viṣṇururukramaḥ || namo brahmaṇe namo vāyave namaste vāyo tvameva pratyakṣaṃ brahmāsi tvāmeva pratyakṣaṃ brahmāvādiṣamṛtamavādiṣaṃ satyamavādiṣaṃ tanmāmāvīttadvaktāramāvīdāvīnmāmāvīdvaktāraṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ || atra prathamāddevatāmātraṃ viśiṣyate'tītakā latā ca || sahanā avatu saha nau bhunaktu saha vīryaṃ karavāvahai | tejakhinā adhītamastu mā vidviṣāvahai śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ || idaṃ śiṣyopādhyāya saha brūtaḥ, anyatra tu dampatī api | mitrādidevatāgaṇo nau āvāṃ śiṣyopādhyāyau karmabhūtāvavatu rakṣatu saha sthitau, tathā bhunaktu pālayatu bhojayatu vā nityānandarūpamapavarga phalam | sahaiva ca sthitau vīryaṃ vedābhyāsasamudbhūtamatinairmalyalakṣaṇaṃ ka vāvahai kurvahai | tejakhinau abhibhavituṃ kenāpyaśakyau | yadadhītaṃ, tadāvayorastu sthiram | mā vidviṣāvahai, āvayoranyonyaṃ vidveṣo mā bhūt | śāntiriti vyākhyātam | evamāvāpasthāne śānti kṛtvā, śiṣyaṃ medhāvitvamanirākariṣṇutvaṃ ca kāmayamānamācāryoṃ vācayehadvayam || yacchandasāmṛṣabho viśvavedāśchandobhyodhyamṛtātsaṃvabhūva | sa māmindro medhayā spṛṇotvamṛtasya vedadhāraṇo bhūyāsam || śarīraṃ me vicakṣaṇaṃ vā madhumaduhe | karṇābhyāṃ bhūri suśravaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kośosmi medhayā pihitaḥ śrutaṃ me gopāya || mantravarṇājjapamātrādeva medhādiphalaṃ dhāraṇaśaktiranirākariṣṇutā tāṃ ca prāpnoti | yaḥ chandasāṃ vedānāṃ ṛṣabho varṣitā kāmānāṃ pradhānabhūto vā oṃkāraḥ viśvavedāḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvadhano vā, chandobhyo vedāntebhyo'mṛtarūpo'dhibabhūva | avidyāvaśena dvaitāpanno vedāntārthānuṣṭhānena sarvavedārthānuṣṭhānena vā jñānakarmasamuccayenādhikamṛtarūpo nityānandādvaita rūpo bhavatītyarthaḥ | sa indraḥ prajāpatiḥ mā māṃ medhayā spṛṇotu prīṇātu | amṛtasyāmṛtatvāya mokṣāyāhaṃ vedadhāraṇaśaktiyuktaḥ syām | anirāka riṣṇutāpyatroktā | tathā mama śarīraṃ vicakṣaṇaṃ mokṣopāyānuṣṭhāna caturaṃ bhūyāt | vāk ca vedayuktā madhumat madhurarasayuktaṃ karma phalaṃ duhe dogdhu | karṇābhyāṃ bhūri bahu ciraṃ suśravaṃ śobhanaṃ śṛṇuyāṃ vedāntarūpam | brahmaṇo vedasyāhaṃ kośo vedārthajñānaratnanicayabhāṇḍāgāraṃ bhūyāsam | bhāṇḍāgāraṃ ca pidhānena sthagitaṃ bhavatītyāha - medhayā prajñājanitasaṃskāreṇa pihita ācchādito rakṣitaḥ dṛḍhasaṃskāravaśena vedārthasyāvismaraṇāt| śrutaṃ me gopāya, mama śrutaṃ ca rakṣa paraprayojanayuktaṃ kurvityarthaḥ || śrīkāmaḥ 'āvahantī vitanvānā' ityādibhirjuhuyāt | āvahantī vitanvānā kurvāṇā varamātmanaḥ | vāsāṃsi mama gāvaścānnapānena vardhaya || to me śriyamāvaha lomaśāṃ paśubhiḥ saha khāhā || ṛgyajuṣābhyāmābhyāṃ dve āhutī juhuyāt | ekāmityeke, ṛgyajuṣānta ekasvāhākārāt | anyāścāhutayo'tra pūrvavyākhyātaiḥ strīliṅgakaitavyāḥ | he śrīḥ mama vāsāṃsi gāścā'nnapānena saha vardhaya | kiṃ kurvatī | āvahantī prāpayantī ḍhokayantī | vitanvānā vividhaṃ viśeṣeṇa vā vistārayantī | ātmanaśca varaṃ kurvāṇā varaṇīyaṃ varamutkṛṣṭaṃ maṇikanakādikamātmasambandhitayā kurvāṇā | ato me śriyamāvaha, yasmātsamyagadhīta vedo'hamupādhyāyāvaśyadeya dakṣiṇāyogyatopanatārthiviśeṣo vā, tato hetorlomaśāṃ lomaśājāviprabhṛtibhirvibhūṣitāṃ paśubhiraśvādibhiḥ saha | upakurvāṇakasyaitaduktamityāhuḥ || yaśaskāma ‘ā mā yantu' ityaṣṭābhirjuhuyāt | yadyācāryo juhoti, athāpi brahmacārī, ubhayathā brahmacāriṇaḥ phalaṃ taduddeśena karmakaraṇāt | ā mā yantu brahmacāriṇaḥ svāhā | saṃ mā yantu brahmacāriṇaḥ svāhā | tapoyaśoyaśāni svāhā | janoyaśoyaśāni svāhā | taṃ tvā bhaga praviśāmi svāhā | sa mā bhaga praviśa svāhā | śreyānvaso yaśoyaśāni svāhā | asminsahasraśākhe vibhajāhaṃ tvayi mṛje svāhā || ye brahmacāriṇo dharmāḥ siddhayaśca te mā māṃ āyāntu | prajāpatirevamabhyarthyate | tadarthaṃ ca suhutamastu | evaṃ samyagāyāntu māṃ ye brahmacāriṇaḥ sambandhino yamaniyamādayaḥ | tapo yaśoyaśāni svāhā, tapāṃsyeva yaśaḥ prakārāḥ tapoyaśoyaśāni tapoyaśoyaśāṃsi samāyāntu, 'prakāre guṇavacanasya' iti dvirvacanam | tadarthaṃ ca suhutamastu | tapoloke vā svargaviśeṣe ye yaśaḥ prakārāste samāyāntvityarthaḥ | evaṃ janoyaśoyaśāni svāheti vyākhyeyam | taṃ tvā bhageti, he bhaga bhajanīya brahman tvāmahaṃ praviśāmi | sa mā bhageti, sa tvaṃ he bhaga māṃ praviśa | śreyānvaso yaśoyaśāni svāhā, he vaso vāsayitaḥ dhanada tvaṃ śreyān praśasyo'tiśayena, atastvatprasādānmāṃ yaśāṃsi praviśantu tadarthaṃ ca suhutamastu | asminsahastreti, asminbahuśākhe yajurvede brahmavibhavopaniṣatpathe vā vibhaja vibhāgayoginaṃ kuru | ahaṃ 'svayi viṣayabhūte he brahman mṛje ātmānaṃ śodhayāmi, vigatanikhilamalaṃ sampādayāmi brahmaṇi kṣīṇaṃ, tadarthaṃ tu suhutamastu | ārayakatrata paddhati paryavasāne tvidaṃ kāryam || vedamanūcyācāryo'ntevāsinamanuśāsti idaṃ kartavyamidamakartavyamityaupaniṣadaikādaśānuvākena | ekādaśānuvākastu - satyaṃ vada | dharmaṃ cara | svādhyāyānmā pramada | ācāryāya priyaṃ dhanamāhṛtya prajātantuṃ mā vyavacchetsīḥ | satyānna pramaditavyam | dharmānna pramaditavyam | yatnānna pramaditavyam | kuśalānna pramaditavyam | svādhyāyapravacanābhyāṃ na pramaditavyam | yajñāddevapitṛkāryebhyo na pramaditavyam | mātṛdevo bhava | pitṛdevo bhava | ācāryadevo bhava | atithidevo bhava | yānyanavadyāni karmāṇi tāni yā kartavyāni no itarāṇi | atha yānyasmākaṃ sucaritāni tāni tvayā kartavyāni no itarāṇi | atha ye kecanāsmacchreyāṃso brāhmaṇā āgaccheran teṣāṃ tvayāsanena praśrayitavyam | śraddhayā deyamaśraddhayā deyam | saṃvidā deyamasaṃvidā deyam | hiyā deyam | bhiyā deyam | vicyai deyam | avittyai deyam | bhūtyai deyam | abhūtyai deyam | atha yadi te karmavicikitsā vṛttivicikitsā vā syādye tatra brāhmaṇāḥ saṃmarśino yuktā āyuktā alakṣā alubdhā dharmakāmā vā syuryathā te tatra varteraṃstathā tvaṃ teṣu vartethāḥ | athābhyākhyāteṣu ye tatra brāhmaṇāḥ saṃmarśino yuktā āyuktā alakṣā alubdhā dharmakāmā vā syuryathā te tatra varteraṃstathā tvaṃ tatra vartethāḥ | eṣa ādeśa eṣa upadeśa eṣā vedopanipadetadanuśāsanametadupāsyam || upaniṣatsaṃhitāmadhītyaivedamucyate | ācārya ekādaśānuvākābhihitāṃ nītimupaniṣaddhyayanānte grāhayati, ata eva " vedādhyayanānantarameva dharmajijñāsā kartavyā" iti jaiminimuninā nigaditam | yata ekādaśānuvākārambha eva 'vedamanūcya' iti śrutirapyasti mūlabhūtā | vedasamuttha eva hi nyāyaḥ pramāṇam | yatrocyate "āpa dharmopadeśaṃ ca vedaśāstrāvirodhinā | . yastarkeṇānusandhatte sa dharmaṃ veda netaraḥ" || iti | avedamūlastu mānuṣamatimātrakalpitaḥ kutarko dharmādharmau prati na pramāṇaṃ yathā saugata bārhaspatyakalpaḥ | yatredamucyate " purāṇaṃ mānavo dharmaḥ sāṃgo vedaścikitsitam | ājñāsiddhāni catvāri na hantavyāni hetubhiḥ " || "tarko'pratiṣṭhaḥ smṛtayo vibhinnā nāsāvṛṣiryasya mataṃ na bhinnam | dharmasya tacvaṃ nihitaṃ guhāyāṃ mahājano yena gataḥ sa panthāḥ " || "hastasparśādivāndhena" iti || he brahmacārin satyaṃ vada, satyaṃ punaḥ paropakāraparyavasāyi, asatyamapi satyaphalaṃ kadācidraktavyaṃ yena brāhmaṇavadhādikaṃ rakṣyate | yathoktaṃ " satyaṃ brūyāt priyaṃ brūyānna brūyātsatyamapriyam | asatyaṃ ca priyaṃ brūyādeṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ " || dharmaṃ cara, vihitakarmācārasaṃgrahādikamanutiṣṭha | khādhyāyānmā pramada, svādhyāyaviṣayaṃ pramādamālasyādinānadhyayanaṃ mā kṛthāḥ | ācāryadakṣiṇārthamabhimataṃ dhanamāhṛtya putrapautrādisantānavicchedaṃ mā kārṣī, gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā vivāhaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | satyasyāsatyabhāṣaṇaṃ pramādaḥ | dharmasya nityanaimittikalakṣaṇasyākaraṇaṃ pramādaḥ | kāmyasya tu viguṇasya karaṇamakaraṇaṃ ca | evaṃ yatnasya pramādaḥ ālasyādyupahatatā | kuśalaṃ śarīrarakṣādikaṃ tatra pramādaḥ svāsthyepyabhayena tacchāntyādikaraṇaṃ, svastyayanaṃ hiṃ pratyahaṃ śāntirūpaṃ vaiśvadevādāvāmnātam | khādhyāyapramādo na kartavyaḥ, pravacane cādhyāpane āvṛtto'pi vedo guṇitavyo'dhyāpayitavyaśca | evaṃ yajñeṣu pākayajñādiṣu pramādo'nanuṣṭhānalakṣaṇo na kartavyaḥ | mātā deva iva yasya sa.. mātṛdevo bhava | tvayā'navadyāni agarhitānyeva karmāṇi kartavyāni, na kadāciditarāṇi | śrutismṛtivihitānyapi lokavigarhitāni varjanīyāni purāṇamokṣaniveśanādīni | asmākaṃ ca gurutadbhāryāpatyaprabhṛtīnāṃ śobhanānyeva caritāni karmāṇi ācaritavyāni, netarāṇi | gurubhirapi sadbhiryāni vyāmohadāni caritāni anuṣṭhitāni tāni śraddhayā nānuṣṭhātavyāni, yathā viśvāmitrācaritaśvajaghanyāśanacaṇḍālayājanādīni | tathā ye kecanāramatsakāśādatiśayena jyāyāṃso bahuvidyetvādinā brāhmaṇā āgaccheyusteṣāṃ svayāsanena praśrayitavyaṃ, āsanadānapādasaṃvāhanāt praśvasanaṃ khedāpanodana. lakṣaṇaṃ kartavyam natu darpeṇodgrāhaṇikādikamārabdhavyamityarthaḥ, śraddhā āstikyabuddhistayaiva deyam | kadācittvaśraddhayā'pi deyaṃ lokavigarhaparihārāya | bahujaneṣu saṃghaṭiteṣu gā. yanādiviṣayeṣu samudāyadāne prastute karmaṇyaprasiddhiparihārāyā'śraddhayāpi deyamityarthaḥ | 1. bahu vittvādinā . athavā'śraddhayā'deyamityakārapraśleṣaḥ | saṃvit bhṛtyādibharaṇāya pratijñā - idaṃ mayā deyamiti | tayā deyamityarthaḥ | asaṃvidāpyapratijñātamapi karmakauśalamavalokya deyam | daurgatye'pi saṃbandhibāndhavārthijanāyābhyāgatāya vākbhūmitṛṇodakādi yathāśakti hiyā deyam | nāgavināyaka durgādyugradevatābhyaḥ pūrvatarasaṃkalpitaṃ balyupahārādi tadākramaṇabhiyā deyam | vittaṃ prayojanaṃ yatrāsti sā vittistadarthaṃ deyam | avittyai ca deyaṃ kadācit | bhūtyai vibhavāya deyabhūtyai api kadācit | śraddhayā deyamityasyaiva sarvo'nuvādaḥ stutyarthatvena vā | evaṃ vedārthe vartamānasya yadi kadācitkarmasu vaidikeṣu saṃśayaḥ syāt keṣucit, vṛttau vā jīvanopāyadhanārjane kimasmādādeyaṃ utaneti, tadā ye tatra tvannavāsadeśe brāhmaṇāstebhyaḥ sandeho'pasārayitavyaḥ | kīdṛśā brāhmaṇāḥ | samyagvimarśakuśalāḥ, yuktāḥ avikalakaraṇāḥ, āyuktāḥ anuṣṭhānasaktāḥ alakṣāḥ akrūramatayaḥ, arūkṣā iti pāṭhe'pyayamevārthaḥ, alubdhāḥ alobhino lobhaśūnyāḥ | dharmakāmā vā syuḥ, dharmakāmā eva yadi syuḥ yathā te tatra karmavṛttyādau pravartante tathaiva tvaṃ pravartethāstata eva nirṇayaṃ kuryā ityarthaḥ | anyācāryapṛṣṭena ca yathārthopadeśinā bhavitavyamarthāt | ye tu tatra abhyākhyātā ābhimukhyena asaṃbhinna buddhayasteṣāṃ buddhisaṃbhedaṃ virodhaṃ ca mā kārṣīḥ | kiṃ tarhi | yathā te pūrvoktaguṇakā brāhmaṇāḥ pravarteran, tathā vartethāḥ saṃvṛttimattvena | abhyākhyātāḥ ābhimukhyena khyātāḥ mantriprabhṛtayaḥ | yadetanmadīyaṃ śāsanaṃ eṣa ādeśaḥ dhārmikasya rājāderājñā | upadeśo vaidiko hitaparyavasāyī vā viśeṣopaniṣadrahasyamityarthaḥ | pratyavāyābhāvena balena lobhena rahasyasaṃbodhanena cānuṣṭhātavyamevametadityarthaḥ || ityāraṇyatratāni saṃpūrṇāni || iti trayaścatvāriṃśī kāṇḍikā || 43 ||
